=== LOYWAIVE.cbl ===
      * SYNTHETIC SAMPLE - written for the Diocle hackathon project.
      * Fictional company. Not derived from any real system.
      * LOYWAIVE - QUILLMARK TRUST & SAVINGS (FICTIONAL)
      *   MONTHLY SERVICE FEE OF 4.50, WAIVED FOR LOYAL CUSTOMERS: AN
      *   AVERAGE BALANCE OF AT LEAST 5000.00 OR TEN YEARS' TENURE.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. LOYWAIVE.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT LY-FILE ASSIGN TO LOYIN
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT LO-FILE ASSIGN TO LOYOUT
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  LY-FILE.
       COPY LOYIN.
       FD  LO-FILE.
       COPY LOYOUT.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF                      PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-MAIN.
           OPEN INPUT LY-FILE OUTPUT LO-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF = 'Y'
               READ LY-FILE
                   AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF
                   NOT AT END PERFORM 1000-FEE
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE LY-FILE LO-FILE
           STOP RUN.

       1000-FEE.
           MOVE LY-ACCT TO LO-ACCT
           IF LY-BALANCE NOT < 5000.00 OR LY-TENURE-MONTHS NOT < 120
               MOVE ZERO TO LO-FEE
               MOVE 'WV' TO LO-CODE
           ELSE
               MOVE 4.50 TO LO-FEE
               MOVE 'CH' TO LO-CODE
           END-IF
           WRITE LO-REC.

      * SYNTHETIC SAMPLE - written for the Diocle hackathon project.
      * Fictional company. Not derived from any real system.
      *----------------------------------------------------------------
      * FEEPOST - QUILLMARK TRUST & SAVINGS (FICTIONAL)
      *   POSTS PAYMENTS (DD PAYIN -> DD POSTOUT) AND ASKS THE FEE
      *   MODULE FOR EACH ONE. THE MODULE NAME IS HELD IN A DATA ITEM
      *   (CALL IDENTIFIER) BUT IT ONLY EVER HOLDS THE ONE LITERAL, SO
      *   THE TARGET IS KNOWN WITHOUT RUNNING THE PROGRAM.
      *----------------------------------------------------------------
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. FEEPOST.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT PAY-FILE ASSIGN TO PAYIN
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT POST-FILE ASSIGN TO POSTOUT
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  PAY-FILE.
       COPY TXNREC.
       FD  POST-FILE.
       COPY POSTREC.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG                 PIC X VALUE 'N'.
           88  END-OF-PAYMENTS         VALUE 'Y'.
       01  WS-FEE-PGM                  PIC X(8) VALUE 'FEECALC'.
       01  WS-FEE                      PIC S9(5)V99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-MAIN.
           OPEN INPUT PAY-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT POST-FILE
           MOVE
               'FEECALC'
               TO WS-FEE-PGM
           PERFORM 8000-READ
           PERFORM 2000-POST UNTIL END-OF-PAYMENTS
           CLOSE PAY-FILE POST-FILE
           STOP RUN.

       2000-POST.
           CALL WS-FEE-PGM USING PAY-AMOUNT WS-FEE
           MOVE PAY-ID TO POST-ID
           MOVE PAY-AMOUNT TO POST-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-FEE TO POST-FEE
           WRITE POST-REC
           PERFORM 8000-READ.

       8000-READ.
           READ PAY-FILE
               AT END SET END-OF-PAYMENTS TO TRUE
           END-READ.

      * SYNTHETIC SAMPLE - written for the Diocle hackathon project.
      * Fictional company. Not derived from any real system.
      *----------------------------------------------------------------
      * FEECALC - PAYMENT FEE MODULE, CALLED BY FEEPOST (FICTIONAL)
      *   1.5 PERCENT OF A POSITIVE PAYMENT, ROUNDED, WITH A MINIMUM OF
      *   1.00. REFUNDS (ZERO OR NEGATIVE) PAY NO FEE.
      *----------------------------------------------------------------
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. FEECALC.
       DATA DIVISION.
       LINKAGE SECTION.
       01  L-AMOUNT                    PIC S9(5)V99
                                       SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
       01  L-FEE                       PIC S9(5)V99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING L-AMOUNT L-FEE.
       0000-MAIN.
           IF L-AMOUNT > 0
               COMPUTE L-FEE ROUNDED = L-AMOUNT * 0.015
               IF L-FEE < 1.00
                   MOVE 1.00 TO L-FEE
               END-IF
           ELSE
               MOVE 0 TO L-FEE
           END-IF
           GOBACK.

=== INTACCR.cbl ===
      * SYNTHETIC SAMPLE - written for the Diocle hackathon project.
      * Fictional company. Not derived from any real system.
      *----------------------------------------------------------------
      * INTACCR - DAILY INTEREST ACCRUAL AND MAINTENANCE FEE
      *   READS THE ACCOUNT EXTRACT (DD ACCTIN), COMPUTES ACCRUED
      *   INTEREST AND FEES, WRITES ONE RESULT PER ACCOUNT (DD INTOUT).
      * CHANGE HISTORY (FICTIONAL)
      *   1994-03-11 RJK  INITIAL VERSION
      *   1998-11-02 MTP  OVERDRAFT PENALTY RATE ADDED
      *   2003-06-19 RJK  PREMIUM TIER FEE WAIVER
      *----------------------------------------------------------------
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. INTACCR.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT ACCT-FILE ASSIGN TO ACCTIN
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
               FILE STATUS IS WS-ACCT-STATUS.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO INTOUT
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
               FILE STATUS IS WS-OUT-STATUS.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  ACCT-FILE.
       COPY ACCTREC.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
       COPY INTREC.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-ACCT-STATUS              PIC XX.
       01  WS-OUT-STATUS               PIC XX.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG                 PIC X VALUE 'N'.
           88  END-OF-ACCOUNTS         VALUE 'Y'.
       01  WS-PENALTY-RATE             PIC 9V9(4) VALUE 0.0500.
       01  WS-FEE-FLOOR                PIC S9(5)V99 COMP-3
                                       VALUE 1000.00.
       01  WS-FEE-CAP                  PIC S9(5)V99 COMP-3
                                       VALUE 25.00.
       01  WS-INTEREST                 PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
       01  WS-FEE                      PIC S9(5)V99 COMP-3.
       01  WS-NEW-BAL                  PIC S9(9)V99 COMP-3.
       01  WS-COUNTERS.
           05  WS-READ-CNT             PIC 9(7) COMP VALUE 0.
           05  WS-WRITE-CNT            PIC 9(7) COMP VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-MAIN.
           PERFORM 1000-INIT
           PERFORM 2000-PROCESS UNTIL END-OF-ACCOUNTS
           PERFORM 9000-TERM
           STOP RUN.

       1000-INIT.
           OPEN INPUT ACCT-FILE
           IF WS-ACCT-STATUS NOT = '00'
               DISPLAY 'INTACCR OPEN ACCTIN FAILED ' WS-ACCT-STATUS
               MOVE 16 TO RETURN-CODE
               STOP RUN
           END-IF
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           IF WS-OUT-STATUS NOT = '00'
               DISPLAY 'INTACCR OPEN INTOUT FAILED ' WS-OUT-STATUS
               MOVE 16 TO RETURN-CODE
               STOP RUN
           END-IF
           PERFORM 8000-READ.

       2000-PROCESS.
           ADD 1 TO WS-READ-CNT
           PERFORM 3000-CALC-INTEREST
           PERFORM 4000-CALC-FEE
           PERFORM 5000-WRITE-RESULT
           PERFORM 8000-READ.

      * SIMPLE DAILY INTEREST, ACTUAL/365. CREDIT BALANCES EARN THE
      * ACCOUNT RATE; OVERDRAWN BALANCES ARE CHARGED RATE + PENALTY.
       3000-CALC-INTEREST.
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN ACCT-BALANCE > ZERO
                   COMPUTE WS-INTEREST ROUNDED =
                       ACCT-BALANCE * ACCT-RATE * ACCT-DAYS / 365
               WHEN ACCT-BALANCE < ZERO
                   COMPUTE WS-INTEREST ROUNDED =
                       ACCT-BALANCE * (ACCT-RATE + WS-PENALTY-RATE)
                       * ACCT-DAYS / 365
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE ZERO TO WS-INTEREST
           END-EVALUATE.

      * MAINTENANCE FEE: 0.15 PERCENT OF THE SHORTFALL BELOW THE FLOOR,
      * TRUNCATED TO THE CENT, CAPPED. PREMIUM TIER IS WAIVED.
       4000-CALC-FEE.
           MOVE ZERO TO WS-FEE
           IF NOT ACCT-TIER-PREMIUM
              AND ACCT-BALANCE < WS-FEE-FLOOR
               COMPUTE WS-FEE =
                   (WS-FEE-FLOOR - ACCT-BALANCE) * 0.0015
               IF WS-FEE > WS-FEE-CAP
                   MOVE WS-FEE-CAP TO WS-FEE
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       5000-WRITE-RESULT.
           COMPUTE WS-NEW-BAL = ACCT-BALANCE + WS-INTEREST - WS-FEE
           MOVE ACCT-ID     TO OUT-ACCT-ID
           MOVE WS-INTEREST TO OUT-INTEREST
           MOVE WS-FEE      TO OUT-FEE
           MOVE WS-NEW-BAL  TO OUT-NEW-BAL
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN WS-NEW-BAL < ZERO
                   MOVE 'OD' TO OUT-STATUS
               WHEN WS-FEE > ZERO
                   MOVE 'FE' TO OUT-STATUS
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 'OK' TO OUT-STATUS
           END-EVALUATE
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT.

       8000-READ.
           READ ACCT-FILE
               AT END
                   SET END-OF-ACCOUNTS TO TRUE
           END-READ.

       9000-TERM.
           CLOSE ACCT-FILE OUT-FILE
           DISPLAY 'INTACCR READ=' WS-READ-CNT ' WRITTEN=' WS-WRITE-CNT.

      * QUARRYSTONE VALLEY CREDIT UNION - ENTIRELY FICTIONAL.
      * SYNTHETIC CODE AND DATA, WRITTEN FOR THE DIOCLE PROJECT.
      * NOT AFFILIATED WITH ANY REAL CREDIT UNION, BANK OR COMPANY.
      *----------------------------------------------------------------
      * QVFEE020 - OVERDRAFT AND RETURNED-ITEM (NSF) FEES
      * CHANGE LOG
      *   1994-01-17 DMV  INITIAL VERSION
      *   2009-08-04 DMV  STUDENT WAIVER UP TO TWO ITEMS
      *   2015-03-30 RNA  NO FEE WHEN OVERDRAWN BY 10.00 OR LESS
      *   2022-10-12 RNA  DAILY CAP 87.00 (THREE ITEMS)
      * TRAPS: BOUNDARY AT EXACTLY -10.00, HALF-PERCENT FEE TRUNCATED,
      *        PREMIUM WAIVER BEATS EVERYTHING, CAP FLAG.
      *----------------------------------------------------------------
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. QVFEE020.
       AUTHOR. D M VARGA.
       DATE-WRITTEN. 1994-01-17.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT ACCT-FILE ASSIGN TO ACCTIN
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT FEE-FILE ASSIGN TO FEEOUT
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  ACCT-FILE.
       COPY QVACCT.
       FD  FEE-FILE.
       COPY QVFEEO.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF                      PIC X VALUE 'N'.
           88  END-OF-FILE             VALUE 'Y'.
       01  WS-ITEM-FEE                 PIC S9(3)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 29.00.
       01  WS-DAILY-CAP                PIC S9(3)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 87.00.
       01  WS-FEE                      PIC S9(5)V99 COMP-3.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-MAIN.
           OPEN INPUT ACCT-FILE OUTPUT FEE-FILE
           PERFORM 8000-READ
           PERFORM 2000-ASSESS UNTIL END-OF-FILE
           CLOSE ACCT-FILE FEE-FILE
           STOP RUN.
       2000-ASSESS.
           MOVE ZERO TO WS-FEE
           MOVE 'NONE' TO QF-REASON
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN QA-TIER-PREMIUM
                   MOVE 'WPRM' TO QF-REASON
               WHEN QA-BALANCE NOT < -10.00 AND QA-NSF-COUNT = ZERO
                   CONTINUE
               WHEN QA-TIER-STUDENT AND QA-NSF-COUNT <= 2
                   MOVE 'WSTU' TO QF-REASON
               WHEN OTHER
                   PERFORM 3000-CALC
           END-EVALUATE
           MOVE QA-ACCT-ID TO QF-ACCT-ID
           MOVE WS-FEE TO QF-FEE
           WRITE QF-REC
           PERFORM 8000-READ.
       3000-CALC.
           COMPUTE WS-FEE = QA-NSF-COUNT * WS-ITEM-FEE
           IF QA-BALANCE < -10.00
      *        EXTENDED OVERDRAFT: 0.5 PCT OF THE OVERDRAWN AMOUNT

           END-IF

               MOVE WS-DAILY-CAP TO WS-FEE
               MOVE 'CAPD' TO QF-REASON
           ELSE
               MOVE 'CHRG' TO QF-REASON

* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.

       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.

       FD  OUT-FILE.

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG            PIC X VALUE 'N'.
           88 WS-EOF              VALUE 'Y'.
           88 WS-NOT-EOF           VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-OD-AMOUNT           PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0.

       01  WS-I                   PIC 9(2) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-TABLE-SIZE          PIC 9(2) VALUE 5.
       01  OD-RATE-TABLE.
           05 OD-TIER OCCURS 5 TIMES INDEXED BY T-IDX.
               10 T-MAX-OD        PIC 9(7)V99.
               10 T-MAX-DAYS      PIC 9(3).
               10 T-RATE          PIC 9(2)V999.
               10 T-CODE          PIC X(4).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           PERFORM INIT-TABLE
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-ONE
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       INIT-TABLE.
           MOVE 50000 TO T-MAX-OD(1)
           MOVE 30 TO T-MAX-DAYS(1)
           MOVE 0.015 TO T-RATE(1)
           MOVE 'OD01' TO T-CODE(1)
           MOVE 200000 TO T-MAX-OD(2)
           MOVE 30 TO T-MAX-DAYS(2)
           MOVE 0.022 TO T-RATE(2)
           MOVE 'OD02' TO T-CODE(2)

           MOVE 60 TO T-MAX-DAYS(3)
           MOVE 0.035 TO T-RATE(3)
           MOVE 'OD03' TO T-CODE(3)
           MOVE 9999999 TO T-MAX-OD(4)
           MOVE 60 TO T-MAX-DAYS(4)
           MOVE 0.048 TO T-RATE(4)
           MOVE 'OD04' TO T-CODE(4)
           MOVE 9999999 TO T-MAX-OD(5)
           MOVE 999 TO T-MAX-DAYS(5)
           MOVE 0.065 TO T-RATE(5)
           MOVE 'OD05' TO T-CODE(5).
       PROCESS-ONE.
           MOVE 0 TO WS-OD-AMOUNT
           MOVE 0 TO WS-INTEREST
           MOVE 0 TO WS-RATE
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-CHARGE-CODE
           IF IN-BALANCE < 0
               COMPUTE WS-OD-AMOUNT = 0 - IN-BALANCE
           ELSE
               MOVE 0 TO WS-OD-AMOUNT
           END-IF
           IF WS-OD-AMOUNT = 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-RATE
               MOVE 'NOOD' TO WS-CHARGE-CODE
           ELSE
               PERFORM FIND-RATE
           END-IF
           IF WS-OD-AMOUNT > 0 AND IN-DAYS-OD > 0
               COMPUTE WS-DAILY-RATE = WS-RATE / 365
               COMPUTE WS-INTEREST = WS-OD-AMOUNT
                   * WS-DAILY-RATE * IN-DAYS-OD
           ELSE
               MOVE 0 TO WS-INTEREST
           END-IF
           PERFORM WRITE-OUT
           IF WS-INTEREST > 1000
               PERFORM WRITE-FEE-REC
           END-IF.
       FIND-RATE.
           MOVE T-RATE(5) TO WS-RATE
           MOVE T-CODE(5) TO WS-CHARGE-CODE
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-I > WS-TABLE-SIZE
               IF WS-OD-AMOUNT <= T-MAX-OD(WS-I)
                   AND IN-DAYS-OD <= T-MAX-DAYS(WS-I)

                   MOVE T-CODE(WS-I) TO WS-CHARGE-CODE
                   EXIT PERFORM
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM.

           MOVE IN-CUST-NAME TO OUT-CUST-NAME
           MOVE IN-BALANCE TO OUT-BALANCE
           MOVE WS-OD-AMOUNT TO OUT-OD-AMOUNT
           MOVE IN-DAYS-OD TO OUT-OD-DAYS
           MOVE WS-RATE TO OUT-APPLIED-RATE
           MOVE WS-INTEREST TO OUT-INTEREST-DUE
           MOVE WS-CHARGE-CODE TO OUT-CHARGE-CODE
           WRITE OUT-REC.
       WRITE-FEE-REC.

           MOVE IN-CUST-NAME TO OUT-CUST-NAME
           MOVE IN-BALANCE TO OUT-BALANCE
           MOVE WS-OD-AMOUNT TO OUT-OD-AMOUNT
           MOVE IN-DAYS-OD TO OUT-OD-DAYS
           MOVE WS-RATE TO OUT-APPLIED-RATE
           COMPUTE OUT-INTEREST-DUE = WS-INTEREST + 25
           MOVE 'FEES' TO OUT-CHARGE-CODE
           WRITE OUT-REC.

You are Diocle's COBOL-to-Java translator for a bank modernization project.
Translate the COBOL batch program into ONE self-contained Java 21 source file (JDK only, no libraries)
whose output is byte-identical to the original compiled with GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm).

I/O contract:
- The public class with main() must be named Gen0020, in the default package.
- Input file paths come from environment variables DD_INFILE; write the outputs to DD_OUTFILE.
- ORGANIZATION LINE SEQUENTIAL files are text, one record per line. ORGANIZATION SEQUENTIAL files are fixed-length
  byte records with no separators: read and write them as bytes (ISO-8859-1), record length from the copybook.
- IBM Enterprise COBOL defaults apply: TRUNC(STD), so a value stored in a binary (COMP) field keeps only its PIC digits;
  DISPLAY of a binary field shows its PIC digits (PIC 9(7) COMP displays 7 digits).
- Storage exactly as GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm) writes it: COMP-3 packed decimal with sign nibble C/D (F if unsigned);
  COMP/COMP-4/BINARY big-endian two's complement (2, 4 or 8 bytes by digits); COMP-5 little-endian; signed DISPLAY
  without SIGN SEPARATE carries the sign in the last digit, negative digit d written as the character d + 0x40;
  PIC 9(n)P(m) stores n digits worth value x 10^m.
- When environment variable DIOCLE_COLLATION is EBCDIC, alphanumeric comparisons (<, >) and SORT keys follow mainframe
  EBCDIC order (lowercase < uppercase < digits): compare the Cp037 bytes, not Java's String order.
- Reproduce every DISPLAY to stdout exactly, and exit with the program's RETURN-CODE (System.exit) when it is not 0.
- "Now" (ACCEPT FROM DATE/TIME/DAY, FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE) comes from environment variable DIOCLE_CLOCK when it is
  set (ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. 2000-02-29T13:45:10.00Z), otherwise from the system clock in UTC.

Fidelity rules:
- Preserve COBOL arithmetic semantics exactly: rounding, truncation, overflow, signs, and numeric display formats.
- Use java.math.BigDecimal for all decimal arithmetic. Never use float or double.
- One private method per COBOL paragraph, named after it in camelCase, called in the same order.
- Readable, idiomatic Java; no special-casing of particular input values.
- Name environment variables literally (System.getenv("DD_..."), DIOCLE_CLOCK, DIOCLE_COLLATION). No network,
  processes, reflection, native code or other files: a guard refuses to run such Java.

           MOVE 0 TO WS-COUNT-ASTERISK WS-COUNT-HASH
           MOVE 0 TO WS-DIV-AMOUNT WS-NET-AMOUNT
           MOVE SD-MEMO-TEXT TO WS-MEMO-WORK
           INSPECT WS-MEMO-WORK TALLYING WS-COUNT-ASTERISK
               FOR ALL "*"
           INSPECT WS-MEMO-WORK TALLYING WS-COUNT-HASH
               FOR ALL "#"
           INSPECT WS-MEMO-WORK REPLACING ALL "#" BY "*"
           INSPECT WS-MEMO-WORK REPLACING ALL "*" BY " "
           IF WS-MEMO-WORK = SPACES
               MOVE "NO MEMO" TO WS-MEMO-WORK
           END-IF
           MOVE WS-MEMO-WORK(1:8) TO WS-MEMO-CODE
           MOVE WS-MEMO-WORK(1:15) TO WS-MEMO-SHORT
           IF WS-MEMO-SHORT(1:1) = SPACE
               MOVE "GEN" TO WS-MEMO-SHORT(1:3)
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-DIV-AMOUNT = SD-BALANCE * SD-DIVIDEND-RATE
               / 100
           IF WS-COUNT-ASTERISK > 5
               COMPUTE WS-DIV-AMOUNT = WS-DIV-AMOUNT * 1.10
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-NET-AMOUNT = WS-DIV-AMOUNT - SD-FEE-AMOUNT
           IF WS-NET-AMOUNT < 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-NET-AMOUNT
           END-IF
           MOVE SD-ACCOUNT-NO TO DP-ACCOUNT-NO
           MOVE WS-MEMO-CODE TO DP-MEMO-CODE
           MOVE WS-MEMO-SHORT TO DP-MEMO-SHORT
           MOVE WS-DIV-AMOUNT TO DP-DIVIDEND-AMT
           MOVE WS-NET-AMOUNT TO DP-NET-POSTING
           MOVE WS-COUNT-ASTERISK TO DP-ASTERISK-CNT
           WRITE DIVIDEND-POSTING-RECORD
           IF WS-COUNT-HASH > 0
               MOVE "BONUS   " TO DP-MEMO-CODE
               MOVE WS-MEMO-SHORT(6:10) TO DP-MEMO-SHORT(1:10)
               ADD 5.00 TO DP-NET-POSTING
               ADD 5.00 TO DP-DIVIDEND-AMT
               WRITE DIVIDEND-POSTING-RECORD
           END-IF
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 SAVINGS-DIVIDEND-RECORD.
           05 SD-ACCOUNT-NO        PIC X(10).
           05 SD-ACCOUNT-NAME      PIC X(20).
           05 SD-MEMO-TEXT         PIC X(30).
           05 SD-BALANCE           PIC 9(7)V99.
           05 SD-DIVIDEND-RATE     PIC 9(02)V999.
           05 SD-FEE-AMOUNT        PIC 9(04)V99.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 DIVIDEND-POSTING-RECORD.
           05 DP-ACCOUNT-NO        PIC X(10).
           05 DP-MEMO-CODE         PIC X(08).
           05 DP-MEMO-SHORT        PIC X(15).
           05 DP-DIVIDEND-AMT      PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 DP-NET-POSTING      PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 DP-ASTERISK-CNT      PIC 9(03).

GEN0036.name: GEN0036
GEN0036.technique: an OCCURS table searched with PERFORM VARYING
GEN0036.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0036.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INPUT-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTPUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  INPUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0036I.
       FD  OUTPUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0036O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG               PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
           88 WS-EOF                VALUE "Y".
       01 WS-COUNT-IN               PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-COUNT-OUT              PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-INTEREST               PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-MATURITY               PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-EFF-RATE               PIC 9(02)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-RATE-ADJ               PIC S9(02)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-FOUND-FLAG             PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
       01 WS-IDX                    PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-SPLIT-COUNT            PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-SPLIT-NUM              PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-SPLIT-PRINCIPAL        PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-SPLIT-INTEREST         PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-SPLIT-MATURITY         PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 PRODUCT-TABLE.
           05 PRODUCT-ENTRY OCCURS 8 TIMES.
               10 TAB-PRODUCT-CODE   PIC X(04).
               10 TAB-BASE-ADJ       PIC S9(02)V99.
               10 TAB-MIN-TERM       PIC 9(03).
               10 TAB-MAX-TERM       PIC 9(03).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           PERFORM LOAD-PRODUCT-TABLE
           OPEN INPUT INPUT-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTPUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ INPUT-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-ONE-RECORD
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE INPUT-FILE OUTPUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       LOAD-PRODUCT-TABLE.
           MOVE "TD01" TO TAB-PRODUCT-CODE(1)
           MOVE 0.25 TO TAB-BASE-ADJ(1)
           MOVE 3 TO TAB-MIN-TERM(1)
           MOVE 6 TO TAB-MAX-TERM(1)
           MOVE "TD03" TO TAB-PRODUCT-CODE(2)
           MOVE 0.50 TO TAB-BASE-ADJ(2)
           MOVE 7 TO TAB-MIN-TERM(2)
           MOVE 12 TO TAB-MAX-TERM(2)
           MOVE "TD06" TO TAB-PRODUCT-CODE(3)
           MOVE 0.75 TO TAB-BASE-ADJ(3)
           MOVE 13 TO TAB-MIN-TERM(3)
           MOVE 24 TO TAB-MAX-TERM(3)
           MOVE "TD12" TO TAB-PRODUCT-CODE(4)
           MOVE 1.00 TO TAB-BASE-ADJ(4)
           MOVE 25 TO TAB-MIN-TERM(4)
           MOVE 36 TO TAB-MAX-TERM(4)
           MOVE "TD24" TO TAB-PRODUCT-CODE(5)
           MOVE 1.25 TO TAB-BASE-ADJ(5)
           MOVE 37 TO TAB-MIN-TERM(5)
           MOVE 60 TO TAB-MAX-TERM(5)
           MOVE "TD36" TO TAB-PRODUCT-CODE(6)
           MOVE 1.50 TO TAB-BASE-ADJ(6)
           MOVE 61 TO TAB-MIN-TERM(6)
           MOVE 120 TO TAB-MAX-TERM(6)
           MOVE "FLEX" TO TAB-PRODUCT-CODE(7)
           MOVE 0.00 TO TAB-BASE-ADJ(7)
           MOVE 1 TO TAB-MIN-TERM(7)
           MOVE 999 TO TAB-MAX-TERM(7)
           MOVE "JUMB" TO TAB-PRODUCT-CODE(8)
           MOVE 0.35 TO TAB-BASE-ADJ(8)
           MOVE 1 TO TAB-MIN-TERM(8)
           MOVE 999 TO TAB-MAX-TERM(8)
           .
       PROCESS-ONE-RECORD.
           ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT-IN
           MOVE "N" TO WS-FOUND-FLAG
           MOVE 0 TO WS-RATE-ADJ
           PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-IDX > 8 OR WS-FOUND-FLAG = "Y"
               IF IN-PRODUCT-CODE = TAB-PRODUCT-CODE(WS-IDX)
                   IF IN-TERM-MONTHS >= TAB-MIN-TERM(WS-IDX)
                   AND IN-TERM-MONTHS <= TAB-MAX-TERM(WS-IDX)
                       MOVE TAB-BASE-ADJ(WS-IDX) TO WS-RATE-ADJ
                       MOVE "Y" TO WS-FOUND-FLAG
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           COMPUTE WS-EFF-RATE = IN-ANNUAL-RATE + WS-RATE-ADJ
           IF WS-EFF-RATE < 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-EFF-RATE
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-INTEREST = IN-PRINCIPAL-AMT * WS-EFF-RATE
               * IN-TERM-MONTHS / 1200
           COMPUTE WS-MATURITY = IN-PRINCIPAL-AMT + WS-INTEREST
           IF IN-PRINCIPAL-AMT > 50000
               MOVE 2 TO WS-SPLIT-COUNT
           ELSE
               MOVE 1 TO WS-SPLIT-COUNT
           END-IF
           IF WS-SPLIT-COUNT = 1
               PERFORM WRITE-SINGLE-OUTPUT
           ELSE
               PERFORM WRITE-SPLIT-OUTPUT
           END-IF
           .
       WRITE-SINGLE-OUTPUT.
           MOVE IN-CUSTOMER-ID TO OUT-CUSTOMER-ID
           MOVE IN-ACCOUNT-NUMBER TO OUT-ACCOUNT-NUMBER
           MOVE IN-PRODUCT-CODE TO OUT-PRODUCT-CODE
           MOVE IN-PRINCIPAL-AMT TO OUT-PRINCIPAL-AMT
           MOVE WS-MATURITY TO OUT-MATURITY-AMT
           MOVE WS-INTEREST TO OUT-INTEREST-EARNED
           MOVE WS-EFF-RATE TO OUT-APPLIED-RATE
           MOVE IN-TERM-MONTHS TO OUT-TERM-MONTHS
           MOVE "M" TO OUT-STATUS-FLAG
           WRITE OUTPUT-RECORD
           ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT-OUT
           .
       WRITE-SPLIT-OUTPUT.
           COMPUTE WS-SPLIT-PRINCIPAL = IN-PRINCIPAL-AMT / 2
           COMPUTE WS-SPLIT-INTEREST = WS-INTEREST / 2
           COMPUTE WS-SPLIT-MATURITY = WS-MATURITY / 2
           PERFORM VARYING WS-SPLIT-NUM FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-SPLIT-NUM > WS-SPLIT-COUNT
               MOVE IN-CUSTOMER-ID TO OUT-CUSTOMER-ID
               MOVE IN-ACCOUNT-NUMBER TO OUT-ACCOUNT-NUMBER
               MOVE IN-PRODUCT-CODE TO OUT-PRODUCT-CODE
               MOVE WS-SPLIT-PRINCIPAL TO OUT-PRINCIPAL-AMT
               MOVE WS-SPLIT-MATURITY TO OUT-MATURITY-AMT
               MOVE WS-SPLIT-INTEREST TO OUT-INTEREST-EARNED
               MOVE WS-EFF-RATE TO OUT-APPLIED-RATE
               MOVE IN-TERM-MONTHS TO OUT-TERM-MONTHS
               IF WS-SPLIT-NUM = 1
                   MOVE "A" TO OUT-STATUS-FLAG
               ELSE
                   MOVE "B" TO OUT-STATUS-FLAG
               END-IF
               WRITE OUTPUT-RECORD
               ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT-OUT
           END-PERFORM
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 INPUT-RECORD.
           05 IN-CUSTOMER-ID        PIC X(08).
           05 IN-ACCOUNT-NUMBER     PIC X(10).
           05 IN-PRINCIPAL-AMT      PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 IN-ANNUAL-RATE        PIC 9(02)V99.
           05 IN-TERM-MONTHS        PIC 9(03).
           05 IN-PRODUCT-CODE       PIC X(04).
           05 FILLER                PIC X(10).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUTPUT-RECORD.
           05 OUT-CUSTOMER-ID        PIC X(08).
           05 OUT-ACCOUNT-NUMBER     PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-PRODUCT-CODE       PIC X(04).
           05 OUT-PRINCIPAL-AMT      PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 OUT-MATURITY-AMT       PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 OUT-INTEREST-EARNED    PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 OUT-APPLIED-RATE       PIC 9(02)V99.
           05 OUT-TERM-MONTHS        PIC 9(03).
           05 OUT-STATUS-FLAG        PIC X(01).
           05 FILLER                 PIC X(05).

GEN0047.name: GEN0047
GEN0047.technique: INSPECT and reference modification on a text field
GEN0047.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0047.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
       COPY GEN0047I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0047O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG              PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
           88 WS-EOF               VALUE "Y".
       01 WS-COUNTERS.
           05 WS-READ-CNT           PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-WRITE-CNT          PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-WORK-FIELDS.
           05 WS-NAME-UPPER         PIC X(20).
           05 WS-SPACE-CNT          PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-DASH-CNT           PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-FIRST-CHAR         PIC X(01).
           05 WS-LAST-NAME-PART     PIC X(10).
       01 WS-DORMANT-FLAG          PIC X(01).
       01 WS-RISK-CODE             PIC X(04).
       01 WS-NOTE                  PIC X(30).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-REC.
           ADD 1 TO WS-READ-CNT
           MOVE "N" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG
           MOVE "LOW " TO WS-RISK-CODE
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-NOTE
           MOVE ACCT-HOLDER-NAME TO WS-NAME-UPPER
           INSPECT WS-NAME-UPPER TALLYING WS-SPACE-CNT
               FOR ALL " "
           INSPECT WS-NAME-UPPER TALLYING WS-DASH-CNT
               FOR ALL "-"
           INSPECT WS-NAME-UPPER REPLACING ALL "-" BY " "
           MOVE WS-NAME-UPPER(1:1) TO WS-FIRST-CHAR
           IF WS-NAME-UPPER(1:10) = SPACES
               MOVE ACCT-HOLDER-NAME(1:10) TO WS-LAST-NAME-PART
           ELSE
               MOVE WS-NAME-UPPER(1:10) TO WS-LAST-NAME-PART
           END-IF
           IF DAYS-INACTIVE > 365
               IF ACCT-BALANCE < 50.00
                   MOVE "Y" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG
                   MOVE "HIGH" TO WS-RISK-CODE
                   MOVE "DORMANT LOW BALANCE" TO WS-NOTE
               ELSE
                   MOVE "Y" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG
                   MOVE "MED " TO WS-RISK-CODE
                   MOVE "DORMANT REVIEW NEEDED" TO WS-NOTE
               END-IF
           ELSE
               IF DAYS-INACTIVE > 180
                   MOVE "P" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG
                   MOVE "MED " TO WS-RISK-CODE
                   MOVE "PRE-DORMANT WATCH" TO WS-NOTE
               ELSE
                   MOVE "N" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG
                   MOVE "LOW " TO WS-RISK-CODE
                   MOVE "ACTIVE ACCOUNT" TO WS-NOTE
               END-IF
           END-IF
           IF WS-SPACE-CNT > 5
               MOVE WS-NOTE(1:20) TO WS-NOTE(1:20)
               INSPECT WS-NOTE REPLACING FIRST " " BY "-"
           END-IF
           MOVE ACCT-NO TO OUT-ACCT-NO
           MOVE WS-LAST-NAME-PART TO OUT-SHORT-NAME
           MOVE WS-DORMANT-FLAG TO OUT-DORMANT-FLAG
           MOVE WS-RISK-CODE TO OUT-RISK-CODE
           MOVE WS-NOTE TO OUT-NOTE
           WRITE GEN0047O-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
           EXIT.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 GEN0047I-REC.
           05 ACCT-NO              PIC X(10).
           05 ACCT-HOLDER-NAME     PIC X(20).
           05 ACCT-BALANCE         PIC 9(7)V99.
           05 DAYS-INACTIVE        PIC 9(4).
           05 ACCT-TYPE            PIC X(04).
           05 FILLER               PIC X(08).      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 GEN0047O-REC.
           05 OUT-ACCT-NO          PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-SHORT-NAME       PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-DORMANT-FLAG     PIC X(01).
           05 OUT-RISK-CODE        PIC X(04).
           05 OUT-NOTE             PIC X(30).
           05 FILLER               PIC X(05).

GEN0049.name: GEN0049
GEN0049.technique: COMPUTE ROUNDED with a truncating MOVE into a smaller field
GEN0049.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0049.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
       COPY GEN0049I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0049O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG                PIC X VALUE 'N'.
          88 WS-EOF                  VALUE 'Y'.
          88 WS-NOT-EOF              VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-COUNTERS.
          05 WS-READ-CNT             PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
          05 WS-WRITE-CNT            PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CALC-FIELDS.
          05 WS-DISCOUNT-PCT         PIC 9(02)V99 VALUE 0.
          05 WS-FEE-AFTER-DISC       PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
          05 WS-TAX-RATE             PIC 9(02)V99 VALUE 7.50.
          05 WS-FEE-WITH-TAX         PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
          05 WS-BILL-HOLD            PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
          05 WS-SPEND-THRESHOLD      PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 15000.00.
       01 WS-FLAG-FIELD              PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-GEN0049.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END SET WS-EOF TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END
                       ADD 1 TO WS-READ-CNT
                       PERFORM PROCESS-REC-GEN0049
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           STOP RUN.
       PROCESS-REC-GEN0049.
           MOVE 0 TO WS-DISCOUNT-PCT
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-FLAG-FIELD
           MOVE 0 TO WS-FEE-WITH-TAX
           MOVE 0 TO WS-FEE-AFTER-DISC
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN TENURE-YEARS-GEN0049 >= 10
                   MOVE 25.00 TO WS-DISCOUNT-PCT
               WHEN TENURE-YEARS-GEN0049 >= 5
                   MOVE 15.00 TO WS-DISCOUNT-PCT
               WHEN TENURE-YEARS-GEN0049 >= 2
                   MOVE 5.00 TO WS-DISCOUNT-PCT
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-DISCOUNT-PCT
           END-EVALUATE
           IF CARD-TYPE-GEN0049 = 'P'
               COMPUTE WS-DISCOUNT-PCT ROUNDED =
                   WS-DISCOUNT-PCT + 10.00
           END-IF
           IF ANNUAL-SPEND-GEN0049 >= WS-SPEND-THRESHOLD
               MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FLAG-FIELD
               MOVE 0 TO WS-FEE-WITH-TAX
           ELSE
               COMPUTE WS-FEE-AFTER-DISC ROUNDED =
                   ANN-FEE-BASE-GEN0049 *
                   (100 - WS-DISCOUNT-PCT) / 100
               COMPUTE WS-FEE-WITH-TAX ROUNDED =
                   WS-FEE-AFTER-DISC *
                   (100 + WS-TAX-RATE) / 100
           END-IF
           MOVE CUST-ID-GEN0049 TO CUST-ID-O-GEN0049
           MOVE WS-DISCOUNT-PCT TO DISCOUNT-RATE-GEN0049
           MOVE WS-FLAG-FIELD TO FEE-WAIVED-FLAG-GEN0049
           IF WS-FLAG-FIELD = 'Y'
               MOVE 0 TO BILL-AMT-GEN0049
               MOVE SPACES TO BILL-DESC-GEN0049
               MOVE 'FEE WAIVED SPEND BONUS' TO BILL-DESC-GEN0049
           ELSE
               MOVE WS-FEE-WITH-TAX TO BILL-AMT-GEN0049
               MOVE 'ANNUAL FEE BILLED    ' TO BILL-DESC-GEN0049
           END-IF
           MOVE BILL-AMT-GEN0049 TO WS-BILL-HOLD
           COMPUTE WS-BILL-HOLD ROUNDED =
               WS-BILL-HOLD * 1.005
           MOVE WS-BILL-HOLD TO BILL-AMT-DISP-GEN0049
           WRITE OUT-REC-GEN0049
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
           EXIT.
       END PROGRAM GEN0049.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC-GEN0049.
           05 CUST-ID-GEN0049        PIC X(10).
           05 CUST-NAME-GEN0049      PIC X(20).
           05 CARD-TYPE-GEN0049      PIC X(01).
           05 CARD-TYPE-R-GEN0049 REDEFINES CARD-TYPE-GEN0049
                                     PIC X.
           05 ANNUAL-SPEND-GEN0049   PIC 9(06)V99.
           05 ANN-FEE-BASE-GEN0049   PIC 9(04)V99.
           05 TENURE-YEARS-GEN0049   PIC 9(02).
       
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC-GEN0049.
           05 CUST-ID-O-GEN0049      PIC X(10).
           05 BILL-AMT-GEN0049       PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 BILL-AMT-DISP-GEN0049  PIC 9(03)V99.
           05 DISCOUNT-RATE-GEN0049  PIC 9(02)V99.
           05 FEE-WAIVED-FLAG-GEN0049 PIC X(01).
           05 BILL-DESC-GEN0049      PIC X(20).

messages.content:
You are Diocle's COBOL-to-Java translator for a bank modernization project.
Translate the COBOL batch program into ONE self-contained Java 21 source file (JDK only, no libraries)
whose output is byte-identical to the original compiled with GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm).

I/O contract:
- The public class with main() must be named Gen0049, in the default package.
- Input file paths come from environment variables DD_INFILE; write the outputs to DD_OUTFILE.
- ORGANIZATION LINE SEQUENTIAL files are text, one record per line. ORGANIZATION SEQUENTIAL files are fixed-length
  byte records with no separators: read and write them as bytes (ISO-8859-1), record length from the copybook.
- IBM Enterprise COBOL defaults apply: TRUNC(STD), so a value stored in a binary (COMP) field keeps only its PIC digits;
  DISPLAY of a binary field shows its PIC digits (PIC 9(7) COMP displays 7 digits).
- Storage exactly as GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm) writes it: COMP-3 packed decimal with sign nibble C/D (F if unsigned);
  COMP/COMP-4/BINARY big-endian two's complement (2, 4 or 8 bytes by digits); COMP-5 little-endian; signed DISPLAY
  without SIGN SEPARATE carries the sign in the last digit, negative digit d written as the character d + 0x40;
  PIC 9(n)P(m) stores n digits worth value x 10^m.
- When environment variable DIOCLE_COLLATION is EBCDIC, alphanumeric comparisons (<, >) and SORT keys follow mainframe
  EBCDIC order (lowercase < uppercase < digits): compare the Cp037 bytes, not Java's String order.
- Reproduce every DISPLAY to stdout exactly, and exit with the program's RETURN-CODE (System.exit) when it is not 0.
- "Now" (ACCEPT FROM DATE/TIME/DAY, FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE) comes from environment variable DIOCLE_CLOCK when it is
  set (ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. 2000-02-29T13:45:10.00Z), otherwise from the system clock in UTC.

Fidelity rules:
- Preserve COBOL arithmetic semantics exactly: rounding, truncation, overflow, signs, and numeric display formats.
- Use java.math.BigDecimal for all decimal arithmetic. Never use float or double.
- One private method per COBOL paragraph, named after it in camelCase, called in the same order.
- Readable, idiomatic Java; no special-casing of particular input values.
- Name environment variables literally (System.getenv("DD_..."), DIOCLE_CLOCK, DIOCLE_COLLATION). No network,
  processes, reflection, native code or other files: a guard refuses to run such Java.

=== GEN0049.cbl ===
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

          88 WS-EOF                  VALUE 'Y'.
          88 WS-NOT-EOF              VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-COUNTERS.
          05 WS-READ-CNT             PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
          05 WS-WRITE-CNT            PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CALC-FIELDS.
          05 WS-DISCOUNT-PCT         PIC 9(02)V99 VALUE 0.
          05 WS-FEE-AFTER-DISC       PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
          05 WS-TAX-RATE             PIC 9(02)V99 VALUE 7.50.
          05 WS-FEE-WITH-TAX         PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
          05 WS-BILL-HOLD            PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
          05 WS-SPEND-THRESHOLD      PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 15000.00.
       01 WS-FLAG-FIELD              PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-GEN0049.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE

           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END SET WS-EOF TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END
                       ADD 1 TO WS-READ-CNT

* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0080.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
       01  IN-REC-BUF      PIC X(50).
           COPY GEN0080I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
       01  OUT-REC-BUF     PIC X(50).
           COPY GEN0080O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG     PIC X VALUE 'N'.
           88 WS-EOF       VALUE 'Y'.
           88 WS-NOT-EOF    VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-CALC-AMT     PIC 9(9)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-EXCESS-AMT   PIC S9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-DAILY-RATE   PIC 9(2)V999 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-INT-CHARGE   PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-MIN-CHARGE   PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 5.00.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-ONE
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-ONE.
           MOVE 0 TO WS-CALC-AMT WS-EXCESS-AMT WS-INT-CHARGE
           EVALUATE IN-REC-TYPE
               WHEN 'A'
                   PERFORM CALC-TYPE-A
               WHEN 'B'
                   PERFORM CALC-TYPE-B
               WHEN OTHER
                   PERFORM CALC-DEFAULT
           END-EVALUATE
           PERFORM WRITE-OUT.
       CALC-TYPE-A.
           MOVE INT-RATE-A TO WS-DAILY-RATE
           MOVE ACCT-NO-A TO OUT-ACCT-NO
           MOVE IN-REC-TYPE TO OUT-REC-TYPE
           MOVE DAYS-OVERDUE-A TO OUT-DAYS-COUNT
           MOVE INT-RATE-A TO OUT-RATE-APPLIED
           COMPUTE WS-CALC-AMT = OVERDRAFT-AMT-A * WS-DAILY-RATE
               * DAYS-OVERDUE-A / 365
           IF OVERDRAFT-AMT-A = 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-CALC-AMT
           END-IF
           IF WS-CALC-AMT < WS-MIN-CHARGE AND OVERDRAFT-AMT-A > 0
               MOVE WS-MIN-CHARGE TO WS-CALC-AMT
           END-IF
           MOVE WS-CALC-AMT TO WS-INT-CHARGE
           MOVE 'OVERDRAFT' TO OUT-REASON-CODE.
       CALC-TYPE-B.
           MOVE ACCT-NO-B TO OUT-ACCT-NO
           MOVE IN-REC-TYPE TO OUT-REC-TYPE
           MOVE DAYS-B TO OUT-DAYS-COUNT
           MOVE PENALTY-RATE-B TO OUT-RATE-APPLIED
           MOVE PENALTY-RATE-B TO WS-DAILY-RATE
           COMPUTE WS-EXCESS-AMT = UTILIZED-AMT-B - LIMIT-AMT-B
           IF WS-EXCESS-AMT < 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-EXCESS-AMT
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-CALC-AMT = WS-EXCESS-AMT * WS-DAILY-RATE
               * DAYS-B / 365
           IF WS-EXCESS-AMT = 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-CALC-AMT
           ELSE
               IF WS-CALC-AMT < WS-MIN-CHARGE
                   MOVE WS-MIN-CHARGE TO WS-CALC-AMT
               END-IF
           END-IF
           MOVE WS-CALC-AMT TO WS-INT-CHARGE
           IF WS-EXCESS-AMT > 0
               MOVE 'EXCESS USE' TO OUT-REASON-CODE
           ELSE
               MOVE 'WITHIN LIM' TO OUT-REASON-CODE
           END-IF.
       CALC-DEFAULT.
           MOVE '0000000000' TO OUT-ACCT-NO
           MOVE IN-REC-TYPE TO OUT-REC-TYPE
           MOVE 0 TO OUT-DAYS-COUNT OUT-RATE-APPLIED
           MOVE 0 TO WS-INT-CHARGE
           MOVE 'UNKNOWN' TO OUT-REASON-CODE.
       WRITE-OUT.
           MOVE WS-INT-CHARGE TO OUT-CHARGE-AMT
           WRITE OUT-REC-BUF FROM OUT-REC
           .

       01 IN-REC.

             10 TYPE-A-FIELDS.

                15 DAYS-OVERDUE-A  PIC 9(3).
                15 INT-RATE-A      PIC 9(2)V999.
                15 FILLER          PIC X(22).
             10 TYPE-B-FIELDS REDEFINES TYPE-A-FIELDS.
                15 ACCT-NO-B        PIC X(10).
                15 LIMIT-AMT-B     PIC 9(7)V99.
                15 UTILIZED-AMT-B  PIC 9(7)V99.
                15 DAYS-B          PIC 9(3).
                15 PENALTY-RATE-B  PIC 9(2)V999.
                15 FILLER          PIC X(13).

          05 OUT-REC-TYPE      PIC X.
          05 OUT-CHARGE-AMT    PIC 9(7)V99.
          05 OUT-DAYS-COUNT    PIC 9(3).
          05 OUT-RATE-APPLIED  PIC 9(2)V999.
          05 OUT-REASON-CODE   PIC X(10).
          05 FILLER            PIC X(19).

You are Diocle's COBOL-to-Java translator for a bank modernization project.
Translate the COBOL batch program into ONE self-contained Java 21 source file (JDK only, no libraries)
whose output is byte-identical to the original compiled with GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm).

I/O contract:
- The public class with main() must be named Gen0087, in the default package.
- Input file paths come from environment variables DD_INFILE; write the outputs to DD_OUTFILE.
- ORGANIZATION LINE SEQUENTIAL files are text, one record per line. ORGANIZATION SEQUENTIAL files are fixed-length
  byte records with no separators: read and write them as bytes (ISO-8859-1), record length from the copybook.
- IBM Enterprise COBOL defaults apply: TRUNC(STD), so a value stored in a binary (COMP) field keeps only its PIC digits;
  DISPLAY of a binary field shows its PIC digits (PIC 9(7) COMP displays 7 digits).
- Storage exactly as GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm) writes it: COMP-3 packed decimal with sign nibble C/D (F if unsigned);
  COMP/COMP-4/BINARY big-endian two's complement (2, 4 or 8 bytes by digits); COMP-5 little-endian; signed DISPLAY
  without SIGN SEPARATE carries the sign in the last digit, negative digit d written as the character d + 0x40;
  PIC 9(n)P(m) stores n digits worth value x 10^m.
- When environment variable DIOCLE_COLLATION is EBCDIC, alphanumeric comparisons (<, >) and SORT keys follow mainframe
  EBCDIC order (lowercase < uppercase < digits): compare the Cp037 bytes, not Java's String order.
- Reproduce every DISPLAY to stdout exactly, and exit with the program's RETURN-CODE (System.exit) when it is not 0.
- "Now" (ACCEPT FROM DATE/TIME/DAY, FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE) comes from environment variable DIOCLE_CLOCK when it is
  set (ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. 2000-02-29T13:45:10.00Z), otherwise from the system clock in UTC.

Fidelity rules:
- Preserve COBOL arithmetic semantics exactly: rounding, truncation, overflow, signs, and numeric display formats.
- Use java.math.BigDecimal for all decimal arithmetic. Never use float or double.
- One private method per COBOL paragraph, named after it in camelCase, called in the same order.
- Readable, idiomatic Java; no special-casing of particular input values.
- Name environment variables literally (System.getenv("DD_..."), DIOCLE_CLOCK, DIOCLE_COLLATION). No network,
  processes, reflection, native code or other files: a guard refuses to run such Java.

- Storage exactly as GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm) writes it: COMP-3 packed decimal with sign nibble C/D (F if unsigned);
  COMP/COMP-4/BINARY big-endian two's complement (2, 4 or 8 bytes by digits); COMP-5 little-endian; signed DISPLAY
  without SIGN SEPARATE carries the sign in the last digit, negative digit d written as the character d + 0x40;
  PIC 9(n)P(m) stores n digits worth value x 10^m.
- When environment variable DIOCLE_COLLATION is EBCDIC, alphanumeric comparisons (<, >) and SORT keys follow mainframe
  EBCDIC order (lowercase < uppercase < digits): compare the Cp037 bytes, not Java's String order.
- Reproduce every DISPLAY to stdout exactly, and exit with the program's RETURN-CODE (System.exit) when it is not 0.
- "Now" (ACCEPT FROM DATE/TIME/DAY, FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE) comes from environment variable DIOCLE_CLOCK when it is
  set (ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. 2000-02-29T13:45:10.00Z), otherwise from the system clock in UTC.

Fidelity rules:
- Preserve COBOL arithmetic semantics exactly: rounding, truncation, overflow, signs, and numeric display formats.
- Use java.math.BigDecimal for all decimal arithmetic. Never use float or double.
- One private method per COBOL paragraph, named after it in camelCase, called in the same order.
- Readable, idiomatic Java; no special-casing of particular input values.
- Name environment variables literally (System.getenv("DD_..."), DIOCLE_CLOCK, DIOCLE_COLLATION). No network,
  processes, reflection, native code or other files: a guard refuses to run such Java.

      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0120.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD IN-FILE.
       COPY GEN0120I.
       FD OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0120O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG              PIC X VALUE 'N'.
           88 WS-EOF               VALUE 'Y'.
       01 WS-SAVED-ACCT.
           05 WS-ACCT-NO           PIC X(10) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-PROP-TAX           PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-INSUR              PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-CURR-BAL           PIC 9(07) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CALC.
           05 WS-SHORTAGE           PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-SPREAD-MOS         PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-MONTHLY-ESC        PIC 9(04) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-REQ-MONTHLY        PIC 9(04) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-ADDON              PIC 9(04) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-REMAIN             PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-NEW-PAY            PIC 9(04) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-I                  PIC 99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-REMAINDER          PIC 9(04) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-REC.
           IF IN-REC-TYPE = 'A'
               MOVE IN-ACCT-NO TO WS-ACCT-NO
               MOVE IN-PROP-TAX-ANN TO WS-PROP-TAX
               MOVE IN-INSUR-ANN TO WS-INSUR
               MOVE IN-CURR-BAL TO WS-CURR-BAL
               MOVE SPACES TO OUT-REC
               MOVE WS-ACCT-NO TO OUT-ACCT-NO
               MOVE WS-ACCT-NO TO OUT-LOAN-NO
               MOVE 0 TO OUT-SPREAD-MONTH
               MOVE 0 TO OUT-BASE-ESCROW
               MOVE 0 TO OUT-SHORTAGE-ADDON
               MOVE 0 TO OUT-NEW-PAYMENT
               MOVE 0 TO OUT-REMAIN-SHORTAGE
               MOVE 'HDR ' TO OUT-REC-TYPE-OUT
               WRITE OUT-REC
           ELSE
               IF IN-REC-TYPE = 'B'
                   MOVE IN-SHORTAGE-TOT TO WS-SHORTAGE
                   MOVE IN-SPREAD-MOS TO WS-SPREAD-MOS
                   MOVE IN-MONTHLY-ESCROW TO WS-MONTHLY-ESC
                   MOVE IN-REQ-MONTHLY TO WS-REQ-MONTHLY
                   IF WS-SPREAD-MOS = 0
                       MOVE 1 TO WS-SPREAD-MOS
                   END-IF
                   COMPUTE WS-ADDON = WS-SHORTAGE / WS-SPREAD-MOS
                   COMPUTE WS-REMAINDER = FUNCTION MOD(WS-SHORTAGE
                       WS-SPREAD-MOS)
                   MOVE WS-SHORTAGE TO WS-REMAIN
                   PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1
                       UNTIL WS-I > WS-SPREAD-MOS
                       MOVE SPACES TO OUT-REC
                       MOVE WS-ACCT-NO TO OUT-ACCT-NO
                       MOVE IN-LOAN-NO TO OUT-LOAN-NO
                       MOVE WS-I TO OUT-SPREAD-MONTH
                       MOVE WS-MONTHLY-ESC TO OUT-BASE-ESCROW
                       IF WS-I = 1
                           COMPUTE OUT-SHORTAGE-ADDON = WS-ADDON
                               + WS-REMAINDER
                       ELSE
                           MOVE WS-ADDON TO OUT-SHORTAGE-ADDON
                       END-IF
                       COMPUTE OUT-NEW-PAYMENT = WS-MONTHLY-ESC
                           + OUT-SHORTAGE-ADDON
                       COMPUTE WS-REMAIN = WS-REMAIN
                           - OUT-SHORTAGE-ADDON
                       IF WS-REMAIN < 0
                           MOVE 0 TO WS-REMAIN
                       END-IF
                       MOVE WS-REMAIN TO OUT-REMAIN-SHORTAGE
                       MOVE 'SPRD' TO OUT-REC-TYPE-OUT
                       WRITE OUT-REC
                   END-PERFORM
               ELSE
                   MOVE SPACES TO OUT-REC
                   MOVE WS-ACCT-NO TO OUT-ACCT-NO
                   MOVE 'UNKNOWN   ' TO OUT-LOAN-NO
                   MOVE 99 TO OUT-SPREAD-MONTH
                   MOVE 0 TO OUT-BASE-ESCROW
                   MOVE 0 TO OUT-SHORTAGE-ADDON
                   MOVE 0 TO OUT-NEW-PAYMENT
                   MOVE 0 TO OUT-REMAIN-SHORTAGE
                   MOVE 'ERR ' TO OUT-REC-TYPE-OUT
                   WRITE OUT-REC
               END-IF
           END-IF.

GEN0004.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0004.
      * CARD ANNUAL FEE BILLING - TABLE SEARCH
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD INFILE.
           COPY GEN0004I.
       FD OUTFILE.
           COPY GEN0004O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-IDX PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-FOUND-FLAG PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-MATCH-FACTOR PIC 9V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CALC-AMT PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-WAIVE-IND PIC X VALUE 'N'.
      * FEE TABLE OCCURS 8 ENTRIES
       01 WS-FEE-TABLE.
           05 WS-FEE-ENTRY OCCURS 8 TIMES INDEXED BY T-IDX.
               10 WS-T-PROD PIC X(02).
               10 WS-T-RATE PIC 9V99.
               10 WS-T-WAIVE-LIMIT PIC 9(04)V99.
       01 WS-TABLE-INIT-DONE PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           PERFORM INIT-TABLE
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = 'Y'
               READ INFILE
                   AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-ONE
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE
           GOBACK.
       INIT-TABLE.
           MOVE '01' TO WS-T-PROD(1)
           MOVE 1.00 TO WS-T-RATE(1)
           MOVE 500.00 TO WS-T-WAIVE-LIMIT(1)
           MOVE '02' TO WS-T-PROD(2)
           MOVE 0.80 TO WS-T-RATE(2)
           MOVE 1000.00 TO WS-T-WAIVE-LIMIT(2)
           MOVE '03' TO WS-T-PROD(3)
           MOVE 1.00 TO WS-T-RATE(3)
           MOVE 200.00 TO WS-T-WAIVE-LIMIT(3)
           MOVE '04' TO WS-T-PROD(4)
           MOVE 0.50 TO WS-T-RATE(4)
           MOVE 1500.00 TO WS-T-WAIVE-LIMIT(4)
           MOVE '05' TO WS-T-PROD(5)
           MOVE 1.00 TO WS-T-RATE(5)
           MOVE 750.00 TO WS-T-WAIVE-LIMIT(5)
           MOVE '06' TO WS-T-PROD(6)
           MOVE 0.00 TO WS-T-RATE(6)
           MOVE 0 TO WS-T-WAIVE-LIMIT(6)
           MOVE '07' TO WS-T-PROD(7)
           MOVE 0.75 TO WS-T-RATE(7)
           MOVE 2000.00 TO WS-T-WAIVE-LIMIT(7)
           MOVE '08' TO WS-T-PROD(8)
           MOVE 1.00 TO WS-T-RATE(8)
           MOVE 300.00 TO WS-T-WAIVE-LIMIT(8)
           MOVE 'Y' TO WS-TABLE-INIT-DONE.
       PROCESS-ONE.
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-FOUND-FLAG
           MOVE 1.00 TO WS-MATCH-FACTOR
           MOVE 0 TO WS-CALC-AMT
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-WAIVE-IND
      * SEARCH TABLE WITH PERFORM VARYING
           PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-IDX > 8
               IF GEN0004I-PROD-CODE = WS-T-PROD(WS-IDX)
                   MOVE WS-T-RATE(WS-IDX) TO WS-MATCH-FACTOR
                   MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FOUND-FLAG
                   IF GEN0004I-ANNUAL-SPEND >=
                       WS-T-WAIVE-LIMIT(WS-IDX)
                       MOVE 'Y' TO WS-WAIVE-IND
                   END-IF
                   EXIT PERFORM
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           IF WS-WAIVE-IND = 'Y'
               MOVE 0 TO WS-CALC-AMT
           ELSE
               COMPUTE WS-CALC-AMT = GEN0004I-BASE-FEE
                   * WS-MATCH-FACTOR
               IF GEN0004I-ACCT-STATUS = 'D'
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-CALC-AMT
                   MOVE 'Y' TO WS-WAIVE-IND
               END-IF
           END-IF
           MOVE GEN0004I-CARD-NUM TO GEN0004O-CARD-NUM
           MOVE GEN0004I-CUST-NAME TO GEN0004O-CUST-NAME
           MOVE GEN0004I-PROD-CODE TO GEN0004O-PROD-CODE
           MOVE WS-CALC-AMT TO GEN0004O-BILLED-FEE
           MOVE WS-WAIVE-IND TO GEN0004O-WAIVE-FLAG
           MOVE WS-MATCH-FACTOR TO GEN0004O-APPLIED-RATE
           WRITE GEN0004O-REC
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 GEN0004I-REC.
           05 GEN0004I-CARD-NUM PIC X(16).
           05 GEN0004I-CUST-NAME PIC X(20).
           05 GEN0004I-PROD-CODE PIC X(02).
           05 GEN0004I-BASE-FEE PIC 9(04)V99.
           05 GEN0004I-ANNUAL-SPEND PIC 9(06)V99.
           05 GEN0004I-ACCT-STATUS PIC X(01).
           05 FILLER PIC X(10).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.

           05 GEN0004O-CARD-NUM PIC X(16).
           05 GEN0004O-CUST-NAME PIC X(20).
           05 GEN0004O-PROD-CODE PIC X(02).
           05 GEN0004O-BILLED-FEE PIC 9(04)V99.
           05 GEN0004O-WAIVE-FLAG PIC X(01).

GEN0002.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0002.
      * DORMANT ACCOUNT FLAGGING - PACKED AMOUNTS
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0002I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0002O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG          PIC X VALUE 'N'.
           88 WS-EOF            VALUE 'Y'.
       01  WS-IN-COUNT          PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-OUT-COUNT         PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-DORMANT-DAYS-LIM  PIC 9(4) VALUE 365.
       01  WS-BALANCE-LIM       PIC S9(7)V99 VALUE 2000.00.
       01  WS-SIGNED-TOTAL      PIC S9(9)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-FEE-THRESHOLD     PIC S9(5)V99 VALUE 100.00.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROC-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           STOP RUN.
       PROC-REC.
           ADD 1 TO WS-IN-COUNT
           MOVE IN-ACCT-NO TO OUT-ACCT-NO
           MOVE IN-BALANCE TO OUT-BALANCE-DISP
           COMPUTE WS-SIGNED-TOTAL = IN-BALANCE - IN-YTD-FEES
           END-COMPUTE
           MOVE WS-SIGNED-TOTAL TO OUT-TOTAL-ADJ
           IF IN-LAST-ACT-DAYS > WS-DORMANT-DAYS-LIM
               MOVE 'D' TO OUT-DORMANT-FLAG
               MOVE 'DORMANT > 365 DAYS    ' TO OUT-REASON
           ELSE
               IF IN-BALANCE < WS-BALANCE-LIM
                   AND IN-LAST-ACT-DAYS > 180
                   MOVE 'W' TO OUT-DORMANT-FLAG
                   MOVE 'WATCH LOW BALANCE   ' TO OUT-REASON
               ELSE
                   MOVE 'A' TO OUT-DORMANT-FLAG
                   MOVE 'ACTIVE              ' TO OUT-REASON
               END-IF
           END-IF
           IF IN-YTD-FEES > WS-FEE-THRESHOLD
               MOVE 'HIGH FEES REVIEW    ' TO OUT-REASON
           END-IF
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-OUT-COUNT
           IF OUT-DORMANT-FLAG = 'D'
               MOVE 'D' TO OUT-DORMANT-FLAG
               MOVE WS-SIGNED-TOTAL TO OUT-TOTAL-ADJ
               MOVE 'SECONDARY ALERT     ' TO OUT-REASON
               WRITE OUT-REC
               ADD 1 TO WS-OUT-COUNT
           END-IF
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 IN-ACCT-NO        PIC X(10).
           05 IN-CUST-NAME      PIC X(20).
           05 IN-LAST-ACT-DAYS  PIC 9(4).
           05 IN-BALANCE        PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
           05 FILLER REDEFINES IN-BALANCE PIC X(5).
           05 IN-YTD-FEES       PIC S9(5)V99 COMP-3.
           05 IN-ACCT-TYPE      PIC X(02).
           05 IN-BRANCH-CODE    PIC X(04).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-ACCT-NO      PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-DORMANT-FLAG PIC X(01).
           05 OUT-BALANCE-DISP PIC S9(7)V99.
           05 FILLER REDEFINES OUT-BALANCE-DISP PIC X(9).
           05 OUT-TOTAL-ADJ    PIC S9(9)V99.
           05 OUT-REASON       PIC X(20).
           05 OUT-BRANCH-CODE  PIC X(04).

GEN0003.name: GEN0003
GEN0003.technique: a control break with subtotals and a final trailer record
GEN0003.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0003.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  INFILE.
       COPY GEN0003I.
       FD  OUTFILE.
       COPY GEN0003O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG       PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
           05 WS-FIRST-READ     PIC X(01) VALUE "Y".
       01 WS-CONTROL-FIELDS.
           05 WS-PREV-CUST      PIC X(08) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-CURR-CUST      PIC X(08) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-COUNTERS.
           05 WS-DETAIL-COUNT   PIC 9(07) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-CUST-COUNT     PIC 9(07) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-GRAND-COUNT    PIC 9(07) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-TOTALS.
           05 WS-CUST-TOTAL     PIC 9(09)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-GRAND-TOTAL    PIC 9(11)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-SCHED-AMT      PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-HOLD-REC.
           05 WS-HOLD-CUST      PIC X(08) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-HOLD-ACCT      PIC X(12) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-HOLD-PAYEE     PIC X(06) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-HOLD-AMT       PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM PRIMING-READ
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = "Y"
               PERFORM PROCESS-RECORD
               PERFORM READ-NEXT
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM FINAL-BREAK
           PERFORM WRITE-TRAILER
           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE
           GOBACK
           STOP RUN
           .
       PRIMING-READ.
           READ INFILE
               AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
               NOT AT END
                   MOVE IR-CUST-ID TO WS-PREV-CUST
                   MOVE "N" TO WS-FIRST-READ
           END-READ
           .
       READ-NEXT.
           READ INFILE
               AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
           END-READ
           .
       PROCESS-RECORD.
           MOVE IR-CUST-ID TO WS-CURR-CUST
           IF WS-CURR-CUST NOT = WS-PREV-CUST
               IF WS-FIRST-READ = "N"
                   PERFORM BREAK-ROUTINE
               END-IF
           END-IF
           MOVE IR-CUST-ID TO WS-HOLD-CUST
           MOVE IR-ACCT-NO TO WS-HOLD-ACCT
           MOVE IR-PAYEE-CODE TO WS-HOLD-PAYEE
           MOVE IR-AMOUNT TO WS-HOLD-AMT
           PERFORM WRITE-DETAIL
           ADD 1 TO WS-CUST-COUNT
           ADD 1 TO WS-GRAND-COUNT
           ADD IR-AMOUNT TO WS-CUST-TOTAL
           ADD IR-AMOUNT TO WS-GRAND-TOTAL
           MOVE WS-CURR-CUST TO WS-PREV-CUST
           MOVE "N" TO WS-FIRST-READ
           .
       WRITE-DETAIL.
           MOVE "D" TO OR-REC-TYPE
           MOVE WS-HOLD-CUST TO OR-CUST-ID
           MOVE WS-HOLD-ACCT TO OR-ACCT-NO
           MOVE WS-HOLD-PAYEE TO OR-PAYEE-CODE
           MOVE WS-HOLD-AMT TO OR-DETAIL-AMT
           MOVE 0 TO OR-SUBTOTAL-AMT
           MOVE 0 TO OR-RECORD-COUNT
           MOVE SPACES TO OR-FILLER
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-DETAIL-COUNT
           .
       BREAK-ROUTINE.
           MOVE "S" TO OR-REC-TYPE
           MOVE WS-PREV-CUST TO OR-CUST-ID
           MOVE SPACES TO OR-ACCT-NO
           MOVE "SUBTOT" TO OR-PAYEE-CODE
           MOVE 0 TO OR-DETAIL-AMT
           MOVE WS-CUST-TOTAL TO OR-SUBTOTAL-AMT
           MOVE WS-CUST-COUNT TO OR-RECORD-COUNT
           MOVE SPACES TO OR-FILLER
           WRITE OUT-REC
           MOVE 0 TO WS-CUST-TOTAL
           MOVE 0 TO WS-CUST-COUNT
           .
       FINAL-BREAK.
           IF WS-GRAND-COUNT > 0
               MOVE "S" TO OR-REC-TYPE
               MOVE WS-PREV-CUST TO OR-CUST-ID
               MOVE SPACES TO OR-ACCT-NO
               MOVE "SUBTOT" TO OR-PAYEE-CODE
               MOVE 0 TO OR-DETAIL-AMT
               MOVE WS-CUST-TOTAL TO OR-SUBTOTAL-AMT
               MOVE WS-CUST-COUNT TO OR-RECORD-COUNT
               MOVE SPACES TO OR-FILLER
               WRITE OUT-REC
           END-IF
           .
       WRITE-TRAILER.
           MOVE "T" TO OR-REC-TYPE
           MOVE "ALL" TO OR-CUST-ID
           MOVE SPACES TO OR-ACCT-NO
           MOVE "TRAILR" TO OR-PAYEE-CODE
           MOVE 0 TO OR-DETAIL-AMT
           MOVE WS-GRAND-TOTAL TO OR-SUBTOTAL-AMT
           MOVE WS-GRAND-COUNT TO OR-RECORD-COUNT
           MOVE SPACES TO OR-FILLER
           WRITE OUT-REC
           .
       END PROGRAM GEN0003.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 IR-CUST-ID        PIC X(08).
           05 IR-ACCT-NO        PIC X(12).
           05 IR-PAYEE-CODE     PIC X(06).
           05 IR-PAYEE-NAME     PIC X(20).
           05 IR-AMOUNT         PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 IR-FREQUENCY      PIC X(01).
           05 IR-INST-COUNT     PIC 9(02).
           05 FILLER            PIC X(14).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 OR-REC-TYPE       PIC X(01).
           05 OR-CUST-ID        PIC X(08).
           05 OR-ACCT-NO        PIC X(12).
           05 OR-PAYEE-CODE     PIC X(06).
           05 OR-DETAIL-AMT     PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 OR-SUBTOTAL-AMT   PIC 9(09)V99.
           05 OR-RECORD-COUNT   PIC 9(07).
           05 OR-FILLER         PIC X(30).

messages.content:
You are Diocle's COBOL-to-Java translator for a bank modernization project.
Translate the COBOL batch program into ONE self-contained Java 21 source file (JDK only, no libraries)
whose output is byte-identical to the original compiled with GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm).

I/O contract:
- The public class with main() must be named Gen0003, in the default package.
- Input file paths come from environment variables DD_INFILE; write the outputs to DD_OUTFILE.
- ORGANIZATION LINE SEQUENTIAL files are text, one record per line. ORGANIZATION SEQUENTIAL files are fixed-length

* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0007.
      * TELLER CASH DRAWER BALANCING
      * INSPECT AND REFERENCE MODIFICATION ON TEXT FIELD
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD IN-FILE.
       COPY GEN0007I.
       FD OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0007O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG         PIC X(01) VALUE 'N'.
           88 WS-EOF          VALUE 'Y'.
           88 WS-NOT-EOF       VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-VARIANCE         PIC S9(07)V99 VALUE +0.
       01 WS-EXPECTED         PIC S9(07)V99 VALUE +0.
       01 WS-SPACE-CNT        PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-ASTERISK-CNT     PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CLEANED-NOTES    PIC X(30) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-FIRST-TEN        PIC X(10) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-LAST-TEN         PIC X(10) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-STATUS-FLAG      PIC X(08) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-NOTES-LEN        PIC 9(02) VALUE 30.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
                OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           STOP RUN
           .
       PROCESS-REC.
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-CLEANED-NOTES
           MOVE NOTES-FIELD TO WS-CLEANED-NOTES
      * COUNT SPACES AND REPLACE ASTERISKS
           MOVE 0 TO WS-SPACE-CNT
           MOVE 0 TO WS-ASTERISK-CNT
           INSPECT WS-CLEANED-NOTES
               TALLYING WS-SPACE-CNT FOR ALL SPACES
               WS-ASTERISK-CNT FOR ALL '*'
               REPLACING ALL '*' BY '-'
      * REFERENCE MODIFICATION ON TEXT FIELD
           MOVE WS-CLEANED-NOTES(1:10) TO WS-FIRST-TEN
           MOVE WS-CLEANED-NOTES(21:10) TO WS-LAST-TEN
           IF WS-CLEANED-NOTES(1:1) = SPACES
               MOVE WS-CLEANED-NOTES(2:) TO WS-CLEANED-NOTES
           END-IF
           IF WS-CLEANED-NOTES(30:1) = '-' OR '*'
               MOVE SPACES TO WS-CLEANED-NOTES(30:1)
           END-IF
      * CALCULATE EXPECTED AND VARIANCE
           COMPUTE WS-EXPECTED = OPENING-BALANCE
               + TRANSACTION-TOTAL
           COMPUTE WS-VARIANCE = CLOSING-COUNT - WS-EXPECTED
           IF WS-VARIANCE = 0
               MOVE 'BALANCED' TO WS-STATUS-FLAG
           ELSE
               IF WS-VARIANCE > 0
                   MOVE 'OVERAGE ' TO WS-STATUS-FLAG
               ELSE
                   MOVE 'SHORTAGE' TO WS-STATUS-FLAG
               END-IF
           END-IF
           PERFORM WRITE-OUT
           IF WS-ASTERISK-CNT > 0
               MOVE 'REVIEW  ' TO WS-STATUS-FLAG
               PERFORM WRITE-OUT
           END-IF
           .
       WRITE-OUT.
           MOVE TELLER-ID TO O-TELLER-ID
           MOVE DRAWER-ID TO O-DRAWER-ID
           MOVE WS-VARIANCE TO O-VARIANCE
           MOVE WS-CLEANED-NOTES TO O-CLEANED-NOTES
           MOVE WS-STATUS-FLAG TO O-STATUS-FLAG
           MOVE WS-SPACE-CNT TO O-SPACE-COUNT
           WRITE OUT-REC
           .

           05 DRAWER-ID        PIC X(04).
           05 OPENING-BALANCE  PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 CLOSING-COUNT    PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 TRANSACTION-TOTAL PIC S9(07)V99.
           05 NOTES-FIELD      PIC X(30).

           05 O-DRAWER-ID      PIC X(04).

           05 O-CLEANED-NOTES  PIC X(30).
           05 O-STATUS-FLAG    PIC X(08).

      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.

      * TELLER CASH DRAWER BALANCING
      * INSPECT AND REFERENCE MODIFICATION ON TEXT FIELD
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD IN-FILE.
       COPY GEN0007I.
       FD OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0007O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG         PIC X(01) VALUE 'N'.
           88 WS-EOF          VALUE 'Y'.
           88 WS-NOT-EOF       VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-VARIANCE         PIC S9(07)V99 VALUE +0.
       01 WS-EXPECTED         PIC S9(07)V99 VALUE +0.
       01 WS-SPACE-CNT        PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-ASTERISK-CNT     PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CLEANED-NOTES    PIC X(30) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-FIRST-TEN        PIC X(10) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-LAST-TEN         PIC X(10) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-STATUS-FLAG      PIC X(08) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-NOTES-LEN        PIC 9(02) VALUE 30.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
                OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           STOP RUN
           .

           MOVE SPACES TO WS-CLEANED-NOTES
           MOVE NOTES-FIELD TO WS-CLEANED-NOTES
      * COUNT SPACES AND REPLACE ASTERISKS
           MOVE 0 TO WS-SPACE-CNT
           MOVE 0 TO WS-ASTERISK-CNT
           INSPECT WS-CLEANED-NOTES
               TALLYING WS-SPACE-CNT FOR ALL SPACES
               WS-ASTERISK-CNT FOR ALL '*'
               REPLACING ALL '*' BY '-'
      * REFERENCE MODIFICATION ON TEXT FIELD
           MOVE WS-CLEANED-NOTES(1:10) TO WS-FIRST-TEN
           MOVE WS-CLEANED-NOTES(21:10) TO WS-LAST-TEN
           IF WS-CLEANED-NOTES(1:1) = SPACES
               MOVE WS-CLEANED-NOTES(2:) TO WS-CLEANED-NOTES
           END-IF
           IF WS-CLEANED-NOTES(30:1) = '-' OR '*'
               MOVE SPACES TO WS-CLEANED-NOTES(30:1)
           END-IF

               + TRANSACTION-TOTAL

               MOVE 'BALANCED' TO WS-STATUS-FLAG
           ELSE

                   MOVE 'OVERAGE ' TO WS-STATUS-FLAG
               ELSE
                   MOVE 'SHORTAGE' TO WS-STATUS-FLAG
               END-IF
           END-IF
           PERFORM WRITE-OUT
           IF WS-ASTERISK-CNT > 0
               MOVE 'REVIEW  ' TO WS-STATUS-FLAG
               PERFORM WRITE-OUT
           END-IF

       WRITE-OUT.
           MOVE TELLER-ID TO O-TELLER-ID
           MOVE DRAWER-ID TO O-DRAWER-ID
           MOVE WS-VARIANCE TO O-VARIANCE
           MOVE WS-CLEANED-NOTES TO O-CLEANED-NOTES
           MOVE WS-STATUS-FLAG TO O-STATUS-FLAG
           MOVE WS-SPACE-CNT TO O-SPACE-COUNT

* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0010.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional insurance premium allocation
      * Uses packed decimal amounts and signed totals.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE
           BLOCK CONTAINS 0 RECORDS.
           COPY GEN0010I.
       FD  OUT-FILE
           BLOCK CONTAINS 0 RECORDS.
           COPY GEN0010O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG        PIC X VALUE "N".
              88 WS-EOF          VALUE "Y".
              88 WS-NOT-EOF      VALUE "N".
       01  WS-COUNTERS.
           05 WS-READ-CNT        PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-WRITE-CNT       PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-CALC.
           05 WS-PREMIUM-DISP    PIC S9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-FEE-DISP        PIC S9(5)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-NET-PREMIUM    PIC S9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-ALLOC-PCT      PIC S9(3)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-ALLOC-AMT      PIC S9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END
                       ADD 1 TO WS-READ-CNT
                       PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-REC.
      * Validate premium and determine allocation percent
           MOVE IN-PREMIUM-AMT TO WS-PREMIUM-DISP
           MOVE IN-FEE-AMT TO WS-FEE-DISP
           IF WS-PREMIUM-DISP < 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-PREMIUM-DISP
           END-IF
           IF WS-FEE-DISP < 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-FEE-DISP
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-NET-PREMIUM = WS-PREMIUM-DISP - WS-FEE-DISP
           IF WS-NET-PREMIUM < 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-NET-PREMIUM
           END-IF
      * Determine allocation percent by policy type
           EVALUATE IN-POLICY-TYPE
               WHEN "A" MOVE 80.00 TO WS-ALLOC-PCT
               WHEN "B" MOVE 65.50 TO WS-ALLOC-PCT
               WHEN "C" MOVE 50.00 TO WS-ALLOC-PCT
               WHEN OTHER MOVE 70.00 TO WS-ALLOC-PCT
           END-EVALUATE
           COMPUTE WS-ALLOC-AMT ROUNDED =
               WS-NET-PREMIUM * WS-ALLOC-PCT / 100
      * Build output record with signed totals
           MOVE IN-POLICY-ID TO OUT-POLICY-ID
           MOVE IN-HOLDER-NAME TO OUT-HOLDER-NAME
           MOVE WS-NET-PREMIUM TO OUT-NET-PREMIUM
           MOVE WS-FEE-DISP TO OUT-FEE-AMT
           MOVE WS-ALLOC-AMT TO OUT-ALLOC-AMT
           COMPUTE OUT-TOTAL-ALLOC = OUT-ALLOC-AMT + OUT-FEE-AMT
           MOVE IN-POLICY-TYPE TO OUT-POLICY-TYPE
           MOVE WS-ALLOC-PCT TO OUT-ALLOC-PCT
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
      * Every input yields one output - duplicate for type A high value
           IF IN-POLICY-TYPE = "A" AND WS-PREMIUM-DISP > 5000
               MOVE IN-POLICY-ID TO OUT-POLICY-ID
               MOVE IN-HOLDER-NAME TO OUT-HOLDER-NAME
               MOVE WS-NET-PREMIUM TO OUT-NET-PREMIUM
               COMPUTE OUT-ALLOC-AMT = WS-NET-PREMIUM - WS-ALLOC-AMT
               MOVE 0 TO OUT-FEE-AMT
               COMPUTE OUT-TOTAL-ALLOC = OUT-ALLOC-AMT
               MOVE "R" TO OUT-POLICY-TYPE
               COMPUTE OUT-ALLOC-PCT = 100 - WS-ALLOC-PCT
               WRITE OUT-REC
               ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
           END-IF
           .      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  IN-REC.
           05 IN-POLICY-ID       PIC X(10).
           05 IN-HOLDER-NAME     PIC X(20).
           05 IN-PREMIUM-AMT     PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
           05 IN-FEE-AMT         PIC S9(5)V99 COMP-3.
           05 IN-POLICY-TYPE     PIC X.
           05 IN-TERM-MONTHS     PIC 9(3).
           05 IN-RISK-CODE       PIC X(4).
           05 IN-FILLER-GRP.
               10 IN-FILLER-X    PIC X(6).
               10 IN-FILLER-N REDEFINES IN-FILLER-X PIC 9(6).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-POLICY-ID      PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-HOLDER-NAME    PIC X(20).
           05 OUT-NET-PREMIUM    PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
           05 OUT-FEE-AMT        PIC S9(5)V99 COMP-3.
           05 OUT-ALLOC-AMT      PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
           05 OUT-TOTAL-ALLOC    PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
           05 OUT-POLICY-TYPE    PIC X.
           05 OUT-ALLOC-PCT      PIC S9(3)V99 COMP-3.
           05 OUT-RESERVE-FLAG   PIC X.

           MOVE 07500 TO TB-RATE(6)
           MOVE "EXTRA LARGE         " TO TB-DESC(6)
           MOVE "XL" TO TB-SIZE-CD(7)
           MOVE 09500 TO TB-RATE(7)

           MOVE "S0" TO TB-SIZE-CD(8)

           MOVE "MINI BOX            " TO TB-DESC(8)
           MOVE "L0" TO TB-SIZE-CD(9)
           MOVE 06000 TO TB-RATE(9)
           MOVE "LARGE PLUS          " TO TB-DESC(9)
           MOVE "XX" TO TB-SIZE-CD(10)
           MOVE 02000 TO TB-RATE(10)

Translate the COBOL batch program into ONE self-contained Java 21 source file (JDK only, no libraries)
whose output is byte-identical to the original compiled with GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm).
