* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0011.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
             ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
             ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0011I.
       FD OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0011O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-FLAGS.
          05 WS-EOF-FLAG        PIC X VALUE "N".
             88 WS-EOF          VALUE "Y".
             88 WS-NOT-EOF      VALUE "N".
          05 WS-FIRST-REC      PIC X VALUE "Y".
             88 WS-IS-FIRST     VALUE "Y".
       01 WS-HOLD-DEPT         PIC X(4) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-DEPT-TOTALS.
          05 WS-D-CONTRIB       PIC 9(9)V99 VALUE 0.
          05 WS-D-MATCH         PIC 9(9)V99 VALUE 0.
          05 WS-D-COUNT         PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-GRAND-TOTALS.
          05 WS-G-CONTRIB       PIC 9(10)V99 VALUE 0.
          05 WS-G-MATCH         PIC 9(10)V99 VALUE 0.
          05 WS-G-COUNT         PIC 9(6) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CALC-MATCH        PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CALC-TOTAL        PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM PRIM-READ
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
              IF WS-IS-FIRST
                 MOVE GI-DEPT TO WS-HOLD-DEPT
                 MOVE "N" TO WS-FIRST-REC
              END-IF
              IF GI-DEPT NOT = WS-HOLD-DEPT
                 PERFORM WRITE-DEPT-SUBTOTAL
                 MOVE GI-DEPT TO WS-HOLD-DEPT
              END-IF
              PERFORM PROCESS-RECORD
              PERFORM PRIM-READ
           END-PERFORM
           IF WS-G-COUNT > 0
              PERFORM WRITE-DEPT-SUBTOTAL
           END-IF
           PERFORM WRITE-TRAILER
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       PRIM-READ.
           READ IN-FILE
              AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
              NOT AT END CONTINUE
           END-READ.
       PROCESS-RECORD.
           COMPUTE WS-CALC-MATCH =
              GI-CONTRIB * GI-MATCH-PCT / 100
           COMPUTE WS-CALC-TOTAL = GI-CONTRIB + WS-CALC-MATCH
           ADD GI-CONTRIB TO WS-D-CONTRIB
           ADD WS-CALC-MATCH TO WS-D-MATCH
           ADD 1 TO WS-D-COUNT
           ADD GI-CONTRIB TO WS-G-CONTRIB
           ADD WS-CALC-MATCH TO WS-G-MATCH
           ADD 1 TO WS-G-COUNT
           MOVE WS-HOLD-DEPT TO GO-DEPT
           MOVE "D" TO GO-REC-TYPE
           MOVE GI-EMP-ID TO GO-EMP-ID
           MOVE GI-CONTRIB TO GO-CONTRIB-AMT
           MOVE WS-CALC-MATCH TO GO-MATCH-AMT
           MOVE WS-CALC-TOTAL TO GO-TOTAL-AMT
           MOVE WS-D-COUNT TO GO-REC-COUNT
           WRITE GEN0011O-REC
           .
       WRITE-DEPT-SUBTOTAL.
           MOVE WS-HOLD-DEPT TO GO-DEPT
           MOVE "S" TO GO-REC-TYPE
           MOVE 0 TO GO-EMP-ID
           MOVE WS-D-CONTRIB TO GO-CONTRIB-AMT
           MOVE WS-D-MATCH TO GO-MATCH-AMT
           COMPUTE WS-CALC-TOTAL = WS-D-CONTRIB + WS-D-MATCH
           MOVE WS-CALC-TOTAL TO GO-TOTAL-AMT
           MOVE WS-D-COUNT TO GO-REC-COUNT
           WRITE GEN0011O-REC
           MOVE 0 TO WS-D-CONTRIB
           MOVE 0 TO WS-D-MATCH
           MOVE 0 TO WS-D-COUNT
           .
       WRITE-TRAILER.
           MOVE "9999" TO GO-DEPT
           MOVE "T" TO GO-REC-TYPE
           MOVE 0 TO GO-EMP-ID
           MOVE WS-G-CONTRIB TO GO-CONTRIB-AMT
           MOVE WS-G-MATCH TO GO-MATCH-AMT
           COMPUTE WS-CALC-TOTAL = WS-G-CONTRIB + WS-G-MATCH
           MOVE WS-CALC-TOTAL TO GO-TOTAL-AMT
           MOVE WS-G-COUNT TO GO-REC-COUNT
           WRITE GEN0011O-REC
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 GEN0011I-REC.
          05 GI-DEPT           PIC X(4).
          05 GI-EMP-ID         PIC 9(6).
          05 GI-EMP-NAME       PIC X(20).
          05 GI-CONTRIB        PIC 9(5)V99.
          05 GI-MATCH-PCT      PIC 9(3).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 GEN0011O-REC.
          05 GO-DEPT           PIC X(4).
          05 GO-REC-TYPE       PIC X(1).
          05 GO-EMP-ID         PIC 9(6).
          05 GO-CONTRIB-AMT    PIC 9(7)V99.
          05 GO-MATCH-AMT      PIC 9(7)V99.
          05 GO-TOTAL-AMT      PIC 9(8)V99.
          05 GO-REC-COUNT      PIC 9(6).

GEN0013.name: GEN0013
GEN0013.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0013.
      * WIRE TRANSFER FEE TIERS - FICTIONAL INSTITUTION
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  INFILE.
       COPY GEN0013I.
       FD  OUTFILE.
       COPY GEN0013O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG      PIC X VALUE 'N'.
               88 WS-EOF       VALUE 'Y'.
               88 WS-NOT-EOF   VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-CALC-FIELDS.
           05 WS-FEE-AMT       PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-TIER-CODE     PIC X(2) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-TIER-DESC     PIC X(20) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-COUNTERS.
           05 WS-REC-COUNT     PIC 9(6) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-TOTAL-FEES    PIC 9(9)V99 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-MAIN.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM 1000-READ-LOOP UNTIL WS-EOF
           PERFORM 9000-CLOSE-UP
           GOBACK
           .
       1000-READ-LOOP.
           READ INFILE
               AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
               NOT AT END PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-RECORD
           END-READ
           .
       2000-PROCESS-RECORD.
           ADD 1 TO WS-REC-COUNT
           MOVE 0 TO WS-FEE-AMT
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-TIER-CODE
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-TIER-DESC
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN WT-TIER-1
                   MOVE 10.00 TO WS-FEE-AMT
                   MOVE 'T1' TO WS-TIER-CODE
                   MOVE 'STANDARD LOW' TO WS-TIER-DESC
               WHEN WT-TIER-2
                   MOVE 18.50 TO WS-FEE-AMT
                   MOVE 'T2' TO WS-TIER-CODE
                   MOVE 'STANDARD MID' TO WS-TIER-DESC
               WHEN WT-TIER-3
                   MOVE 27.00 TO WS-FEE-AMT
                   MOVE 'T3' TO WS-TIER-CODE
                   MOVE 'PREMIUM MID' TO WS-TIER-DESC
               WHEN WT-TIER-4
                   MOVE 35.00 TO WS-FEE-AMT
                   MOVE 'T4' TO WS-TIER-CODE
                   MOVE 'PREMIUM HIGH' TO WS-TIER-DESC
               WHEN WT-TIER-5
                   MOVE 50.00 TO WS-FEE-AMT
                   MOVE 'T5' TO WS-TIER-CODE
                   MOVE 'PRIORITY TOP' TO WS-TIER-DESC
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 75.00 TO WS-FEE-AMT
                   MOVE 'TX' TO WS-TIER-CODE
                   MOVE 'EXCEPTION REVIEW' TO WS-TIER-DESC
           END-EVALUATE
           IF WT-URGENT-FLAG = 'Y'
               ADD 15.00 TO WS-FEE-AMT
           END-IF
           IF WT-INTERNATIONAL = 'Y'
               ADD 20.00 TO WS-FEE-AMT
           END-IF
           PERFORM 3000-WRITE-OUTPUT
           .
       3000-WRITE-OUTPUT.
           MOVE WT-TRANSFER-ID TO OT-TRANSFER-ID
           MOVE WT-AMOUNT TO OT-AMOUNT
           MOVE WT-CURRENCY TO OT-CURRENCY
           MOVE WS-FEE-AMT TO OT-FEE-AMT
           ADD WS-FEE-AMT TO WS-TOTAL-FEES
           COMPUTE OT-TOTAL-DEBIT = WT-AMOUNT + WS-FEE-AMT
           MOVE WS-TIER-CODE TO OT-TIER-CODE
           MOVE WS-TIER-DESC TO OT-TIER-DESC
           MOVE WT-URGENT-FLAG TO OT-URGENT-FLAG
           MOVE WT-INTERNATIONAL TO OT-INTL-FLAG
           WRITE WIRE-FEE-OUT-REC
           .
       9000-CLOSE-UP.
           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  WIRE-TRANSFER-REC.
           05 WT-TRANSFER-ID       PIC X(10).
           05 WT-AMOUNT            PIC 9(7)V99.
               88 WT-TIER-1        VALUE 0 THRU 9999.99.
               88 WT-TIER-2        VALUE 10000 THRU 24999.99.
               88 WT-TIER-3        VALUE 25000 THRU 99999.99.
               88 WT-TIER-4        VALUE 100000 THRU 249999.99.
               88 WT-TIER-5        VALUE 250000 THRU 999999.99.
           05 WT-CURRENCY          PIC X(3).
           05 WT-URGENT-FLAG       PIC X.
               88 WT-URGENT        VALUE 'Y'.
               88 WT-NORMAL        VALUE 'N'.
           05 WT-INTERNATIONAL     PIC X.
               88 WT-DOMESTIC      VALUE 'N'.
               88 WT-INTL          VALUE 'Y'.
           05 WT-NUM-TRANSFERS     PIC 9(3).
           05 FILLER               PIC X(10).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  WIRE-FEE-OUT-REC.
           05 OT-TRANSFER-ID       PIC X(10).
           05 OT-AMOUNT            PIC 9(7)V99.
           05 OT-CURRENCY          PIC X(3).
           05 OT-FEE-AMT           PIC 9(5)V99.
           05 OT-TOTAL-DEBIT       PIC 9(7)V99.
           05 OT-TIER-CODE         PIC X(2).
           05 OT-TIER-DESC         PIC X(20).
           05 OT-URGENT-FLAG       PIC X.
           05 OT-INTL-FLAG         PIC X.
           05 FILLER               PIC X(15).

GEN0014.name: GEN0014
GEN0014.technique: SIGN LEADING SEPARATE amounts and DIVIDE ... REMAINDER
GEN0014.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0014.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
       COPY GEN0014I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0014O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-CONTROL.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG            PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
              88 WS-EOF               VALUE "Y".
              88 WS-NOT-EOF           VALUE "N".
       01  WS-WORK-FIELDS.
           05 WS-NOTES-OF-20         PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-REMAINDER-AMT       PIC S9(07)V99
                                     SIGN LEADING SEPARATE VALUE +0.
           05 WS-AVAIL-AFTER         PIC S9(07)V99
                                     SIGN LEADING SEPARATE VALUE +0.
           05 WS-TWENTY              PIC S9(07)V99
                                     SIGN LEADING SEPARATE VALUE +20.
           05 WS-ONE                 PIC S9(07)V99
                                     SIGN LEADING SEPARATE VALUE +1.
           05 WS-DECISION-CODE       PIC X(08) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-DUMMY-GIVING        PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-DUMMY-REMAIN        PIC S9(07)V99
                                     SIGN LEADING SEPARATE VALUE +0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM DO-WITHDRAWAL-CHECK
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       DO-WITHDRAWAL-CHECK.
           MOVE 0 TO WS-NOTES-OF-20
           MOVE +0 TO WS-REMAINDER-AMT
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-DECISION-CODE
           MOVE ATM-BALANCE TO WS-AVAIL-AFTER
           IF ATM-REQUEST-AMT IS POSITIVE
               DIVIDE ATM-REQUEST-AMT BY WS-TWENTY
                   GIVING WS-NOTES-OF-20
                   REMAINDER WS-REMAINDER-AMT
               END-DIVIDE
           ELSE
               MOVE 0 TO WS-NOTES-OF-20
               MOVE ATM-REQUEST-AMT TO WS-REMAINDER-AMT
           END-IF
           DIVIDE WS-TWENTY BY WS-ONE
               GIVING WS-DUMMY-GIVING
               REMAINDER WS-DUMMY-REMAIN
           END-DIVIDE
           IF ATM-REQUEST-AMT <= 0
               MOVE "INVALID " TO WS-DECISION-CODE
           ELSE
               IF ATM-REQUEST-AMT > ATM-BALANCE
                   MOVE "DECL-BAL" TO WS-DECISION-CODE
               ELSE
                   IF ATM-REQUEST-AMT > ATM-DAILY-LIMIT
                       MOVE "DECL-LIM" TO WS-DECISION-CODE
                   ELSE
                       MOVE "APPROVED" TO WS-DECISION-CODE
                       SUBTRACT ATM-REQUEST-AMT FROM WS-AVAIL-AFTER
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF
           MOVE ATM-ACCOUNT-NUM TO OUT-ACCOUNT-NUM
           MOVE ATM-CARD-NUM TO OUT-CARD-NUM
           MOVE ATM-REQUEST-AMT TO OUT-REQUEST-AMT
           MOVE ATM-DAILY-LIMIT TO OUT-DAILY-LIMIT
           MOVE ATM-BALANCE TO OUT-BALANCE
           MOVE WS-DECISION-CODE TO OUT-DECISION-CODE
           MOVE WS-NOTES-OF-20 TO OUT-NOTES-OF-20
           MOVE WS-REMAINDER-AMT TO OUT-REMAINDER-AMT
           MOVE WS-AVAIL-AFTER TO OUT-AVAIL-AFTER
           WRITE OUT-REC
           EXIT.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 GEN0014I-REC.
           05 ATM-ACCOUNT-NUM       PIC X(10).
           05 ATM-CARD-NUM          PIC X(16).
           05 ATM-REQUEST-AMT       PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 ATM-DAILY-LIMIT       PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 ATM-BALANCE           PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 ATM-TXN-COUNT         PIC 9(03).
           05 ATM-LOCATION-CODE     PIC X(04).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 GEN0014O-REC.
           05 OUT-REC.
              10 OUT-ACCOUNT-NUM    PIC X(10).
              10 OUT-CARD-NUM       PIC X(16).
              10 OUT-REQUEST-AMT    PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
              10 OUT-DAILY-LIMIT    PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
              10 OUT-BALANCE        PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
              10 OUT-DECISION-CODE  PIC X(08).
              10 OUT-NOTES-OF-20    PIC 9(06).
              10 OUT-REMAINDER-AMT  PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
              10 OUT-AVAIL-AFTER    PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.

GEN0017.name: GEN0017
GEN0017.technique: COMPUTE ROUNDED with a truncating MOVE into a smaller field
GEN0017.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0017.
      * DORMANT ACCOUNT FLAGGING WITH ROUNDED FEE AND TRUNCATION
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
       COPY GEN0017I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0017O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG               PIC X VALUE 'N'.
           88 WS-EOF                VALUE 'Y'.
           88 WS-NOT-EOF             VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-COUNTS.
           05 WS-READ-CNT            PIC 9(6) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-WRITE-CNT           PIC 9(6) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-DORMANT-CNT          PIC 9(6) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-WORK-FIELDS.
           05 WS-DORMANT-FEE-CALC    PIC 9(5)V999 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-FEE-DISP            PIC 9(4)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-FEE-TRUNC-WORK      PIC 9(3)V9 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-FEE-RATE            PIC V999 VALUE .025.
           05 WS-DAYS-LIMIT          PIC 9(4) VALUE 365.
           05 WS-BAL-LIMIT           PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 1000.00.
       01 WS-HOLD-BUFFER.
           05 WS-HOLD-CODE           PIC X(12).
           05 WS-HOLD-CODE-R REDEFINES WS-HOLD-CODE PIC 9(12).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END
                       ADD 1 TO WS-READ-CNT
                       PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           DISPLAY 'READ=' WS-READ-CNT ' WRITTEN=' WS-WRITE-CNT
           DISPLAY 'DORMANT=' WS-DORMANT-CNT
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-REC.
      * COMPUTE DORMANT FEE WITH ROUNDING
           COMPUTE WS-DORMANT-FEE-CALC ROUNDED =
               IN-ACCOUNT-BALANCE * WS-FEE-RATE
           MOVE WS-DORMANT-FEE-CALC TO WS-FEE-DISP
      * TRUNCATING MOVE INTO SMALLER FIELD
           MOVE WS-FEE-DISP TO WS-FEE-TRUNC-WORK
           MOVE IN-ACCOUNT-NUM TO OUT-ACCOUNT-NUM
           MOVE IN-DAYS-INACTIVE TO OUT-DAYS-INACTIVE
           MOVE WS-FEE-DISP TO OUT-DORMANT-FEE
           MOVE WS-FEE-TRUNC-WORK TO OUT-FEE-TRUNC
           IF IN-DAYS-INACTIVE > WS-DAYS-LIMIT
               MOVE 'Y' TO OUT-DORMANT-FLAG
               MOVE 'DORMANT>365 ' TO OUT-REASON-CODE
               ADD 1 TO WS-DORMANT-CNT
           ELSE
               IF IN-ACCOUNT-BALANCE < WS-BAL-LIMIT
                   AND IN-DAYS-INACTIVE > 180
                   MOVE 'Y' TO OUT-DORMANT-FLAG
                   MOVE 'LOWBAL-DORM ' TO OUT-REASON-CODE
                   ADD 1 TO WS-DORMANT-CNT
               ELSE
                   MOVE 'N' TO OUT-DORMANT-FLAG
                   MOVE 'ACTIVE      ' TO OUT-REASON-CODE
               END-IF
           END-IF
           MOVE OUT-REASON-CODE TO WS-HOLD-CODE
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
           EXIT.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 IN-ACCOUNT-NUM       PIC X(10).
           05 IN-ACCOUNT-NAME       PIC X(20).
           05 IN-ACCOUNT-BALANCE    PIC 9(7)V99.
           05 IN-DAYS-INACTIVE      PIC 9(4).
           05 IN-ACCT-TYPE          PIC X(06).
           05 IN-BRANCH-CODE        PIC X(04).
           05 FILLER                PIC X(23).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-ACCOUNT-NUM       PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-DORMANT-FLAG       PIC X(01).
           05 OUT-DAYS-INACTIVE      PIC 9(4).
           05 OUT-DORMANT-FEE        PIC 9(4)V99.
           05 OUT-FEE-TRUNC          PIC 9(3)V9.
           05 OUT-REASON-CODE        PIC X(12).
           05 FILLER                 PIC X(39).

GEN0022.name: GEN0022
GEN0022.technique: SIGN LEADING SEPARATE amounts and DIVIDE ... REMAINDER
GEN0022.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0022.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0022I.
       FD OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0022O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG              PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-CALC-BAL              PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
       01 WS-VARIANCE              PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
       01 WS-VARIANCE-CENTS        PIC S9(09) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
       01 WS-DOLLARS               PIC S9(07) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
       01 WS-CENTS                 PIC S9(02) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
       01 WS-STATUS               PIC X(10).
       01 WS-HUNDRED-CENTS         PIC S9(05) VALUE +100
                                       SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = 'Y'
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-REC.
      * Compute expected drawer balance
           COMPUTE WS-CALC-BAL = IN-DRAWER-OPEN + IN-CASH-IN
               - IN-CASH-OUT
      * Reconcile with system balance for status check
           IF WS-CALC-BAL = IN-SYSTEM-BAL
               MOVE 'BALANCED  ' TO WS-STATUS
           ELSE
               IF WS-CALC-BAL > IN-SYSTEM-BAL
                   MOVE 'OVER-SYS  ' TO WS-STATUS
               ELSE
                   MOVE 'SHORT-SYS ' TO WS-STATUS
               END-IF
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-VARIANCE = IN-PHYSICAL-COUNT - WS-CALC-BAL
      * Convert variance to cents and split dollars/cents
           COMPUTE WS-VARIANCE-CENTS = WS-VARIANCE * 100
           DIVIDE WS-VARIANCE-CENTS BY WS-HUNDRED-CENTS
               GIVING WS-DOLLARS REMAINDER WS-CENTS
           END-DIVIDE
      * Override status if physical variance is significant
           IF WS-VARIANCE NOT = 0
               IF WS-VARIANCE > 0
                   MOVE 'OVERPHYS  ' TO WS-STATUS
               ELSE
                   MOVE 'SHORTPHYS ' TO WS-STATUS
               END-IF
           END-IF
           MOVE IN-TELLER-ID TO OUT-TELLER-ID
           MOVE WS-CALC-BAL TO OUT-CALC-BAL
           MOVE WS-VARIANCE TO OUT-VARIANCE
           MOVE WS-STATUS TO OUT-STATUS
           MOVE WS-DOLLARS TO OUT-DOLLARS
           MOVE WS-CENTS TO OUT-CENTS-REMAIN
           MOVE WS-VARIANCE-CENTS TO OUT-VAR-CENTS
           WRITE OUT-REC
           . 
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 IN-TELLER-ID         PIC X(06).
           05 IN-DRAWER-OPEN       PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 IN-CASH-IN           PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 IN-CASH-OUT          PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 IN-SYSTEM-BAL        PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 IN-PHYSICAL-COUNT    PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 IN-TRAN-COUNT        PIC 9(04).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-TELLER-ID        PIC X(06).
           05 OUT-CALC-BAL         PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 OUT-VARIANCE         PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 OUT-STATUS           PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-DOLLARS          PIC S9(07) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 OUT-CENTS-REMAIN     PIC S9(02) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 OUT-VAR-CENTS        PIC S9(09) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG PIC X VALUE 'N'.
          88 WS-EOF VALUE 'Y'.
          88 WS-NOT-EOF VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-INTEREST-RATE PIC S9(02)V999 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-BASE-RATE PIC S9(02)V999 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-BONUS-RATE PIC S9(02)V999 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-TERM-FACTOR PIC S9(03)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-INTEREST-AMT PIC S9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-MATURITY-AMT PIC S9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-DISP-PRINCIPAL PIC $$$,$$9.99.
       01 WS-DISP-INTEREST PIC $$$,$$9.99.
       01 WS-DISP-MATURITY PIC $$$,$$9.99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-MAIN SECTION.
           PERFORM 1000-OPEN-FILES
           PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-ALL
           PERFORM 3000-CLOSE-FILES
           GOBACK
           .
       1000-OPEN-FILES SECTION.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           .
       2000-PROCESS-ALL SECTION.
           PERFORM 2100-READ-NEXT
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               PERFORM 2200-CALC-MATURITY
               PERFORM 2300-WRITE-OUTPUT
               PERFORM 2100-READ-NEXT
           END-PERFORM
           .
       2100-READ-NEXT SECTION.
           READ IN-FILE
               AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
               NOT AT END MOVE 'N' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
           END-READ
           .
       2200-CALC-MATURITY SECTION.
      * DETERMINE BASE RATE USING TERM CONDITIONS
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN TD-TERM-SHORT
                   MOVE 3.25 TO WS-BASE-RATE
               WHEN TD-TERM-MEDIUM
                   MOVE 4.50 TO WS-BASE-RATE
               WHEN TD-TERM-LONG
                   MOVE 5.75 TO WS-BASE-RATE
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 2.00 TO WS-BASE-RATE
           END-EVALUATE
      * DETERMINE BONUS BASED ON RATE TYPE
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN TD-RATE-PROMO
                   MOVE 0.75 TO WS-BONUS-RATE
               WHEN TD-RATE-FIXED
                   MOVE 0.25 TO WS-BONUS-RATE
               WHEN TD-RATE-VARIABLE
                   MOVE 0.00 TO WS-BONUS-RATE
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 0.00 TO WS-BONUS-RATE
           END-EVALUATE
           COMPUTE WS-INTEREST-RATE = WS-BASE-RATE
               + WS-BONUS-RATE
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN TD-BAL-TIER-LOW
                   COMPUTE WS-TERM-FACTOR =
                       TD-TERM-MONTHS / 12
               WHEN TD-BAL-TIER-MID
                   COMPUTE WS-TERM-FACTOR =
                       TD-TERM-MONTHS / 12 * 1.05
               WHEN TD-BAL-TIER-HIGH
                   COMPUTE WS-TERM-FACTOR =
                       TD-TERM-MONTHS / 12 * 1.10
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-TERM-FACTOR
           END-EVALUATE
           COMPUTE WS-INTEREST-AMT ROUNDED =
               TD-PRINCIPAL * WS-INTEREST-RATE / 100
               * WS-TERM-FACTOR
           COMPUTE WS-MATURITY-AMT =
               TD-PRINCIPAL + WS-INTEREST-AMT
           .
       2300-WRITE-OUTPUT SECTION.
           MOVE TD-ACCOUNT-NO TO OT-ACCOUNT-NO
           MOVE TD-PRINCIPAL TO OT-PRINCIPAL
           MOVE WS-INTEREST-RATE TO OT-APPLIED-RATE
           MOVE WS-INTEREST-AMT TO OT-INTEREST-EARNED
           MOVE WS-MATURITY-AMT TO OT-MATURITY-AMT
           MOVE TD-TERM-MONTHS TO OT-TERM-MONTHS
           MOVE TD-RATE-TYPE TO OT-RATE-TYPE
           WRITE OT-RECORD
           .
       3000-CLOSE-FILES SECTION.
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-RECORD.
           05 TD-ACCOUNT-NO PIC X(10).
           05 TD-CUSTOMER-NAME PIC X(20).
           05 TD-PRINCIPAL PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 TD-ANNUAL-RATE PIC 9(02)V99.
           05 TD-TERM-MONTHS PIC 9(02).
              88 TD-TERM-SHORT VALUE 03 06.
              88 TD-TERM-MEDIUM VALUE 12 24.
              88 TD-TERM-LONG VALUE 36 60.
           05 TD-RATE-TYPE PIC X.
              88 TD-RATE-FIXED VALUE 'F'.
              88 TD-RATE-VARIABLE VALUE 'V'.
              88 TD-RATE-PROMO VALUE 'P'.
           05 TD-BAL-TIER PIC X.
              88 TD-BAL-TIER-LOW VALUE '1'.
              88 TD-BAL-TIER-MID VALUE '2'.
              88 TD-BAL-TIER-HIGH VALUE '3'.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OT-RECORD.
           05 OT-ACCOUNT-NO PIC X(10).
           05 OT-PRINCIPAL PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 OT-APPLIED-RATE PIC 9(02)V999.
           05 OT-INTEREST-EARNED PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 OT-MATURITY-AMT PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 OT-TERM-MONTHS PIC 9(02).
           05 OT-RATE-TYPE PIC X.
           05 FILLER PIC X(20).

GEN0019.name: GEN0019
GEN0019.technique: a control break with subtotals and a final trailer record
GEN0019.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0019.
      * CARD ANNUAL FEE BILLING - CONTROL BREAK
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD INFILE.
           COPY GEN0019I.
       FD OUTFILE.
           COPY GEN0019O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG           PIC X VALUE "N".
               88 WS-EOF            VALUE "Y".
               88 WS-NOT-EOF        VALUE "N".
           05 WS-FIRST-REC-FLAG    PIC X VALUE "Y".
               88 WS-FIRST-REC     VALUE "Y".
       01 WS-CONTROL-FIELDS.
           05 WS-PREV-BRANCH        PIC X(4) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-CURR-BRANCH        PIC X(4) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-COUNTERS.
           05 WS-BRANCH-COUNT       PIC 9(6) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-BRANCH-FEE-TOT     PIC 9(9)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-BRANCH-TXN-TOT     PIC 9(9)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-GRAND-COUNT        PIC 9(8) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-GRAND-FEE-TOT      PIC 9(11)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-GRAND-TXN-TOT      PIC 9(11)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-HOLD-FIELDS.
           05 WS-HOLD-FEE           PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-HOLD-TXN           PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       100-MAIN.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM 200-READ-NEXT
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               PERFORM 300-PROCESS-RECORD
               PERFORM 200-READ-NEXT
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM 400-BREAK-ROUTINE
           PERFORM 500-WRITE-TRAILER
           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE
           GOBACK
           .
       200-READ-NEXT.
           READ INFILE
               AT END SET WS-EOF TO TRUE
               NOT AT END CONTINUE
           END-READ
           .
       300-PROCESS-RECORD.
           MOVE IN-BRANCH-ID OF IN-REC TO WS-CURR-BRANCH
           IF WS-FIRST-REC THEN
               MOVE WS-CURR-BRANCH TO WS-PREV-BRANCH
               SET WS-NOT-EOF TO TRUE
      *        CLEAR FIRST FLAG AFTER INIT
               MOVE "N" TO WS-FIRST-REC-FLAG
           END-IF
           IF WS-CURR-BRANCH NOT = WS-PREV-BRANCH
               PERFORM 400-BREAK-ROUTINE
               MOVE WS-CURR-BRANCH TO WS-PREV-BRANCH
           END-IF
           PERFORM 310-WRITE-DETAIL
           .
       310-WRITE-DETAIL.
           MOVE "D" TO OUT-REC-TYPE OF OUT-REC
           MOVE IN-BRANCH-ID OF IN-REC TO OUT-BRANCH-ID OF OUT-REC
           MOVE IN-CARD-NUM OF IN-REC TO OUT-CARD-NUM OF OUT-REC
           MOVE IN-CARD-TYPE OF IN-REC TO OUT-CARD-TYPE OF OUT-REC
           MOVE IN-ANNUAL-FEE OF IN-REC TO OUT-ANNUAL-FEE OF OUT-REC
           MOVE IN-TXN-AMT OF IN-REC TO OUT-TXN-AMT OF OUT-REC
           MOVE IN-BILL-MONTH OF IN-REC TO OUT-BILL-MONTH OF OUT-REC
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-FILLER-FLAG OF OUT-REC
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-BRANCH-COUNT
           ADD 1 TO WS-GRAND-COUNT
           MOVE IN-ANNUAL-FEE OF IN-REC TO WS-HOLD-FEE
           MOVE IN-TXN-AMT OF IN-REC TO WS-HOLD-TXN
           ADD WS-HOLD-FEE TO WS-BRANCH-FEE-TOT
           ADD WS-HOLD-TXN TO WS-BRANCH-TXN-TOT
           ADD WS-HOLD-FEE TO WS-GRAND-FEE-TOT
           ADD WS-HOLD-TXN TO WS-GRAND-TXN-TOT
           .
       400-BREAK-ROUTINE.
           IF WS-BRANCH-COUNT = 0
               EXIT PARAGRAPH
           END-IF
           MOVE "S" TO OUT-REC-TYPE OF OUT-REC
           MOVE WS-PREV-BRANCH TO OUT-BRANCH-ID OF OUT-REC
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-CARD-NUM OF OUT-REC
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-CARD-TYPE OF OUT-REC
           MOVE WS-BRANCH-FEE-TOT TO OUT-ANNUAL-FEE OF OUT-REC
           MOVE WS-BRANCH-TXN-TOT TO OUT-TXN-AMT OF OUT-REC
           MOVE WS-BRANCH-COUNT TO OUT-SUB-COUNT
           WRITE OUT-REC
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BRANCH-COUNT
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BRANCH-FEE-TOT
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BRANCH-TXN-TOT
           .
       500-WRITE-TRAILER.
           MOVE "T" TO OUT-REC-TYPE OF OUT-REC
           MOVE "9999" TO OUT-BRANCH-ID OF OUT-REC
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-CARD-NUM OF OUT-REC
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-CARD-TYPE OF OUT-REC
           MOVE WS-GRAND-FEE-TOT TO OUT-ANNUAL-FEE OF OUT-REC
           MOVE WS-GRAND-TXN-TOT TO OUT-TXN-AMT OF OUT-REC
           MOVE WS-GRAND-COUNT TO OUT-SUB-COUNT
           WRITE OUT-REC
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 IN-BRANCH-ID          PIC X(4).
           05 IN-CARD-NUM           PIC X(16).
           05 IN-CARD-TYPE          PIC X(1).
           05 IN-BILL-MONTH         PIC X(6).
           05 IN-ANNUAL-FEE         PIC 9(5)V99.
           05 IN-TXN-AMT            PIC 9(7)V99.
           05 IN-CUST-NAME          PIC X(20).
           05 IN-FILLER-AREA        PIC X(10).
           05 IN-FILLER-REDEF REDEFINES IN-FILLER-AREA PIC X(10).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-REC-TYPE          PIC X(1).
           05 OUT-BRANCH-ID         PIC X(4).
           05 OUT-CARD-NUM          PIC X(16).
           05 OUT-CARD-TYPE         PIC X(1).
           05 OUT-BILL-MONTH        PIC X(6).
           05 OUT-ANNUAL-FEE        PIC 9(9)V99.
           05 OUT-TXN-AMT           PIC 9(9)V99.
           05 OUT-SUB-COUNT         PIC 9(8).
           05 OUT-FILLER-FLAG       PIC X(5).
           05 OUT-REDEF-AREA REDEFINES OUT-FILLER-FLAG PIC X(5).

GEN0018.name: GEN0018
GEN0018.technique: packed decimal (COMP-3) amounts and signed totals
GEN0018.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0018.
      * Standing order scheduling - expand installments
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  INFILE.
       COPY GEN0018I.
       FD  OUTFILE.
       COPY GEN0018O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-CTRL.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG            PIC X VALUE "N".
              88 WS-EOF               VALUE "Y".
              88 WS-NOT-EOF            VALUE "N".
           05 WS-READ-CNT             PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-WRITE-CNT            PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-CALC.
           05 WS-SEQ                 PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-DUE-DATE            PIC 9(08) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-YEAR                PIC 9(04) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-MONTH               PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-DAY                 PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-RUN-TOTAL           PIC S9(08)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-MONTH-INC           PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-WEEK-INC            PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ INFILE
                   AT END SET WS-EOF TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END
                       ADD 1 TO WS-READ-CNT
                       PERFORM PROCESS-ORDER
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-ORDER.
           MOVE 0 TO WS-SEQ
           MOVE 0 TO WS-RUN-TOTAL
           MOVE SO-START-DATE TO WS-DUE-DATE
      * Derive increment by frequency code
           EVALUATE SO-FREQ-CODE
               WHEN "M" MOVE 1 TO WS-MONTH-INC
               WHEN "W" MOVE 7 TO WS-WEEK-INC
               WHEN "Q" MOVE 3 TO WS-MONTH-INC
               WHEN OTHER MOVE 1 TO WS-MONTH-INC
           END-EVALUATE
           PERFORM VARYING WS-SEQ FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-SEQ > SO-NUM-INSTALLMENTS
               ADD SO-AMOUNT TO WS-RUN-TOTAL
               MOVE SO-ACCT-NO TO OUT-ACCT-NO
               MOVE SO-PAYEE-NO TO OUT-PAYEE-NO
               MOVE WS-SEQ TO OUT-SEQ-NO
               MOVE WS-DUE-DATE TO OUT-DUE-DATE
               MOVE SO-AMOUNT TO OUT-AMOUNT
               MOVE WS-RUN-TOTAL TO OUT-RUNNING-TOTAL
               MOVE SO-FREQ-CODE TO OUT-FREQ-CODE
               WRITE OUTFILE-RECORD
               ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
               PERFORM CALC-NEXT-DATE
           END-PERFORM.
       CALC-NEXT-DATE.
           IF SO-FREQ-CODE = "W"
               ADD WS-WEEK-INC TO WS-DUE-DATE
           ELSE
               MOVE WS-DUE-DATE TO WS-YEAR
      * Simple month increment using YYYYMMDD integer math
               COMPUTE WS-YEAR = WS-DUE-DATE / 10000
               COMPUTE WS-MONTH = FUNCTION MOD
                   (WS-DUE-DATE / 100, 100)
               COMPUTE WS-DAY = FUNCTION MOD(WS-DUE-DATE, 100)
               ADD WS-MONTH-INC TO WS-MONTH
               PERFORM UNTIL WS-MONTH <= 12
                   SUBTRACT 12 FROM WS-MONTH
                   ADD 1 TO WS-YEAR
               END-PERFORM
               COMPUTE WS-DUE-DATE = WS-YEAR * 10000
                   + WS-MONTH * 100 + WS-DAY
           END-IF.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  INFILE-RECORD.
           05 SO-ACCT-NO              PIC X(10).
           05 SO-PAYEE-NO             PIC X(08).
           05 SO-AMOUNT               PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3.
           05 SO-AMOUNT-X REDEFINES SO-AMOUNT PIC X(05).
           05 SO-FREQ-CODE            PIC X.
           05 SO-START-DATE           PIC 9(08).
           05 SO-NUM-INSTALLMENTS     PIC 9(03).
           05 SO-REFERENCE            PIC X(12).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  OUTFILE-RECORD.
           05 OUT-ACCT-NO             PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-PAYEE-NO            PIC X(08).
           05 OUT-SEQ-NO              PIC 9(03).
           05 OUT-DUE-DATE            PIC 9(08).
           05 OUT-AMOUNT              PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3.
           05 OUT-AMOUNT-X REDEFINES OUT-AMOUNT PIC X(05).
           05 OUT-RUNNING-TOTAL        PIC S9(08)V99 COMP-3.
           05 OUT-FREQ-CODE           PIC X.
           05 OUT-STATUS              PIC X(06).

GEN0025.name: GEN0025
GEN0025.technique: COMPUTE ROUNDED with a truncating MOVE into a smaller field
GEN0025.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0025.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
       COPY GEN0025I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0025O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG          PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
               88 WS-EOF           VALUE "Y".
               88 WS-NOT-EOF        VALUE "N".
       01 WS-COUNTERS.
           05 WS-IN-CNT            PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-OUT-CNT            PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CALC-FIELDS.
           05 WS-MONTHLY-CALC      PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-RISK-ADJ-CALC     PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-FEE-CALC          PIC 9(04)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-WORK-PREMIUM      PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-WORK-RISK        PIC 9V99 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
                OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END SET WS-EOF TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           .
       PROCESS-REC.
           ADD 1 TO WS-IN-CNT
      * calculate monthly allocation with rounding
           COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-CALC ROUNDED =
               (IR-ANNUAL-PREMIUM + IR-BASE-FEE) / IR-TERM-MONTHS
           END-COMPUTE
      * calculate risk adjusted amount with rounding
           COMPUTE WS-RISK-ADJ-CALC ROUNDED =
               WS-MONTHLY-CALC * (1 + IR-RISK-FACTOR / 10)
           END-COMPUTE
      * calculate fee portion per month rounded
           COMPUTE WS-FEE-CALC ROUNDED = IR-BASE-FEE / IR-TERM-MONTHS
           END-COMPUTE
           MOVE IR-POLICY-NUM TO OR-POLICY-NUM
           MOVE IR-HOLDER-NAME TO OR-HOLDER-NAME
           MOVE IR-COVERAGE-CODE TO OR-COVERAGE-CODE
           MOVE WS-MONTHLY-CALC TO OR-ALLOC-MONTHLY
      * truncating move into smaller field without rounding
           MOVE WS-RISK-ADJ-CALC TO OR-ALLOC-TRUNC
           MOVE WS-RISK-ADJ-CALC TO OR-RISK-ADJ-AMT
           MOVE WS-FEE-CALC TO OR-FEE-PORTION
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-OUT-CNT
      * second output for audit trail same input yields extra record
           MOVE IR-POLICY-NUM TO OR-POLICY-NUM
           MOVE IR-HOLDER-NAME TO OR-HOLDER-NAME
           MOVE IR-COVERAGE-CODE TO OR-COVERAGE-CODE
           COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-CALC ROUNDED = WS-FEE-CALC * 0.25
           END-COMPUTE
           MOVE WS-MONTHLY-CALC TO OR-ALLOC-MONTHLY
           MOVE WS-MONTHLY-CALC TO OR-ALLOC-TRUNC
           MOVE WS-MONTHLY-CALC TO OR-RISK-ADJ-AMT
           MOVE WS-MONTHLY-CALC TO OR-FEE-PORTION
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-OUT-CNT
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 IR-POLICY-NUM        PIC X(08).
           05 IR-HOLDER-NAME       PIC X(20).
           05 IR-ANNUAL-PREMIUM    PIC 9(06)V99.
           05 IR-RISK-FACTOR       PIC 9V99.
           05 IR-COVERAGE-CODE     PIC X(02).
           05 IR-COVERAGE-DESC REDEFINES IR-COVERAGE-CODE PIC X(02).
           05 IR-TERM-MONTHS       PIC 9(03).
           05 IR-BASE-FEE          PIC 9(04)V99.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 OR-POLICY-NUM        PIC X(08).
           05 OR-HOLDER-NAME       PIC X(20).
           05 OR-ALLOC-MONTHLY     PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 OR-ALLOC-TRUNC       PIC 9(03)V99.
           05 OR-RISK-ADJ-AMT      PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 OR-COVERAGE-CODE     PIC X(02).
           05 OR-COVERAGE-DESC REDEFINES OR-COVERAGE-CODE PIC X(02).
           05 OR-FEE-PORTION       PIC 9(04)V99.

GEN0023.name: GEN0023
GEN0023.technique: INSPECT and reference modification on a text field
GEN0023.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0023.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0023I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0023O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG            PIC X VALUE "N".
       01  WS-REC-COUNT           PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-NET-PAY             PIC S9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-NAME-UPPER          PIC X(20) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-TEXT-WORK           PIC X(30) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-BLANK-COUNT         PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-PREFIX              PIC X(4) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-SUFFIX              PIC X(10) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-DED-CAT             PIC X(10) VALUE SPACES.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = "Y"
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-REC.
           ADD 1 TO WS-REC-COUNT
           MOVE IN-NAME TO WS-NAME-UPPER
           INSPECT WS-NAME-UPPER CONVERTING
               "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
               TO "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
           MOVE IN-NOTES TO WS-TEXT-WORK
           INSPECT WS-TEXT-WORK TALLYING WS-BLANK-COUNT
               FOR ALL SPACES
           MOVE IN-NOTES(1:4) TO WS-PREFIX
           MOVE IN-NOTES(7:10) TO WS-SUFFIX
           INSPECT WS-TEXT-WORK REPLACING ALL "-" BY " "
           INSPECT WS-PREFIX TALLYING WS-BLANK-COUNT
               FOR ALL " "
           MOVE IN-NOTES(1:15) TO OUT-DESC-A
           MOVE WS-TEXT-WORK(1:15) TO OUT-DESC-B
           MOVE WS-NAME-UPPER TO OUT-EMP-NAME-OUT
           MOVE IN-EMP-ID TO OUT-EMP-ID-OUT
           COMPUTE WS-NET-PAY = IN-GROSS-PAY - IN-DED-AMT
           IF WS-NET-PAY < 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-NET-PAY
           END-IF
           MOVE WS-NET-PAY TO OUT-NET-PAY
           MOVE IN-DED-AMT TO OUT-DED-AMT-OUT
           MOVE WS-PREFIX TO OUT-PREFIX
           MOVE WS-SUFFIX TO OUT-SUFFIX
           MOVE WS-BLANK-COUNT TO OUT-BLANK-CNT
           MOVE WS-REC-COUNT TO OUT-SEQ-NO
           WRITE OUT-REC
           IF IN-DED-AMT > 500
               MOVE "HIGH-DEDUCT" TO OUT-DESC-A
               MOVE IN-NOTES(16:15) TO OUT-DESC-B
               ADD 1 TO WS-REC-COUNT
               MOVE WS-REC-COUNT TO OUT-SEQ-NO
               WRITE OUT-REC
           END-IF.
      * END OF PROGRAM GEN0023
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  IN-REC.
           05 IN-EMP-ID          PIC X(6).
           05 IN-NAME             PIC X(20).
           05 IN-NOTES            PIC X(30).
           05 IN-GROSS-PAY        PIC 9(7)V99.
           05 IN-DED-AMT          PIC 9(5)V99.
           05 IN-DEPT-CODE        PIC X(4).
           05 FILLER              PIC X(10).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-SEQ-NO          PIC 9(5).
           05 OUT-EMP-ID-OUT      PIC X(6).
           05 OUT-EMP-NAME-OUT    PIC X(20).
           05 OUT-DESC-A          PIC X(15).
           05 OUT-DESC-B          PIC X(15).
           05 OUT-PREFIX          PIC X(4).

GEN0026.name: GEN0026
GEN0026.technique: packed decimal (COMP-3) amounts and signed totals
GEN0026.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0026.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD IN-FILE.
       COPY GEN0026I.
       FD OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0026O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG      PIC X VALUE "N".
               88 WS-EOF        VALUE "Y".
               88 WS-NOT-EOF    VALUE "N".
           05 WS-MATCH-PCT      PIC S9V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-MATCH-CAP-RATE PIC S9V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-CAP-AMT        PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-CALC-MATCH    PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-TOTAL-AMT     PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-REMAIN        PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-COUNTERS.
           05 WS-READ-CNT      PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-WRITE-CNT     PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-ONE
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-ONE.
           ADD 1 TO WS-READ-CNT
           MOVE 0 TO WS-CALC-MATCH WS-TOTAL-AMT WS-CAP-AMT
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN PEN-YEARS-SVC >= 10
                   MOVE 1.00 TO WS-MATCH-PCT
                   MOVE 0.06 TO WS-MATCH-CAP-RATE
               WHEN PEN-YEARS-SVC >= 5
                   MOVE 0.75 TO WS-MATCH-PCT
                   MOVE 0.05 TO WS-MATCH-CAP-RATE
               WHEN PEN-YEARS-SVC >= 1
                   MOVE 0.50 TO WS-MATCH-PCT
                   MOVE 0.04 TO WS-MATCH-CAP-RATE
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-MATCH-PCT
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-MATCH-CAP-RATE
           END-EVALUATE
           COMPUTE WS-CAP-AMT = PEN-SALARY-ANN * WS-MATCH-CAP-RATE
           COMPUTE WS-CALC-MATCH = PEN-EMP-CONTRIB * WS-MATCH-PCT
           IF PEN-ER-BASE > WS-CALC-MATCH
               MOVE WS-CALC-MATCH TO WS-CALC-MATCH
           ELSE
               MOVE PEN-ER-BASE TO WS-CALC-MATCH
           END-IF
           IF WS-CALC-MATCH > WS-CAP-AMT
               MOVE WS-CAP-AMT TO WS-CALC-MATCH
           END-IF
           IF WS-MATCH-PCT = 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-CALC-MATCH
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-AMT = PEN-EMP-CONTRIB + WS-CALC-MATCH
           MOVE PEN-EMP-ID TO POUT-EMP-ID
           MOVE PEN-DEPT-CODE TO POUT-DEPT-CODE
           MOVE PEN-YEARS-SVC TO POUT-YEARS-SVC
           MOVE PEN-EMP-CONTRIB TO POUT-EMP-CONTRIB
           MOVE WS-CALC-MATCH TO POUT-MATCH-AMT
           MOVE WS-TOTAL-AMT TO POUT-TOTAL-CONT
           IF WS-CALC-MATCH > 0
               MOVE "M" TO POUT-MATCH-STAT
           ELSE
               MOVE "N" TO POUT-MATCH-STAT
           END-IF
           WRITE PENSION-OUTPUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
           IF PEN-EMP-CONTRIB > WS-CAP-AMT
               COMPUTE WS-REMAIN = PEN-EMP-CONTRIB - WS-CAP-AMT
               MOVE PEN-EMP-ID TO POUT-EMP-ID
               MOVE PEN-DEPT-CODE TO POUT-DEPT-CODE
               MOVE PEN-YEARS-SVC TO POUT-YEARS-SVC
               MOVE WS-REMAIN TO POUT-EMP-CONTRIB
               MOVE 0 TO POUT-MATCH-AMT
               MOVE WS-REMAIN TO POUT-TOTAL-CONT
               MOVE "X" TO POUT-MATCH-STAT
               WRITE PENSION-OUTPUT-REC
               ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
           END-IF
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 PENSION-INPUT-REC.
           05 PEN-EMP-ID        PIC X(06).
           05 PEN-DEPT-CODE    PIC X(04).
           05 PEN-EMP-CONTRIB  PIC S9(06)V99 COMP-3.
           05 PEN-ER-BASE      PIC S9(06)V99 COMP-3.
           05 PEN-YEARS-SVC    PIC 9(02).
           05 PEN-SALARY-ANN  PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 PENSION-OUTPUT-REC.
           05 POUT-EMP-ID      PIC X(06).
           05 POUT-DEPT-CODE   PIC X(04).
           05 POUT-YEARS-SVC   PIC 9(02).
           05 POUT-EMP-CONTRIB PIC S9(06)V99 COMP-3.
           05 POUT-MATCH-AMT   PIC S9(06)V99 COMP-3.
           05 POUT-TOTAL-CONT  PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3.
           05 POUT-MATCH-STAT  PIC X(01).

GEN0024.name: GEN0024
GEN0024.technique: a REDEFINES record with two record types
GEN0024.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0024.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD INFILE.
       COPY GEN0024I.
       FD OUTFILE.
       COPY GEN0024O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG PIC X VALUE 'N'.
          88 WS-EOF VALUE 'Y'.
          88 WS-NOT-EOF VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-COUNTS.
          05 WS-READ-CNT PIC 9(6) VALUE 0.
          05 WS-WRITE-CNT PIC 9(6) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CALC.
          05 WS-SETTLE-AMT PIC 9(9)V99 VALUE 0.
          05 WS-FEE-AMT PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
          05 WS-ADJ-AMT PIC S9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
      * Main settlement batching driver
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ INFILE
                   AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-REC SECTION.
           ADD 1 TO WS-READ-CNT
           EVALUATE G24I-REC-TYPE
               WHEN 'S' PERFORM PROCESS-SALE
               WHEN 'A' PERFORM PROCESS-ADJ
               WHEN OTHER PERFORM PROCESS-OTHER
           END-EVALUATE
           EXIT.
       PROCESS-SALE SECTION.
      * Sale: calculate fee and settlement amount
           COMPUTE WS-FEE-AMT = G24I-SALE-AMOUNT
               * G24I-SALE-FEE-PCT / 100
           COMPUTE WS-SETTLE-AMT = G24I-SALE-AMOUNT
               - WS-FEE-AMT
           MOVE G24I-SALE-MERCHANT TO G24O-MERCHANT
           MOVE WS-SETTLE-AMT TO G24O-SETTLE-AMT
           MOVE WS-FEE-AMT TO G24O-FEE-AMT
           MOVE 'S' TO G24O-TYPE
           MOVE SPACES TO G24O-FILLER
           WRITE G24O-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
           EXIT.
       PROCESS-ADJ SECTION.
      * Adjustment: settlement is adjustment amount
           MOVE G24I-ADJ-AMOUNT TO WS-ADJ-AMT
           MOVE G24I-ADJ-MERCHANT TO G24O-MERCHANT
           IF WS-ADJ-AMT >= 0
               MOVE WS-ADJ-AMT TO G24O-SETTLE-AMT
           ELSE
               COMPUTE WS-SETTLE-AMT = -1 * WS-ADJ-AMT
               MOVE WS-SETTLE-AMT TO G24O-SETTLE-AMT
           END-IF
           MOVE 0 TO G24O-FEE-AMT
           MOVE 'A' TO G24O-TYPE
           MOVE G24I-ADJ-REASON TO G24O-FILLER
           WRITE G24O-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
      * Large adjustments generate audit trail record
           IF WS-ADJ-AMT < -1000 OR WS-ADJ-AMT > 1000
               MOVE G24I-ADJ-MERCHANT TO G24O-MERCHANT
               MOVE 0 TO G24O-SETTLE-AMT
               MOVE 0 TO G24O-FEE-AMT
               MOVE 'X' TO G24O-TYPE
               MOVE 'AUDIT-LARGE' TO G24O-FILLER
               WRITE G24O-REC
               ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
           END-IF
           EXIT.
       PROCESS-OTHER SECTION.
      * Unknown type: write suspense record
           MOVE SPACES TO G24O-MERCHANT
           MOVE 0 TO G24O-SETTLE-AMT
           MOVE 0 TO G24O-FEE-AMT
           MOVE 'E' TO G24O-TYPE
           MOVE 'UNKNOWN-TYPE' TO G24O-FILLER
           WRITE G24O-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
           EXIT.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 G24I-REC.
          05 G24I-REC-TYPE PIC X.
          05 G24I-RAW-BUFFER PIC X(40).
          05 G24I-SALE REDEFINES G24I-RAW-BUFFER.
             10 G24I-SALE-MERCHANT PIC X(10).
             10 G24I-SALE-AMOUNT PIC 9(7)V99.
             10 G24I-SALE-FEE-PCT PIC 9(2)V99.
             10 G24I-SALE-TXN-CNT PIC 9(4).
             10 G24I-SALE-FILLER PIC X(13).
          05 G24I-ADJ REDEFINES G24I-RAW-BUFFER.
             10 G24I-ADJ-MERCHANT PIC X(10).
             10 G24I-ADJ-AMOUNT PIC S9(7)V99.
             10 G24I-ADJ-REASON PIC X(10).
             10 G24I-ADJ-TXN-CNT PIC 9(4).
             10 G24I-ADJ-FILLER PIC X(7).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 G24O-REC.
          05 G24O-MERCHANT PIC X(10).
          05 G24O-SETTLE-AMT PIC 9(9)V99.
          05 G24O-FEE-AMT PIC 9(7)V99.
          05 G24O-TYPE PIC X.
          05 G24O-FILLER PIC X(10).

GEN0029.name: GEN0029
GEN0029.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0029.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0029I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0029O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG                 PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
           88 WS-EOF                    VALUE "Y".
           88 WS-NOT-EOF                 VALUE "N".
       01  WS-CALC-REMAIN              PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-LIMIT-CAT                PIC X(01) VALUE SPACE.
           88 WS-LIMIT-LOW              VALUE "L".
           88 WS-LIMIT-MED              VALUE "M".
           88 WS-LIMIT-HIGH             VALUE "H".
       01  WS-STATUS-CAT               PIC X(01) VALUE SPACE.
           88 WS-STATUS-ACTIVE          VALUE "A".
           88 WS-STATUS-BLOCKED         VALUE "B".
           88 WS-STATUS-RESTRICT        VALUE "R".
       01  WS-AMT-CAT                  PIC X(01) VALUE SPACE.
           88 WS-AMT-SMALL              VALUE "S".
           88 WS-AMT-LARGE              VALUE "L".
           88 WS-AMT-OVER               VALUE "O".
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-ONE
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE
           CLOSE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           STOP RUN
           .
       PROCESS-ONE.
           MOVE I-ACCT-NUM TO O-ACCT-NUM
           MOVE I-WITHDRAW-AMT TO O-WITHDRAW-AMT
           MOVE I-DAILY-TOTAL TO O-DAILY-TOTAL
           MOVE I-DAILY-LIMIT TO O-LIMIT-AMT
      * Classify limit tier
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN I-DAILY-LIMIT < 00500.00 MOVE "L" TO WS-LIMIT-CAT
               WHEN I-DAILY-LIMIT < 01500.00 MOVE "M" TO WS-LIMIT-CAT
               WHEN OTHER MOVE "H" TO WS-LIMIT-CAT
           END-EVALUATE
      * Classify card status
           MOVE I-CARD-STATUS TO WS-STATUS-CAT
      * Classify amount vs remaining
           COMPUTE WS-CALC-REMAIN = I-DAILY-LIMIT - I-DAILY-TOTAL
           IF WS-CALC-REMAIN < ZERO MOVE ZERO TO WS-CALC-REMAIN
           END-IF
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN I-WITHDRAW-AMT > WS-CALC-REMAIN
                   MOVE "O" TO WS-AMT-CAT
               WHEN I-WITHDRAW-AMT > 00300.00
                   MOVE "L" TO WS-AMT-CAT
               WHEN OTHER MOVE "S" TO WS-AMT-CAT
           END-EVALUATE
      * Decide outcome using 88 levels
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN WS-STATUS-BLOCKED
                   MOVE "D" TO O-DECISION-CODE
                   MOVE "DENIED-BLK " TO O-DECISION-TXT
                   MOVE ZERO TO O-REMAINING-LIMIT
               WHEN WS-STATUS-RESTRICT
                   MOVE "R" TO O-DECISION-CODE
                   MOVE "REVIEW     " TO O-DECISION-TXT
                   MOVE WS-CALC-REMAIN TO O-REMAINING-LIMIT
               WHEN WS-AMT-OVER
                   MOVE "X" TO O-DECISION-CODE
                   MOVE "OVER LIMIT " TO O-DECISION-TXT
                   MOVE WS-CALC-REMAIN TO O-REMAINING-LIMIT
               WHEN WS-AMT-LARGE
                   EVALUATE TRUE
                       WHEN WS-LIMIT-LOW
                           MOVE "F" TO O-DECISION-CODE
                           MOVE "FEE APPLY  " TO O-DECISION-TXT
                       WHEN WS-LIMIT-MED
                           MOVE "A" TO O-DECISION-CODE
                           MOVE "APPROVED   " TO O-DECISION-TXT
                       WHEN WS-LIMIT-HIGH
                           MOVE "A" TO O-DECISION-CODE
                           MOVE "APPROVED   " TO O-DECISION-TXT
                   END-EVALUATE
                   COMPUTE O-REMAINING-LIMIT =
                       WS-CALC-REMAIN - I-WITHDRAW-AMT
                   IF O-REMAINING-LIMIT < ZERO
                       MOVE ZERO TO O-REMAINING-LIMIT
                   END-IF
               WHEN WS-AMT-SMALL
                   MOVE "A" TO O-DECISION-CODE
                   MOVE "APPROVED   " TO O-DECISION-TXT
                   COMPUTE O-REMAINING-LIMIT =
                       WS-CALC-REMAIN - I-WITHDRAW-AMT
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE "E" TO O-DECISION-CODE
                   MOVE "ERROR      " TO O-DECISION-TXT
                   MOVE WS-CALC-REMAIN TO O-REMAINING-LIMIT
           END-EVALUATE
           WRITE OUT-REC
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 I-ACCT-NUM                PIC X(10).
           05 I-ACCT-TYPE               PIC X(01).
           05 I-WITHDRAW-AMT            PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 I-DAILY-TOTAL             PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 I-DAILY-LIMIT              PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 I-TRAN-COUNT              PIC 9(02).
           05 I-CARD-STATUS             PIC X(01).
           05 I-FLAGS                   PIC X(02).
           05 I-FLAGS-R REDEFINES I-FLAGS PIC XX.
           05 FILLER                    PIC X(05).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 O-ACCT-NUM              PIC X(10).
           05 O-WITHDRAW-AMT           PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 O-DAILY-TOTAL             PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 O-LIMIT-AMT               PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 O-DECISION-CODE           PIC X(01).
           05 O-DECISION-TXT            PIC X(12).
           05 O-REMAINING-LIMIT         PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 FILLER                    PIC X(04).

GEN0027.name: GEN0027
GEN0027.technique: a control break with subtotals and a final trailer record
GEN0027.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0027.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD IN-FILE.
       COPY GEN0027I.
       FD OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0027O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG              PIC X(1) VALUE "N".
           88 WS-EOF               VALUE "Y".
           88 WS-NOT-EOF            VALUE "N".
       01 WS-PREV-BRANCH           PIC X(4) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-FIRST-REC             PIC X(1) VALUE "Y".
           88 WS-IS-FIRST          VALUE "Y".
           88 WS-NOT-FIRST         VALUE "N".
       01 WS-BRANCH-TOTAL          PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-BRANCH-COUNT          PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-GRAND-TOTAL           PIC 9(9)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-GRAND-COUNT           PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CURR-BILL             PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-HOLD-REC.
           05 WS-HOLD-BRANCH       PIC X(4).
           05 WS-HOLD-BOX          PIC X(6).
           05 WS-HOLD-SIZE         PIC X(1).
           05 WS-HOLD-FEE          PIC 9(4)V99.
           05 WS-HOLD-MONTHS       PIC 9(02).
           05 WS-HOLD-LATE         PIC 9(3)V99.
           05 WS-HOLD-NAME         PIC X(20).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
                OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM READ-NEXT
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               PERFORM CHECK-BREAK
               PERFORM PROCESS-DETAIL
               PERFORM READ-NEXT
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM WRITE-FINAL-SUBTOTAL
           PERFORM WRITE-TRAILER
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       READ-NEXT.
           READ IN-FILE
               AT END SET WS-EOF TO TRUE
               NOT AT END
                   MOVE IN-BRANCH-ID TO WS-HOLD-BRANCH
                   MOVE IN-BOX-NUMBER TO WS-HOLD-BOX
                   MOVE IN-BOX-SIZE-TYPE TO WS-HOLD-SIZE
                   MOVE IN-MONTHLY-FEE TO WS-HOLD-FEE
                   MOVE IN-RENTAL-MONTHS TO WS-HOLD-MONTHS
                   MOVE IN-LATE-FEE TO WS-HOLD-LATE
                   MOVE IN-CUSTOMER-NAME TO WS-HOLD-NAME
           END-READ.
       CHECK-BREAK.
           IF WS-IS-FIRST
               MOVE WS-HOLD-BRANCH TO WS-PREV-BRANCH
               SET WS-NOT-FIRST TO TRUE
           ELSE
               IF WS-HOLD-BRANCH NOT = WS-PREV-BRANCH
                   PERFORM WRITE-SUBTOTAL
                   MOVE WS-HOLD-BRANCH TO WS-PREV-BRANCH
               END-IF
           END-IF.
       PROCESS-DETAIL.
           COMPUTE WS-CURR-BILL = WS-HOLD-FEE * WS-HOLD-MONTHS
               + WS-HOLD-LATE
           ADD WS-CURR-BILL TO WS-BRANCH-TOTAL
           ADD 1 TO WS-BRANCH-COUNT
           ADD WS-CURR-BILL TO WS-GRAND-TOTAL
           ADD 1 TO WS-GRAND-COUNT
           MOVE WS-HOLD-BRANCH TO OUT-BRANCH-ID
           MOVE "D" TO OUT-RECORD-TYPE
           MOVE WS-HOLD-BOX TO OUT-BOX-NUMBER
           MOVE WS-HOLD-SIZE TO OUT-BOX-SIZE-TYPE
           MOVE WS-CURR-BILL TO OUT-BILL-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-BRANCH-TOTAL TO OUT-BRANCH-TOTAL
           MOVE WS-GRAND-TOTAL TO OUT-GRAND-TOTAL
           MOVE WS-BRANCH-COUNT TO OUT-REC-COUNT
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-FILLER
           WRITE OUT-REC.
       WRITE-SUBTOTAL.
           MOVE WS-PREV-BRANCH TO OUT-BRANCH-ID
           MOVE "S" TO OUT-RECORD-TYPE
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-BOX-NUMBER
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-BOX-SIZE-TYPE
           MOVE 0 TO OUT-BILL-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-BRANCH-TOTAL TO OUT-BRANCH-TOTAL
           MOVE WS-GRAND-TOTAL TO OUT-GRAND-TOTAL
           MOVE WS-BRANCH-COUNT TO OUT-REC-COUNT
           MOVE "SUBTOTAL  " TO OUT-FILLER
           WRITE OUT-REC
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BRANCH-TOTAL
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BRANCH-COUNT.
       WRITE-FINAL-SUBTOTAL.
           IF WS-NOT-FIRST
               PERFORM WRITE-SUBTOTAL
           END-IF.
       WRITE-TRAILER.
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-BRANCH-ID
           MOVE "T" TO OUT-RECORD-TYPE
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-BOX-NUMBER
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-BOX-SIZE-TYPE
           MOVE 0 TO OUT-BILL-AMOUNT
           MOVE 0 TO OUT-BRANCH-TOTAL
           MOVE WS-GRAND-TOTAL TO OUT-GRAND-TOTAL
           MOVE WS-GRAND-COUNT TO OUT-REC-COUNT
           MOVE "TRAILER   " TO OUT-FILLER
           WRITE OUT-REC.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 IN-BRANCH-ID         PIC X(4).
           05 IN-BOX-NUMBER        PIC X(6).
           05 IN-BOX-SIZE-TYPE     PIC X(1).
           05 IN-MONTHLY-FEE       PIC 9(4)V99.
           05 IN-RENTAL-MONTHS     PIC 9(02).
           05 IN-LATE-FEE          PIC 9(3)V99.
           05 IN-CUSTOMER-NAME     PIC X(20).
           05 IN-REDEF-BLOCK REDEFINES IN-CUSTOMER-NAME PIC X(20).      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-BRANCH-ID         PIC X(4).
           05 OUT-RECORD-TYPE       PIC X(1).
           05 OUT-BOX-NUMBER        PIC X(6).
           05 OUT-BOX-SIZE-TYPE     PIC X(1).
           05 OUT-BILL-AMOUNT       PIC 9(6)V99.
           05 OUT-REDEF-BLOCK REDEFINES OUT-BILL-AMOUNT PIC X(8).
           05 OUT-BRANCH-TOTAL      PIC 9(8)V99.
           05 OUT-GRAND-TOTAL       PIC 9(9)V99.
           05 OUT-REC-COUNT         PIC 9(5).
           05 OUT-FILLER            PIC X(10).

messages.content:
You are Diocle's COBOL-to-Java translator for a bank modernization project.
Translate the COBOL batch program into ONE self-contained Java 21 source file (JDK only, no libraries)
whose output is byte-identical to the original compiled with GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm).

I/O contract:
- The public class with main() must be named Gen0027, in the default package.
- Input file paths come from environment variables DD_INFILE; write the outputs to DD_OUTFILE.
- ORGANIZATION LINE SEQUENTIAL files are text, one record per line. ORGANIZATION SEQUENTIAL files are fixed-length
  byte records with no separators: read and write them as bytes (ISO-8859-1), record length from the copybook.
- IBM Enterprise COBOL defaults apply: TRUNC(STD), so a value stored in a binary (COMP) field keeps only its PIC digits;
  DISPLAY of a binary field shows its PIC digits (PIC 9(7) COMP displays 7 digits).
- Storage exactly as GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm) writes it: COMP-3 packed decimal with sign nibble C/D (F if unsigned);
  COMP/COMP-4/BINARY big-endian two's complement (2, 4 or 8 bytes by digits); COMP-5 little-endian; signed DISPLAY
  without SIGN SEPARATE carries the sign in the last digit, negative digit d written as the character d + 0x40;

           MOVE WS-HOLD-SIZE TO OUT-BOX-SIZE-TYPE

               MOVE 0 TO WS-WORK-BILLED
           ELSE
               COMPUTE WS-WORK-BILLED = IN-ANNUAL-FEE
                       + IN-LATE-FEE
           END-IF
      * SIGNED TOTAL ALLOWS CREDIT BALANCE
           COMPUTE WS-WORK-TOTAL = WS-WORK-BILLED
           IF IN-CARD-TYPE = "P"
               COMPUTE WS-WORK-TOTAL = WS-WORK-TOTAL
                       - 10.00
           END-IF
           MOVE IN-CARD-NUM TO OUT-CARD-NUM
           MOVE IN-CUST-ID TO OUT-CUST-ID
           MOVE IN-CARD-TYPE TO OUT-CARD-TYPE
           MOVE "ANNUAL FEE  " TO OUT-FEE-DESC
           MOVE WS-WORK-BILLED TO OUT-BILLED-AMT
           MOVE WS-WORK-TOTAL TO OUT-TOTAL-DUE
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
      * SECOND RECORD FOR ITEMIZED LATE FEE WHEN APPLICABLE
           IF IN-LATE-FEE > 0 AND IN-WAIVER-FLAG NOT = "Y"
              AND IN-WAIVER-FLAG NOT = "y"
               MOVE "LATE FEE    " TO OUT-FEE-DESC
               MOVE IN-LATE-FEE TO OUT-BILLED-AMT
               MOVE IN-LATE-FEE TO OUT-TOTAL-DUE
               WRITE OUT-REC
               ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
           END-IF.
       1300-CLOSE-FILES.
           MOVE WS-READ-CNT TO WS-DISP-READ
           MOVE WS-WRITE-CNT TO WS-DISP-WRITE
           DISPLAY "GEN0034 READ : " WS-DISP-READ
           DISPLAY "GEN0034 WROTE: " WS-DISP-WRITE
           CLOSE INFILE
           CLOSE OUTFILE
           STOP RUN.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 IN-CARD-NUM        PIC X(16).
           05 IN-CUST-ID         PIC X(10).
           05 IN-CARD-TYPE       PIC X(01).
           05 IN-WAIVER-FLAG     PIC X(01).
           05 IN-FEE-GROUP.
               10 IN-ANNUAL-FEE  PIC S9(05)V99 COMP-3.
               10 IN-LATE-FEE    PIC S9(04)V99 COMP-3.
           05 IN-FEE-BYTES REDEFINES IN-FEE-GROUP PIC X(07).
           05 FILLER             PIC X(04).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-CARD-NUM       PIC X(16).
           05 OUT-CUST-ID        PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-CARD-TYPE      PIC X(01).
           05 OUT-FEE-DESC       PIC X(12).
           05 OUT-AMT-GROUP.
               10 OUT-BILLED-AMT PIC S9(05)V99 COMP-3.
               10 OUT-TOTAL-DUE  PIC S9(06)V99 COMP-3.

GEN0037.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0037.
      * TELLER CASH DRAWER BALANCING
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD INFILE.
           COPY GEN0037I.
       FD OUTFILE.
           COPY GEN0037O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG PIC X VALUE 'N'.
          88 AT-EOF VALUE 'Y'.
          88 NOT-EOF VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-CALC-FIELDS.
          05 WS-EXPECTED-CLOSE PIC S9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
          05 WS-VARIANCE PIC S9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
          05 WS-ABS-VARIANCE PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-STATUS-FLAGS.
          05 WS-BAL-IND PIC X VALUE 'N'.
             88 IS-BALANCED VALUE 'Y'.
             88 NOT-BALANCED VALUE 'N'.
          05 WS-SHORT-SMALL-IND PIC X VALUE 'N'.
             88 IS-SHORT-SMALL VALUE 'Y'.
          05 WS-SHORT-LARGE-IND PIC X VALUE 'N'.
             88 IS-SHORT-LARGE VALUE 'Y'.
          05 WS-OVER-SMALL-IND PIC X VALUE 'N'.
             88 IS-OVER-SMALL VALUE 'Y'.
          05 WS-OVER-LARGE-IND PIC X VALUE 'N'.
             88 IS-OVER-LARGE VALUE 'Y'.
       01 WS-COUNTS.
          05 WS-IN-COUNT PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
          05 WS-OUT-COUNT PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM UNTIL AT-EOF
               READ INFILE
                   AT END SET AT-EOF TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END
                       ADD 1 TO WS-IN-COUNT
                       PERFORM PROCESS-ONE
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE
           GOBACK
           STOP RUN.
       PROCESS-ONE.
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-BAL-IND
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-SHORT-SMALL-IND
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-SHORT-LARGE-IND
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-OVER-SMALL-IND
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-OVER-LARGE-IND
           COMPUTE WS-EXPECTED-CLOSE =
               TR-OPEN-AMT + TR-CASH-DEPOSITS
               - TR-CASH-WITHDRAWALS - TR-CHECKS-CASHED
           COMPUTE WS-VARIANCE = TR-CLOSE-AMT
               - WS-EXPECTED-CLOSE
           IF WS-VARIANCE < 0
               COMPUTE WS-ABS-VARIANCE = WS-VARIANCE * -1
           ELSE
               MOVE WS-VARIANCE TO WS-ABS-VARIANCE
           END-IF
           IF WS-VARIANCE = 0
               SET IS-BALANCED TO TRUE
           ELSE
               IF WS-VARIANCE < 0 AND WS-ABS-VARIANCE <= 5
                   SET IS-SHORT-SMALL TO TRUE
               END-IF
               IF WS-VARIANCE < 0 AND WS-ABS-VARIANCE > 5
                   SET IS-SHORT-LARGE TO TRUE
               END-IF
               IF WS-VARIANCE > 0 AND WS-ABS-VARIANCE <= 5
                   SET IS-OVER-SMALL TO TRUE
               END-IF
               IF WS-VARIANCE > 0 AND WS-ABS-VARIANCE > 5
                   SET IS-OVER-LARGE TO TRUE
               END-IF
           END-IF
           MOVE TR-TELLER-ID TO TO-TELLER-ID
           MOVE TR-DRAWER-NUM TO TO-DRAWER-NUM
           MOVE WS-EXPECTED-CLOSE TO TO-EXPECTED-AMT
           MOVE TR-CLOSE-AMT TO TO-REPORTED-AMT
           MOVE WS-VARIANCE TO TO-VARIANCE
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN IS-BALANCED
                   MOVE 'BALANCED' TO TO-STATUS-CODE
                   MOVE 'NO ACTION REQUIRED' TO TO-ACTION-TEXT
               WHEN IS-SHORT-SMALL
                   MOVE 'SHORT-SM' TO TO-STATUS-CODE
                   MOVE 'LOG AND RECOUNT' TO TO-ACTION-TEXT
               WHEN IS-SHORT-LARGE
                   MOVE 'SHORT-LG' TO TO-STATUS-CODE
                   MOVE 'SUPERVISOR REVIEW' TO TO-ACTION-TEXT
               WHEN IS-OVER-SMALL
                   MOVE 'OVER-SM' TO TO-STATUS-CODE
                   MOVE 'LOG AND RECOUNT' TO TO-ACTION-TEXT
               WHEN IS-OVER-LARGE
                   MOVE 'OVER-LG' TO TO-STATUS-CODE
                   MOVE 'SUPERVISOR REVIEW' TO TO-ACTION-TEXT
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 'UNKNOWN' TO TO-STATUS-CODE
                   MOVE 'MANUAL INVESTIGATE' TO TO-ACTION-TEXT
           END-EVALUATE
           WRITE TELLER-REC-OUT
           ADD 1 TO WS-OUT-COUNT
           EXIT.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 TELLER-REC-IN.
          05 TR-TELLER-ID PIC X(05).
          05 TR-DRAWER-NUM PIC X(03).
          05 TR-OPEN-AMT PIC 9(06)V99.
          05 TR-CASH-DEPOSITS PIC 9(06)V99.
          05 TR-CASH-WITHDRAWALS PIC 9(06)V99.
          05 TR-CHECKS-CASHED PIC 9(06)V99.
          05 TR-CLOSE-AMT PIC 9(06)V99.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 TELLER-REC-OUT.
          05 TO-TELLER-ID PIC X(05).
          05 TO-DRAWER-NUM PIC X(03).
          05 TO-EXPECTED-AMT PIC 9(06)V99.
          05 TO-REPORTED-AMT PIC 9(06)V99.
          05 TO-VARIANCE PIC S9(06)V99.
          05 TO-STATUS-CODE PIC X(10).
          05 TO-ACTION-TEXT PIC X(20).

GEN0030.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0030.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0030I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0030O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG             PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
           05 WS-MONTH-IX             PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-AMOUNTS.
           05 WS-SHORT-CENTS          PIC S9(09) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-TAX-CENTS            PIC S9(09) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-SHORT-BASE-CENTS     PIC S9(09) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-SHORT-REM-CENTS      PIC S9(09) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-TAX-BASE-CENTS       PIC S9(09) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-TAX-REM-CENTS        PIC S9(09) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-SHORT-MO-CENTS       PIC S9(09) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-TAX-MO-CENTS         PIC S9(09) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-DISPLAY-AMTS.
           05 WS-DISP-SHORT-MO        PIC S9(7)V99
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE CHARACTER.
           05 WS-DISP-TAX-MO          PIC S9(7)V99
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE CHARACTER.
           05 WS-DISP-TOTAL-MO        PIC S9(7)V99
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE CHARACTER.
       01 WS-COUNTERS.
           05 WS-MONTHS-NUM           PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = "Y"
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           .
       PROCESS-REC.
      * CONVERT TO CENTS FOR INTEGER DIVIDE WITH REMAINDER
           COMPUTE WS-SHORT-CENTS = ES-SHORTAGE-AMT * 100
           COMPUTE WS-TAX-CENTS = ES-ANNUAL-TAX-AMT * 100
           MOVE ES-MONTHS-SPREAD TO WS-MONTHS-NUM
           IF WS-MONTHS-NUM = 0
               MOVE 1 TO WS-MONTHS-NUM
           END-IF
      * SHORTAGE SPREAD
           DIVIDE WS-MONTHS-NUM INTO WS-SHORT-CENTS
               GIVING WS-SHORT-BASE-CENTS
               REMAINDER WS-SHORT-REM-CENTS
           END-DIVIDE
      * TAX SPREAD
           DIVIDE WS-MONTHS-NUM INTO WS-TAX-CENTS
               GIVING WS-TAX-BASE-CENTS
               REMAINDER WS-TAX-REM-CENTS
           END-DIVIDE
           PERFORM VARYING WS-MONTH-IX FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-MONTH-IX > WS-MONTHS-NUM
               MOVE WS-SHORT-BASE-CENTS TO WS-SHORT-MO-CENTS
               MOVE WS-TAX-BASE-CENTS TO WS-TAX-MO-CENTS
               MOVE "N" TO ES-OUT-REMAINDER-FLAG
               IF WS-MONTH-IX = WS-MONTHS-NUM
                   ADD WS-SHORT-REM-CENTS TO WS-SHORT-MO-CENTS
                   ADD WS-TAX-REM-CENTS TO WS-TAX-MO-CENTS
                   IF WS-SHORT-REM-CENTS NOT = 0
                       MOVE "R" TO ES-OUT-REMAINDER-FLAG
                   END-IF
               END-IF
               COMPUTE WS-DISP-SHORT-MO = WS-SHORT-MO-CENTS / 100
               COMPUTE WS-DISP-TAX-MO = WS-TAX-MO-CENTS / 100
               COMPUTE WS-DISP-TOTAL-MO = WS-DISP-SHORT-MO
                   + WS-DISP-TAX-MO
               MOVE ES-LOAN-ID TO ES-OUT-LOAN-ID
               MOVE WS-MONTH-IX TO ES-OUT-MONTH-NO
               MOVE WS-DISP-SHORT-MO TO ES-OUT-SHORTAGE-MO
               MOVE WS-DISP-TAX-MO TO ES-OUT-TAX-MO
               MOVE WS-DISP-TOTAL-MO TO ES-OUT-TOTAL-MO
               WRITE ES-OUTPUT-REC
           END-PERFORM
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 ES-INPUT-REC.
           05 ES-LOAN-ID              PIC X(10).
           05 ES-BORROWER-NAME        PIC X(20).
           05 ES-SHORTAGE-AMT         PIC S9(7)V99
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE CHARACTER.
           05 ES-MONTHS-SPREAD        PIC 9(03).
           05 ES-ANNUAL-TAX-AMT       PIC S9(7)V99
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE CHARACTER.
           05 ES-FILLER               PIC X(08).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 ES-OUTPUT-REC.
           05 ES-OUT-LOAN-ID          PIC X(10).
           05 ES-OUT-MONTH-NO         PIC 9(03).
           05 ES-OUT-SHORTAGE-MO      PIC S9(7)V99
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE CHARACTER.
           05 ES-OUT-TAX-MO           PIC S9(7)V99
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE CHARACTER.
           05 ES-OUT-TOTAL-MO         PIC S9(7)V99
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE CHARACTER.
           05 ES-OUT-REMAINDER-FLAG   PIC X(01).
