GEN0033.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0033.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  INFILE.
       COPY GEN0033I.
       FD  OUTFILE.
       COPY GEN0033O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG               PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
           88 WS-EOF                 VALUE "Y".
           88 WS-NOT-EOF             VALUE "N".
       01  WS-COUNTERS.
           05 WS-I                   PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-MONTH               PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-CALC-FIELDS.
           05 WS-FEE-CALC            PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-GROSS-CALC          PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-NET-CALC            PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-INSTALL-AMT         PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-HOLD-CUSTOMER          PIC X(08) VALUE SPACES.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ INFILE
                   AT END SET WS-EOF TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-ORDER
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE
           GOBACK
           .
       PROCESS-ORDER.
      * Standing order scheduling - split into installments
           MOVE IN-CUSTOMER-ID TO WS-HOLD-CUSTOMER
           IF IN-NUM-INSTALLMENTS = 0
               MOVE 1 TO IN-NUM-INSTALLMENTS
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-INSTALL-AMT ROUNDED =
               IN-ORDER-AMOUNT / IN-NUM-INSTALLMENTS
           END-COMPUTE
           MOVE IN-START-MONTH TO WS-MONTH
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-I > IN-NUM-INSTALLMENTS
               PERFORM CALC-FEE
               PERFORM BUILD-OUTPUT
               ADD 1 TO WS-MONTH
               IF WS-MONTH > 12
                   MOVE 1 TO WS-MONTH
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           .
       CALC-FEE.
      * COMPUTE ROUNDED then truncating MOVE into smaller field
           COMPUTE WS-FEE-CALC ROUNDED =
               WS-INSTALL-AMT * IN-FEE-RATE / 100
           END-COMPUTE
           COMPUTE WS-GROSS-CALC = WS-INSTALL-AMT
           END-COMPUTE
           COMPUTE WS-NET-CALC = WS-GROSS-CALC - WS-FEE-CALC
           END-COMPUTE
           .
       BUILD-OUTPUT.
           MOVE WS-HOLD-CUSTOMER TO OUT-CUSTOMER-ID
           MOVE WS-I TO OUT-INSTALLMENT-NO
           MOVE WS-MONTH TO OUT-SCHEDULED-MONTH
           MOVE WS-GROSS-CALC TO OUT-GROSS-AMOUNT
      * Truncating MOVE: WS-FEE-CALC 9(5)V99 into 999V99
           MOVE WS-FEE-CALC TO OUT-FEE-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-NET-CALC TO OUT-NET-AMOUNT
           MOVE IN-ORDER-TYPE TO OUT-ORDER-TYPE
           WRITE OUT-REC
           .
       END PROGRAM GEN0033.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 IN-CUSTOMER-ID         PIC X(08).
           05 IN-ORDER-AMOUNT        PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 IN-FEE-RATE            PIC 9(02)V999.
           05 IN-NUM-INSTALLMENTS    PIC 9(02).
           05 IN-START-MONTH         PIC 9(02).
           05 IN-ORDER-TYPE          PIC X(04).

              10 IN-TYPE-CODE        PIC X(02).
              10 IN-PRIORITY-FLAG    PIC X(02).
           05 FILLER                 PIC X(10).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.

GEN0035.name: GEN0035
GEN0035.technique: a control break with subtotals and a final trailer record
GEN0035.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0035.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0035I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0035O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG             PIC X VALUE 'N'.
           88 EOF-YES VALUE 'Y'.
           88 EOF-NO  VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-PREV-BRANCH          PIC X(04) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-FIRST-READ           PIC X VALUE 'Y'.
       01 WS-BRANCH-COUNT         PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-BRANCH-TOT-INT       PIC 9(09)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-BRANCH-TOT-CHG       PIC 9(09)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-GRAND-COUNT          PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-GRAND-TOT-INT        PIC 9(09)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-GRAND-TOT-CHG        PIC 9(09)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CALC-INTEREST        PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CALC-CHARGE          PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-DAILY-RATE            PIC 9(02)V99999 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
                OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM READ-NEXT
           PERFORM UNTIL EOF-YES
               IF WS-FIRST-READ = 'Y'
                   MOVE IN-BRANCH-CODE TO WS-PREV-BRANCH
                   MOVE 'N' TO WS-FIRST-READ
               END-IF
               IF IN-BRANCH-CODE NOT = WS-PREV-BRANCH
                   PERFORM WRITE-BRANCH-TRAILER
                   MOVE IN-BRANCH-CODE TO WS-PREV-BRANCH
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-BRANCH-COUNT
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-BRANCH-TOT-INT
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-BRANCH-TOT-CHG
               END-IF
               PERFORM CALC-INTEREST
               PERFORM WRITE-DETAIL
               ADD 1 TO WS-BRANCH-COUNT
               ADD 1 TO WS-GRAND-COUNT
               ADD WS-CALC-INTEREST TO WS-BRANCH-TOT-INT
               ADD WS-CALC-CHARGE TO WS-BRANCH-TOT-CHG
               ADD WS-CALC-INTEREST TO WS-GRAND-TOT-INT
               ADD WS-CALC-CHARGE TO WS-GRAND-TOT-CHG
               PERFORM READ-NEXT
           END-PERFORM
           IF WS-FIRST-READ = 'N'
               PERFORM WRITE-BRANCH-TRAILER
           END-IF
           PERFORM WRITE-FINAL-TRAILER
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       READ-NEXT.
           READ IN-FILE
               AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
               NOT AT END MOVE 'N' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
           END-READ.
       CALC-INTEREST.
           MOVE 0 TO WS-CALC-INTEREST
           MOVE 0 TO WS-CALC-CHARGE
           IF IN-OD-AMOUNT > 0 AND IN-OD-DAYS > 0
               COMPUTE WS-DAILY-RATE = IN-ANNUAL-RATE / 365
               COMPUTE WS-CALC-INTEREST ROUNDED =
                   IN-OD-AMOUNT * WS-DAILY-RATE * IN-OD-DAYS
                   / 100
               IF WS-CALC-INTEREST < 5.00
                   MOVE 5.00 TO WS-CALC-CHARGE
               ELSE
                   COMPUTE WS-CALC-CHARGE ROUNDED =
                       WS-CALC-INTEREST * 0.10 + 2.50
               END-IF
           ELSE
               MOVE 0 TO WS-CALC-CHARGE
           END-IF.
       WRITE-DETAIL.
           MOVE 'D' TO OUT-REC-TYPE
           MOVE IN-ACCT-NUMBER TO OUT-D-ACCT
           MOVE IN-BRANCH-CODE TO OUT-D-BRANCH
           MOVE WS-CALC-INTEREST TO OUT-D-INTEREST
           MOVE WS-CALC-CHARGE TO OUT-D-CHARGE
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-D-FILLER
           WRITE OUT-RECORD.
       WRITE-BRANCH-TRAILER.
           MOVE 'T' TO OUT-REC-TYPE
           MOVE WS-PREV-BRANCH TO OUT-T-BRANCH
           MOVE WS-BRANCH-COUNT TO OUT-T-COUNT
           MOVE WS-BRANCH-TOT-INT TO OUT-T-TOT-INT
           MOVE WS-BRANCH-TOT-CHG TO OUT-T-TOT-CHG
           MOVE 'B' TO OUT-T-FLAG
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-T-FILLER
           WRITE OUT-RECORD.
       WRITE-FINAL-TRAILER.
           MOVE 'T' TO OUT-REC-TYPE
           MOVE 'ALL ' TO OUT-T-BRANCH
           MOVE WS-GRAND-COUNT TO OUT-T-COUNT
           MOVE WS-GRAND-TOT-INT TO OUT-T-TOT-INT
           MOVE WS-GRAND-TOT-CHG TO OUT-T-TOT-CHG
           MOVE 'F' TO OUT-T-FLAG
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-T-FILLER
           WRITE OUT-RECORD.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-RECORD.
           05 IN-ACCT-NUMBER      PIC X(10).
           05 IN-BRANCH-CODE      PIC X(04).
           05 IN-CUSTOMER-NAME    PIC X(20).
           05 IN-OD-AMOUNT        PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3.
           05 IN-OD-DAYS          PIC 9(03).
           05 IN-ANNUAL-RATE      PIC 9(02)V99.
           05 IN-FILLER           PIC X(10).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-RECORD.
           05 OUT-REC-TYPE        PIC X(01).
           05 OUT-REC-BODY        PIC X(79).
           05 OUT-DETAIL REDEFINES OUT-REC-BODY.
               10 OUT-D-ACCT      PIC X(10).
               10 OUT-D-BRANCH    PIC X(04).
               10 OUT-D-INTEREST  PIC 9(07)V99.
               10 OUT-D-CHARGE    PIC 9(05)V99.
               10 OUT-D-FILLER    PIC X(49).
           05 OUT-TRAILER REDEFINES OUT-REC-BODY.
               10 OUT-T-BRANCH    PIC X(04).

       01 WS-TEMP-LATE             PIC S9(05)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.

           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = "Y"
               READ IN-FILE

                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-REC.
           ADD 1 TO WS-COUNTER
      * Compute discount amount from percentage.
           COMPUTE WS-DISCOUNT-AMT = IN-ANNUAL-FEE
               * IN-DISCOUNT-PCT / 100
           COMPUTE WS-SUBTOTAL = IN-ANNUAL-FEE
               + IN-INSURANCE-FEE - WS-DISCOUNT-AMT
           IF WS-SUBTOTAL < 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-SUBTOTAL
           END-IF
      * Late charge: fixed rate per day.
           IF IN-LATE-DAYS > 0
               COMPUTE WS-TEMP-LATE = IN-LATE-DAYS * WS-LATE-RATE

               MOVE IN-BRANCH-CODE TO OUT-BRANCH-CODE
               MOVE IN-BOX-SIZE TO OUT-BOX-SIZE
               MOVE IN-INSURANCE-FEE TO OUT-BASE-AMT
               MOVE 0 TO OUT-LATE-CHARGE
               MOVE IN-INSURANCE-FEE TO OUT-TOTAL-DUE
               MOVE "I" TO OUT-BILL-STATUS
               WRITE OUT-REC
           END-IF

               MOVE 0 TO WS-SUBTOTAL
           END-IF
      * Late charge: fixed rate per day.
           IF IN-LATE-DAYS > 0
               COMPUTE WS-TEMP-LATE = IN-LATE-DAYS * WS-LATE-RATE
           ELSE
               MOVE 0 TO WS-TEMP-LATE
           END-IF
           MOVE IN-BOX-ID TO OUT-BOX-ID
           MOVE IN-CUST-ID TO OUT-CUST-ID
           MOVE IN-BRANCH-CODE TO OUT-BRANCH-CODE
           MOVE IN-BOX-SIZE TO OUT-BOX-SIZE
           MOVE WS-SUBTOTAL TO OUT-BASE-AMT
           MOVE WS-TEMP-LATE TO OUT-LATE-CHARGE
           COMPUTE OUT-TOTAL-DUE = WS-SUBTOTAL + WS-TEMP-LATE
           IF OUT-TOTAL-DUE > 0
               MOVE "P" TO OUT-BILL-STATUS
           ELSE
               MOVE "Z" TO OUT-BILL-STATUS
           END-IF
           WRITE OUT-REC
      * Second record for large boxes includes insurance detail.
           IF IN-BOX-SIZE = "L"
               MOVE IN-BOX-ID TO OUT-BOX-ID
               MOVE IN-CUST-ID TO OUT-CUST-ID
               MOVE IN-BRANCH-CODE TO OUT-BRANCH-CODE
               MOVE IN-BOX-SIZE TO OUT-BOX-SIZE
               MOVE IN-INSURANCE-FEE TO OUT-BASE-AMT
               MOVE 0 TO OUT-LATE-CHARGE
               MOVE IN-INSURANCE-FEE TO OUT-TOTAL-DUE
               MOVE "I" TO OUT-BILL-STATUS
               WRITE OUT-REC
           END-IF
           .

GEN0043.name: GEN0043
GEN0043.technique: a control break with subtotals and a final trailer record
GEN0043.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0043.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
       COPY GEN0043I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0043O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG PIC X VALUE "N".
           88  WS-EOF VALUE "Y".
           88  WS-NOT-EOF VALUE "N".
       01  WS-PREV-TIER PIC X(02) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-FIRST-REC PIC X VALUE "Y".
           88  WS-IS-FIRST VALUE "Y".
       01  WS-CURR-FEE PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-SUB-COUNT PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-SUB-AMT PIC 9(09) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-SUB-FEE PIC 9(09) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-GRAND-COUNT PIC 9(07) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-GRAND-AMT PIC 9(11) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-GRAND-FEE PIC 9(11) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
               OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM READ-NEXT
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               PERFORM CALC-FEE-TIER
               PERFORM CHECK-BREAK
               PERFORM WRITE-DETAIL
               PERFORM UPDATE-TOTALS
               PERFORM READ-NEXT
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM WRITE-SUBTOTAL-IF-NEEDED
           PERFORM WRITE-TRAILER
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       READ-NEXT.
           READ IN-FILE
               AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
               NOT AT END CONTINUE
           END-READ.
       CALC-FEE-TIER.
           IF IN-TRANSFER-AMT < 10000
               MOVE 15 TO WS-CURR-FEE
           ELSE
               IF IN-TRANSFER-AMT < 50000
                   MOVE 25 TO WS-CURR-FEE
               ELSE
                   IF IN-TRANSFER-AMT < 100000
                       MOVE 35 TO WS-CURR-FEE
                   ELSE
                       MOVE 50 TO WS-CURR-FEE
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF
           IF IN-CUSTOMER-TIER = "PR"
               COMPUTE WS-CURR-FEE = WS-CURR-FEE - 5
           END-IF
           IF WS-CURR-FEE < 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-CURR-FEE
           END-IF.
       CHECK-BREAK.
           IF WS-IS-FIRST
               MOVE IN-CUSTOMER-TIER TO WS-PREV-TIER
               MOVE "N" TO WS-FIRST-REC
           ELSE
               IF IN-CUSTOMER-TIER NOT = WS-PREV-TIER
                   PERFORM WRITE-SUBTOTAL
                   MOVE IN-CUSTOMER-TIER TO WS-PREV-TIER
               END-IF
           END-IF.
       WRITE-DETAIL.
           MOVE "D" TO OUT-REC-TYPE
           MOVE IN-CUSTOMER-TIER TO OUT-TIER-CODE
           MOVE IN-TRANSFER-ID TO OUT-TRANSFER-ID
           MOVE IN-TRANSFER-AMT TO OUT-TRANSFER-AMT
           MOVE WS-CURR-FEE TO OUT-FEE-AMT
           MOVE IN-BRANCH-CODE TO OUT-BRANCH-CODE
           WRITE OUT-RECORD.
       UPDATE-TOTALS.
           ADD 1 TO WS-SUB-COUNT
           ADD IN-TRANSFER-AMT TO WS-SUB-AMT
           ADD WS-CURR-FEE TO WS-SUB-FEE
           ADD 1 TO WS-GRAND-COUNT
           ADD IN-TRANSFER-AMT TO WS-GRAND-AMT
           ADD WS-CURR-FEE TO WS-GRAND-FEE.
       WRITE-SUBTOTAL.
           MOVE "S" TO OUT-REC-TYPE
           MOVE WS-PREV-TIER TO OUT-TIER-CODE
           MOVE WS-SUB-COUNT TO OUT-SUB-COUNT
           MOVE WS-SUB-AMT TO OUT-SUB-AMT
           MOVE WS-SUB-FEE TO OUT-SUB-FEE
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-TRANSFER-ID
           WRITE OUT-RECORD
           MOVE 0 TO WS-SUB-COUNT WS-SUB-AMT WS-SUB-FEE.
       WRITE-SUBTOTAL-IF-NEEDED.
           IF WS-GRAND-COUNT > 0
               PERFORM WRITE-SUBTOTAL
           END-IF.
       WRITE-TRAILER.
           MOVE "T" TO OUT-REC-TYPE
           MOVE WS-GRAND-COUNT TO OUT-TRAILER-COUNT
           MOVE WS-GRAND-AMT TO OUT-TRAILER-AMT
           MOVE WS-GRAND-FEE TO OUT-TRAILER-FEE
           WRITE OUT-RECORD.
       END PROGRAM GEN0043.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  IN-RECORD.
           05  IN-TRANSFER-ID PIC X(10).
           05  IN-CUSTOMER-TIER PIC X(02).
           05  IN-BRANCH-CODE PIC X(04).
           05  IN-TRANSFER-AMT PIC 9(09).
           05  IN-BASE-FEE PIC 9(04).
           05  IN-TRANSFER-TYPE PIC X(01).
           05  IN-FILLER PIC X(08).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  OUT-RECORD.
           05  OUT-REC-TYPE PIC X(01).
           05  OUT-DETAIL-AREA.
               10  OUT-TIER-CODE PIC X(02).
               10  OUT-TRANSFER-ID PIC X(10).
               10  OUT-TRANSFER-AMT PIC 9(09).
               10  OUT-FEE-AMT PIC 9(05).
               10  OUT-BRANCH-CODE PIC X(04).
               10  OUT-SUB-COUNT PIC 9(06).
               10  OUT-SUB-AMT PIC 9(09).
               10  OUT-SUB-FEE PIC 9(09).
           05  OUT-TRAILER-AREA REDEFINES OUT-DETAIL-AREA.
               10  OUT-TRAILER-COUNT PIC 9(07).
               10  OUT-TRAILER-AMT PIC 9(11).
               10  OUT-TRAILER-FEE PIC 9(11).
               10  OUT-TRAILER-FILLER PIC X(17).

GEN0048.name: GEN0048
GEN0048.technique: a REDEFINES record with two record types
GEN0048.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0048.
      * STANDING ORDER SCHEDULING WITH REDEFINES.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD IN-FILE.
       COPY GEN0048I.
       FD OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0048O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-STATUS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG        PIC X VALUE "N".
               88 WS-EOF                 VALUE "Y".
               88 WS-NOT-EOF             VALUE "N".
           05 WS-REC-TYPE-HOLD   PIC X VALUE SPACE.
       01 WS-COUNTERS.
           05 WS-READ-CNT        PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-WRITE-CNT       PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-SEQ-NUM         PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-LOOP-IDX        PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-GEN-COUNT       PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-HOLD-FIELDS.
           05 WS-HOLD-ACCT       PIC 9(10) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-HOLD-AMT        PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-HOLD-DATE       PIC 9(08) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-HOLD-DAY        PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CALC-FIELDS.
           05 WS-BASE-DATE       PIC 9(08) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-NEXT-DATE       PIC 9(08) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-AMT-DISPLAY     PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
                OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-ONE-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           .
       PROCESS-ONE-REC.
           ADD 1 TO WS-READ-CNT
           MOVE I-REC-TYPE TO WS-REC-TYPE-HOLD
           EVALUATE WS-REC-TYPE-HOLD
               WHEN "S" PERFORM HANDLE-TYPE-S
               WHEN "C" PERFORM HANDLE-TYPE-C
               WHEN OTHER PERFORM HANDLE-DEFAULT
           END-EVALUATE
           .
       HANDLE-TYPE-S.
      * TYPE S : SINGLE STANDING ORDER
           MOVE S-ACCT-NUM TO WS-HOLD-ACCT
           MOVE S-AMOUNT TO WS-HOLD-AMT
           MOVE S-START-DATE TO WS-HOLD-DATE
           MOVE 1 TO WS-GEN-COUNT
           PERFORM VARYING WS-LOOP-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-LOOP-IDX > WS-GEN-COUNT
               MOVE WS-LOOP-IDX TO WS-SEQ-NUM
               PERFORM BUILD-AND-WRITE
           END-PERFORM
           .
       HANDLE-TYPE-C.
      * TYPE C : CUSTOM SCHEDULE MULTIPLE PAYMENTS
           MOVE C-ACCT-NUM TO WS-HOLD-ACCT
           MOVE C-AMOUNT TO WS-HOLD-AMT
           MOVE C-START-DATE TO WS-HOLD-DATE
           MOVE C-DAY-OF-MON TO WS-HOLD-DAY
           IF C-NUM-PAYMENTS < 1
               MOVE 1 TO WS-GEN-COUNT
           ELSE
               IF C-NUM-PAYMENTS > 4
                   MOVE 4 TO WS-GEN-COUNT
               ELSE
                   MOVE C-NUM-PAYMENTS TO WS-GEN-COUNT
               END-IF
           END-IF
           PERFORM VARYING WS-LOOP-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-LOOP-IDX > WS-GEN-COUNT
               MOVE WS-LOOP-IDX TO WS-SEQ-NUM
               PERFORM BUILD-AND-WRITE
           END-PERFORM
           .
       HANDLE-DEFAULT.
      * UNKNOWN TYPE STILL PRODUCES ONE OUTPUT FOR AUDIT
           IF I-REC-TYPE = SPACE
               MOVE 0 TO WS-HOLD-ACCT
           ELSE
               MOVE S-ACCT-NUM TO WS-HOLD-ACCT
           END-IF
           MOVE 0 TO WS-HOLD-AMT
           MOVE 20250101 TO WS-HOLD-DATE
           MOVE 1 TO WS-GEN-COUNT
           MOVE 1 TO WS-SEQ-NUM
           MOVE 1 TO WS-LOOP-IDX
           PERFORM BUILD-AND-WRITE
           .
       BUILD-AND-WRITE.
           MOVE WS-HOLD-ACCT TO O-ACCT-NUM
           MOVE WS-HOLD-AMT TO O-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-HOLD-DATE TO O-DUE-DATE
           MOVE WS-SEQ-NUM TO O-SEQ-NO
           MOVE WS-REC-TYPE-HOLD TO O-SRC-TYPE
           MOVE WS-READ-CNT TO O-BATCH-SEQ
           IF WS-LOOP-IDX = 1
               MOVE "FIRST " TO O-DESC
           ELSE
               MOVE "FOLLOW" TO O-DESC
           END-IF
           WRITE O-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
           ADD WS-LOOP-IDX TO WS-HOLD-DATE
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 I-REC.
           05 I-REC-TYPE        PIC X.
           05 I-PAYLOAD         PIC X(42).
           05 I-TYPE-S REDEFINES I-PAYLOAD.
               10 S-ACCT-NUM    PIC 9(10).
               10 S-AMOUNT      PIC 9(07)V99.
               10 S-FREQ-CODE   PIC X(02).
               10 S-START-DATE  PIC 9(08).
               10 S-CURRENCY    PIC X(03).
               10 FILLER        PIC X(10).
           05 I-TYPE-C REDEFINES I-PAYLOAD.
               10 C-ACCT-NUM    PIC 9(10).
               10 C-AMOUNT      PIC 9(07)V99.
               10 C-DAY-OF-MON  PIC 9(02).
               10 C-NUM-PAYMENTS PIC 9(03).
               10 C-START-DATE  PIC 9(08).
               10 FILLER        PIC X(08).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 O-REC.
           05 O-ACCT-NUM        PIC 9(10).
           05 O-AMOUNT          PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 O-DUE-DATE        PIC 9(08).
           05 O-SEQ-NO          PIC 9(03).
           05 O-SRC-TYPE        PIC X.
           05 O-BATCH-SEQ       PIC 9(05).
           05 O-DESC            PIC X(06).
           05 FILLER            PIC X(05).

GEN0045.name: GEN0045
GEN0045.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0045.
      * ESCROW SHORTAGE SPREADING
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  INFILE.
           COPY GEN0045I.
       FD  OUTFILE.
           COPY GEN0045O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG              PIC X(01) VALUE 'N'.
           88 WS-EOF               VALUE 'Y'.
           88 WS-NOT-EOF           VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-CALC-FIELDS.
           05 WS-SHORTAGE-CALC      PIC S9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-BASE-PMT           PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-MONTHLY-ADJ        PIC S9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-NEW-PMT            PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-SPREAD-MOS         PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-CLASS-TEXT         PIC X(12) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-STATUS-TEXT        PIC X(10) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-SHORTAGE-BUCKET       PIC 9(01) VALUE 0.
           88 BK-NONE              VALUE 0.
           88 BK-MINOR             VALUE 1.
           88 BK-MODERATE          VALUE 2.
           88 BK-SEVERE            VALUE 3.
       01 WS-BALANCE-CHECK         PIC X(01) VALUE 'N'.
           88 BAL-NEGATIVE         VALUE 'Y'.
           88 BAL-POSITIVE         VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-THRESHOLDS.
           05 WS-MINOR-LIMIT        PIC 9(04)V99 VALUE 0500.00.
           05 WS-MOD-LIMIT          PIC 9(04)V99 VALUE 1500.00.
           05 WS-SEV-LIMIT          PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 99999.00.
      * WORK COUNTERS
       01 WS-COUNTS.
           05 WS-READ-CNT           PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-WRITE-CNT          PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       000-MAIN SECTION.
           PERFORM 100-OPEN-FILES
           PERFORM 200-PROCESS-LOOP UNTIL WS-EOF
           PERFORM 300-CLOSE-FILES
           GOBACK
           .
       100-OPEN-FILES SECTION.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           .
       200-PROCESS-LOOP SECTION.
           READ INFILE
               AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
               NOT AT END PERFORM 210-HANDLE-RECORD
           END-READ
           .
       210-HANDLE-RECORD SECTION.
           ADD 1 TO WS-READ-CNT
      * COMPUTE SHORTAGE FROM INPUT FIELDS
           COMPUTE WS-SHORTAGE-CALC = IN-ESCROW-REQUIRED
               - IN-ESCROW-BALANCE
           END-COMPUTE
           IF WS-SHORTAGE-CALC < 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-SHORTAGE-CALC
           END-IF
      * OVERRIDE WITH EXPLICIT SHORTAGE IF PROVIDED
           IF IN-SHORTAGE-AMT > WS-SHORTAGE-CALC
               MOVE IN-SHORTAGE-AMT TO WS-SHORTAGE-CALC
           END-IF
      * DETERMINE BASE MONTHLY ESCROW PAYMENT
           COMPUTE WS-BASE-PMT = IN-ANNUAL-TAXES / 12
           END-COMPUTE
      * CLASSIFY SHORTAGE FOR SPREADING
           PERFORM 220-CLASSIFY-SHORTAGE
      * SPREAD USING EVALUATE TRUE OVER 88 LEVELS
           PERFORM 230-SPREAD-EVALUATE
      * BUILD OUTPUT RECORD
           PERFORM 240-BUILD-OUTPUT
           WRITE OUTPUT-REC-GEN0045
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
           .
       220-CLASSIFY-SHORTAGE SECTION.
           MOVE 0 TO WS-SHORTAGE-BUCKET
           IF WS-SHORTAGE-CALC = 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-SHORTAGE-BUCKET
           ELSE
               IF WS-SHORTAGE-CALC <= WS-MINOR-LIMIT
                   MOVE 1 TO WS-SHORTAGE-BUCKET
               ELSE
                   IF WS-SHORTAGE-CALC <= WS-MOD-LIMIT
                       MOVE 2 TO WS-SHORTAGE-BUCKET
                   ELSE
                       MOVE 3 TO WS-SHORTAGE-BUCKET
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF
      * SET BALANCE FLAG FOR EVALUATE DEMO
           IF IN-ESCROW-BALANCE < 0
               MOVE 'Y' TO WS-BALANCE-CHECK
           ELSE
               MOVE 'N' TO WS-BALANCE-CHECK
           END-IF
           .
       230-SPREAD-EVALUATE SECTION.
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN BK-NONE
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-SPREAD-MOS
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-MONTHLY-ADJ
                   MOVE "NONE        " TO WS-CLASS-TEXT
                   MOVE "CURRENT   " TO WS-STATUS-TEXT
               WHEN BK-MINOR
                   MOVE 12 TO WS-SPREAD-MOS
                   COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-ADJ =
                       WS-SHORTAGE-CALC / 12
                   END-COMPUTE
                   MOVE "MINOR       " TO WS-CLASS-TEXT
                   MOVE "SPREAD-12 " TO WS-STATUS-TEXT
               WHEN BK-MODERATE
                   MOVE 24 TO WS-SPREAD-MOS
                   COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-ADJ =
                       WS-SHORTAGE-CALC / 24
                   END-COMPUTE
                   MOVE "MODERATE    " TO WS-CLASS-TEXT
                   MOVE "SPREAD-24 " TO WS-STATUS-TEXT
               WHEN BK-SEVERE
                   MOVE 36 TO WS-SPREAD-MOS
                   COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-ADJ =
                       WS-SHORTAGE-CALC / 36
                   END-COMPUTE
                   MOVE "SEVERE      " TO WS-CLASS-TEXT
                   MOVE "SPREAD-36 " TO WS-STATUS-TEXT
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 12 TO WS-SPREAD-MOS
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-MONTHLY-ADJ
                   MOVE "UNKNOWN     " TO WS-CLASS-TEXT
                   MOVE "REVIEW    " TO WS-STATUS-TEXT
           END-EVALUATE
      * SECOND EVALUATE TRUE SHOWING BALANCE CONDITION
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN BAL-NEGATIVE
                   MOVE "HOLD      " TO WS-STATUS-TEXT
               WHEN BAL-POSITIVE
                   CONTINUE
               WHEN OTHER
                   CONTINUE
           END-EVALUATE
           COMPUTE WS-NEW-PMT = WS-BASE-PMT + WS-MONTHLY-ADJ
           END-COMPUTE
           .
       240-BUILD-OUTPUT SECTION.
           MOVE IN-LOAN-NO TO OUT-LOAN-NO
           MOVE WS-CLASS-TEXT TO OUT-SHORTAGE-CLASS
           MOVE WS-SPREAD-MOS TO OUT-SPREAD-MONTHS
           MOVE WS-MONTHLY-ADJ TO OUT-MONTHLY-ADJ
           MOVE WS-NEW-PMT TO OUT-NEW-ESCROW-PMT
           MOVE WS-STATUS-TEXT TO OUT-ESCROW-STATUS
           .
       300-CLOSE-FILES SECTION.
           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 INPUT-REC-GEN0045.
           05 IN-LOAN-NO              PIC X(10).
           05 IN-ESCROW-BALANCE       PIC 9(7)V99.
           05 IN-ESCROW-REQUIRED      PIC 9(7)V99.
           05 IN-ANNUAL-TAXES         PIC 9(6)V99.
           05 IN-PROP-TYPE            PIC X(02).
           05 IN-SHORTAGE-AMT         PIC S9(6)V99.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUTPUT-REC-GEN0045.
           05 OUT-LOAN-NO              PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-SHORTAGE-CLASS       PIC X(12).
           05 OUT-SPREAD-MONTHS        PIC 9(02).
           05 OUT-MONTHLY-ADJ           PIC S9(5)V99.
           05 OUT-NEW-ESCROW-PMT       PIC 9(06)V99.
           05 OUT-ESCROW-STATUS        PIC X(10).

GEN0044.name: GEN0044
GEN0044.technique: an OCCURS table searched with PERFORM VARYING
GEN0044.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0044.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0044I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0044O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG          PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
       01 WS-DLY-LIM           PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-PTX-LIM           PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-NEW-TOT           PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-REMAIN            PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 0.

       01 WS-LIMIT-TABLE.
           05 WS-ENT OCCURS 5 TIMES.
               10 WS-TBL-TYPE  PIC X(02).
               10 WS-TBL-DLY   PIC 9(05)V99.
               10 WS-TBL-PTX   PIC 9(05)V99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           PERFORM INIT-TABLE
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = "Y"
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROC-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       INIT-TABLE.
           MOVE "CH" TO WS-TBL-TYPE(1)
           MOVE 1000.00 TO WS-TBL-DLY(1)
           MOVE 500.00 TO WS-TBL-PTX(1)
           MOVE "SV" TO WS-TBL-TYPE(2)
           MOVE 800.00 TO WS-TBL-DLY(2)
           MOVE 300.00 TO WS-TBL-PTX(2)
           MOVE "PR" TO WS-TBL-TYPE(3)
           MOVE 2000.00 TO WS-TBL-DLY(3)
           MOVE 1000.00 TO WS-TBL-PTX(3)
           MOVE "ST" TO WS-TBL-TYPE(4)
           MOVE 500.00 TO WS-TBL-DLY(4)
           MOVE 200.00 TO WS-TBL-PTX(4)
           MOVE "BU" TO WS-TBL-TYPE(5)
           MOVE 5000.00 TO WS-TBL-DLY(5)
           MOVE 1500.00 TO WS-TBL-PTX(5).
       PROC-REC.
           MOVE "N" TO WS-FOUND
           MOVE 800.00 TO WS-DLY-LIM
           MOVE 300.00 TO WS-PTX-LIM
           PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
             UNTIL WS-IDX > 5
               IF WS-TBL-TYPE(WS-IDX) = AI-ACCT-TYPE
                   MOVE WS-TBL-DLY(WS-IDX) TO WS-DLY-LIM
                   MOVE WS-TBL-PTX(WS-IDX) TO WS-PTX-LIM
                   MOVE "Y" TO WS-FOUND
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           COMPUTE WS-NEW-TOT = AI-DLY-TOT + AI-REQ-AMT
           IF AI-TRN-CODE NOT = "WDR "
               MOVE "REJECT  " TO WS-DECISION
               MOVE 0 TO WS-APPROVED
               MOVE "R01" TO WS-REASON
               COMPUTE WS-REMAIN = WS-DLY-LIM - AI-DLY-TOT
           ELSE
               IF AI-REQ-AMT > WS-PTX-LIM
                   MOVE "REJECT  " TO WS-DECISION
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-APPROVED
                   MOVE "R02" TO WS-REASON
                   COMPUTE WS-REMAIN = WS-DLY-LIM - AI-DLY-TOT
               ELSE
                   IF WS-NEW-TOT > WS-DLY-LIM
                       MOVE "REJECT  " TO WS-DECISION
                       MOVE 0 TO WS-APPROVED
                       MOVE "R03" TO WS-REASON
                       COMPUTE WS-REMAIN = WS-DLY-LIM -
                         AI-DLY-TOT
                   ELSE
                       MOVE "APPROVE " TO WS-DECISION
                       MOVE AI-REQ-AMT TO WS-APPROVED
                       MOVE "A00" TO WS-REASON
                       COMPUTE WS-REMAIN = WS-DLY-LIM -
                         WS-NEW-TOT
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF
           PERFORM WRITE-OUT.
       WRITE-OUT.
           MOVE AI-ACCT-NUM TO AO-ACCT-NUM
           MOVE WS-DECISION TO AO-DECISION
           MOVE WS-APPROVED TO AO-APP-AMT
           MOVE WS-REMAIN TO AO-REM-LIM
           MOVE WS-REASON TO AO-REASON
           WRITE ATM-OUT-REC.
       END PROGRAM GEN0044.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 ATM-IN-REC.
           05 AI-ACCT-NUM      PIC X(10).
           05 AI-ACCT-TYPE     PIC X(02).
           05 AI-REQ-AMT       PIC 9(05)V99 COMP-3.
           05 AI-DLY-TOT       PIC 9(05)V99 COMP-3.
           05 AI-TRN-CODE      PIC X(04).
           05 FILLER           PIC X(10).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 ATM-OUT-REC.
           05 AO-ACCT-NUM      PIC X(10).
           05 AO-DECISION      PIC X(08).
           05 AO-APP-AMT       PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 AO-REM-LIM       PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 AO-REASON        PIC X(03).
           05 FILLER           PIC X(10).

GEN0046.name: GEN0046
GEN0046.technique: SIGN LEADING SEPARATE amounts and DIVIDE ... REMAINDER
GEN0046.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0046.
      * SAVINGS DIVIDEND POSTING FICTIONAL
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD IN-FILE.
       COPY GEN0046I.
       FD OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0046O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG PIC X VALUE "N".
               88 WS-EOF VALUE "Y".
               88 WS-NOT-EOF VALUE "N".
       01 WS-COUNTS.
           05 WS-IN-CNT PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-OUT-CNT PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CALC.
           05 WS-PRODUCT PIC S9(9)V999
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 WS-NUMERATOR PIC S9(9)V999
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 WS-DIVISOR PIC S9(4) VALUE +1000.
           05 WS-DIVD-AMT PIC S9(7)V99
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 WS-REM-AMT PIC S9(5)V999
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 WS-NEW-BAL PIC S9(7)V99
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 WS-QUOTIENT PIC S9(7) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-REM-CENTS PIC S9(5) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-WORK-CENTS PIC S9(9) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-MONTH-Q PIC S9(7) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-MONTH-R PIC S9(5) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM DO-POST
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           STOP RUN.
       DO-POST.
           ADD 1 TO WS-IN-CNT
           MULTIPLY BEGIN-BAL BY ANNUAL-RATE
               GIVING WS-PRODUCT
           MOVE WS-PRODUCT TO WS-NUMERATOR
           COMPUTE WS-WORK-CENTS = WS-NUMERATOR * 100
           DIVIDE WS-WORK-CENTS BY 1000
               GIVING WS-QUOTIENT REMAINDER WS-REM-CENTS
           COMPUTE WS-DIVD-AMT = WS-QUOTIENT / 100
           COMPUTE WS-REM-AMT = WS-REM-CENTS / 100000
           DIVIDE WS-QUOTIENT BY 12
               GIVING WS-MONTH-Q REMAINDER WS-MONTH-R
           ADD WS-DIVD-AMT TO BEGIN-BAL GIVING WS-NEW-BAL
           PERFORM WRITE-OUT
           ADD 1 TO WS-OUT-CNT.
       WRITE-OUT.
           MOVE ACCT-NUM TO OUT-ACCT-NUM
           MOVE CUST-NAME TO OUT-CUST-NAME
           MOVE BEGIN-BAL TO OUT-BEGIN-BAL
           MOVE WS-DIVD-AMT TO OUT-DIVIDEND-AMT
           MOVE WS-REM-CENTS TO OUT-REMAINDER-CENTS
           MOVE WS-NEW-BAL TO OUT-NEW-BAL
           MOVE ANNUAL-RATE TO OUT-RATE-APPLIED
           MOVE WS-MONTH-Q TO OUT-MONTH-QUOT
           MOVE WS-MONTH-R TO OUT-MONTH-REM
           WRITE OUT-REC
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 ACCT-NUM PIC X(10).
           05 CUST-NAME PIC X(20).
           05 BEGIN-BAL PIC S9(7)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 ANNUAL-RATE PIC S9(3)V999 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 BRANCH-CODE PIC X(4).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-ACCT-NUM PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-CUST-NAME PIC X(20).
           05 OUT-BEGIN-BAL PIC S9(7)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 OUT-DIVIDEND-AMT PIC S9(7)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 OUT-REMAINDER-CENTS PIC S9(5).
           05 OUT-NEW-BAL PIC S9(7)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 OUT-RATE-APPLIED PIC S9(3)V999 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 OUT-MONTH-QUOT PIC S9(7).
           05 OUT-MONTH-REM PIC S9(5).

GEN0050.name: GEN0050
GEN0050.technique: packed decimal (COMP-3) amounts and signed totals
GEN0050.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0050.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  INFILE.
       COPY GEN0050I.
       FD  OUTFILE.
       COPY GEN0050O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG           PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
       01  WS-TOTALS.
           05 WS-TOT-OD-AMT      PIC S9(9)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-TOT-CHARGE      PIC S9(9)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-TOT-NEW-BAL     PIC S9(9)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-REC-COUNT       PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-CALC-FIELDS.
           05 WS-OD-AMOUNT       PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-DAILY-RATE      PIC S9(04)V9999 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-INT-CHARGE      PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-NEW-BALANCE     PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-RATE-ADJ        PIC S9(02)V999 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = "Y"
               READ INFILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM WRITE-TRAILER
           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-REC.
           ADD 1 TO WS-REC-COUNT
      * DETERMINE OVERDRAFT AMOUNT
           IF IN-BALANCE < 0
               MOVE IN-BALANCE TO WS-OD-AMOUNT
           ELSE
               MOVE 0 TO WS-OD-AMOUNT
           END-IF
      * APPLY RATE GROUP ADJUSTMENT
           IF IN-RATE-GROUP = 01
               MOVE IN-ANNUAL-RATE TO WS-RATE-ADJ
           ELSE
               IF IN-RATE-GROUP = 02
                   COMPUTE WS-RATE-ADJ = IN-ANNUAL-RATE
                     + 0.015
               ELSE
                   COMPUTE WS-RATE-ADJ = IN-ANNUAL-RATE
                     + 0.030
               END-IF
           END-IF
      * CALCULATE DAILY RATE AND CHARGE
           COMPUTE WS-DAILY-RATE = WS-RATE-ADJ / 365
           IF WS-OD-AMOUNT < 0 AND IN-DAYS-OD > 0
               COMPUTE WS-INT-CHARGE = WS-OD-AMOUNT
                 * WS-DAILY-RATE * IN-DAYS-OD
               COMPUTE WS-INT-CHARGE = WS-INT-CHARGE * -1
           ELSE
               MOVE 0 TO WS-INT-CHARGE
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-NEW-BALANCE = IN-BALANCE - WS-INT-CHARGE
      * POPULATE OUTPUT
           MOVE IN-ACCT-NO TO OUT-ACCT-NO
           MOVE IN-CUST-NAME TO OUT-ACCT-NAME
           MOVE WS-OD-AMOUNT TO OUT-OD-AMOUNT
           MOVE IN-DAYS-OD TO OUT-DAYS-OD
           MOVE WS-RATE-ADJ TO OUT-INT-RATE
           MOVE WS-INT-CHARGE TO OUT-INT-CHARGE
           MOVE WS-NEW-BALANCE TO OUT-NEW-BALANCE
           IF WS-INT-CHARGE > 50
               MOVE "02" TO OUT-CHARGE-CODE
           ELSE
               MOVE "01" TO OUT-CHARGE-CODE
           END-IF
           MOVE "D" TO OUT-TOTAL-FLAG
           ADD WS-OD-AMOUNT TO WS-TOT-OD-AMT
           ADD WS-INT-CHARGE TO WS-TOT-CHARGE
           ADD WS-NEW-BALANCE TO WS-TOT-NEW-BAL
           WRITE OUT-CHARGE-REC
           . 
       WRITE-TRAILER.
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-CHARGE-REC
           MOVE "TRAILER" TO OUT-ACCT-NO
           MOVE WS-TOT-OD-AMT TO OUT-OD-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-TOT-CHARGE TO OUT-INT-CHARGE
           MOVE WS-TOT-NEW-BAL TO OUT-NEW-BALANCE
           MOVE "99" TO OUT-CHARGE-CODE
           MOVE "T" TO OUT-TOTAL-FLAG
           WRITE OUT-CHARGE-REC
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-OVERDRAFT-REC.
           05 IN-ACCT-NO         PIC X(10).
           05 IN-CUST-NAME       PIC X(20).
           05 IN-BALANCE         PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
           05 IN-OD-LIMIT        PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
           05 IN-DAYS-OD         PIC 9(03).
           05 IN-ANNUAL-RATE     PIC S9(02)V999 COMP-3.
           05 IN-RATE-GROUP      PIC X(02).
           05 FILLER REDEFINES IN-RATE-GROUP PIC 9(02).
           05 IN-ACCT-TYPE       PIC X(01).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-CHARGE-REC.
           05 OUT-ACCT-NO         PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-ACCT-NAME      PIC X(20).
           05 OUT-OD-AMOUNT      PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
           05 OUT-DAYS-OD        PIC 9(03).
           05 OUT-INT-RATE       PIC S9(02)V99 COMP-3.
           05 OUT-INT-CHARGE     PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
           05 OUT-NEW-BALANCE    PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
           05 OUT-CHARGE-CODE    PIC X(02).
           05 FILLER REDEFINES OUT-CHARGE-CODE PIC 9(02).
           05 OUT-TOTAL-FLAG     PIC X(01).

GEN0051.name: GEN0051
GEN0051.technique: a control break with subtotals and a final trailer record
GEN0051.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0051.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0051I.
       FD OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0051O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG               PIC X VALUE "N".
       01 WS-PREV-BRANCH            PIC X(04) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-FIRST-REC              PIC X VALUE "Y".
       01 WS-BRANCH-CNT             PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-BRANCH-PRINCIPAL       PIC 9(09)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-BRANCH-INTEREST        PIC 9(09)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-BRANCH-MATURITY        PIC 9(09)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-GRAND-CNT              PIC 9(07) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-GRAND-PRINCIPAL        PIC 9(11)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-GRAND-INTEREST         PIC 9(11)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-GRAND-MATURITY         PIC 9(11)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CALC-INTEREST          PIC 9(09)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CALC-MATURITY          PIC 9(09)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-RATE-DECIMAL           PIC 9V9999 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM READ-NEXT
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = "Y"
               IF WS-FIRST-REC = "Y"
                   MOVE IN-BRANCH-CODE OF GEN0051I-RECORD
                     TO WS-PREV-BRANCH
                   MOVE "N" TO WS-FIRST-REC
               END-IF
               IF IN-BRANCH-CODE OF GEN0051I-RECORD
                  NOT = WS-PREV-BRANCH
                   PERFORM WRITE-BRANCH-TOTAL
               END-IF
               PERFORM PROCESS-DETAIL
               PERFORM READ-NEXT
           END-PERFORM
           IF WS-BRANCH-CNT > 0
               PERFORM WRITE-BRANCH-TOTAL
           END-IF
           PERFORM WRITE-TRAILER
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       READ-NEXT.
           READ IN-FILE
               AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
               NOT AT END CONTINUE
           END-READ.
       PROCESS-DETAIL.
           COMPUTE WS-RATE-DECIMAL =
               IN-INTEREST-RATE OF GEN0051I-RECORD / 100
           COMPUTE WS-CALC-INTEREST =
               IN-PRINCIPAL-AMT OF GEN0051I-RECORD
               * WS-RATE-DECIMAL
               * IN-TERM-MONTHS OF GEN0051I-RECORD / 12
           COMPUTE WS-CALC-MATURITY =
               IN-PRINCIPAL-AMT OF GEN0051I-RECORD
               + WS-CALC-INTEREST
           MOVE "D" TO OUT-REC-TYPE OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE IN-BRANCH-CODE OF GEN0051I-RECORD
             TO OUT-BRANCH-CODE OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE IN-ACCOUNT-NUM OF GEN0051I-RECORD
             TO OUT-ACCOUNT-NUM OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE IN-PRINCIPAL-AMT OF GEN0051I-RECORD
             TO OUT-PRINCIPAL-AMT OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE WS-CALC-INTEREST
             TO OUT-INTEREST-AMT OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE WS-CALC-MATURITY
             TO OUT-MATURITY-AMT OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE IN-TERM-MONTHS OF GEN0051I-RECORD
             TO OUT-TERM-MONTHS OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-FILLER-TEXT OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           WRITE GEN0051O-RECORD
           ADD 1 TO WS-BRANCH-CNT
           ADD 1 TO WS-GRAND-CNT
           ADD IN-PRINCIPAL-AMT OF GEN0051I-RECORD
               TO WS-BRANCH-PRINCIPAL
           ADD WS-CALC-INTEREST TO WS-BRANCH-INTEREST
           ADD WS-CALC-MATURITY TO WS-BRANCH-MATURITY
           ADD IN-PRINCIPAL-AMT OF GEN0051I-RECORD
               TO WS-GRAND-PRINCIPAL
           ADD WS-CALC-INTEREST TO WS-GRAND-INTEREST
           ADD WS-CALC-MATURITY TO WS-GRAND-MATURITY.
       WRITE-BRANCH-TOTAL.
           MOVE "S" TO OUT-REC-TYPE OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE WS-PREV-BRANCH
             TO OUT-BRANCH-CODE OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-ACCOUNT-NUM OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE WS-BRANCH-PRINCIPAL
             TO OUT-PRINCIPAL-AMT OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE WS-BRANCH-INTEREST
             TO OUT-INTEREST-AMT OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE WS-BRANCH-MATURITY
             TO OUT-MATURITY-AMT OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE WS-BRANCH-CNT
             TO OUT-TERM-MONTHS OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE "BRANCH TOTAL" 
             TO OUT-FILLER-TEXT OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           WRITE GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE IN-BRANCH-CODE OF GEN0051I-RECORD
             TO WS-PREV-BRANCH
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BRANCH-CNT
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BRANCH-PRINCIPAL
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BRANCH-INTEREST
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BRANCH-MATURITY.
       WRITE-TRAILER.
           MOVE "T" TO OUT-REC-TYPE OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE "9999" TO OUT-BRANCH-CODE OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-ACCOUNT-NUM OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE WS-GRAND-PRINCIPAL
             TO OUT-PRINCIPAL-AMT OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE WS-GRAND-INTEREST
             TO OUT-INTEREST-AMT OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE WS-GRAND-MATURITY
             TO OUT-MATURITY-AMT OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE WS-GRAND-CNT
             TO OUT-TERM-MONTHS OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           MOVE "FINAL TRAILER" 
             TO OUT-FILLER-TEXT OF GEN0051O-RECORD
           WRITE GEN0051O-RECORD.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 GEN0051I-RECORD.
           05 IN-BRANCH-CODE        PIC X(04).
           05 IN-ACCOUNT-NUM        PIC X(10).
           05 IN-CUSTOMER-NAME      PIC X(20).
           05 IN-PRINCIPAL-AMT      PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 IN-INTEREST-RATE      PIC 9(02)V99.
           05 IN-TERM-MONTHS        PIC 9(03).
           05 IN-CURRENCY-CODE      PIC X(03).
           05 FILLER                PIC X(10).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 GEN0051O-RECORD.
           05 OUT-REC-TYPE          PIC X.
           05 OUT-BRANCH-CODE       PIC X(04).
           05 OUT-ACCOUNT-NUM       PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-PRINCIPAL-AMT     PIC 9(11)V99.
           05 OUT-INTEREST-AMT      PIC 9(11)V99.
           05 OUT-MATURITY-AMT      PIC 9(11)V99.
           05 OUT-TERM-MONTHS       PIC 9(05).
           05 OUT-FILLER-TEXT       PIC X(20).
           05 FILLER                PIC X(05).

GEN0052.name: GEN0052
GEN0052.technique: an OCCURS table searched with PERFORM VARYING
GEN0052.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0052.
      * TELLER CASH DRAWER BALANCING - TABLE SEARCH WITH
      * PERFORM VARYING OVER DENOMINATION/BALANCE RANGE
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
       COPY GEN0052I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0052O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG       PIC X VALUE "N".
               88 WS-EOF        VALUE "Y".
               88 WS-NOT-EOF    VALUE "N".
       01  WS-CALC.
           05 WS-EXPECTED-BAL  PIC S9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-ACTUAL-BAL    PIC S9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-DIFFERENCE    PIC S9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-ABS-DIFF      PIC  9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-CAT-CODE      PIC 9 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-CAT-TEXT      PIC X(10) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-IDX              PIC 99 VALUE 0.
       01  BAL-RANGE-TABLE.
           05 BR-ENTRY OCCURS 5 TIMES.
               10 BR-LOW       PIC 9(07)V99.
               10 BR-HIGH      PIC 9(07)V99.
               10 BR-LABEL     PIC X(10).
       01  DENOM-TABLE.
           05 DN-ENTRY OCCURS 6 TIMES.
               10 DN-VALUE     PIC 9(04)V99.
               10 DN-COUNT     PIC 9(04).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           PERFORM INIT-TABLES
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       INIT-TABLES.
           MOVE 0 TO BR-LOW(1)
           MOVE 9.99 TO BR-HIGH(1)
           MOVE "TINY      " TO BR-LABEL(1)
           MOVE 10.00 TO BR-LOW(2)
           MOVE 99.99 TO BR-HIGH(2)
           MOVE "SMALL     " TO BR-LABEL(2)
           MOVE 100.00 TO BR-LOW(3)
           MOVE 999.99 TO BR-HIGH(3)
           MOVE "MEDIUM    " TO BR-LABEL(3)
           MOVE 1000.00 TO BR-LOW(4)
           MOVE 9999.99 TO BR-HIGH(4)
           MOVE "LARGE     " TO BR-LABEL(4)
           MOVE 10000.00 TO BR-LOW(5)
           MOVE 99999.99 TO BR-HIGH(5)
           MOVE "HUGE      " TO BR-LABEL(5)
           MOVE 100.00 TO DN-VALUE(1)
           MOVE 50.00 TO DN-VALUE(2)
           MOVE 20.00 TO DN-VALUE(3)
           MOVE 10.00 TO DN-VALUE(4)
           MOVE 5.00 TO DN-VALUE(5)
           MOVE 1.00 TO DN-VALUE(6)
           PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-IDX > 6
               MOVE 0 TO DN-COUNT(WS-IDX)
           END-PERFORM.
       PROCESS-REC.
           COMPUTE WS-EXPECTED-BAL = TI-OPENING-BAL
               + TI-CASH-RECEIVED - TI-CASH-PAID
           MOVE TI-ACTUAL-CASH TO WS-ACTUAL-BAL
           COMPUTE WS-DIFFERENCE = WS-ACTUAL-BAL
               - WS-EXPECTED-BAL
           IF WS-DIFFERENCE < 0
               COMPUTE WS-ABS-DIFF = WS-DIFFERENCE * -1
           ELSE
               MOVE WS-DIFFERENCE TO WS-ABS-DIFF
           END-IF
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-CAT-TEXT
           MOVE 0 TO WS-CAT-CODE
           PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-IDX > 5

                   MOVE WS-IDX TO WS-CAT-CODE

           PERFORM FILL-DENOMS

           PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-IDX > 6

* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.

       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.

       FD  OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0053O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG            PIC X(01) VALUE 'N'.
              88 WS-EOF                VALUE 'Y'.
              88 WS-NOT-EOF            VALUE 'N'.
           05 WS-COUNT-IN            PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-COUNT-OUT           PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CALC.
           05 WS-NET-PAY             PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-ADJ-AMT             PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-CAP-LIMIT           PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 50000.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
               OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END SET WS-EOF TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END
                       ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT-IN
                       PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           .
       PROCESS-REC.
      * EVALUATE TRUE OVER 88-LEVEL CONDITIONS
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN DED-HEALTH
                   MOVE 'HEALTH' TO OUT-DEDUCT-DESC
                   MOVE IN-DEDUCT-AMT TO WS-ADJ-AMT
                   MOVE 'HEALTH POSTED' TO OUT-MESSAGE
               WHEN DED-RETIRE
                   MOVE 'RETIREMENT' TO OUT-DEDUCT-DESC
                   COMPUTE WS-ADJ-AMT = IN-DEDUCT-AMT * 1.05
                   MOVE 'RETIRE W/MATCH' TO OUT-MESSAGE
               WHEN DED-TAX
                   MOVE 'TAX W/H' TO OUT-DEDUCT-DESC
                   COMPUTE WS-ADJ-AMT = IN-DEDUCT-AMT + 25.00
                   MOVE 'TAX FEE APPLIED' TO OUT-MESSAGE
               WHEN DED-UNION
                   MOVE 'UNION DUES' TO OUT-DEDUCT-DESC
                   MOVE IN-DEDUCT-AMT TO WS-ADJ-AMT
                   MOVE 'UNION DUES OK' TO OUT-MESSAGE
               WHEN DED-OTHER
                   MOVE 'OTHER' TO OUT-DEDUCT-DESC
                   MOVE IN-DEDUCT-AMT TO WS-ADJ-AMT
                   MOVE 'OTHER DEDUCT' TO OUT-MESSAGE
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 'UNKNOWN' TO OUT-DEDUCT-DESC
                   MOVE IN-DEDUCT-AMT TO WS-ADJ-AMT
                   MOVE 'UNKNOWN CODE' TO OUT-MESSAGE
           END-EVALUATE
           PERFORM CALC-NET
           PERFORM WRITE-OUT
           .
       CALC-NET.
           IF WS-ADJ-AMT > IN-GROSS-PAY
               MOVE IN-GROSS-PAY TO WS-ADJ-AMT
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-NET-PAY = IN-GROSS-PAY - WS-ADJ-AMT
           IF WS-NET-PAY < 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-NET-PAY
           END-IF
           .

           MOVE IN-EMP-ID TO OUT-EMP-ID
           MOVE IN-EMP-NAME TO OUT-EMP-NAME
           MOVE WS-ADJ-AMT TO OUT-POSTED-AMT
           MOVE WS-NET-PAY TO OUT-NET-PAY
           MOVE IN-PAY-PERIOD TO OUT-PAY-PERIOD
           MOVE IN-DEPT-CODE TO OUT-DEPT-CODE
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN WS-NET-PAY = 0

               WHEN WS-ADJ-AMT >= WS-CAP-LIMIT
                   SET STATUS-CAP TO TRUE
               WHEN OTHER
                   SET STATUS-OK TO TRUE
           END-EVALUATE
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT-OUT

              88 DED-RETIRE            VALUE 'RT'.
              88 DED-TAX               VALUE 'TX'.
              88 DED-UNION             VALUE 'UN'.
              88 DED-OTHER             VALUE 'OT'.
           05 IN-DEDUCT-AMT          PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 IN-DEDUCT-AMT-X        REDEFINES IN-DEDUCT-AMT
                                         PIC X(07).
           05 IN-GROSS-PAY           PIC 9(06)V99.
           05 IN-PAY-PERIOD          PIC 9(06).

messages.content:
You are Diocle's COBOL-to-Java translator for a bank modernization project.
Translate the COBOL batch program into ONE self-contained Java 21 source file (JDK only, no libraries)
whose output is byte-identical to the original compiled with GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm).

I/O contract:
- The public class with main() must be named Gen0053, in the default package.
- Input file paths come from environment variables DD_INFILE; write the outputs to DD_OUTFILE.
- ORGANIZATION LINE SEQUENTIAL files are text, one record per line. ORGANIZATION SEQUENTIAL files are fixed-length
  byte records with no separators: read and write them as bytes (ISO-8859-1), record length from the copybook.
- IBM Enterprise COBOL defaults apply: TRUNC(STD), so a value stored in a binary (COMP) field keeps only its PIC digits;
  DISPLAY of a binary field shows its PIC digits (PIC 9(7) COMP displays 7 digits).
- Storage exactly as GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm) writes it: COMP-3 packed decimal with sign nibble C/D (F if unsigned);
  COMP/COMP-4/BINARY big-endian two's complement (2, 4 or 8 bytes by digits); COMP-5 little-endian; signed DISPLAY
  without SIGN SEPARATE carries the sign in the last digit, negative digit d written as the character d + 0x40;
  PIC 9(n)P(m) stores n digits worth value x 10^m.
- When environment variable DIOCLE_COLLATION is EBCDIC, alphanumeric comparisons (<, >) and SORT keys follow mainframe
  EBCDIC order (lowercase < uppercase < digits): compare the Cp037 bytes, not Java's String order.
- Reproduce every DISPLAY to stdout exactly, and exit with the program's RETURN-CODE (System.exit) when it is not 0.
- "Now" (ACCEPT FROM DATE/TIME/DAY, FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE) comes from environment variable DIOCLE_CLOCK when it is
  set (ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. 2000-02-29T13:45:10.00Z), otherwise from the system clock in UTC.

Fidelity rules:
- Preserve COBOL arithmetic semantics exactly: rounding, truncation, overflow, signs, and numeric display formats.
- Use java.math.BigDecimal for all decimal arithmetic. Never use float or double.
- One private method per COBOL paragraph, named after it in camelCase, called in the same order.
- Readable, idiomatic Java; no special-casing of particular input values.
- Name environment variables literally (System.getenv("DD_..."), DIOCLE_CLOCK, DIOCLE_COLLATION). No network,
  processes, reflection, native code or other files: a guard refuses to run such Java.

       01  WS-WORD-CNT           PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.

       01  WS-BASE-AMT           PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-RISK-AMT           PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-TOTAL-AMT          PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
                OUTPUT OUTFILE

               READ INFILE
                   AT END SET WS-EOF TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-RECORD
               END-READ

           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE

       PROCESS-RECORD.
           MOVE POLICY-DESC TO WS-CLEAN-DESC
           INSPECT WS-CLEAN-DESC TALLYING WS-WORD-CNT
               FOR ALL SPACES
           INSPECT WS-CLEAN-DESC REPLACING ALL "_" BY " "
           INSPECT WS-CLEAN-DESC REPLACING ALL "-" BY " "
           MOVE WS-CLEAN-DESC(1:10) TO WS-SNIP
           IF WS-SNIP = SPACES
               MOVE POLICY-DESC(1:10) TO WS-SNIP

           COMPUTE WS-BASE-AMT = PREMIUM-AMT * 0.70

           IF RISK-FACTOR > 500

               COMPUTE WS-BASE-AMT = PREMIUM-AMT - WS-RISK-AMT
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-AMT = WS-BASE-AMT + WS-RISK-AMT
           PERFORM WRITE-BASE
           PERFORM WRITE-RISK

GEN0054.name: GEN0054
GEN0054.technique: SIGN LEADING SEPARATE amounts and DIVIDE ... REMAINDER
GEN0054.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0054.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0054I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0054O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG                 PIC X(1) VALUE "N".
       01  WS-GROSS-NUM                PIC S9(9)V99
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE VALUE +0.
       01  WS-FEE-NUM                  PIC S9(9)V99
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE VALUE +0.
       01  WS-NET-NUM                  PIC S9(9)V99
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE VALUE +0.
       01  WS-FEE-BPS-NUM              PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-WORK-AMT-CENTS           PIC S9(9) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-DIVISOR                  PIC 9(5) VALUE 10000.
       01  WS-FEE-CENTS                PIC S9(9) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-REMAINDER-CENTS          PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-BATCH-SEQ                PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-TXN-REMAINING            PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-PER-TXN-GROSS            PIC S9(9)V99
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE VALUE +0.
       01  WS-PER-TXN-CENTS            PIC S9(9) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-PER-TXN-FEE-CENTS        PIC S9(9) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-PER-TXN-REMAINDER        PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = "Y"
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-RECORD
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE
           CLOSE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           STOP RUN.
       PROCESS-RECORD.
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BATCH-SEQ
           MOVE GROSS-AMOUNT TO WS-GROSS-NUM
           MOVE FEE-RATE-BPS TO WS-FEE-BPS-NUM
           MOVE TXN-COUNT TO WS-TXN-REMAINING
      * compute per-transaction gross using DIVIDE REMAINDER
           IF WS-TXN-REMAINING = 0
               MOVE 1 TO WS-TXN-REMAINING
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-WORK-AMT-CENTS = WS-GROSS-NUM * 100
           DIVIDE WS-TXN-REMAINING INTO WS-WORK-AMT-CENTS
               GIVING WS-PER-TXN-CENTS
               REMAINDER WS-REMAINDER-CENTS
           END-DIVIDE
           COMPUTE WS-PER-TXN-GROSS = WS-PER-TXN-CENTS / 100
           PERFORM BATCH-LOOP UNTIL WS-TXN-REMAINING = 0.
       BATCH-LOOP.
           ADD 1 TO WS-BATCH-SEQ
           MOVE WS-PER-TXN-GROSS TO WS-PER-TXN-GROSS
           COMPUTE WS-PER-TXN-CENTS = WS-PER-TXN-GROSS * 100
      * compute fee for this batch slice with DIVIDE REMAINDER
           MULTIPLY WS-PER-TXN-CENTS BY WS-FEE-BPS-NUM
               GIVING WS-WORK-AMT-CENTS
           END-MULTIPLY
           DIVIDE WS-WORK-AMT-CENTS BY WS-DIVISOR
               GIVING WS-PER-TXN-FEE-CENTS
               REMAINDER WS-PER-TXN-REMAINDER
           END-DIVIDE
           COMPUTE WS-FEE-NUM = WS-PER-TXN-FEE-CENTS / 100
           COMPUTE WS-NET-NUM = WS-PER-TXN-GROSS - WS-FEE-NUM
      * adjust last slice with remainder from gross split
           IF WS-TXN-REMAINING = 1
               COMPUTE WS-NET-NUM = WS-NET-NUM
                   + (WS-REMAINDER-CENTS / 100)
           END-IF
           PERFORM WRITE-SETTLEMENT
           SUBTRACT 1 FROM WS-TXN-REMAINING
           END-SUBTRACT.
       WRITE-SETTLEMENT.
           MOVE MERCHANT-ID TO SETTLEMENT-MERCHANT-ID
           MOVE TXN-DATE TO SETTLEMENT-DATE
           MOVE WS-PER-TXN-GROSS TO SETTLEMENT-GROSS
           MOVE WS-FEE-NUM TO SETTLEMENT-FEE
           MOVE WS-NET-NUM TO SETTLEMENT-NET

           IF WS-PER-TXN-REMAINDER > 0

               MOVE "N" TO SETTLEMENT-FLAG
           END-IF
           WRITE SETTLEMENT-RECORD
           END-WRITE.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  MERCHANT-TRANSACTION-RECORD.

GEN0057.name: GEN0057
GEN0057.technique: COMPUTE ROUNDED with a truncating MOVE into a smaller field
GEN0057.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0057.
      * SAFE DEPOSIT BOX RENTAL BILLING - TRUNCATING MOVE DEMO
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0057I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0057O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG           PIC X VALUE "N".
       01  WS-TOTAL-CALC         PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-TAX-CALC           PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-GRAND-CALC         PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-DISCOUNT-PCT       PIC 9V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-BOX-SURCHARGE      PIC 9(03)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-MONTHLY-NET        PIC 9(04)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-COUNT-IN           PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-COUNT-OUT          PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = "Y"
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           .
       PROCESS-REC.
           ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT-IN
      * DETERMINE DISCOUNT BY TERM
           IF GEN0057I-MONTHS >= 12
               MOVE 0.10 TO WS-DISCOUNT-PCT
           ELSE
               IF GEN0057I-MONTHS >= 6
                   MOVE 0.05 TO WS-DISCOUNT-PCT
               ELSE
                   MOVE 0.00 TO WS-DISCOUNT-PCT
               END-IF
           END-IF
      * DETERMINE SURCHARGE BY BOX SIZE
           EVALUATE GEN0057I-SIZE-CODE
               WHEN "S" MOVE 0 TO WS-BOX-SURCHARGE
               WHEN "M" MOVE 15.50 TO WS-BOX-SURCHARGE
               WHEN "L" MOVE 35.75 TO WS-BOX-SURCHARGE
               WHEN "X" MOVE 60.00 TO WS-BOX-SURCHARGE
               WHEN OTHER MOVE 10.00 TO WS-BOX-SURCHARGE
           END-EVALUATE
      * COMPUTE WITH ROUNDED - THEN TRUNCATING MOVE
           COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-NET ROUNDED =
               GEN0057I-MONTHLY-RATE * (1 - WS-DISCOUNT-PCT)
           COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-CALC ROUNDED =
               (WS-MONTHLY-NET * GEN0057I-MONTHS)
               + WS-BOX-SURCHARGE + GEN0057I-INSURANCE-FEE
           COMPUTE WS-TAX-CALC ROUNDED =
               WS-TOTAL-CALC * 0.0825
           COMPUTE WS-GRAND-CALC ROUNDED =
               WS-TOTAL-CALC + WS-TAX-CALC
      * MOVE TO OUTPUT - TRUNCATION OCCURS HERE
           MOVE GEN0057I-BOX-ID TO GEN0057O-BOX-ID
           MOVE GEN0057I-CUST-ID TO GEN0057O-CUST-ID
           MOVE GEN0057I-SIZE-CODE TO GEN0057O-SIZE-CODE
           MOVE WS-MONTHLY-NET TO GEN0057O-MONTHLY-NET
      * WS-GRAND-CALC IS 9(06)V99, GEN0057O-AMT-DUE IS 9(04)V9
      * THIS MOVE TRUNCATES INTEGER AND DECIMAL PORTIONS
           MOVE WS-GRAND-CALC TO GEN0057O-AMT-DUE
           MOVE WS-TAX-CALC TO GEN0057O-TAX-AMT
           MOVE WS-TOTAL-CALC TO GEN0057O-SUBTOTAL
           MOVE GEN0057I-MONTHS TO GEN0057O-MONTHS
           WRITE GEN0057O-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT-OUT
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  GEN0057I-REC.
           05 GEN0057I-BOX-ID         PIC X(06).
           05 GEN0057I-CUST-ID        PIC X(08).
           05 GEN0057I-SIZE-CODE      PIC X.
           05 GEN0057I-MONTHS         PIC 9(02).
           05 GEN0057I-MONTHLY-RATE   PIC 9(04)V99.
           05 GEN0057I-INSURANCE-FEE  PIC 9(04)V99.
           05 FILLER                  PIC X(05).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  GEN0057O-REC.
           05 GEN0057O-BOX-ID         PIC X(06).
           05 GEN0057O-CUST-ID        PIC X(08).
           05 GEN0057O-SIZE-CODE      PIC X.
           05 GEN0057O-MONTHS         PIC 9(02).
           05 GEN0057O-MONTHLY-NET    PIC 9(04)V99.
           05 GEN0057O-SUBTOTAL       PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 GEN0057O-TAX-AMT        PIC 9(04)V99.
           05 GEN0057O-AMT-DUE        PIC 9(04)V9.
           05 FILLER                  PIC X(04).

GEN0058.name: GEN0058
GEN0058.technique: packed decimal (COMP-3) amounts and signed totals
GEN0058.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0058.
      * WIRE TRANSFER FEE TIERS WITH PACKED AMOUNTS
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0058I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0058O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG           PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
           88 WS-EOF             VALUE "Y".
           88 WS-NOT-EOF         VALUE "N".
       01  WS-COUNTERS.
           05 WS-READ-CNT        PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-WRITE-CNT       PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-CALC-FIELDS.
           05 WS-FEE              PIC S9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-TOTAL            PIC S9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-TIER-CODE        PIC X(02) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-BASE-FEE         PIC S9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-PRIORITY-FEE     PIC S9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
                OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END
                       ADD 1 TO WS-READ-CNT
                       PERFORM PROCESS-RECORD
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           DISPLAY "READ: " WS-READ-CNT
           DISPLAY "WRITTEN: " WS-WRITE-CNT
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-RECORD.
      * DETERMINE FEE TIER BASED ON AMOUNT
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-TIER-CODE
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BASE-FEE WS-PRIORITY-FEE WS-FEE
           IF WIRE-AMOUNT < 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-BASE-FEE
               MOVE "ER" TO WS-TIER-CODE
           ELSE
               IF WIRE-AMOUNT < 1000
                   MOVE 10.00 TO WS-BASE-FEE
                   MOVE "T1" TO WS-TIER-CODE
               ELSE
                   IF WIRE-AMOUNT < 5000
                       MOVE 25.00 TO WS-BASE-FEE
                       MOVE "T2" TO WS-TIER-CODE
                   ELSE
                       IF WIRE-AMOUNT < 25000
                           MOVE 40.00 TO WS-BASE-FEE
                           MOVE "T3" TO WS-TIER-CODE
                       ELSE
                           MOVE 65.00 TO WS-BASE-FEE
                           MOVE "T4" TO WS-TIER-CODE
                       END-IF
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF
      * PRIORITY SURCHARGE
           IF WIRE-PRIORITY = 01
               MOVE 0 TO WS-PRIORITY-FEE
           ELSE
               IF WIRE-PRIORITY = 02
                   MOVE 5.00 TO WS-PRIORITY-FEE
               ELSE
                   MOVE 15.00 TO WS-PRIORITY-FEE
               END-IF
           END-IF
           IF WS-TIER-CODE = "ER"
               MOVE 0 TO WS-FEE
           ELSE
               COMPUTE WS-FEE = WS-BASE-FEE + WS-PRIORITY-FEE
           END-IF
      * REGION ADJUSTMENT FOR INTERNATIONAL
           IF WIRE-REGION = "IN"
               COMPUTE WS-FEE = WS-FEE + 12.50
           END-IF
           IF WIRE-TYPE = "R"
               COMPUTE WS-FEE = WS-FEE * 0.5
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-TOTAL = WIRE-AMOUNT + WS-FEE
           IF WIRE-AMOUNT < 0
               COMPUTE WS-TOTAL = WIRE-AMOUNT - WS-FEE
           END-IF
           PERFORM WRITE-OUTPUT
           .
       WRITE-OUTPUT.
           MOVE WIRE-ID TO OUT-ID
           MOVE WS-TIER-CODE TO OUT-TIER
           MOVE WIRE-AMOUNT TO OUT-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-FEE TO OUT-FEE
           MOVE WS-TOTAL TO OUT-TOTAL
           IF WS-TIER-CODE = "ER"
               MOVE "INVALID AMOUNT      " TO OUT-DESC
           ELSE
               IF WS-TIER-CODE = "T1"
                   MOVE "TIER1 STANDARD      " TO OUT-DESC
               ELSE
                   IF WS-TIER-CODE = "T2"
                       MOVE "TIER2 MID RANGE     " TO OUT-DESC
                   ELSE
                       IF WS-TIER-CODE = "T3"
                           MOVE "TIER3 HIGH VALUE    "
                             TO OUT-DESC
                       ELSE
                           MOVE "TIER4 PREMIUM       "
                             TO OUT-DESC
                       END-IF
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  IN-REC.
           05 WIRE-ID            PIC X(08).
           05 WIRE-TYPE          PIC X(01).
           05 WIRE-REGION        PIC X(02).
           05 WIRE-PRIORITY      PIC 9(02).
           05 WIRE-AMOUNT        PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3.
           05 WIRE-AMOUNT-X REDEFINES WIRE-AMOUNT PIC X(05).
           05 WIRE-CHANNEL       PIC X(02).
           05 FILLER             PIC X(04).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-ID             PIC X(08).
           05 OUT-TIER           PIC X(02).
           05 OUT-DESC           PIC X(20).
           05 OUT-AMOUNT         PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3.
           05 OUT-AMOUNT-X REDEFINES OUT-AMOUNT PIC X(05).
           05 OUT-FEE            PIC S9(05)V99 COMP-3.
           05 OUT-TOTAL          PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3.
           05 FILLER             PIC X(03).

GEN0060.name: GEN0060
GEN0060.technique: an OCCURS table searched with PERFORM VARYING
GEN0060.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0060.
      * Escrow shortage spreading using OCCURS table.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
             ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
             ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD INFILE
           RECORD CONTAINS 80 CHARACTERS.
       COPY GEN0060I.
       FD OUTFILE
           RECORD CONTAINS 80 CHARACTERS.
       COPY GEN0060O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-SPREAD-TABLE.
          05 WS-MONTH-ENTRY OCCURS 12 TIMES.
             10 WS-MTH-NUM PIC 9(02).
             10 WS-MTH-AMT PIC 9(07)V99.
             10 WS-MTH-FEE PIC 9(04)V99.
       01 WS-IDX PIC 9(02).
       01 WS-JDX PIC 9(02).
       01 WS-SHORTAGE PIC 9(07)V99.
       01 WS-MONTHLY-SHARE PIC 9(07)V99.
       01 WS-REMAINDER PIC 9(07)V99.
       01 WS-SPREAD-MONTHS PIC 9(02).
       01 WS-TOTAL-SPREAD PIC 9(07)V99.
       01 WS-BASE-ESCROW PIC 9(07)V99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM INIT-TABLE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = 'Y'
             READ INFILE
               AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
               NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-ONE
             END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE
           GOBACK.
       INIT-TABLE.
           PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
             UNTIL WS-IDX > 12
             MOVE WS-IDX TO WS-MTH-NUM(WS-IDX)
             MOVE ZERO TO WS-MTH-AMT(WS-IDX)
             MOVE ZERO TO WS-MTH-FEE(WS-IDX)
           END-PERFORM.
       PROCESS-ONE.
           MOVE IN-SHORTAGE-AMT TO WS-SHORTAGE
           MOVE IN-SPREAD-TERM TO WS-SPREAD-MONTHS
           MOVE IN-REQ-ESCROW TO WS-BASE-ESCROW
           IF WS-SPREAD-MONTHS = ZERO
             MOVE 12 TO WS-SPREAD-MONTHS
           END-IF
           IF WS-SPREAD-MONTHS > 12
             MOVE 12 TO WS-SPREAD-MONTHS
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-SHARE =
             WS-SHORTAGE / WS-SPREAD-MONTHS
           MOVE ZERO TO WS-REMAINDER
           MOVE ZERO TO WS-TOTAL-SPREAD
           PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
             UNTIL WS-IDX > WS-SPREAD-MONTHS
             MOVE WS-MONTHLY-SHARE TO WS-MTH-AMT(WS-IDX)
             ADD WS-MTH-AMT(WS-IDX) TO WS-TOTAL-SPREAD
           END-PERFORM
           COMPUTE WS-REMAINDER = WS-SHORTAGE - WS-TOTAL-SPREAD
           IF WS-REMAINDER NOT = ZERO
             ADD WS-REMAINDER TO WS-MTH-AMT(1)
           END-IF
           PERFORM VARYING WS-JDX FROM 1 BY 1
             UNTIL WS-JDX > WS-SPREAD-MONTHS
             MOVE IN-LOAN-ID TO OUT-LOAN-ID
             MOVE WS-JDX TO OUT-SEQ-NUM
             MOVE WS-MTH-AMT(WS-JDX) TO OUT-SPREAD-AMT
             COMPUTE OUT-NEW-PAYMENT =
               WS-BASE-ESCROW + WS-MTH-AMT(WS-JDX)
             MOVE IN-PROP-CODE TO OUT-PROP-CODE
             MOVE IN-BRANCH-ID TO OUT-BRANCH-ID
             WRITE OUT-REC
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
             UNTIL WS-IDX > 12
             MOVE ZERO TO WS-MTH-AMT(WS-IDX)
           END-PERFORM.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
          05 IN-LOAN-ID PIC X(10).
          05 IN-BRANCH-ID PIC X(04).
          05 IN-PROP-CODE PIC X(02).
          05 IN-REQ-ESCROW PIC 9(07)V99.
          05 IN-CUR-ESCROW PIC 9(07)V99.
          05 IN-SHORTAGE-AMT PIC 9(07)V99.
          05 IN-SPREAD-TERM PIC 9(02).
          05 FILLER PIC X(28).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
          05 OUT-LOAN-ID PIC X(10).
          05 OUT-BRANCH-ID PIC X(04).
          05 OUT-PROP-CODE PIC X(02).
          05 OUT-SEQ-NUM PIC 9(02).
          05 OUT-SPREAD-AMT PIC 9(07)V99.
          05 OUT-NEW-PAYMENT PIC 9(07)V99.
          05 FILLER PIC X(38).
