GEN0063.name: GEN0063
GEN0063.technique: INSPECT and reference modification on a text field
GEN0063.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0063.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  INFILE.
           COPY GEN0063I.
       FD  OUTFILE.
           COPY GEN0063O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG          PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
              88 WS-EOF             VALUE "Y".
              88 WS-NOT-EOF         VALUE "N".
       01  WS-WORK.
           05 WS-SPACES             PIC 9(04) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-SEQ                PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-AMT-WORK           PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-ABBR               PIC X(12) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-NOTE-WORK          PIC X(20) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-UPPER-NAME        PIC X(20) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-CYCLES             PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-I                  PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ INFILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-ONE
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE
           GOBACK
           .
       PROCESS-ONE.
           MOVE 0 TO WS-SPACES WS-SEQ
           MOVE IN-PAYEE-NAME TO WS-UPPER-NAME
           INSPECT WS-UPPER-NAME TALLYING WS-SPACES
               FOR ALL " "
           INSPECT WS-UPPER-NAME CONVERTING
               "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
               TO "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-ABBR WS-NOTE-WORK
           MOVE WS-UPPER-NAME(1:12) TO WS-ABBR
           IF WS-ABBR(1:1) = SPACE
               MOVE WS-UPPER-NAME(2:12) TO WS-ABBR
           END-IF
           INSPECT WS-ABBR REPLACING ALL " " BY "-"
           MOVE IN-ORDER-AMT TO WS-AMT-WORK
           MOVE IN-CYCLES-REQ TO WS-CYCLES
           IF WS-CYCLES = 0
               MOVE 2 TO WS-CYCLES
           END-IF
           IF WS-CYCLES > 4
               MOVE 4 TO WS-CYCLES
           END-IF
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-I > WS-CYCLES
               MOVE WS-I TO WS-SEQ
               PERFORM BUILD-NOTE
               PERFORM WRITE-ONE
           END-PERFORM
           .
       BUILD-NOTE.
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-NOTE-WORK
           STRING "CYCLE " DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  WS-SEQ DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  " FQ" DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  IN-FREQ-MONTHS DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  INTO WS-NOTE-WORK
           END-STRING
           INSPECT WS-NOTE-WORK REPLACING ALL " " BY "-"
           .
       WRITE-ONE.
           MOVE IN-ORDER-ID TO OUT-ORDER-ID
           MOVE WS-ABBR TO OUT-PAYEE-ABBR
           MOVE WS-SEQ TO OUT-SEQ-NUM
           MOVE WS-AMT-WORK TO OUT-SCHED-AMT
           MOVE WS-NOTE-WORK TO OUT-NOTE
           MOVE WS-SPACES TO OUT-TRACE-CNT
           WRITE OUT-REC
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 IN-ORDER-ID          PIC X(10).
           05 IN-PAYEE-NAME        PIC X(20).
           05 IN-ORDER-AMT         PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 IN-FREQ-MONTHS       PIC 9(02).
           05 IN-CYCLES-REQ        PIC 9(03).
           05 IN-START-MONTH       PIC X(08).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-ORDER-ID        PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-PAYEE-ABBR       PIC X(12).
           05 OUT-SEQ-NUM          PIC 9(03).
           05 OUT-SCHED-AMT        PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 OUT-NOTE             PIC X(20).
           05 OUT-TRACE-CNT        PIC 9(04).

messages.content:
You are Diocle's COBOL-to-Java translator for a bank modernization project.
Translate the COBOL batch program into ONE self-contained Java 21 source file (JDK only, no libraries)
whose output is byte-identical to the original compiled with GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm).

I/O contract:
- The public class with main() must be named Gen0063, in the default package.
- Input file paths come from environment variables DD_INFILE; write the outputs to DD_OUTFILE.
- ORGANIZATION LINE SEQUENTIAL files are text, one record per line. ORGANIZATION SEQUENTIAL files are fixed-length
  byte records with no separators: read and write them as bytes (ISO-8859-1), record length from the copybook.
- IBM Enterprise COBOL defaults apply: TRUNC(STD), so a value stored in a binary (COMP) field keeps only its PIC digits;
  DISPLAY of a binary field shows its PIC digits (PIC 9(7) COMP displays 7 digits).
- Storage exactly as GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm) writes it: COMP-3 packed decimal with sign nibble C/D (F if unsigned);
  COMP/COMP-4/BINARY big-endian two's complement (2, 4 or 8 bytes by digits); COMP-5 little-endian; signed DISPLAY
  without SIGN SEPARATE carries the sign in the last digit, negative digit d written as the character d + 0x40;
  PIC 9(n)P(m) stores n digits worth value x 10^m.
- When environment variable DIOCLE_COLLATION is EBCDIC, alphanumeric comparisons (<, >) and SORT keys follow mainframe
  EBCDIC order (lowercase < uppercase < digits): compare the Cp037 bytes, not Java's String order.
- Reproduce every DISPLAY to stdout exactly, and exit with the program's RETURN-CODE (System.exit) when it is not 0.
- "Now" (ACCEPT FROM DATE/TIME/DAY, FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE) comes from environment variable DIOCLE_CLOCK when it is
  set (ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. 2000-02-29T13:45:10.00Z), otherwise from the system clock in UTC.

Fidelity rules:
- Preserve COBOL arithmetic semantics exactly: rounding, truncation, overflow, signs, and numeric display formats.
- Use java.math.BigDecimal for all decimal arithmetic. Never use float or double.
- One private method per COBOL paragraph, named after it in camelCase, called in the same order.
- Readable, idiomatic Java; no special-casing of particular input values.
- Name environment variables literally (System.getenv("DD_..."), DIOCLE_CLOCK, DIOCLE_COLLATION). No network,
  processes, reflection, native code or other files: a guard refuses to run such Java.

      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.

           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  INFILE.
           COPY GEN0063I.
       FD  OUTFILE.
           COPY GEN0063O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG          PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
              88 WS-EOF             VALUE "Y".
              88 WS-NOT-EOF         VALUE "N".
       01  WS-WORK.
           05 WS-SPACES             PIC 9(04) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-SEQ                PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-AMT-WORK           PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-ABBR               PIC X(12) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-NOTE-WORK          PIC X(20) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-UPPER-NAME        PIC X(20) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-CYCLES             PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-I                  PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ INFILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-ONE
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE
           GOBACK
           .
       PROCESS-ONE.
           MOVE 0 TO WS-SPACES WS-SEQ
           MOVE IN-PAYEE-NAME TO WS-UPPER-NAME
           INSPECT WS-UPPER-NAME TALLYING WS-SPACES
               FOR ALL " "
           INSPECT WS-UPPER-NAME CONVERTING
               "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
               TO "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-ABBR WS-NOTE-WORK
           MOVE WS-UPPER-NAME(1:12) TO WS-ABBR
           IF WS-ABBR(1:1) = SPACE
               MOVE WS-UPPER-NAME(2:12) TO WS-ABBR
           END-IF
           INSPECT WS-ABBR REPLACING ALL " " BY "-"
           MOVE IN-ORDER-AMT TO WS-AMT-WORK
           MOVE IN-CYCLES-REQ TO WS-CYCLES
           IF WS-CYCLES = 0
               MOVE 2 TO WS-CYCLES
           END-IF
           IF WS-CYCLES > 4
               MOVE 4 TO WS-CYCLES
           END-IF
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-I > WS-CYCLES
               MOVE WS-I TO WS-SEQ
               PERFORM BUILD-NOTE
               PERFORM WRITE-ONE
           END-PERFORM
           .
       BUILD-NOTE.
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-NOTE-WORK
           STRING "CYCLE " DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  WS-SEQ DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  " FQ" DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  IN-FREQ-MONTHS DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  INTO WS-NOTE-WORK
           END-STRING
           INSPECT WS-NOTE-WORK REPLACING ALL " " BY "-"
           .
       WRITE-ONE.
           MOVE IN-ORDER-ID TO OUT-ORDER-ID
           MOVE WS-ABBR TO OUT-PAYEE-ABBR
           MOVE WS-SEQ TO OUT-SEQ-NUM
           MOVE WS-AMT-WORK TO OUT-SCHED-AMT
           MOVE WS-NOTE-WORK TO OUT-NOTE
           MOVE WS-SPACES TO OUT-TRACE-CNT
           WRITE OUT-REC
           .

GEN0064.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0064.
      * CARD ANNUAL FEE BILLING - REDEFINES TWO TYPES
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
       COPY GEN0064I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0064O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG        PIC X VALUE "N".
           88 WS-EOF          VALUE "Y".
           88 WS-NOT-EOF      VALUE "N".
       01  WS-COUNTS.
           05 WS-READ-CNT     PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-WRITE-CNT    PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-WAIVED-CNT   PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-BILLED-TOT   PIC 9(09) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-WORK.
           05 WS-FEE-AMT      PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-WAIVE-FLAG   PIC X VALUE "N".
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
                OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END
                       ADD 1 TO WS-READ-CNT
                       PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM WRITE-SUMMARY
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-REC.
           EVALUATE GI-REC-TYPE
               WHEN "1"
                   PERFORM BILL-CARD
               WHEN "2"
                   PERFORM BILL-TRAILER
               WHEN OTHER
                   PERFORM BILL-OTHER
           END-EVALUATE.
       BILL-CARD.
           MOVE "N" TO WS-WAIVE-FLAG
           MOVE GI-ANNUAL-FEE TO WS-FEE-AMT
      * WAIVE LOGIC: HIGH LIMIT OR PREMIUM STATUS
           IF GI-CREDIT-LIMIT > 15000
               MOVE "Y" TO WS-WAIVE-FLAG
           END-IF
           IF GI-ACCT-STATUS = "PREMIUM"
               MOVE "Y" TO WS-WAIVE-FLAG
           END-IF
           IF GI-ACCT-STATUS = "STAFF"
               MOVE "Y" TO WS-WAIVE-FLAG
           END-IF
           MOVE GI-CARD-NUM TO GO-CARD-NUM
           MOVE GI-CARDHOLDER TO GO-CARDHOLDER
           MOVE GI-ANNUAL-FEE TO GO-ANNUAL-FEE
           MOVE WS-WAIVE-FLAG TO GO-FEE-WAIVED
           IF WS-WAIVE-FLAG = "Y"
               MOVE 0 TO GO-BILLED-AMT
               ADD 1 TO WS-WAIVED-CNT
           ELSE
               MOVE WS-FEE-AMT TO GO-BILLED-AMT
               ADD WS-FEE-AMT TO WS-BILLED-TOT
           END-IF
           MOVE "D" TO GO-REC-TYPE
           MOVE SPACES TO GO-FILLER-TXT
           WRITE GEN0064O-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT.
       BILL-TRAILER.
           MOVE SPACES TO GO-CARD-NUM
           MOVE "TRAILER SUMMARY" TO GO-CARDHOLDER
           MOVE GI-TOTAL-FEES TO GO-ANNUAL-FEE
           MOVE "N" TO GO-FEE-WAIVED
           MOVE 0 TO GO-BILLED-AMT
           MOVE "T" TO GO-REC-TYPE
           MOVE SPACES TO GO-FILLER-TXT
           WRITE GEN0064O-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT.
       BILL-OTHER.
           MOVE GI-CARD-NUM TO GO-CARD-NUM
           MOVE GI-CARDHOLDER TO GO-CARDHOLDER
           MOVE 0 TO GO-ANNUAL-FEE
           MOVE "N" TO GO-FEE-WAIVED
           MOVE 0 TO GO-BILLED-AMT
           MOVE "E" TO GO-REC-TYPE
           MOVE SPACES TO GO-FILLER-TXT
           WRITE GEN0064O-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT.
       WRITE-SUMMARY.
           MOVE "SUMMARY" TO GO-CARD-NUM
           MOVE WS-WRITE-CNT TO GO-CARDHOLDER
           MOVE WS-BILLED-TOT TO GO-ANNUAL-FEE
           MOVE "N" TO GO-FEE-WAIVED
           MOVE WS-BILLED-TOT TO GO-BILLED-AMT
           MOVE "S" TO GO-REC-TYPE
           MOVE SPACES TO GO-FILLER-TXT
           WRITE GEN0064O-REC.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 GEN0064I-REC.
           05 GI-REC-TYPE        PIC X.
           05 GI-REC-BODY        PIC X(60).
           05 GI-DETAIL REDEFINES GI-REC-BODY.
               10 GI-CARD-NUM      PIC X(16).
               10 GI-CARDHOLDER   PIC X(20).
               10 GI-ANNUAL-FEE    PIC 9(05).
               10 GI-CREDIT-LIMIT PIC 9(06).
               10 GI-ACCT-STATUS  PIC X(13).
           05 GI-TRAILER REDEFINES GI-REC-BODY.
               10 GI-TOTAL-CARDS   PIC 9(05).
               10 GI-TOTAL-FEES    PIC 9(07)V99.
               10 FILLER           PIC X(46).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 GEN0064O-REC.
           05 GO-CARD-NUM        PIC X(16).
           05 GO-CARDHOLDER      PIC X(20).
           05 GO-ANNUAL-FEE      PIC 9(05).
           05 GO-FEE-WAIVED      PIC X.
           05 GO-BILLED-AMT      PIC 9(05).
           05 GO-REC-TYPE        PIC X.
           05 GO-FILLER-TXT      PIC X(10).

messages.content:
You are Diocle's COBOL-to-Java translator for a bank modernization project.
Translate the COBOL batch program into ONE self-contained Java 21 source file (JDK only, no libraries)
whose output is byte-identical to the original compiled with GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm).

I/O contract:
- The public class with main() must be named Gen0067, in the default package.
- Input file paths come from environment variables DD_INFILE; write the outputs to DD_OUTFILE.
- ORGANIZATION LINE SEQUENTIAL files are text, one record per line. ORGANIZATION SEQUENTIAL files are fixed-length
  byte records with no separators: read and write them as bytes (ISO-8859-1), record length from the copybook.
- IBM Enterprise COBOL defaults apply: TRUNC(STD), so a value stored in a binary (COMP) field keeps only its PIC digits;
  DISPLAY of a binary field shows its PIC digits (PIC 9(7) COMP displays 7 digits).
- Storage exactly as GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm) writes it: COMP-3 packed decimal with sign nibble C/D (F if unsigned);
  COMP/COMP-4/BINARY big-endian two's complement (2, 4 or 8 bytes by digits); COMP-5 little-endian; signed DISPLAY
  without SIGN SEPARATE carries the sign in the last digit, negative digit d written as the character d + 0x40;
  PIC 9(n)P(m) stores n digits worth value x 10^m.
- When environment variable DIOCLE_COLLATION is EBCDIC, alphanumeric comparisons (<, >) and SORT keys follow mainframe
  EBCDIC order (lowercase < uppercase < digits): compare the Cp037 bytes, not Java's String order.
- Reproduce every DISPLAY to stdout exactly, and exit with the program's RETURN-CODE (System.exit) when it is not 0.
- "Now" (ACCEPT FROM DATE/TIME/DAY, FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE) comes from environment variable DIOCLE_CLOCK when it is
  set (ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. 2000-02-29T13:45:10.00Z), otherwise from the system clock in UTC.

Fidelity rules:
- Preserve COBOL arithmetic semantics exactly: rounding, truncation, overflow, signs, and numeric display formats.
- Use java.math.BigDecimal for all decimal arithmetic. Never use float or double.
- One private method per COBOL paragraph, named after it in camelCase, called in the same order.
- Readable, idiomatic Java; no special-casing of particular input values.
- Name environment variables literally (System.getenv("DD_..."), DIOCLE_CLOCK, DIOCLE_COLLATION). No network,
  processes, reflection, native code or other files: a guard refuses to run such Java.

GEN0065.name: GEN0065
GEN0065.technique: COMPUTE ROUNDED with a truncating MOVE into a smaller field
GEN0065.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0065.
      * Overdraft interest charging - compute rounded
      * then truncate via MOVE to smaller output field.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0065I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0065O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG           PIC X(01) VALUE 'N'.
           88 WS-EOF             VALUE 'Y'.
           88 WS-NOT-EOF         VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-INTEREST-FULL      PIC 9(06)V999 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-ANNUAL-FACTOR      PIC 9(02)V999 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-DAILY-RATE         PIC 9(01)V99999 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-OD-AMOUNT          PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-COUNT-IN           PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-COUNT-OUT          PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM READ-IN
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               PERFORM PROCESS-ONE
               PERFORM READ-IN
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           .
       READ-IN.
           READ IN-FILE
               AT END SET WS-EOF TO TRUE
               NOT AT END ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT-IN
           END-READ
           .
       PROCESS-ONE.
      * Only charge if overdrawn and days > 0
           IF OD-BALANCE OF IN-REC > 0
               AND OD-DAYS OF IN-REC > 0
               MOVE OD-BALANCE OF IN-REC TO WS-OD-AMOUNT
      * Derive daily rate from annual rate / 365
               COMPUTE WS-DAILY-RATE ROUNDED =
                   ANNUAL-RATE OF IN-REC / 365
               END-COMPUTE
      * Compute interest = balance * daily-rate * days
               COMPUTE WS-INTEREST-FULL ROUNDED =
                   WS-OD-AMOUNT * WS-DAILY-RATE
                   * OD-DAYS OF IN-REC / 100
               END-COMPUTE
           ELSE
               MOVE 0 TO WS-INTEREST-FULL
           END-IF
      * Prepare output fields
           MOVE ACCT-NUM OF IN-REC TO OT-ACCT-NUM OF OUT-REC
           MOVE OD-BALANCE OF IN-REC TO OT-OD-BALANCE OF OUT-REC
           MOVE OD-DAYS OF IN-REC TO OT-OD-DAYS OF OUT-REC
           MOVE WS-INTEREST-FULL TO OT-INTEREST-DISP OF OUT-REC
      * Truncating MOVE into smaller field (no rounding)
           MOVE WS-INTEREST-FULL TO OT-INTEREST-CHARGE OF OUT-REC
      * New balance includes truncated charge
           COMPUTE OT-NEW-BALANCE OF OUT-REC =
               OD-BALANCE OF IN-REC
               + OT-INTEREST-CHARGE OF OUT-REC
           END-COMPUTE
           MOVE WS-DAILY-RATE TO OT-DAILY-RATE OF OUT-REC
           IF OT-INTEREST-CHARGE OF OUT-REC > 999.99
               MOVE 'H' TO OT-WARN-FLAG OF OUT-REC
           ELSE
               MOVE ' ' TO OT-WARN-FLAG OF OUT-REC
           END-IF
           WRITE OUT-REC OF OUT-FILE
           ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT-OUT
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  IN-REC.
           05 ACCT-NUM           PIC X(10).
           05 OD-BALANCE         PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 OD-DAYS            PIC 9(03).
           05 ANNUAL-RATE        PIC 9(02)V99.
           05 ACCT-STATUS        PIC X(02).
           05 FILLER REDEFINES ACCT-STATUS.
              10 ACCT-STATUS-CODE PIC X(02).
           05 BRANCH-ID          PIC X(04).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  OUT-REC.
           05 OT-ACCT-NUM        PIC X(10).
           05 OT-OD-BALANCE      PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 OT-OD-DAYS         PIC 9(03).
           05 OT-DAILY-RATE      PIC 9(01)V99999.
           05 OT-INTEREST-DISP   PIC 9(06)V999.
           05 OT-INTEREST-CHARGE PIC 9(04)V99.
           05 OT-NEW-BALANCE     PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 OT-WARN-FLAG       PIC X(01).
           05 FILLER REDEFINES OT-WARN-FLAG.
              10 OT-WARN-CODE    PIC X(01).

messages.content:
You are Diocle's COBOL-to-Java translator for a bank modernization project.
Translate the COBOL batch program into ONE self-contained Java 21 source file (JDK only, no libraries)
whose output is byte-identical to the original compiled with GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm).

I/O contract:
- The public class with main() must be named Gen0065, in the default package.
- Input file paths come from environment variables DD_INFILE; write the outputs to DD_OUTFILE.
- ORGANIZATION LINE SEQUENTIAL files are text, one record per line. ORGANIZATION SEQUENTIAL files are fixed-length
  byte records with no separators: read and write them as bytes (ISO-8859-1), record length from the copybook.
- IBM Enterprise COBOL defaults apply: TRUNC(STD), so a value stored in a binary (COMP) field keeps only its PIC digits;
  DISPLAY of a binary field shows its PIC digits (PIC 9(7) COMP displays 7 digits).
- Storage exactly as GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm) writes it: COMP-3 packed decimal with sign nibble C/D (F if unsigned);
  COMP/COMP-4/BINARY big-endian two's complement (2, 4 or 8 bytes by digits); COMP-5 little-endian; signed DISPLAY
  without SIGN SEPARATE carries the sign in the last digit, negative digit d written as the character d + 0x40;
  PIC 9(n)P(m) stores n digits worth value x 10^m.
- When environment variable DIOCLE_COLLATION is EBCDIC, alphanumeric comparisons (<, >) and SORT keys follow mainframe
  EBCDIC order (lowercase < uppercase < digits): compare the Cp037 bytes, not Java's String order.
- Reproduce every DISPLAY to stdout exactly, and exit with the program's RETURN-CODE (System.exit) when it is not 0.
- "Now" (ACCEPT FROM DATE/TIME/DAY, FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE) comes from environment variable DIOCLE_CLOCK when it is
  set (ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. 2000-02-29T13:45:10.00Z), otherwise from the system clock in UTC.

Fidelity rules:
- Preserve COBOL arithmetic semantics exactly: rounding, truncation, overflow, signs, and numeric display formats.
- Use java.math.BigDecimal for all decimal arithmetic. Never use float or double.
- One private method per COBOL paragraph, named after it in camelCase, called in the same order.
- Readable, idiomatic Java; no special-casing of particular input values.
- Name environment variables literally (System.getenv("DD_..."), DIOCLE_CLOCK, DIOCLE_COLLATION). No network,
  processes, reflection, native code or other files: a guard refuses to run such Java.

=== GEN0065.cbl ===
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0065.
      * Overdraft interest charging - compute rounded
      * then truncate via MOVE to smaller output field.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0065I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0065O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG           PIC X(01) VALUE 'N'.
           88 WS-EOF             VALUE 'Y'.
           88 WS-NOT-EOF         VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-INTEREST-FULL      PIC 9(06)V999 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-ANNUAL-FACTOR      PIC 9(02)V999 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-DAILY-RATE         PIC 9(01)V99999 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-OD-AMOUNT          PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-COUNT-IN           PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-COUNT-OUT          PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM READ-IN
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               PERFORM PROCESS-ONE
               PERFORM READ-IN
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           .
       READ-IN.
           READ IN-FILE
               AT END SET WS-EOF TO TRUE
               NOT AT END ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT-IN
           END-READ
           .
       PROCESS-ONE.
      * Only charge if overdrawn and days > 0
           IF OD-BALANCE OF IN-REC > 0
               AND OD-DAYS OF IN-REC > 0
               MOVE OD-BALANCE OF IN-REC TO WS-OD-AMOUNT
      * Derive daily rate from annual rate / 365
               COMPUTE WS-DAILY-RATE ROUNDED =
                   ANNUAL-RATE OF IN-REC / 365
               END-COMPUTE
      * Compute interest = balance * daily-rate * days
               COMPUTE WS-INTEREST-FULL ROUNDED =
                   WS-OD-AMOUNT * WS-DAILY-RATE
                   * OD-DAYS OF IN-REC / 100
               END-COMPUTE
           ELSE
               MOVE 0 TO WS-INTEREST-FULL
           END-IF
      * Prepare output fields
           MOVE ACCT-NUM OF IN-REC TO OT-ACCT-NUM OF OUT-REC
           MOVE OD-BALANCE OF IN-REC TO OT-OD-BALANCE OF OUT-REC
           MOVE OD-DAYS OF IN-REC TO OT-OD-DAYS OF OUT-REC
           MOVE WS-INTEREST-FULL TO OT-INTEREST-DISP OF OUT-REC
      * Truncating MOVE into smaller field (no rounding)
           MOVE WS-INTEREST-FULL TO OT-INTEREST-CHARGE OF OUT-REC
      * New balance includes truncated charge
           COMPUTE OT-NEW-BALANCE OF OUT-REC =
               OD-BALANCE OF IN-REC
               + OT-INTEREST-CHARGE OF OUT-REC
           END-COMPUTE
           MOVE WS-DAILY-RATE TO OT-DAILY-RATE OF OUT-REC
           IF OT-INTEREST-CHARGE OF OUT-REC > 999.99
               MOVE 'H' TO OT-WARN-FLAG OF OUT-REC
           ELSE
               MOVE ' ' TO OT-WARN-FLAG OF OUT-REC
           END-IF
           WRITE OUT-REC OF OUT-FILE
           ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT-OUT
           .

=== GEN0065I.cpy ===
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  IN-REC.
           05 ACCT-NUM           PIC X(10).
           05 OD-BALANCE         PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 OD-DAYS            PIC 9(03).
           05 ANNUAL-RATE        PIC 9(02)V99.
           05 ACCT-STATUS        PIC X(02).
           05 FILLER REDEFINES ACCT-STATUS.
              10 ACCT-STATUS-CODE PIC X(02).

=== GEN0065O.cpy ===
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  OUT-REC.
           05 OT-ACCT-NUM        PIC X(10).
           05 OT-OD-BALANCE      PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 OT-OD-DAYS         PIC 9(03).
           05 OT-DAILY-RATE      PIC 9(01)V99999.
           05 OT-INTEREST-DISP   PIC 9(06)V999.
           05 OT-INTEREST-CHARGE PIC 9(04)V99.
           05 OT-NEW-BALANCE     PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 OT-WARN-FLAG       PIC X(01).
           05 FILLER REDEFINES OT-WARN-FLAG.
              10 OT-WARN-CODE    PIC X(01).

GEN0068.name: GEN0068
GEN0068.technique: an OCCURS table searched with PERFORM VARYING
GEN0068.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0068.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
       COPY GEN0068I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0068O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG             PIC X VALUE 'N'.
               88 WS-EOF               VALUE 'Y'.
               88 WS-NOT-EOF           VALUE 'N'.
           05 WS-FOUND-FLAG            PIC X VALUE 'N'.
               88 WS-FOUND             VALUE 'Y'.
               88 WS-NOT-FOUND         VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-COUNTERS.
           05 WS-REC-CNT              PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-OUT-CNT              PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CALC.
           05 WS-DED-AMT              PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-NET-PAY              PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-RATE                 PIC 9(03)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-DED-DESC             PIC X(15) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-IDX                  PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-SEQ                  PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-DED-TABLE.
           05 WS-DED-ENTRY OCCURS 08 TIMES.
               10 WS-TAB-CODE         PIC X(04).
               10 WS-TAB-RATE         PIC 9(03)V99.
               10 WS-TAB-DESC         PIC X(15).
               10 WS-TAB-MIN-GROSS    PIC 9(07)V99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           PERFORM LOAD-TABLE-PARA
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC-PARA
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       LOAD-TABLE-PARA.
           MOVE 'TAX1' TO WS-TAB-CODE(1)
           MOVE 015.50 TO WS-TAB-RATE(1)
           MOVE 'FEDERAL TAX    ' TO WS-TAB-DESC(1)
           MOVE 0000000.00 TO WS-TAB-MIN-GROSS(1)
           MOVE 'TAX2' TO WS-TAB-CODE(2)
           MOVE 005.00 TO WS-TAB-RATE(2)
           MOVE 'STATE TAX      ' TO WS-TAB-DESC(2)
           MOVE 0000000.00 TO WS-TAB-MIN-GROSS(2)
           MOVE 'RET1' TO WS-TAB-CODE(3)
           MOVE 007.50 TO WS-TAB-RATE(3)
           MOVE 'RETIREMENT     ' TO WS-TAB-DESC(3)
           MOVE 001500.00 TO WS-TAB-MIN-GROSS(3)
           MOVE 'MED1' TO WS-TAB-CODE(4)
           MOVE 002.75 TO WS-TAB-RATE(4)
           MOVE 'MEDICAL        ' TO WS-TAB-DESC(4)
           MOVE 0000000.00 TO WS-TAB-MIN-GROSS(4)
           MOVE 'DEN1' TO WS-TAB-CODE(5)
           MOVE 001.20 TO WS-TAB-RATE(5)
           MOVE 'DENTAL         ' TO WS-TAB-DESC(5)
           MOVE 002000.00 TO WS-TAB-MIN-GROSS(5)
           MOVE 'LIF1' TO WS-TAB-CODE(6)
           MOVE 000.80 TO WS-TAB-RATE(6)
           MOVE 'LIFE INS       ' TO WS-TAB-DESC(6)
           MOVE 0000000.00 TO WS-TAB-MIN-GROSS(6)
           MOVE 'UNON' TO WS-TAB-CODE(7)
           MOVE 001.50 TO WS-TAB-RATE(7)
           MOVE 'UNION DUES     ' TO WS-TAB-DESC(7)
           MOVE 0000000.00 TO WS-TAB-MIN-GROSS(7)
           MOVE 'CHRT' TO WS-TAB-CODE(8)
           MOVE 002.00 TO WS-TAB-RATE(8)
           MOVE 'CHARITY        ' TO WS-TAB-DESC(8)
           MOVE 003000.00 TO WS-TAB-MIN-GROSS(8)
           .
       PROCESS-REC-PARA.
           ADD 1 TO WS-REC-CNT
           MOVE 0 TO WS-SEQ
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-FOUND-FLAG
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-DED-DESC
           MOVE 0 TO WS-RATE
           PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-IDX > 8
               IF IN-DED-CODE = WS-TAB-CODE(WS-IDX)
                   MOVE WS-TAB-RATE(WS-IDX) TO WS-RATE
                   MOVE WS-TAB-DESC(WS-IDX) TO WS-DED-DESC
                   MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FOUND-FLAG
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           IF WS-NOT-FOUND
               MOVE 010.00 TO WS-RATE
               MOVE 'GENERAL DEDUCT ' TO WS-DED-DESC
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-DED-AMT = IN-GROSS-PAY * WS-RATE / 100
           COMPUTE WS-NET-PAY = IN-GROSS-PAY - WS-DED-AMT
           ADD 1 TO WS-SEQ
           PERFORM WRITE-OUT-PARA
           IF IN-GROSS-PAY > 4000.00
               MOVE 'MED1' TO WS-DED-DESC
               MOVE 002.75 TO WS-RATE
               COMPUTE WS-DED-AMT = IN-GROSS-PAY * WS-RATE / 100
               COMPUTE WS-NET-PAY = WS-NET-PAY - WS-DED-AMT
               ADD 1 TO WS-SEQ
               MOVE 'MED1' TO OUT-DED-CODE
               MOVE 'MEDICAL        ' TO OUT-DED-DESC
               PERFORM WRITE-OUT-PARA-2
           END-IF
           IF IN-HOURS-WORKED > 80
               MOVE 001.50 TO WS-RATE
               COMPUTE WS-DED-AMT = IN-GROSS-PAY * WS-RATE / 100
               COMPUTE WS-NET-PAY = WS-NET-PAY - WS-DED-AMT
               ADD 1 TO WS-SEQ
               MOVE 'UNON' TO OUT-DED-CODE
               MOVE 'UNION DUES     ' TO OUT-DED-DESC
               PERFORM WRITE-OUT-PARA-2
           END-IF
           .
       WRITE-OUT-PARA.
           MOVE IN-EMP-ID TO OUT-EMP-ID
           MOVE IN-EMP-NAME TO OUT-EMP-NAME
           MOVE IN-DED-CODE TO OUT-DED-CODE
           MOVE WS-DED-DESC TO OUT-DED-DESC
           MOVE WS-DED-AMT TO OUT-DED-AMT
           MOVE WS-NET-PAY TO OUT-NET-PAY
           MOVE WS-SEQ TO OUT-DED-SEQ
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-OUT-CNT
           .
       WRITE-OUT-PARA-2.
           MOVE IN-EMP-ID TO OUT-EMP-ID
           MOVE IN-EMP-NAME TO OUT-EMP-NAME
           MOVE WS-DED-AMT TO OUT-DED-AMT
           MOVE WS-NET-PAY TO OUT-NET-PAY
           MOVE WS-SEQ TO OUT-DED-SEQ
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-OUT-CNT
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 IN-EMP-ID             PIC X(06).
           05 IN-EMP-NAME            PIC X(20).
           05 IN-GROSS-PAY           PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 IN-DEPT-CODE           PIC X(04).
           05 IN-DED-CODE            PIC X(04).
           05 IN-HOURS-WORKED        PIC 9(03).
           05 FILLER                 PIC X(10).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-EMP-ID             PIC X(06).
           05 OUT-EMP-NAME            PIC X(20).
           05 OUT-DED-CODE            PIC X(04).
           05 OUT-DED-DESC            PIC X(15).
           05 OUT-DED-AMT             PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 OUT-NET-PAY             PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 OUT-DED-SEQ             PIC 9(02).
           05 FILLER                  PIC X(05).

GEN0070.name: GEN0070
GEN0070.technique: SIGN LEADING SEPARATE amounts and DIVIDE ... REMAINDER
GEN0070.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0070.
      * Insurance premium allocation.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0070I.
       FD OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0070O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG PIC X VALUE "N".
       01 WS-PREMIUM-NUM PIC S9(9)V99
           SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
       01 WS-DIVISOR PIC S9(4) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
       01 WS-QUOTIENT PIC S9(9) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
       01 WS-REMAINDER PIC S9(4) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
       01 WS-MONTHLY-AMT PIC S9(7)V99
           SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
       01 WS-REMAINDER-AMT PIC S9(7)V99
           SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
       01 WS-CTR PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = "Y"
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-REC.
           MOVE PREMIUM-AMT OF INS-INPUT-REC
               TO WS-PREMIUM-NUM
           MOVE TERM-MONTHS OF INS-INPUT-REC
               TO WS-DIVISOR
           IF WS-DIVISOR = 0
               MOVE 1 TO WS-DIVISOR
           END-IF
      * Divide premium into monthly allocation.
           DIVIDE WS-PREMIUM-NUM BY WS-DIVISOR
               GIVING WS-QUOTIENT
               REMAINDER WS-REMAINDER
           END-DIVIDE
           COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-AMT = WS-PREMIUM-NUM
               / WS-DIVISOR
           END-COMPUTE
           MOVE WS-REMAINDER TO WS-REMAINDER-AMT
           PERFORM WRITE-ALLOC
           ADD 1 TO WS-CTR
           .
       WRITE-ALLOC.
           MOVE POL-NUM OF INS-INPUT-REC
               TO POL-NUM-O OF INS-OUTPUT-REC
           MOVE WS-MONTHLY-AMT
               TO MONTHLY-ALLOC OF INS-OUTPUT-REC
           MOVE WS-REMAINDER
               TO REM-AMT OF INS-OUTPUT-REC
           MOVE ALLOC-PCT OF INS-INPUT-REC
               TO ALLOC-PCT-O OF INS-OUTPUT-REC
           MOVE RISK-CODE OF INS-INPUT-REC
               TO RISK-CODE-O OF INS-OUTPUT-REC
           MOVE WS-CTR TO SEQ-NUM OF INS-OUTPUT-REC
           WRITE OUT-REC
           .
       END PROGRAM GEN0070.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 INS-INPUT-REC.
           05 POL-NUM PIC X(10).
           05 FILLER PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
           05 PREMIUM-AMT PIC S9(7)V99
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 ALLOC-PCT PIC S9(3) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 TERM-MONTHS PIC S9(3) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 RISK-CODE PIC X(4).
           05 FILLER PIC X(5) VALUE SPACES.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 INS-OUTPUT-REC.
           05 POL-NUM-O PIC X(10).
           05 FILLER PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
           05 OUT-REC PIC X(20) VALUE SPACES.
           05 MONTHLY-ALLOC PIC S9(7)V99
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 REM-AMT PIC S9(4) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 ALLOC-PCT-O PIC S9(3)
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 RISK-CODE-O PIC X(4).
           05 SEQ-NUM PIC 9(4).

GEN0074.name: GEN0074
GEN0074.technique: packed decimal (COMP-3) amounts and signed totals
GEN0074.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0074.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0074I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0074O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-STATUS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG           PIC X(01) VALUE 'N'.
              88 WS-EOF                    VALUE 'Y'.
              88 WS-NOT-EOF                VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-CALC-FIELDS.
           05 WS-NEW-TOTAL          PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-REMAINING          PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-LIMIT-OK           PIC X(01) VALUE 'Y'.
           05 WS-AMT-OK             PIC X(01) VALUE 'Y'.
       01  WS-COUNTERS.
           05 WS-READ-COUNT         PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-WRITE-COUNT        PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
                OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END
                       ADD 1 TO WS-READ-COUNT
                       PERFORM PROCESS-ONE-RECORD
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           .
       PROCESS-ONE-RECORD SECTION.
       P1-START.
      * Validate amount and compute new total
           MOVE 'Y' TO WS-LIMIT-OK
           MOVE 'Y' TO WS-AMT-OK
           IF IN-REQ-AMT <= 0
               MOVE 'N' TO WS-AMT-OK
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-NEW-TOTAL = IN-DAILY-TOTAL + IN-REQ-AMT
           COMPUTE WS-REMAINING = IN-DAILY-LIMIT - WS-NEW-TOTAL
           IF WS-NEW-TOTAL > IN-DAILY-LIMIT
               MOVE 'N' TO WS-LIMIT-OK
           END-IF
           IF IN-WITHDRAWAL-CNT >= 10
               MOVE 'N' TO WS-LIMIT-OK
           END-IF
      * Move common fields to output
           MOVE IN-ACCT-NO TO OUT-ACCT-NO
           MOVE IN-ATM-ID TO OUT-ATM-ID
           MOVE IN-REQ-AMT TO OUT-REQ-AMT
           MOVE WS-NEW-TOTAL TO OUT-NEW-TOTAL
           MOVE WS-REMAINING TO OUT-REMAIN-LIMIT
           IF WS-AMT-OK = 'N'
               MOVE 'DENIED  ' TO OUT-DECISION
               MOVE 'INVALID AMOUNT      ' TO OUT-REASON
           ELSE
               IF WS-LIMIT-OK = 'N'
                   MOVE 'DENIED  ' TO OUT-DECISION
                   IF WS-NEW-TOTAL > IN-DAILY-LIMIT
                       MOVE 'DAILY LIMIT EXCEEDED' TO OUT-REASON
                   ELSE
                       MOVE 'TOO MANY WITHDRAWALS' TO OUT-REASON
                   END-IF
               ELSE
                   MOVE 'APPROVED' TO OUT-DECISION
                   MOVE 'WITHIN LIMITS       ' TO OUT-REASON
               END-IF
           END-IF
           WRITE OUT-ATM-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-COUNT
      * Every input yields one output; add alert record if denied
           IF OUT-DECISION = 'DENIED  '
               MOVE 'DENIED  ' TO OUT-DECISION
               MOVE 'ALERT FOR REVIEW    ' TO OUT-REASON
               WRITE OUT-ATM-REC
               ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-COUNT
           END-IF
           EXIT
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-ATM-REC.
           05 IN-ACCT-NO           PIC X(10).
           05 IN-ATM-ID             PIC X(06).
           05 IN-REQ-AMT            PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
           05 IN-REQ-AMT-X          REDEFINES IN-REQ-AMT PIC X(05).
           05 IN-DAILY-TOTAL        PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
           05 IN-DAILY-LIMIT        PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
           05 IN-WITHDRAWAL-CNT    PIC 9(03).
           05 IN-ACCT-TYPE          PIC X(01).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-ATM-REC.
           05 OUT-ACCT-NO           PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-ATM-ID            PIC X(06).
           05 OUT-REQ-AMT           PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
           05 OUT-NEW-TOTAL         PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
           05 OUT-DECISION          PIC X(08).
           05 OUT-REASON             PIC X(20).
           05 OUT-REASON-X           REDEFINES OUT-REASON PIC X(20).
           05 OUT-REMAIN-LIMIT      PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.

GEN0073.name: GEN0073

GEN0073.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.

       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.

       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0076.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0076I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0076O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG              PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-TABLE-INIT-DONE       PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-IDX                   PIC 99 VALUE 01.
       01 WS-FOUND-FLAG            PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-MATCH-RATE            PIC 9(2)V999 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-MATCH-DESC            PIC X(12) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-CALC-DIVIDEND         PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CALC-NEW-BAL          PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-BONUS-RATE            PIC 9(2)V999 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-TIER-TABLE.
           05 WS-TIER-ENTRY OCCURS 08 TIMES.
               10 WS-T-CODE        PIC X(02).
               10 WS-T-MIN-BAL     PIC 9(7)V99.
               10 WS-T-RATE        PIC 9(2)V999.
               10 WS-T-DESC        PIC X(12).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           PERFORM INIT-TABLE-PARA
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = 'Y'
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC-PARA
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           STOP RUN.
       INIT-TABLE-PARA.
           MOVE 'A1' TO WS-T-CODE(1)
           MOVE 0000000.00 TO WS-T-MIN-BAL(1)
           MOVE 001.250 TO WS-T-RATE(1)
           MOVE 'STANDARD    ' TO WS-T-DESC(1)
           MOVE 'A2' TO WS-T-CODE(2)
           MOVE 0005000.00 TO WS-T-MIN-BAL(2)
           MOVE 001.750 TO WS-T-RATE(2)
           MOVE 'SILVER      ' TO WS-T-DESC(2)
           MOVE 'B1' TO WS-T-CODE(3)
           MOVE 0010000.00 TO WS-T-MIN-BAL(3)
           MOVE 002.100 TO WS-T-RATE(3)
           MOVE 'GOLD        ' TO WS-T-DESC(3)
           MOVE 'B2' TO WS-T-CODE(4)
           MOVE 0025000.00 TO WS-T-MIN-BAL(4)
           MOVE 002.500 TO WS-T-RATE(4)
           MOVE 'PLATINUM    ' TO WS-T-DESC(4)
           MOVE 'C1' TO WS-T-CODE(5)
           MOVE 0050000.00 TO WS-T-MIN-BAL(5)
           MOVE 002.900 TO WS-T-RATE(5)
           MOVE 'PREMIUM     ' TO WS-T-DESC(5)
           MOVE 'C2' TO WS-T-CODE(6)
           MOVE 0100000.00 TO WS-T-MIN-BAL(6)
           MOVE 003.250 TO WS-T-RATE(6)
           MOVE 'ELITE       ' TO WS-T-DESC(6)
           MOVE 'D1' TO WS-T-CODE(7)
           MOVE 0000000.00 TO WS-T-MIN-BAL(7)
           MOVE 000.750 TO WS-T-RATE(7)
           MOVE 'YOUTH       ' TO WS-T-DESC(7)
           MOVE 'D2' TO WS-T-CODE(8)
           MOVE 0000000.00 TO WS-T-MIN-BAL(8)
           MOVE 001.000 TO WS-T-RATE(8)
           MOVE 'SENIOR      ' TO WS-T-DESC(8)
           MOVE 'Y' TO WS-TABLE-INIT-DONE.
       PROCESS-REC-PARA.
           MOVE 'N' TO WS-FOUND-FLAG
           MOVE 0 TO WS-MATCH-RATE
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-MATCH-DESC
           PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-IDX > 8
               IF I-TIER-CODE = WS-T-CODE(WS-IDX)
                   MOVE WS-T-RATE(WS-IDX) TO WS-MATCH-RATE
                   MOVE WS-T-DESC(WS-IDX) TO WS-MATCH-DESC
                   MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FOUND-FLAG
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           IF WS-FOUND-FLAG = 'N'
               MOVE 001.000 TO WS-MATCH-RATE
               MOVE 'DEFAULT     ' TO WS-MATCH-DESC
           END-IF
           IF I-BALANCE < WS-T-MIN-BAL(WS-IDX - 1)
               AND WS-FOUND-FLAG = 'Y'
               MOVE 0 TO WS-MATCH-RATE
               COMPUTE WS-MATCH-RATE = WS-MATCH-RATE * 0.5
           END-IF
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BONUS-RATE
           IF I-TERM-MONTHS >= 12
               MOVE 000.250 TO WS-BONUS-RATE
           END-IF
           IF I-TERM-MONTHS >= 24
               MOVE 000.500 TO WS-BONUS-RATE
           END-IF
           ADD WS-BONUS-RATE TO WS-MATCH-RATE
           COMPUTE WS-CALC-DIVIDEND ROUNDED =
               I-BALANCE * WS-MATCH-RATE / 100
           COMPUTE WS-CALC-NEW-BAL = I-BALANCE + WS-CALC-DIVIDEND
           MOVE I-ACCOUNT-NUM TO O-ACCOUNT-NUM
           MOVE I-CUSTOMER-NAME TO O-CUSTOMER-NAME
           MOVE I-BALANCE TO O-OLD-BALANCE
           MOVE WS-MATCH-RATE TO O-DIVIDEND-RATE
           MOVE WS-CALC-DIVIDEND TO O-DIVIDEND-AMT
           MOVE WS-CALC-NEW-BAL TO O-NEW-BALANCE
           MOVE WS-MATCH-DESC TO O-TIER-DESC
           WRITE OUT-REC.
       END PROGRAM GEN0076.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 I-ACCOUNT-NUM        PIC X(10).
           05 I-CUSTOMER-NAME      PIC X(20).
           05 I-ACCOUNT-TYPE       PIC X(02).
           05 I-BALANCE            PIC 9(7)V99.
           05 I-TERM-MONTHS        PIC 99.
           05 I-TIER-CODE         PIC X(02).
           05 FILLER               PIC X(12).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 O-ACCOUNT-NUM        PIC X(10).
           05 O-CUSTOMER-NAME      PIC X(20).
           05 O-OLD-BALANCE        PIC 9(7)V99.
           05 O-DIVIDEND-RATE      PIC 9(2)V999.
           05 O-DIVIDEND-AMT       PIC 9(7)V99.
           05 O-NEW-BALANCE        PIC 9(7)V99.
           05 O-TIER-DESC          PIC X(12).

* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0077.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD INFILE.
       COPY GEN0077I.
       FD OUTFILE.
       COPY GEN0077O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG            PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
               88 WS-EOF             VALUE "Y".
               88 WS-NOT-EOF          VALUE "N".
           05 WS-COUNT-IN            PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-COUNT-OUT            PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-COUNT-FLAGGED        PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-WORK.
           05 WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP    PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
           05 WS-REASON-TMP          PIC X(02) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-ACTION-TMP          PIC X(12) VALUE SPACES.
      * HOLD CALCULATED CATEGORY
       01 WS-CATEGORY                PIC X(02) VALUE SPACES.
      *--------------------------------------------------
      * MAIN PROCEDURE
      *--------------------------------------------------
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ INFILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM SHOW-TOTALS
           CLOSE INFILE
           CLOSE OUTFILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-REC.
           ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT-IN
           MOVE "N" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-REASON-TMP
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-ACTION-TMP
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-CATEGORY
      * EVALUATE DORMANT STATUS USING 88 LEVELS
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN IN-DORMANT-CANDIDATE AND IN-TYPE-SAVINGS
                   MOVE "Y" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP
                   MOVE "DA" TO WS-REASON-TMP
                   MOVE "FLAG DORMANT" TO WS-ACTION-TMP
               WHEN IN-DORMANT-CANDIDATE AND IN-TYPE-MONEY-MKT
                   MOVE "Y" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP
                   MOVE "DA" TO WS-REASON-TMP
                   MOVE "FLAG DORMANT" TO WS-ACTION-TMP
               WHEN IN-DORMANT-CANDIDATE AND IN-TYPE-CHECKING
                   IF IN-BALANCE < 100.00
                       MOVE "Y" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP
                       MOVE "CH" TO WS-REASON-TMP
                       MOVE "REVIEW CHK " TO WS-ACTION-TMP
                   ELSE
                       MOVE "N" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP
                       MOVE "CH" TO WS-REASON-TMP
                       MOVE "NO ACTION  " TO WS-ACTION-TMP
                   END-IF
               WHEN IN-SEMI-DORMANT
                   MOVE "N" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP
                   MOVE "SE" TO WS-REASON-TMP
                   MOVE "WATCH LIST " TO WS-ACTION-TMP
               WHEN IN-ACTIVE
                   MOVE "N" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP
                   MOVE "AC" TO WS-REASON-TMP
                   MOVE "ACTIVE     " TO WS-ACTION-TMP
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE "N" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP
                   MOVE "AC" TO WS-REASON-TMP
                   MOVE "ACTIVE     " TO WS-ACTION-TMP
           END-EVALUATE
      * SECOND EVALUATE TO REFINE FOR OVERDRAFTS
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP = "Y" AND IN-SOME-OVERDRAFT
                   MOVE "SE" TO WS-REASON-TMP
                   MOVE "REVIEW OD  " TO WS-ACTION-TMP
               WHEN WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP = "N" AND IN-NO-OVERDRAFT
                   CONTINUE
               WHEN OTHER
                   CONTINUE
           END-EVALUATE
           PERFORM WRITE-OUT
           .
       WRITE-OUT.
           MOVE IN-ACCOUNT-ID TO OUT-ACCOUNT-ID
           MOVE IN-ACCOUNT-TYPE TO OUT-ACCOUNT-TYPE
           MOVE IN-BALANCE TO OUT-BALANCE
           MOVE IN-LAST-ACT-DAYS TO OUT-DAYS-INACTIVE
           MOVE WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP TO OUT-DORMANT-FLAG
           MOVE WS-REASON-TMP TO OUT-REASON-CODE
           MOVE WS-ACTION-TMP TO OUT-ACTION-TEXT
           MOVE IN-BRANCH-CODE TO OUT-BRANCH-CODE
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT-OUT
           IF WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP = "Y"
               ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT-FLAGGED
           END-IF
           .
       SHOW-TOTALS.
      * DISPLAY TOTALS FOR BATCH LOG - NOT DATE DEPENDENT
           DISPLAY "IN=" WS-COUNT-IN " OUT=" WS-COUNT-OUT
           DISPLAY "FLAGGED=" WS-COUNT-FLAGGED
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 IN-ACCOUNT-ID         PIC X(10).
           05 IN-ACCOUNT-TYPE        PIC X(02).
               88 IN-TYPE-SAVINGS    VALUE "SA".
               88 IN-TYPE-CHECKING   VALUE "CH".
               88 IN-TYPE-MONEY-MKT  VALUE "MM".
               88 IN-TYPE-VALID      VALUE "SA" "CH" "MM".
           05 IN-BALANCE             PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 IN-LAST-ACT-DAYS       PIC 9(04).
               88 IN-DORMANT-CANDIDATE VALUE 365 THRU 9999.
               88 IN-ACTIVE          VALUE 0000 THRU 0364.
               88 IN-SEMI-DORMANT    VALUE 180 THRU 0364.
           05 IN-OVERDRAFT-COUNT     PIC 9(02).
               88 IN-NO-OVERDRAFT    VALUE 00.
               88 IN-SOME-OVERDRAFT  VALUE 01 THRU 99.
           05 IN-BRANCH-CODE         PIC X(03).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-ACCOUNT-ID         PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-ACCOUNT-TYPE      PIC X(02).
           05 OUT-BALANCE            PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 OUT-DAYS-INACTIVE      PIC 9(04).
           05 OUT-DORMANT-FLAG       PIC X(01).
               88 OUT-FLAGGED        VALUE "Y".
               88 OUT-NOT-FLAGGED    VALUE "N".
           05 OUT-REASON-CODE        PIC X(02).
               88 OUT-REASON-DORMANT VALUE "DA".
               88 OUT-REASON-SEMI    VALUE "SE".
               88 OUT-REASON-ACTIVE  VALUE "AC".
               88 OUT-REASON-CHECK   VALUE "CH".
           05 OUT-ACTION-TEXT        PIC X(12).
           05 OUT-BRANCH-CODE        PIC X(03).

           05 WS-COUNT-OUT            PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-COUNT-FLAGGED        PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-WORK.
           05 WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP    PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
           05 WS-REASON-TMP          PIC X(02) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-ACTION-TMP          PIC X(12) VALUE SPACES.
      * HOLD CALCULATED CATEGORY
       01 WS-CATEGORY                PIC X(02) VALUE SPACES.
      *--------------------------------------------------
      * MAIN PROCEDURE
      *--------------------------------------------------
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ INFILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM SHOW-TOTALS
           CLOSE INFILE
           CLOSE OUTFILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-REC.
           ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT-IN
           MOVE "N" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-REASON-TMP
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-ACTION-TMP
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-CATEGORY
      * EVALUATE DORMANT STATUS USING 88 LEVELS
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN IN-DORMANT-CANDIDATE AND IN-TYPE-SAVINGS
                   MOVE "Y" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP
                   MOVE "DA" TO WS-REASON-TMP
                   MOVE "FLAG DORMANT" TO WS-ACTION-TMP
               WHEN IN-DORMANT-CANDIDATE AND IN-TYPE-MONEY-MKT
                   MOVE "Y" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP
                   MOVE "DA" TO WS-REASON-TMP
                   MOVE "FLAG DORMANT" TO WS-ACTION-TMP
               WHEN IN-DORMANT-CANDIDATE AND IN-TYPE-CHECKING
                   IF IN-BALANCE < 100.00
                       MOVE "Y" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP
                       MOVE "CH" TO WS-REASON-TMP
                       MOVE "REVIEW CHK " TO WS-ACTION-TMP
                   ELSE
                       MOVE "N" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP
                       MOVE "CH" TO WS-REASON-TMP
                       MOVE "NO ACTION  " TO WS-ACTION-TMP
                   END-IF
               WHEN IN-SEMI-DORMANT
                   MOVE "N" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP
                   MOVE "SE" TO WS-REASON-TMP
                   MOVE "WATCH LIST " TO WS-ACTION-TMP
               WHEN IN-ACTIVE
                   MOVE "N" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP
                   MOVE "AC" TO WS-REASON-TMP
                   MOVE "ACTIVE     " TO WS-ACTION-TMP
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE "N" TO WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP
                   MOVE "AC" TO WS-REASON-TMP
                   MOVE "ACTIVE     " TO WS-ACTION-TMP
           END-EVALUATE
      * SECOND EVALUATE TO REFINE FOR OVERDRAFTS
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP = "Y" AND IN-SOME-OVERDRAFT
                   MOVE "SE" TO WS-REASON-TMP
                   MOVE "REVIEW OD  " TO WS-ACTION-TMP
               WHEN WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP = "N" AND IN-NO-OVERDRAFT
                   CONTINUE
               WHEN OTHER
                   CONTINUE
           END-EVALUATE
           PERFORM WRITE-OUT
           .
       WRITE-OUT.
           MOVE IN-ACCOUNT-ID TO OUT-ACCOUNT-ID
           MOVE IN-ACCOUNT-TYPE TO OUT-ACCOUNT-TYPE
           MOVE IN-BALANCE TO OUT-BALANCE
           MOVE IN-LAST-ACT-DAYS TO OUT-DAYS-INACTIVE
           MOVE WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP TO OUT-DORMANT-FLAG
           MOVE WS-REASON-TMP TO OUT-REASON-CODE
           MOVE WS-ACTION-TMP TO OUT-ACTION-TEXT
           MOVE IN-BRANCH-CODE TO OUT-BRANCH-CODE
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT-OUT
           IF WS-DORMANT-FLAG-TMP = "Y"
               ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT-FLAGGED
           END-IF
           .
       SHOW-TOTALS.
      * DISPLAY TOTALS FOR BATCH LOG - NOT DATE DEPENDENT
           DISPLAY "IN=" WS-COUNT-IN " OUT=" WS-COUNT-OUT
           DISPLAY "FLAGGED=" WS-COUNT-FLAGGED
           .

GEN0078.name: GEN0078
GEN0078.technique: SIGN LEADING SEPARATE amounts and DIVIDE ... REMAINDER
GEN0078.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0078.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD INFILE.
           COPY GEN0078I.
       FD OUTFILE.
           COPY GEN0078O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-STATUS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
              88 WS-EOF VALUE "Y".
              88 WS-NOT-EOF VALUE "N".
           05 WS-INSTALLMENTS-NUM PIC 9(03) VALUE ZERO.
           05 WS-I PIC 9(03) VALUE ZERO.
       01 WS-AMOUNTS.
           05 WS-BASE-AMT PIC S9(7)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE
               VALUE +0.
           05 WS-REMAINDER-AMT PIC S9(7)V99 SIGN LEADING
               SEPARATE VALUE +0.
           05 WS-CURRENT-AMT PIC S9(7)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE
               VALUE +0.
           05 WS-REMAINDER-CENTS PIC S9(7)V99 SIGN LEADING
               SEPARATE VALUE +0.
       01 WS-COUNTERS.
           05 WS-READ-CNT PIC 9(05) VALUE ZERO.
           05 WS-WRITE-CNT PIC 9(05) VALUE ZERO.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ INFILE
                   AT END SET WS-EOF TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END
                       ADD 1 TO WS-READ-CNT
                       PERFORM PROCESS-ORDER
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE
           GOBACK
           .
       PROCESS-ORDER.
           MOVE SO-INSTALLMENTS TO WS-INSTALLMENTS-NUM
           IF WS-INSTALLMENTS-NUM = ZERO
               MOVE +0 TO WS-BASE-AMT
               MOVE SO-AMOUNT TO WS-REMAINDER-AMT
               PERFORM WRITE-SINGLE-RECORD
           ELSE
               DIVIDE SO-AMOUNT BY WS-INSTALLMENTS-NUM
                   GIVING WS-BASE-AMT
                   REMAINDER WS-REMAINDER-AMT
               END-DIVIDE
               PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1
                   UNTIL WS-I > WS-INSTALLMENTS-NUM
                   PERFORM BUILD-INSTALLMENT
               END-PERFORM
           END-IF
           .
       BUILD-INSTALLMENT.
           MOVE SO-ID TO OUT-SO-ID
           MOVE WS-I TO OUT-INSTALL-NUM
           MOVE SO-FREQ-CODE TO OUT-FREQ-CODE
           IF WS-I = WS-INSTALLMENTS-NUM
               ADD WS-REMAINDER-AMT TO WS-BASE-AMT
                   GIVING WS-CURRENT-AMT
               END-ADD
               MOVE "R" TO OUT-REMAINDER-FLAG
           ELSE
               MOVE WS-BASE-AMT TO WS-CURRENT-AMT
               MOVE " " TO OUT-REMAINDER-FLAG
           END-IF
           MOVE WS-CURRENT-AMT TO OUT-INSTALL-AMT
           IF OUT-INSTALL-AMT < 0
               MOVE "NEGATIVE " TO OUT-STATUS
           ELSE
               MOVE "SCHEDULED " TO OUT-STATUS
           END-IF
           WRITE OUT-SCHEDULE-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
           IF WS-I = WS-INSTALLMENTS-NUM
               SUBTRACT WS-REMAINDER-AMT FROM WS-CURRENT-AMT
                   GIVING WS-BASE-AMT
               END-SUBTRACT
           END-IF
           .
       WRITE-SINGLE-RECORD.
           MOVE SO-ID TO OUT-SO-ID
           MOVE 1 TO OUT-INSTALL-NUM
           MOVE SO-AMOUNT TO OUT-INSTALL-AMT
           MOVE "E" TO OUT-REMAINDER-FLAG
           MOVE SO-FREQ-CODE TO OUT-FREQ-CODE
           MOVE "NO-SPLIT  " TO OUT-STATUS
           WRITE OUT-SCHEDULE-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-STANDING-ORDER-REC.
           05 SO-ID PIC X(10).
           05 SO-SOURCE-ACCT PIC X(12).
           05 SO-DEST-ACCT PIC X(12).
           05 SO-AMOUNT PIC S9(7)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 SO-INSTALLMENTS PIC 9(03).
           05 SO-FREQ-CODE PIC X(01).
           05 FILLER PIC X(10).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-SCHEDULE-REC.
           05 OUT-SO-ID PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-INSTALL-NUM PIC 9(03).
           05 OUT-INSTALL-AMT PIC S9(7)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 OUT-REMAINDER-FLAG PIC X(01).
           05 OUT-FREQ-CODE PIC X(01).
           05 OUT-STATUS PIC X(10).
           05 FILLER PIC X(15).

GEN0079.name: GEN0079
GEN0079.technique: INSPECT and reference modification on a text field
GEN0079.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0079.
      * Card annual fee billing
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  INFILE.
           COPY GEN0079I.
       FD  OUTFILE.
           COPY GEN0079O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG PIC X VALUE "N".
           88 WS-EOF VALUE "Y".
           88 WS-NOT-EOF VALUE "N".
       01  WS-SPACE-CNT PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-MASKED-CARD PIC X(16) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-LAST4 PIC X(04) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-NOTE-BASE PIC X(30) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-TIER-DISC PIC 9(4)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-FINAL-FEE PIC 9(4)V99 VALUE 0.
      * Billing note template
       01  WS-TEMPLATE PIC X(30) VALUE
           "CARD FEE DUE : TIER- ".
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ INFILE
                   AT END SET WS-EOF TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE
           GOBACK
           STOP RUN.
       PROCESS-REC.
      * Count spaces in holder name with INSPECT
           MOVE 0 TO WS-SPACE-CNT
           INSPECT GEN0079I-HOLDER-NAME TALLYING
               WS-SPACE-CNT FOR ALL " ".
      * Reference modification to extract last 4 of card
           MOVE GEN0079I-CARD-NUMBER(13:4) TO WS-LAST4
      * Build masked card using reference modification
           MOVE ALL "*" TO WS-MASKED-CARD
           MOVE WS-LAST4 TO WS-MASKED-CARD(13:4)
      * Build note with INSPECT replacing placeholder
           MOVE WS-TEMPLATE TO WS-NOTE-BASE
           INSPECT WS-NOTE-BASE REPLACING FIRST " "
               BY GEN0079I-TIER-CODE.
      * Tier discount logic
           EVALUATE GEN0079I-TIER-CODE
               WHEN "G" MOVE 0 TO WS-TIER-DISC
               WHEN "S" MOVE 10.00 TO WS-TIER-DISC
               WHEN "P" MOVE 25.00 TO WS-TIER-DISC
               WHEN OTHER MOVE 5.00 TO WS-TIER-DISC
           END-EVALUATE
           COMPUTE WS-FINAL-FEE = GEN0079I-ANNUAL-FEE
               - WS-TIER-DISC
           END-COMPUTE
           IF WS-FINAL-FEE < 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-FINAL-FEE
           END-IF
      * Reference modification for holder initials area
           IF GEN0079I-HOLDER-NAME(1:1) NOT = SPACE
               MOVE WS-NOTE-BASE(1:20) TO WS-NOTE-BASE(1:20)
           END-IF
      * Extra fee waiver if name has many spaces
           IF WS-SPACE-CNT > 3
               COMPUTE WS-FINAL-FEE = WS-FINAL-FEE - 5.00
               END-COMPUTE
               IF WS-FINAL-FEE < 0 MOVE 0 TO WS-FINAL-FEE
               END-IF
           END-IF
           MOVE WS-MASKED-CARD TO GEN0079O-CARD-NUMBER
           MOVE WS-NOTE-BASE TO GEN0079O-BILLING-NOTE
           MOVE WS-FINAL-FEE TO GEN0079O-FEE-CHARGED
           MOVE GEN0079I-DUE-MONTH TO GEN0079O-DUE-MONTH
           MOVE WS-SPACE-CNT TO GEN0079O-NAME-SPACES
           WRITE GEN0079O-REC
           EXIT.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  GEN0079I-REC.
           05 GEN0079I-CARD-NUMBER PIC X(16).
           05 GEN0079I-HOLDER-NAME PIC X(20).
           05 GEN0079I-ANNUAL-FEE PIC 9(4)V99.
           05 GEN0079I-TIER-CODE PIC X(01).
           05 GEN0079I-DUE-MONTH PIC 9(02).
           05 GEN0079I-FILLER PIC X(05).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  GEN0079O-REC.
           05 GEN0079O-CARD-NUMBER PIC X(16).
           05 GEN0079O-BILLING-NOTE PIC X(30).
           05 GEN0079O-FEE-CHARGED PIC 9(4)V99.
           05 GEN0079O-DUE-MONTH PIC 9(02).
           05 GEN0079O-NAME-SPACES PIC 9(02).
           05 GEN0079O-FILLER PIC X(04).

GEN0082.name: GEN0082
GEN0082.technique: packed decimal (COMP-3) amounts and signed totals
GEN0082.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0082.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0082I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0082O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG           PIC X(01) VALUE 'N'.
              88 WS-EOF             VALUE 'Y'.
              88 WS-NOT-EOF         VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-CALCS.
           05 WS-NET-CASH           PIC S9(08)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-TOTAL-FEES         PIC S9(06)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-AVG-FEE            PIC S9(05)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-REMAIN             PIC S9(08)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-COUNTERS.
           05 WS-IN-CNT             PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-OUT-CNT            PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
                OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-REC.
           ADD 1 TO WS-IN-CNT
           COMPUTE WS-NET-CASH = CASH-IN - CASH-OUT
           COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-FEES = FEE-AMT * TRANS-CNT
           IF TRANS-CNT = 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-AVG-FEE
           ELSE
               COMPUTE WS-AVG-FEE = FEE-AMT / 1
           END-IF
      *    BUILD PRIMARY BALANCING RECORD
           MOVE TELLER-ID TO O-TELLER-ID
           MOVE DRAWER-SEQ TO O-DRAWER-SEQ
           MOVE WS-NET-CASH TO O-NET-CASH
           MOVE WS-TOTAL-FEES TO O-TOTAL-FEES
           MOVE TRANS-CNT TO O-TRANS-CNT
           IF WS-NET-CASH < 0
               MOVE 'SHORT     ' TO O-BALANCE-STATUS
               MOVE 'S' TO O-ADJUST-FLAG
           ELSE
               IF WS-NET-CASH = 0
                   MOVE 'BALANCED  ' TO O-BALANCE-STATUS
                   MOVE 'B' TO O-ADJUST-FLAG
               ELSE
                   MOVE 'LONG      ' TO O-BALANCE-STATUS
                   MOVE 'L' TO O-ADJUST-FLAG
               END-IF
           END-IF
           WRITE OUT-TELLER-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-OUT-CNT
      *    SECOND RECORD FOR LARGE DRAWERS
           IF TRANS-CNT > 20
               COMPUTE WS-REMAIN = WS-NET-CASH - WS-TOTAL-FEES
               MOVE TELLER-ID TO O-TELLER-ID
               MOVE DRAWER-SEQ TO O-DRAWER-SEQ
               MOVE WS-REMAIN TO O-NET-CASH
               MOVE WS-TOTAL-FEES TO O-TOTAL-FEES
               MOVE 'REVIEW    ' TO O-BALANCE-STATUS
               MOVE 'R' TO O-ADJUST-FLAG
               WRITE OUT-TELLER-REC
               ADD 1 TO WS-OUT-CNT
           END-IF
           IF FEE-AMT > 50
               MOVE TELLER-ID TO O-TELLER-ID
               MOVE DRAWER-SEQ TO O-DRAWER-SEQ
               MOVE 0 TO O-NET-CASH
               MOVE FEE-AMT TO O-TOTAL-FEES
               MOVE 'HIGH-FEE  ' TO O-BALANCE-STATUS
               MOVE 'H' TO O-ADJUST-FLAG
               WRITE OUT-TELLER-REC
               ADD 1 TO WS-OUT-CNT
           END-IF.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-TELLER-REC.
           05 TELLER-ID             PIC X(05).
           05 DRAWER-SEQ            PIC 9(04).
           05 DRAWER-SEQ-X REDEFINES DRAWER-SEQ PIC X(04).
           05 CASH-IN               PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3.
           05 CASH-OUT              PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3.
           05 FEE-AMT               PIC S9(05)V99 COMP-3.
           05 TRANS-CNT             PIC 9(04).
           05 BRANCH-CODE           PIC X(03).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-TELLER-REC.
           05 O-TELLER-ID           PIC X(05).
           05 O-DRAWER-SEQ          PIC 9(04).
           05 O-NET-CASH            PIC S9(08)V99 COMP-3.
           05 O-TOTAL-FEES          PIC S9(06)V99 COMP-3.
           05 O-BALANCE-STATUS      PIC X(10).
           05 O-STATUS-X REDEFINES O-BALANCE-STATUS PIC X(10).
           05 O-TRANS-CNT           PIC 9(04).
           05 O-ADJUST-FLAG         PIC X(01).

GEN0085.name: GEN0085
GEN0085.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0085.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0085I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0085O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG             PIC X(01) VALUE 'N'.
           88 WS-EOF               VALUE 'Y'.
           88 WS-NOT-EOF            VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-CALC-BASE            PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-CALC-RISK            PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-CALC-FEE             PIC 9(04)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-CALC-TOTAL           PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-RISK-CAT             PIC X(01) VALUE 'M'.
           88 WS-RISK-LOW           VALUE 'L'.
           88 WS-RISK-MED           VALUE 'M'.
           88 WS-RISK-HIGH          VALUE 'H'.
       01  WS-TYPE-GROUP           PIC X(01) VALUE 'X'.
           88 WS-GROUP-STANDARD    VALUE 'S'.
           88 WS-GROUP-PREMIUM     VALUE 'P'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
                OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END SET WS-EOF TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-ONE
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           .
       PROCESS-ONE SECTION.
           MOVE 0 TO WS-CALC-BASE WS-CALC-RISK WS-CALC-FEE
           MOVE 0 TO WS-CALC-TOTAL
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN IN-RISK-SCORE < 030
                   MOVE 'L' TO WS-RISK-CAT
               WHEN IN-RISK-SCORE < 070
                   MOVE 'M' TO WS-RISK-CAT
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 'H' TO WS-RISK-CAT
           END-EVALUATE
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN VAL-TYPE-A
                   MOVE 'S' TO WS-TYPE-GROUP
               WHEN VAL-TYPE-B
                   MOVE 'S' TO WS-TYPE-GROUP
               WHEN VAL-TYPE-C
                   MOVE 'P' TO WS-TYPE-GROUP
               WHEN VAL-TYPE-D
                   MOVE 'P' TO WS-TYPE-GROUP
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 'S' TO WS-TYPE-GROUP
           END-EVALUATE
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN WS-RISK-LOW AND WS-GROUP-STANDARD
                   COMPUTE WS-CALC-BASE = IN-PREMIUM-AMT * 0.80
                   COMPUTE WS-CALC-RISK = IN-PREMIUM-AMT * 0.15
                   MOVE 12.50 TO WS-CALC-FEE
               WHEN WS-RISK-LOW AND WS-GROUP-PREMIUM
                   COMPUTE WS-CALC-BASE = IN-PREMIUM-AMT * 0.75
                   COMPUTE WS-CALC-RISK = IN-PREMIUM-AMT * 0.20
                   MOVE 15.00 TO WS-CALC-FEE
               WHEN WS-RISK-MED AND WS-GROUP-STANDARD
                   COMPUTE WS-CALC-BASE = IN-PREMIUM-AMT * 0.70
                   COMPUTE WS-CALC-RISK = IN-PREMIUM-AMT * 0.25
                   MOVE 18.75 TO WS-CALC-FEE
               WHEN WS-RISK-MED AND WS-GROUP-PREMIUM
                   COMPUTE WS-CALC-BASE = IN-PREMIUM-AMT * 0.65
                   COMPUTE WS-CALC-RISK = IN-PREMIUM-AMT * 0.30
                   MOVE 20.00 TO WS-CALC-FEE
               WHEN WS-RISK-HIGH
                   COMPUTE WS-CALC-BASE = IN-PREMIUM-AMT * 0.55
                   COMPUTE WS-CALC-RISK = IN-PREMIUM-AMT * 0.40
                   MOVE 25.50 TO WS-CALC-FEE
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE IN-PREMIUM-AMT TO WS-CALC-BASE
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-CALC-RISK WS-CALC-FEE
           END-EVALUATE
           COMPUTE WS-CALC-TOTAL = WS-CALC-BASE + WS-CALC-RISK
               + WS-CALC-FEE
           MOVE IN-POLICY-NUM TO OUT-POLICY-NUM
           MOVE IN-POLICY-TYPE TO OUT-POLICY-TYPE
           MOVE WS-CALC-BASE TO OUT-ALLOC-BASE
           MOVE WS-CALC-RISK TO OUT-ALLOC-RISK
           MOVE WS-CALC-FEE TO OUT-ALLOC-FEE
