GEN0084.name: GEN0084
GEN0084.technique: an OCCURS table searched with PERFORM VARYING
GEN0084.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0084.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0084I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0084O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG               PIC X VALUE "N".
       01  WS-REC-COUNT              PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-NET-AMT                PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-GROUP                  PIC X(04) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-STATUS                 PIC X(01) VALUE "A".
       01  WS-IDX                    PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-FOUND                  PIC X VALUE "N".
       01  WS-CAT-TABLE.
           05 WS-CAT-ENTRIES OCCURS 6 TIMES INDEXED BY C-IDX.
              10 WS-T-CAT            PIC X(02).
              10 WS-T-GROUP           PIC X(04).
              10 WS-T-LIMIT           PIC 9(07)V99.
       01  WS-TOTAL-GROSS            PIC 9(09)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-TOTAL-NET              PIC 9(09)V99 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           PERFORM INIT-TABLE
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = "Y"
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       INIT-TABLE.
           MOVE "01" TO WS-T-CAT(1)
           MOVE "B01 " TO WS-T-GROUP(1)
           MOVE 500000.00 TO WS-T-LIMIT(1)
           MOVE "02" TO WS-T-CAT(2)
           MOVE "B02 " TO WS-T-GROUP(2)
           MOVE 300000.00 TO WS-T-LIMIT(2)
           MOVE "03" TO WS-T-CAT(3)
           MOVE "B03 " TO WS-T-GROUP(3)
           MOVE 100000.00 TO WS-T-LIMIT(3)
           MOVE "04" TO WS-T-CAT(4)
           MOVE "B04 " TO WS-T-GROUP(4)
           MOVE 750000.00 TO WS-T-LIMIT(4)
           MOVE "05" TO WS-T-CAT(5)
           MOVE "B05 " TO WS-T-GROUP(5)
           MOVE 200000.00 TO WS-T-LIMIT(5)
           MOVE "99" TO WS-T-CAT(6)
           MOVE "B99 " TO WS-T-GROUP(6)
           MOVE 999999.99 TO WS-T-LIMIT(6)
           .
       PROCESS-REC.
           ADD 1 TO WS-REC-COUNT
           COMPUTE WS-NET-AMT = G84-GROSS-AMT - G84-FEE-AMT
           MOVE "N" TO WS-FOUND
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-GROUP
           PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-IDX > 6
               IF G84-MERCHANT-CAT = WS-T-CAT(WS-IDX)
                   MOVE WS-T-GROUP(WS-IDX) TO WS-GROUP
                   MOVE "Y" TO WS-FOUND
                   EXIT PERFORM
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           IF WS-FOUND = "N"
               MOVE "B00 " TO WS-GROUP
           END-IF
           IF WS-NET-AMT < 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-NET-AMT
               MOVE "E" TO WS-STATUS
           ELSE
               MOVE "A" TO WS-STATUS
               IF WS-NET-AMT > 50000
                   MOVE "H" TO WS-STATUS
               END-IF
           END-IF
           MOVE G84-MERCHANT-ID TO G84O-MERCHANT-ID
           MOVE G84-SETTLE-DATE TO G84O-SETTLE-DATE
           MOVE G84-MERCHANT-CAT TO G84O-CATEGORY
           MOVE G84-GROSS-AMT TO G84O-GROSS-AMT
           MOVE G84-FEE-AMT TO G84O-FEE-AMT
           MOVE WS-NET-AMT TO G84O-NET-AMT
           MOVE WS-GROUP TO G84O-BATCH-GROUP
           MOVE WS-STATUS TO G84O-STATUS-FLAG
           WRITE GEN0084O-REC
           ADD G84-GROSS-AMT TO WS-TOTAL-GROSS
           ADD WS-NET-AMT TO WS-TOTAL-NET
           IF G84-TXN-COUNT > 100
               PERFORM WRITE-SUMMARY-REC
           END-IF
           .
       WRITE-SUMMARY-REC.
           MOVE G84-MERCHANT-ID TO G84O-MERCHANT-ID
           MOVE G84-SETTLE-DATE TO G84O-SETTLE-DATE
           MOVE G84-MERCHANT-CAT TO G84O-CATEGORY
           MOVE G84-GROSS-AMT TO G84O-GROSS-AMT
           MOVE G84-FEE-AMT TO G84O-FEE-AMT
           MOVE WS-NET-AMT TO G84O-NET-AMT
           MOVE "SUMM" TO G84O-BATCH-GROUP
           MOVE "S" TO G84O-STATUS-FLAG
           WRITE GEN0084O-REC
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
        01 GEN0084I-REC.
           05 G84-MERCHANT-ID        PIC X(08).
           05 G84-MERCHANT-CAT       PIC X(02).
           05 G84-GROSS-AMT          PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 G84-FEE-AMT            PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 G84-TXN-COUNT          PIC 9(04).
           05 G84-SETTLE-DATE        PIC X(08).
           05 G84-FILLER             PIC X(10).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
        01 GEN0084O-REC.
           05 G84O-MERCHANT-ID       PIC X(08).
           05 G84O-SETTLE-DATE       PIC X(08).
           05 G84O-CATEGORY          PIC X(02).
           05 G84O-GROSS-AMT         PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 G84O-FEE-AMT           PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 G84O-NET-AMT           PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 G84O-BATCH-GROUP       PIC X(04).
           05 G84O-STATUS-FLAG       PIC X(01).
           05 G84O-FILLER            PIC X(06).

GEN0083.technique: a control break with subtotals and a final trailer record
GEN0083.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0083.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  INFILE.
           COPY GEN0083I.
       FD  OUTFILE.
           COPY GEN0083O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG         PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
           05 WS-FIRST-REC        PIC X(01) VALUE "Y".
       01  WS-PREV-DEPT           PIC X(04) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-CURR-DEPT           PIC X(04) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-DEPT-CNT            PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-DEPT-TOTAL          PIC 9(09)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-GRAND-CNT           PIC 9(07) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-GRAND-TOTAL         PIC 9(11)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-RUN-TOTAL           PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM 1000-OPEN-FILES
           PERFORM 1100-READ-INPUT
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = "Y"
               PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-RECORD
               PERFORM 1100-READ-INPUT
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM 3000-WRITE-FINAL-TRAILER
           PERFORM 9000-CLOSE-FILES
           GOBACK.
       1000-OPEN-FILES.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           MOVE 0 TO WS-DEPT-CNT
           MOVE 0 TO WS-DEPT-TOTAL
           MOVE 0 TO WS-GRAND-CNT
           MOVE 0 TO WS-GRAND-TOTAL
           MOVE 0 TO WS-RUN-TOTAL
           .
       1100-READ-INPUT.
           READ INFILE
               AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
               NOT AT END CONTINUE
           END-READ
           .
       2000-PROCESS-RECORD.
           MOVE IR-DEPT-CODE TO WS-CURR-DEPT
           IF WS-FIRST-REC = "Y"
               MOVE WS-CURR-DEPT TO WS-PREV-DEPT
               MOVE "N" TO WS-FIRST-REC
           END-IF
           IF WS-CURR-DEPT NOT = WS-PREV-DEPT
               PERFORM 2500-WRITE-SUBTOTAL
           END-IF
           ADD 1 TO WS-DEPT-CNT
           ADD 1 TO WS-GRAND-CNT
           ADD IR-DEDUCTION-AMT TO WS-DEPT-TOTAL
           ADD IR-DEDUCTION-AMT TO WS-GRAND-TOTAL
           ADD IR-DEDUCTION-AMT TO WS-RUN-TOTAL
           PERFORM 2100-WRITE-DETAIL
           MOVE WS-CURR-DEPT TO WS-PREV-DEPT
           .
       2100-WRITE-DETAIL.
           MOVE "D" TO OR-REC-TYPE
           MOVE IR-DEPT-CODE TO OR-DEPT-CODE
           MOVE IR-EMP-ID TO OR-EMP-ID
           MOVE IR-DEDUCTION-TYPE TO OR-DED-TYPE
           MOVE IR-DEDUCTION-AMT TO OR-DED-AMT
           MOVE WS-RUN-TOTAL TO OR-RUN-TOTAL
           WRITE OUT-RECORD
           .
       2500-WRITE-SUBTOTAL.
           MOVE "S" TO OR-REC-TYPE
           MOVE WS-PREV-DEPT TO OR-SUB-DEPT
           MOVE WS-DEPT-CNT TO OR-SUB-CNT
           MOVE WS-DEPT-TOTAL TO OR-SUB-TOTAL
           WRITE OUT-RECORD
           MOVE 0 TO WS-DEPT-CNT
           MOVE 0 TO WS-DEPT-TOTAL
           .
       3000-WRITE-FINAL-TRAILER.
           IF WS-FIRST-REC = "N"
               MOVE "S" TO OR-REC-TYPE
               MOVE WS-PREV-DEPT TO OR-SUB-DEPT
               MOVE WS-DEPT-CNT TO OR-SUB-CNT
               MOVE WS-DEPT-TOTAL TO OR-SUB-TOTAL
               WRITE OUT-RECORD
           END-IF
           MOVE "T" TO OR-REC-TYPE
           MOVE WS-GRAND-CNT TO OR-TRAIL-CNT
           MOVE WS-GRAND-TOTAL TO OR-TRAIL-TOTAL
           WRITE OUT-RECORD
           .
       9000-CLOSE-FILES.
           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-RECORD.
           05 IR-DEPT-CODE        PIC X(04).
           05 IR-EMP-ID           PIC 9(06).
           05 IR-EMP-NAME         PIC X(20).
           05 IR-DEDUCTION-TYPE   PIC X(02).
           05 IR-DEDUCTION-AMT    PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 IR-PAY-PERIOD        PIC 9(06).
           05 FILLER               PIC X(10).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.

           05 OR-REC-TYPE         PIC X(01).
           05 OR-DATA             PIC X(79).

               10 OR-EMP-ID       PIC X(06).
               10 OR-DED-TYPE     PIC X(02).
               10 OR-DED-AMT      PIC 9(05)V99.

GEN0086.name: GEN0086
GEN0086.technique: SIGN LEADING SEPARATE amounts and DIVIDE ... REMAINDER
GEN0086.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0086.
      * PENSION CONTRIBUTION MATCHING WITH REMAINDER
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
       COPY GEN0086I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0086O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG         PIC X VALUE "N".
              88 WS-EOF            VALUE "Y".
              88 WS-NOT-EOF        VALUE "N".
       01  WS-COUNTS.
           05 WS-READ-CNT         PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-WRITE-CNT        PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-CALC-FIELDS.
           05 WS-SALARY-NUM       PIC S9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-CONTRIB-NUM      PIC S9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-MATCH-NUM        PIC S9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-CAP-NUM          PIC S9(7)V99 VALUE 1500.00.
           05 WS-HALF-NUM         PIC S9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-DIVISOR          PIC 9(4) VALUE 100.
           05 WS-QUOTIENT         PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-REMAINDER-NUM   PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-REMAINDER-AMT   PIC S9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-YEARS-NUM       PIC 9(2) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-DISPLAY-FIELDS.
           05 WS-DISP-READ       PIC ZZ,ZZ9.
           05 WS-DISP-WRITE      PIC ZZ,ZZ9.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           PERFORM OPEN-FILES
           PERFORM READ-LOOP UNTIL WS-EOF
           PERFORM CLOSE-FILES
           PERFORM SHOW-STATS
           GOBACK
           STOP RUN.
       OPEN-FILES.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           MOVE "N" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
           MOVE 0 TO WS-READ-CNT
           MOVE 0 TO WS-WRITE-CNT.
       READ-LOOP.
           READ IN-FILE
               AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
               NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-RECORD
           END-READ.
       PROCESS-RECORD.
           ADD 1 TO WS-READ-CNT
      * CONVERT SIGN SEPARATE FIELDS TO NUMERIC
           MOVE EMP-SALARY TO WS-SALARY-NUM
           MOVE EMP-CONTRIB TO WS-CONTRIB-NUM
           MOVE EMP-YEARS TO WS-YEARS-NUM
      * COMPUTE 50 PERCENT MATCH
           DIVIDE WS-CONTRIB-NUM BY 2 GIVING WS-HALF-NUM
           MOVE WS-HALF-NUM TO WS-MATCH-NUM
      * APPLY CAP OF 1500.00
           IF WS-MATCH-NUM > WS-CAP-NUM
               MOVE WS-CAP-NUM TO WS-MATCH-NUM
           END-IF
      * VESTING ADJUSTMENT BY YEARS
           IF WS-YEARS-NUM < 3
               DIVIDE WS-MATCH-NUM BY 2 GIVING WS-MATCH-NUM
           END-IF
      * COMPUTE REMAINDER WHEN DIVIDED BY 100
           DIVIDE WS-CONTRIB-NUM BY WS-DIVISOR
               GIVING WS-QUOTIENT REMAINDER WS-REMAINDER-NUM
           END-DIVIDE
           MOVE WS-REMAINDER-NUM TO WS-REMAINDER-AMT
           DIVIDE WS-REMAINDER-AMT BY 100
               GIVING WS-REMAINDER-AMT
           END-DIVIDE
           PERFORM WRITE-OUT-REC
      * SECOND RECORD FOR HIGH CONTRIBUTORS
           IF WS-CONTRIB-NUM > 2000
               MOVE WS-MATCH-NUM TO WS-MATCH-NUM
               MOVE "BONUS-ELIG" TO OUT-STATUS
               PERFORM WRITE-BONUS-REC
           END-IF.
       WRITE-OUT-REC.
           MOVE EMP-ID TO OUT-EMP-ID
           MOVE WS-MATCH-NUM TO OUT-MATCH-AMT
           MOVE WS-REMAINDER-AMT TO OUT-REMAINDER-AMT
           MOVE "MATCHED   " TO OUT-STATUS
           IF WS-YEARS-NUM < 3
               MOVE "PART-VEST " TO OUT-STATUS
           END-IF
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT.
       WRITE-BONUS-REC.
           MOVE EMP-ID TO OUT-EMP-ID
           MOVE WS-MATCH-NUM TO OUT-MATCH-AMT
           MOVE WS-REMAINDER-AMT TO OUT-REMAINDER-AMT
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT.
       CLOSE-FILES.
           CLOSE IN-FILE
           CLOSE OUT-FILE.
       SHOW-STATS.
           MOVE WS-READ-CNT TO WS-DISP-READ
           MOVE WS-WRITE-CNT TO WS-DISP-WRITE
           DISPLAY "READ: " WS-DISP-READ
           DISPLAY "WRITTEN: " WS-DISP-WRITE
           DISPLAY "DONE GEN0086".
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  IN-REC.
           05 EMP-ID              PIC X(6).
           05 EMP-SALARY          PIC S9(6)V99
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 EMP-CONTRIB         PIC S9(5)V99
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 DEPT-CODE           PIC X(4).
           05 EMP-YEARS           PIC 9(2).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-EMP-ID          PIC X(6).
           05 OUT-MATCH-AMT       PIC S9(5)V99
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 OUT-REMAINDER-AMT  PIC S9(5)V99
               SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 OUT-STATUS          PIC X(10).

GEN0090.name: GEN0090
GEN0090.technique: packed decimal (COMP-3) amounts and signed totals
GEN0090.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0090.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  INFILE.
           COPY GEN0090I.
       FD  OUTFILE.
           COPY GEN0090O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG            PIC X(01) VALUE 'N'.
               88 WS-EOF              VALUE 'Y'.
               88 WS-NOT-EOF          VALUE 'N'.
           05 WS-SPREAD-MONTHS-NUM   PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-LOOP-IDX            PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-REMAINDER-CNT       PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CALC-FIELDS.
           05 WS-SHORTAGE-PER-MTH    PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-ADJUSTED-PAY        PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-RUNNING-TOT         PIC S9(09)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-LAST-PORTION        PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-SHORTAGE-WORK       PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-DISPLAY-FIELDS.
           05 WS-REC-CNT-IN          PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-REC-CNT-OUT         PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           PERFORM INIT-PARA
           PERFORM PROCESS-LOOP UNTIL WS-EOF
           PERFORM END-PARA
           GOBACK
           .
       INIT-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM READ-INFILE
           .
       READ-INFILE.
           READ INFILE
               AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
               NOT AT END
                   ADD 1 TO WS-REC-CNT-IN
           END-READ
           .
       PROCESS-LOOP.
           PERFORM CALC-SPREAD-PARA
           PERFORM WRITE-SPREAD-PARA
           PERFORM READ-INFILE
           .
       CALC-SPREAD-PARA.
           MOVE 0 TO WS-RUNNING-TOT
           MOVE ESI-SHORTAGE-AMT TO WS-SHORTAGE-WORK
           MOVE ESI-SPREAD-MONTHS TO WS-SPREAD-MONTHS-NUM
           IF WS-SPREAD-MONTHS-NUM = 0
               MOVE 1 TO WS-SPREAD-MONTHS-NUM
           END-IF
           IF WS-SPREAD-MONTHS-NUM > 36
               MOVE 36 TO WS-SPREAD-MONTHS-NUM
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-SHORTAGE-PER-MTH ROUNDED =
               ESI-SHORTAGE-AMT / WS-SPREAD-MONTHS-NUM
           COMPUTE WS-ADJUSTED-PAY =
               ESI-MONTHLY-PAYMENT + WS-SHORTAGE-PER-MTH
           MOVE ESI-SHORTAGE-AMT TO WS-LAST-PORTION
           .
       WRITE-SPREAD-PARA.
           PERFORM VARYING WS-LOOP-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-LOOP-IDX > WS-SPREAD-MONTHS-NUM
               MOVE ESI-ACCOUNT-ID TO ESO-ACCOUNT-ID
               MOVE ESI-REGION-CODE TO ESO-REGION-CODE
               MOVE WS-LOOP-IDX TO ESO-SPREAD-SEQ
               MOVE WS-ADJUSTED-PAY TO ESO-ADJUSTED-PAYMENT
               IF WS-LOOP-IDX < WS-SPREAD-MONTHS-NUM
                   MOVE WS-SHORTAGE-PER-MTH TO ESO-SHORTAGE-PORTION
                   ADD WS-SHORTAGE-PER-MTH TO WS-RUNNING-TOT
               ELSE
                   COMPUTE WS-LAST-PORTION =
                       ESI-SHORTAGE-AMT -
                       (WS-SHORTAGE-PER-MTH *
                       (WS-SPREAD-MONTHS-NUM - 1))
                   MOVE WS-LAST-PORTION TO ESO-SHORTAGE-PORTION
                   COMPUTE WS-ADJUSTED-PAY =
                       ESI-MONTHLY-PAYMENT + WS-LAST-PORTION
                   MOVE WS-ADJUSTED-PAY TO ESO-ADJUSTED-PAYMENT
                   ADD WS-LAST-PORTION TO WS-RUNNING-TOT
               END-IF
               MOVE WS-RUNNING-TOT TO ESO-RUNNING-TOTAL
               MOVE SPACES TO ESO-FILLER-A
               WRITE GEN0090O-REC
               ADD 1 TO WS-REC-CNT-OUT
           END-PERFORM
           .
       END-PARA.
           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE
           DISPLAY 'GEN0090 PROCESSED '
               WS-REC-CNT-IN ' INPUT RECORDS'
           DISPLAY 'GEN0090 WROTE '
               WS-REC-CNT-OUT ' OUTPUT RECORDS'
           STOP RUN
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 GEN0090I-REC.
           05 ESI-ACCOUNT-ID         PIC X(10).
           05 ESI-REGION-CODE        PIC X(04).
           05 ESI-SPREAD-MONTHS      PIC 9(03).
           05 ESI-FILLER-A           PIC X(03).
           05 ESI-MONTHLY-PAYMENT    PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3.
           05 ESI-ESCROW-PORTION     PIC S9(05)V99 COMP-3.
           05 ESI-SHORTAGE-AMT       PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 GEN0090O-REC.

* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.

       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0093I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0093O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG                PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
           88 WS-EOF                   VALUE "Y".
           88 WS-NOT-EOF               VALUE "N".
       01  WS-FREQ-CODE               PIC X(02) VALUE SPACES.
           88 WS-FREQ-MONTHLY          VALUE "MO".
           88 WS-FREQ-WEEKLY           VALUE "WK".
           88 WS-FREQ-BIWEEKLY         VALUE "BW".
           88 WS-FREQ-QUARTERLY        VALUE "QT".
           88 WS-FREQ-ANNUAL           VALUE "AN".
       01  WS-FREQ-DESC               PIC X(12) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-MONTH-INC               PIC 9(02) VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-INST-IDX                PIC 9(02) VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-START-YYYY              PIC 9(04) VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-START-MM                PIC 9(02) VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-CURR-YYYY               PIC 9(04) VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-CURR-MM                 PIC 9(02) VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-TOTAL-MONTHS            PIC 9(04) VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-DUE-YYYYMM              PIC 9(06) VALUE ZERO.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
                OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-ORDER
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           STOP RUN.
       PROCESS-ORDER.
           MOVE IN-FREQ-CODE TO WS-FREQ-CODE
      *    determine description and increment via 88 levels
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN WS-FREQ-MONTHLY
                   MOVE "MONTHLY     " TO WS-FREQ-DESC
                   MOVE 1 TO WS-MONTH-INC
               WHEN WS-FREQ-WEEKLY
                   MOVE "WEEKLY      " TO WS-FREQ-DESC
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-MONTH-INC
               WHEN WS-FREQ-BIWEEKLY
                   MOVE "BIWEEKLY    " TO WS-FREQ-DESC
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-MONTH-INC
               WHEN WS-FREQ-QUARTERLY
                   MOVE "QUARTERLY   " TO WS-FREQ-DESC
                   MOVE 3 TO WS-MONTH-INC
               WHEN WS-FREQ-ANNUAL
                   MOVE "ANNUAL      " TO WS-FREQ-DESC
                   MOVE 12 TO WS-MONTH-INC
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE "UNKNOWN     " TO WS-FREQ-DESC
                   MOVE 1 TO WS-MONTH-INC
           END-EVALUATE
           COMPUTE WS-START-YYYY = FUNCTION INTEGER
               (IN-START-YYYYMM / 100)
           COMPUTE WS-START-MM = FUNCTION MOD
               (IN-START-YYYYMM 100)
           IF WS-START-MM = 0
               MOVE 1 TO WS-START-MM
           END-IF
           IF WS-START-MM > 12
               MOVE 12 TO WS-START-MM
           END-IF
           PERFORM VARYING WS-INST-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-INST-IDX > IN-INST-COUNT
               PERFORM CALC-DUE-DATE
               PERFORM WRITE-INSTALLMENT
           END-PERFORM.
       CALC-DUE-DATE.
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN WS-FREQ-WEEKLY
                   COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-MONTHS =
                       WS-START-MM + (WS-INST-IDX - 1) / 4
               WHEN WS-FREQ-BIWEEKLY
                   COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-MONTHS =
                       WS-START-MM + (WS-INST-IDX - 1) / 2
               WHEN OTHER
                   COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-MONTHS = WS-START-MM +
                       (WS-INST-IDX - 1) * WS-MONTH-INC
           END-EVALUATE
           COMPUTE WS-CURR-YYYY = WS-START-YYYY +
               (WS-TOTAL-MONTHS - 1) / 12
           COMPUTE WS-CURR-MM = FUNCTION MOD
               (WS-TOTAL-MONTHS - 1 12) + 1
           COMPUTE WS-DUE-YYYYMM = WS-CURR-YYYY * 100
               + WS-CURR-MM.
       WRITE-INSTALLMENT.
           MOVE IN-ACCT-NUM TO OUT-ACCT-NUM
           MOVE IN-BENE-NAME TO OUT-BENE-NAME
           MOVE IN-AMOUNT TO OUT-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-DUE-YYYYMM TO OUT-DUE-YYYYMM
           MOVE WS-INST-IDX TO OUT-SEQ-NUM
           MOVE WS-FREQ-DESC TO OUT-FREQ-DESC
           IF WS-INST-IDX = 1
               MOVE "F" TO OUT-STATUS-FLAG
           ELSE
               MOVE "S" TO OUT-STATUS-FLAG
           END-IF
           WRITE OUT-REC.

GEN0094.name: GEN0094
GEN0094.technique: SIGN LEADING SEPARATE amounts and DIVIDE ... REMAINDER
GEN0094.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0094.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
       COPY GEN0094I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0094O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG             PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
       01 WS-ANNUAL-CENTS         PIC S9(07) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-MONTHLY-CENTS        PIC S9(07) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-REMAINDER-CENTS-WS   PIC S9(07) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-QUOTIENT             PIC S9(07) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-REWARD-ADJ           PIC S9(07) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-DIVISOR              PIC 9(02) VALUE 12.
       01 WS-STATUS-WORK          PIC X(10) VALUE SPACES.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = "Y"
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           .
       PROCESS-REC.
      * Convert annual fee to cents for integer divide
           COMPUTE WS-ANNUAL-CENTS = IN-ANNUAL-FEE * 100
           DIVIDE WS-ANNUAL-CENTS BY WS-DIVISOR
               GIVING WS-QUOTIENT
               REMAINDER WS-REMAINDER-CENTS-WS
           END-DIVIDE
           COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-CENTS = WS-QUOTIENT
           IF WS-REMAINDER-CENTS-WS < 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-REMAINDER-CENTS-WS
           END-IF
      * Reward adjustment based on points
           MOVE 0 TO WS-REWARD-ADJ
           IF IN-REWARD-POINTS > 5000
               COMPUTE WS-REWARD-ADJ = IN-REWARD-POINTS / 100
           END-IF
           IF IN-ACCT-STATUS = "A"
               MOVE "ACTIVE    " TO WS-STATUS-WORK
           ELSE
               MOVE "REVIEW    " TO WS-STATUS-WORK
               IF IN-ANNUAL-FEE < 0
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-MONTHLY-CENTS
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-REMAINDER-CENTS-WS
               END-IF
           END-IF
      * First output record : monthly billing detail
           MOVE IN-CARD-NUM TO OUT-CARD-NUM
           MOVE IN-ANNUAL-FEE TO OUT-ANNUAL-FEE
           COMPUTE OUT-MONTHLY-INST = WS-MONTHLY-CENTS / 100
           MOVE WS-REMAINDER-CENTS-WS TO OUT-REMAINDER-CENTS
           MOVE 12 TO OUT-INST-COUNT
           MOVE WS-STATUS-WORK TO OUT-BILL-STATUS
           MOVE WS-REWARD-ADJ TO OUT-REWARD-ADJ
           WRITE OUT-REC
      * Second output record : summary if fee waived or charged
           IF IN-TXN-COUNT > 20 AND IN-ACCT-STATUS = "A"
               MOVE IN-CARD-NUM TO OUT-CARD-NUM
               MOVE 0 TO OUT-ANNUAL-FEE
               MOVE 0 TO OUT-MONTHLY-INST
               MOVE 0 TO OUT-REMAINDER-CENTS
               MOVE 0 TO OUT-INST-COUNT
               MOVE "WAIVED    " TO OUT-BILL-STATUS
               MOVE WS-REWARD-ADJ TO OUT-REWARD-ADJ
               WRITE OUT-REC
           ELSE
               IF WS-REMAINDER-CENTS-WS > 0
                   MOVE IN-CARD-NUM TO OUT-CARD-NUM
                   MOVE IN-ANNUAL-FEE TO OUT-ANNUAL-FEE
                   COMPUTE OUT-MONTHLY-INST = WS-MONTHLY-CENTS / 100
                   MOVE WS-REMAINDER-CENTS-WS TO OUT-REMAINDER-CENTS
                   MOVE 01 TO OUT-INST-COUNT
                   MOVE "ADJUST    " TO OUT-BILL-STATUS
                   MOVE 0 TO OUT-REWARD-ADJ
                   WRITE OUT-REC
               END-IF
           END-IF
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 IN-CARD-NUM         PIC X(16).
           05 IN-CARDHOLDER-NAME  PIC X(20).
           05 IN-ANNUAL-FEE       PIC S9(04)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 IN-TXN-COUNT        PIC 9(03).
           05 IN-REWARD-POINTS    PIC 9(05).
           05 IN-ACCT-STATUS      PIC X(01).
           05 FILLER              PIC X(07).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-CARD-NUM        PIC X(16).
           05 OUT-ANNUAL-FEE      PIC S9(04)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 OUT-MONTHLY-INST    PIC S9(04)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 OUT-REMAINDER-CENTS PIC S9(02) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 OUT-INST-COUNT      PIC 9(02).
           05 OUT-BILL-STATUS     PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-REWARD-ADJ      PIC S9(05) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(05).

GEN0095.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0095.

       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE

           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE

       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD IN-FILE.
       COPY GEN0095I.
       FD OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0095O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-DAILY-RATE PIC 9(2)V9(6).
       01 WS-INTEREST PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-TOTAL-DUE PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-SPACE-CNT PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-NAME-LEN PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-NAME-UP PIC X(20).
       01 WS-INIT PIC X(05) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-POS PIC 9(2) VALUE 1.
       01 WS-I PIC 9(2) VALUE 1.
       01 WS-CHAR PIC X.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = 'Y'
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-RECORD
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-RECORD.
      * Calculate overdraft interest and format name
           MOVE 0 TO WS-INTEREST WS-TOTAL-DUE
           MOVE 0 TO WS-SPACE-CNT WS-NAME-LEN
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-INIT WS-NAME-UP
           MOVE IN-ACCT-NAME TO WS-NAME-UP
      * Inspect name field to count spaces
           INSPECT WS-NAME-UP TALLYING WS-SPACE-CNT
               FOR ALL SPACES
           INSPECT WS-NAME-UP REPLACING ALL '_' BY ' '
           INSPECT WS-NAME-UP CONVERTING
               'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'
               TO 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
           COMPUTE WS-NAME-LEN = FUNCTION LENGTH(WS-NAME-UP)
      * Reference modification to build initials
           MOVE 1 TO WS-POS
           MOVE WS-NAME-UP(1:1) TO WS-INIT(1:1)
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 2 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-I > 20
               MOVE WS-NAME-UP(WS-I:1) TO WS-CHAR
               IF WS-CHAR = ' ' AND WS-I < 20
                   IF WS-NAME-UP(WS-I + 1:1) NOT = ' '
                       ADD 1 TO WS-POS
                       IF WS-POS <= 5
                           MOVE WS-NAME-UP(WS-I + 1:1)
                               TO WS-INIT(WS-POS:1)
                       END-IF
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
      * Daily rate and interest charge
           IF IN-OD-DAYS > 0 AND IN-OD-BALANCE > 0
               COMPUTE WS-DAILY-RATE = IN-OD-RATE / 36500
               COMPUTE WS-INTEREST = IN-OD-BALANCE
                   * WS-DAILY-RATE * IN-OD-DAYS
               COMPUTE WS-INTEREST =
                   FUNCTION INTEGER(WS-INTEREST * 100) / 100
           ELSE
               MOVE 0 TO WS-INTEREST
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-DUE = IN-OD-BALANCE + WS-INTEREST
      * Reference modification to clean display name
           MOVE WS-NAME-UP(1:20) TO OUT-DISP-NAME
           MOVE IN-ACCT-NUM TO OUT-ACCT-NUM
           MOVE WS-INIT TO OUT-NAME-INIT
           MOVE WS-INTEREST TO OUT-INT-CHARGE
           MOVE WS-TOTAL-DUE TO OUT-TOTAL-DUE
           MOVE WS-SPACE-CNT TO OUT-SPACE-CNT
           IF WS-INTEREST > 500
               MOVE 'HIGH ' TO OUT-FLAG
           ELSE
               IF WS-INTEREST > 100
                   MOVE 'MED  ' TO OUT-FLAG
               ELSE
                   MOVE 'LOW  ' TO OUT-FLAG
               END-IF
           END-IF
           WRITE OUT-REC
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 IN-ACCT-NUM PIC X(10).
           05 IN-ACCT-NAME PIC X(20).
           05 IN-OD-BALANCE PIC 9(7)V99.
           05 IN-OD-RATE PIC 9(2)V99.
           05 IN-OD-DAYS PIC 9(3).
           05 IN-ACCT-TYPE PIC X(08).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-ACCT-NUM PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-DISP-NAME PIC X(20).
           05 OUT-NAME-INIT PIC X(05).
           05 OUT-INT-CHARGE PIC 9(7)V99.
           05 OUT-TOTAL-DUE PIC 9(7)V99.
           05 OUT-SPACE-CNT PIC 9(3).
           05 OUT-FLAG PIC X(05).

messages.content:
You are Diocle's COBOL-to-Java translator for a bank modernization project.
Translate the COBOL batch program into ONE self-contained Java 21 source file (JDK only, no libraries)
whose output is byte-identical to the original compiled with GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm).

I/O contract:
- The public class with main() must be named Gen0095, in the default package.
- Input file paths come from environment variables DD_INFILE; write the outputs to DD_OUTFILE.
- ORGANIZATION LINE SEQUENTIAL files are text, one record per line. ORGANIZATION SEQUENTIAL files are fixed-length
  byte records with no separators: read and write them as bytes (ISO-8859-1), record length from the copybook.
- IBM Enterprise COBOL defaults apply: TRUNC(STD), so a value stored in a binary (COMP) field keeps only its PIC digits;
  DISPLAY of a binary field shows its PIC digits (PIC 9(7) COMP displays 7 digits).
- Storage exactly as GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm) writes it: COMP-3 packed decimal with sign nibble C/D (F if unsigned);
  COMP/COMP-4/BINARY big-endian two's complement (2, 4 or 8 bytes by digits); COMP-5 little-endian; signed DISPLAY
  without SIGN SEPARATE carries the sign in the last digit, negative digit d written as the character d + 0x40;
  PIC 9(n)P(m) stores n digits worth value x 10^m.
- When environment variable DIOCLE_COLLATION is EBCDIC, alphanumeric comparisons (<, >) and SORT keys follow mainframe
  EBCDIC order (lowercase < uppercase < digits): compare the Cp037 bytes, not Java's String order.
- Reproduce every DISPLAY to stdout exactly, and exit with the program's RETURN-CODE (System.exit) when it is not 0.
- "Now" (ACCEPT FROM DATE/TIME/DAY, FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE) comes from environment variable DIOCLE_CLOCK when it is
  set (ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. 2000-02-29T13:45:10.00Z), otherwise from the system clock in UTC.

Fidelity rules:
- Preserve COBOL arithmetic semantics exactly: rounding, truncation, overflow, signs, and numeric display formats.
- Use java.math.BigDecimal for all decimal arithmetic. Never use float or double.
- One private method per COBOL paragraph, named after it in camelCase, called in the same order.
- Readable, idiomatic Java; no special-casing of particular input values.
- Name environment variables literally (System.getenv("DD_..."), DIOCLE_CLOCK, DIOCLE_COLLATION). No network,
  processes, reflection, native code or other files: a guard refuses to run such Java.

           88 WS-EOF VALUE "Y".
       01  WS-EXPECTED-BAL PIC 9(8)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-FEE-CALC PIC 9(7)V999 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-FEE-TRUNC PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-NET-CASH PIC S9(8)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-DISCREPANCY PIC S9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-COUNTER PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       000-MAIN SECTION.
           PERFORM 100-OPEN-FILES
           PERFORM 200-PROCESS UNTIL WS-EOF
           PERFORM 300-CLOSE-FILES
           GOBACK
           .
       100-OPEN-FILES SECTION.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           .
       200-PROCESS SECTION.
           READ IN-FILE
               AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
               NOT AT END PERFORM 210-DO-BALANCING
           END-READ
           .
       210-DO-BALANCING SECTION.
      * COMPUTE EXPECTED BALANCE AND FEES WITH ROUNDING
           COMPUTE WS-EXPECTED-BAL ROUNDED =
               I-OPENING-BAL + I-CASH-IN - I-CASH-OUT
           END-COMPUTE
           COMPUTE WS-FEE-CALC ROUNDED =
               I-CASH-IN * I-FEE-RATE / 100
           END-COMPUTE
      * TRUNCATING MOVE INTO SMALLER FIELD
           MOVE WS-FEE-CALC TO WS-FEE-TRUNC
           COMPUTE WS-NET-CASH ROUNDED =
               WS-EXPECTED-BAL - WS-FEE-TRUNC
           END-COMPUTE
           COMPUTE WS-DISCREPANCY =
               I-CLOSING-BAL - WS-NET-CASH
           END-COMPUTE
           ADD 1 TO WS-COUNTER
           PERFORM 220-WRITE-OUT
           IF I-CASH-IN > 50000
               PERFORM 230-WRITE-ADJUSTMENT
           END-IF
           .
       220-WRITE-OUT SECTION.
           MOVE I-TELLER-ID TO O-TELLER-ID
           MOVE I-DRAWER-NUM TO O-DRAWER-NUM
           MOVE WS-EXPECTED-BAL TO O-EXPECTED-BAL
           MOVE WS-FEE-TRUNC TO O-FEE-AMT
           MOVE WS-NET-CASH TO O-NET-BALANCE
           MOVE WS-DISCREPANCY TO O-DISCREPANCY
           MOVE WS-COUNTER TO O-SEQ-NUM
           IF WS-DISCREPANCY = 0
               MOVE "BAL" TO O-STATUS
           ELSE
               MOVE "OFF" TO O-STATUS
           END-IF
           WRITE O-REC
           .
       230-WRITE-ADJUSTMENT SECTION.
      * SECOND OUTPUT FOR LARGE DEPOSITS - AUDIT TRAIL
           MOVE I-TELLER-ID TO O-TELLER-ID
           MOVE I-DRAWER-NUM TO O-DRAWER-NUM
           MOVE WS-EXPECTED-BAL TO O-EXPECTED-BAL
           MOVE WS-FEE-TRUNC TO O-FEE-AMT
           MOVE WS-NET-CASH TO O-NET-BALANCE
           MOVE WS-DISCREPANCY TO O-DISCREPANCY
           MOVE "AUD" TO O-STATUS
           WRITE O-REC
           .
       300-CLOSE-FILES SECTION.
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  I-REC.
           05 I-TELLER-ID PIC X(06).
           05 I-DRAWER-NUM PIC 9(03).
           05 I-OPENING-BAL PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 I-CASH-IN PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 I-CASH-OUT PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 I-CLOSING-BAL PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 I-FEE-RATE PIC 9V999.
           05 I-TRANS-COUNT PIC 9(04).
           05 FILLER PIC X(10).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  O-REC.
           05 O-TELLER-ID PIC X(06).
           05 O-DRAWER-NUM PIC 9(03).
           05 O-SEQ-NUM PIC 9(05).
           05 O-EXPECTED-BAL PIC 9(08)V99.
           05 O-FEE-AMT PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 O-NET-BALANCE PIC 9(08)V99.
           05 O-DISCREPANCY PIC S9(07)V99.
           05 O-STATUS PIC X(03).
           05 FILLER PIC X(08).

GEN0100.name: GEN0100
GEN0100.technique: an OCCURS table searched with PERFORM VARYING
GEN0100.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0100.
      *
      * Insurance premium allocation
      *
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0100I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0100O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG        PIC X VALUE 'N'.
           88 WS-EOF          VALUE 'Y'.
           88 WS-NOT-EOF      VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-ALLOC-TABLE.
           05 WS-ALLOC-ENTRY OCCURS 5 TIMES.
              10 WS-THRESHOLD   PIC 9(7)V99.
              10 WS-PCT-BASE    PIC 9(03)V99.
              10 WS-PCT-RIDER   PIC 9(03)V99.
              10 WS-PCT-FEE     PIC 9(03)V99.
       01  WS-IDX             PIC 9(02).
       01  WS-MATCH-IDX       PIC 9(02).
       01  WS-PREMIUM-NUM     PIC 9(7)V99.
       01  WS-RISK-SCORE      PIC 9(03).
       01  WS-BASE-AMT        PIC 9(7)V99.
       01  WS-RIDER-AMT       PIC 9(7)V99.
       01  WS-FEE-AMT         PIC 9(7)V99.
       01  WS-TOTAL-CHK       PIC 9(7)V99.
       01  WS-REMAIN          PIC 9(7)V99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           PERFORM INIT-TABLE
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-ONE
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       INIT-TABLE.
           MOVE 5000.00 TO WS-THRESHOLD(1)
           MOVE 60.00 TO WS-PCT-BASE(1)
           MOVE 25.00 TO WS-PCT-RIDER(1)
           MOVE 15.00 TO WS-PCT-FEE(1)
           MOVE 10000.00 TO WS-THRESHOLD(2)
           MOVE 65.00 TO WS-PCT-BASE(2)
           MOVE 20.00 TO WS-PCT-RIDER(2)
           MOVE 15.00 TO WS-PCT-FEE(2)
           MOVE 20000.00 TO WS-THRESHOLD(3)
           MOVE 70.00 TO WS-PCT-BASE(3)
           MOVE 20.00 TO WS-PCT-RIDER(3)
           MOVE 10.00 TO WS-PCT-FEE(3)
           MOVE 50000.00 TO WS-THRESHOLD(4)
           MOVE 75.00 TO WS-PCT-BASE(4)
           MOVE 15.00 TO WS-PCT-RIDER(4)
           MOVE 10.00 TO WS-PCT-FEE(4)
           MOVE 9999999.99 TO WS-THRESHOLD(5)
           MOVE 80.00 TO WS-PCT-BASE(5)
           MOVE 12.00 TO WS-PCT-RIDER(5)
           MOVE  8.00 TO WS-PCT-FEE(5)
           .
       PROCESS-ONE.
           MOVE IN-PREMIUM-AMT TO WS-PREMIUM-NUM
           MOVE IN-RISK-SCORE TO WS-RISK-SCORE
           PERFORM FIND-BRACKET
           PERFORM CALC-ALLOCATION
           PERFORM WRITE-OUTPUTS
           .
       FIND-BRACKET.
           MOVE 5 TO WS-MATCH-IDX
           PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-IDX > 5
               IF WS-PREMIUM-NUM <= WS-THRESHOLD(WS-IDX)
                   MOVE WS-IDX TO WS-MATCH-IDX
                   EXIT PERFORM
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           .
       CALC-ALLOCATION.
           COMPUTE WS-BASE-AMT =
               WS-PREMIUM-NUM * WS-PCT-BASE(WS-MATCH-IDX)
               / 100
           COMPUTE WS-RIDER-AMT =
               WS-PREMIUM-NUM * WS-PCT-RIDER(WS-MATCH-IDX)
               / 100
           COMPUTE WS-FEE-AMT =
               WS-PREMIUM-NUM * WS-PCT-FEE(WS-MATCH-IDX)
               / 100
           ADD WS-BASE-AMT WS-RIDER-AMT TO WS-TOTAL-CHK
           ADD WS-TOTAL-CHK WS-FEE-AMT TO WS-TOTAL-CHK
           COMPUTE WS-REMAIN = WS-PREMIUM-NUM - WS-TOTAL-CHK
           ADD WS-REMAIN TO WS-BASE-AMT
           .
       WRITE-OUTPUTS.
           MOVE IN-POLICY-ID TO OUT-POLICY-ID
           MOVE IN-CUSTOMER-NAME TO OUT-CUSTOMER-NAME
           MOVE 'BASE' TO OUT-ALLOC-CODE
           MOVE WS-BASE-AMT TO OUT-ALLOC-AMT
           MOVE WS-MATCH-IDX TO OUT-BRACKET-IDX
           MOVE WS-RISK-SCORE TO OUT-RISK-SCORE
           WRITE OUT-REC
           MOVE 'RIDER' TO OUT-ALLOC-CODE
           MOVE WS-RIDER-AMT TO OUT-ALLOC-AMT
           WRITE OUT-REC
           MOVE 'FEE' TO OUT-ALLOC-CODE
           MOVE WS-FEE-AMT TO OUT-ALLOC-AMT
           WRITE OUT-REC
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  IN-REC.
           05 IN-POLICY-ID      PIC X(10).
           05 IN-CUSTOMER-NAME  PIC X(20).
           05 IN-PREMIUM-AMT    PIC 9(7)V99.
           05 IN-RISK-SCORE     PIC 9(03).
           05 IN-COVER-TYPE     PIC X(08).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-POLICY-ID     PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-CUSTOMER-NAME PIC X(20).
           05 OUT-ALLOC-CODE    PIC X(05).
           05 OUT-ALLOC-AMT     PIC 9(7)V99.
           05 OUT-BRACKET-IDX   PIC 9(02).
           05 OUT-RISK-SCORE    PIC 9(03).

GEN0098.name: GEN0098
GEN0098.technique: packed decimal (COMP-3) amounts and signed totals
GEN0098.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0098.
      * SYNTHETIC. Payroll deduction posting.
      * Fictional institution. Packed amounts.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0098I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0098O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG PIC X VALUE 'N'.
           88 WS-EOF VALUE 'Y'.
           88 WS-NOT-EOF VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-READ-CNT PIC 9(9) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-WRITE-CNT PIC 9(9) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-GROSS-DISP PIC S9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-DEDUCT-DISP PIC S9(5)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-NET-CALC PIC S9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-TOTAL-DED PIC S9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-HOLD-EMP PIC X(6) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-HOLD-PERIOD PIC X(6) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-DED-CODE PIC X(2) VALUE SPACES.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END SET WS-EOF TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-REC.
           ADD 1 TO WS-READ-CNT
           MOVE IN-EMP-ID TO WS-HOLD-EMP
           MOVE IN-PAY-PERIOD TO WS-HOLD-PERIOD
           MOVE IN-DEDUCTION-CODE TO WS-DED-CODE
      * Validate gross and deduction packed fields
           MOVE IN-GROSS-PAY TO WS-GROSS-DISP
           MOVE IN-DEDUCTION-AMT TO WS-DEDUCT-DISP
           IF WS-GROSS-DISP < 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-GROSS-DISP
           END-IF
           IF WS-DEDUCT-DISP < 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-DEDUCT-DISP
           END-IF
           IF WS-DEDUCT-DISP > WS-GROSS-DISP
               MOVE WS-GROSS-DISP TO WS-DEDUCT-DISP
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-NET-CALC = WS-GROSS-DISP - WS-DEDUCT-DISP
           MOVE WS-DEDUCT-DISP TO WS-TOTAL-DED
      * Build output posting record
           MOVE WS-HOLD-EMP TO OUT-EMP-ID
           MOVE WS-HOLD-PERIOD TO OUT-PAY-PERIOD
           MOVE WS-NET-CALC TO OUT-NET-PAY
           MOVE WS-TOTAL-DED TO OUT-TOTAL-DEDUCTIONS
           MOVE WS-DED-CODE TO OUT-DEDUCTION-CODE
           MOVE WS-GROSS-DISP TO OUT-GROSS-PAY
           MOVE WS-READ-CNT TO OUT-SEQ-NUM
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
      * Second posting for split deduction type
           IF IN-DEDUCTION-CODE = 'SP'
               MOVE WS-HOLD-EMP TO OUT-EMP-ID
               MOVE WS-HOLD-PERIOD TO OUT-PAY-PERIOD
               MOVE 0 TO OUT-NET-PAY
               MOVE WS-DEDUCT-DISP TO OUT-TOTAL-DEDUCTIONS
               MOVE 'SP' TO OUT-DEDUCTION-CODE
               MOVE WS-GROSS-DISP TO OUT-GROSS-PAY
               ADD 1 TO WS-READ-CNT
               MOVE WS-READ-CNT TO OUT-SEQ-NUM
               WRITE OUT-REC
               ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
           END-IF
           EXIT.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 IN-EMP-ID PIC X(6).
           05 IN-PAY-PERIOD PIC X(6).
           05 IN-GROSS-PAY PIC 9(7)V99 COMP-3.
           05 IN-DEDUCTION-AMT PIC 9(5)V99 COMP-3.
           05 IN-DEDUCTION-CODE PIC X(2).
           05 IN-CODE-REDEF REDEFINES IN-DEDUCTION-CODE PIC X(2).
           05 IN-FILLER-GROUP PIC X(4).
               88 IN-CODE-SP VALUE 'SP'.
           05 IN-RESERVED PIC X(10).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-EMP-ID PIC X(6).
           05 OUT-PAY-PERIOD PIC X(6).
           05 OUT-GROSS-PAY PIC S9(7)V99.
           05 OUT-NET-PAY PIC S9(7)V99.
           05 OUT-TOTAL-DEDUCTIONS PIC S9(7)V99.
           05 OUT-DEDUCTION-CODE PIC X(2).
           05 OUT-SEQ-NUM PIC 9(9).
           05 OUT-STATUS PIC X(2).
           05 OUT-REDEF-GROUP REDEFINES OUT-STATUS PIC X(2).
           05 OUT-FILLER PIC X(20).

GEN0102.name: GEN0102
GEN0102.technique: SIGN LEADING SEPARATE amounts and DIVIDE ... REMAINDER
GEN0102.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0102.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0102I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0102O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG            PIC X(01) VALUE 'N'.
           88 WS-EOF              VALUE 'Y'.
           88 WS-NOT-EOF          VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-COUNTERS.
           05 WS-READ-CNT         PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-WRITE-CNT        PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-CALC-FIELDS.
           05 WS-ANNUAL-NUM       PIC S9(06) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-MONTHLY-CALC     PIC S9(05) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-REMAINDER-CALC   PIC S9(04) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-BALANCE-CALC     PIC S9(06) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-MONTHS-REMAIN    PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-DISPLAY-MONTHLY  PIC S9(05) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 WS-DISPLAY-REM      PIC S9(04) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 WS-DISPLAY-BAL      PIC S9(06) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END
                       ADD 1 TO WS-READ-CNT
                       PERFORM PROCESS-ONE
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           .
       PROCESS-ONE.
           MOVE SDB-ANNUAL-FEE TO WS-ANNUAL-NUM
      *    compute monthly charge and remainder using DIVIDE
           DIVIDE WS-ANNUAL-NUM BY 12 GIVING WS-MONTHLY-CALC
               REMAINDER WS-REMAINDER-CALC
           END-DIVIDE
           MOVE WS-MONTHLY-CALC TO WS-DISPLAY-MONTHLY
           MOVE WS-REMAINDER-CALC TO WS-DISPLAY-REM
           COMPUTE WS-MONTHS-REMAIN = 12 - SDB-MONTHS-PAID
           COMPUTE WS-BALANCE-CALC = WS-MONTHLY-CALC
               * WS-MONTHS-REMAIN + WS-REMAINDER-CALC
           MOVE WS-BALANCE-CALC TO WS-DISPLAY-BAL
      *    first output is monthly statement
           MOVE SDB-BOX-ID TO OUT-BOX-ID
           MOVE SDB-CUST-ID TO OUT-CUST-ID
           MOVE SDB-CUST-NAME TO OUT-CUST-NAME
           MOVE WS-DISPLAY-MONTHLY TO OUT-MONTHLY-DUE
           MOVE WS-DISPLAY-REM TO OUT-REMAINDER-AMT
           MOVE SDB-MONTHS-PAID TO OUT-MONTHS-PAID
           MOVE WS-DISPLAY-BAL TO OUT-BALANCE-DUE
           MOVE 'MONTHLY   ' TO OUT-BILL-TYPE
           WRITE SAFE-BOX-OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
      *    second record if balance remains
           IF WS-MONTHS-REMAIN > 0
               MOVE 'BALANCE   ' TO OUT-BILL-TYPE
               WRITE SAFE-BOX-OUT-REC
               ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
           END-IF
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 SAFE-BOX-IN-REC.
           05 SDB-BOX-ID          PIC X(08).
           05 SDB-CUST-ID         PIC X(06).
           05 SDB-BOX-SIZE        PIC 9(01).
           05 SDB-ANNUAL-FEE      PIC S9(05) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 SDB-FEE-AS-X REDEFINES SDB-ANNUAL-FEE PIC X(06).
           05 SDB-MONTHS-PAID     PIC 9(02).
           05 SDB-CUST-NAME       PIC X(20).
           05 SDB-BRANCH-CODE     PIC X(04).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 SAFE-BOX-OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-BOX-ID          PIC X(08).
           05 OUT-CUST-ID         PIC X(06).
           05 OUT-CUST-NAME       PIC X(20).
           05 OUT-MONTHLY-DUE     PIC S9(05) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 OUT-REMAINDER-AMT   PIC S9(04) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 OUT-MONTHS-PAID     PIC 9(02).
           05 OUT-BALANCE-DUE     PIC S9(06) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 OUT-BILL-TYPE       PIC X(10).

GEN0107.name: GEN0107
GEN0107.technique: a control break with subtotals and a final trailer record
GEN0107.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0107.
      * DORMANT ACCOUNT FLAGGING WITH CONTROL BREAK
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0107I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0107O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
       01  WS-CURR-BRANCH PIC X(04) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-FIRST-REC PIC X(01) VALUE "Y".
       01  WS-BRANCH-COUNT PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-BRANCH-DORMANT-CNT PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-BRANCH-BAL-TOT PIC 9(09)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-BRANCH-DORM-BAL PIC 9(09)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-GRAND-COUNT PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-GRAND-DORMANT PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-GRAND-BAL PIC 9(10)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-GRAND-DORM-BAL PIC 9(10)V99 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM READ-NEXT
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = "Y"
               PERFORM CHECK-BREAK
               PERFORM PROCESS-RECORD
               PERFORM READ-NEXT
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM WRITE-BRANCH-TRAILER
           PERFORM WRITE-FINAL-TRAILER
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       READ-NEXT.
           READ IN-FILE
               AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
           END-READ.
       CHECK-BREAK.
           IF WS-FIRST-REC = "Y"
               MOVE IN-BRANCH-ID TO WS-CURR-BRANCH
               MOVE "N" TO WS-FIRST-REC
           ELSE
               IF IN-BRANCH-ID NOT = WS-CURR-BRANCH
                   PERFORM WRITE-BRANCH-TRAILER
                   MOVE IN-BRANCH-ID TO WS-CURR-BRANCH
               END-IF
           END-IF.
       PROCESS-RECORD.
           ADD 1 TO WS-BRANCH-COUNT
           ADD 1 TO WS-GRAND-COUNT
           ADD IN-BALANCE TO WS-BRANCH-BAL-TOT
           ADD IN-BALANCE TO WS-GRAND-BAL
           IF IN-DAYS-INACTIVE > 365
               ADD 1 TO WS-BRANCH-DORMANT-CNT
               ADD 1 TO WS-GRAND-DORMANT
               ADD IN-BALANCE TO WS-BRANCH-DORM-BAL
               ADD IN-BALANCE TO WS-GRAND-DORM-BAL
               MOVE "DORMANT" TO OUT-STATUS
           ELSE
               MOVE "ACTIVE " TO OUT-STATUS
           END-IF
           MOVE "D" TO OUT-TYPE
           MOVE IN-BRANCH-ID TO OUT-BRANCH
           MOVE IN-ACCT-NO TO OUT-ACCT-NO
           MOVE IN-DAYS-INACTIVE TO OUT-DAYS
           MOVE IN-BALANCE TO OUT-BALANCE
           MOVE WS-BRANCH-DORMANT-CNT TO OUT-GRP-COUNT
           MOVE WS-BRANCH-DORM-BAL TO OUT-GRP-AMT
           WRITE OUTPUT-REC
           .
       WRITE-BRANCH-TRAILER.
           IF WS-BRANCH-COUNT > 0
               MOVE "S" TO OUT-TYPE
               MOVE WS-CURR-BRANCH TO OUT-BRANCH
               MOVE SPACES TO OUT-ACCT-NO
               MOVE "SUBTOTAL" TO OUT-STATUS
               MOVE 0 TO OUT-DAYS
               MOVE WS-BRANCH-BAL-TOT TO OUT-BALANCE
               MOVE WS-BRANCH-DORMANT-CNT TO OUT-GRP-COUNT
               MOVE WS-BRANCH-DORM-BAL TO OUT-GRP-AMT
               WRITE OUTPUT-REC
           END-IF
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BRANCH-COUNT
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BRANCH-DORMANT-CNT
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BRANCH-BAL-TOT
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BRANCH-DORM-BAL
           .
       WRITE-FINAL-TRAILER.
           MOVE "T" TO OUT-TYPE
           MOVE "ALL " TO OUT-BRANCH
           MOVE "FINAL" TO OUT-ACCT-NO
           MOVE "TRAILER " TO OUT-STATUS
           MOVE 0 TO OUT-DAYS
           MOVE WS-GRAND-BAL TO OUT-BALANCE
           MOVE WS-GRAND-DORMANT TO OUT-GRP-COUNT
           MOVE WS-GRAND-DORM-BAL TO OUT-GRP-AMT
           WRITE OUTPUT-REC
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  INPUT-REC.
           05 IN-BRANCH-ID PIC X(04).
           05 IN-ACCT-NO PIC X(10).
           05 IN-ACCT-TYPE PIC X(02).
           05 IN-DAYS-INACTIVE PIC 9(04).
           05 IN-BALANCE PIC 9(07)V99.

GEN0105.name: GEN0105
GEN0105.technique: COMPUTE ROUNDED with a truncating MOVE into a smaller field
GEN0105.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0105.
      * Escrow shortage spreading with rounded
      * monthly calc and truncating MOVE.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0105I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0105O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-CTRL.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG         PIC X VALUE "N".
           05 WS-READ-CNT         PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-WRITE-CNT        PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-CALC.
           05 WS-MONTHLY-RAW      PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-MONTHLY-RND      PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-TRUNC-BUF        PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-NEW-PAYMENT      PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-REMAIN-SHORT     PIC 9(6)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-IDX              PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-SPREAD-MONTHS-N  PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM READ-LOOP UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = "Y"
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           .
       READ-LOOP.
           READ IN-FILE
               AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
               NOT AT END PERFORM PROC-REC
           END-READ
           .
       PROC-REC.
           ADD 1 TO WS-READ-CNT
      * Validate spread months to avoid zero divide
           MOVE IN-SPREAD-MONTHS TO WS-SPREAD-MONTHS-N
           IF WS-SPREAD-MONTHS-N = 0
               MOVE 12 TO WS-SPREAD-MONTHS-N
           END-IF
      * Rounded monthly shortage portion
           COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-RND ROUNDED =
               IN-SHORTAGE-AMT / WS-SPREAD-MONTHS-N
           END-COMPUTE
      * Keep raw unrounded for audit comparison
           COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-RAW =
               IN-SHORTAGE-AMT / WS-SPREAD-MONTHS-N
           END-COMPUTE
      * Truncating MOVE: larger buffer to smaller
      * output field deliberately loses high digits
      * and decimal precision
           MOVE IN-SHORTAGE-AMT TO WS-TRUNC-BUF
           MOVE WS-TRUNC-BUF TO OUT-SHORTAGE-TRUNC
      * New escrow payment with rounded shortage
           COMPUTE WS-NEW-PAYMENT ROUNDED =
               IN-BASE-PAYMENT + WS-MONTHLY-RND
           END-COMPUTE
           MOVE IN-ACCT-NO TO OUT-ACCT-NO
           MOVE IN-PROP-TAX-CODE TO OUT-PROP-TAX-CODE
           MOVE WS-MONTHLY-RND TO OUT-MONTHLY-ADJ-RND
           MOVE WS-MONTHLY-RAW TO OUT-MONTHLY-ADJ-RAW
           MOVE WS-NEW-PAYMENT TO OUT-NEW-PAYMENT
           MOVE IN-BASE-PAYMENT TO OUT-BASE-PAYMENT
           MOVE IN-ESCROW-BAL TO OUT-ESCROW-BAL
      * Generate one header record per input
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
      * Also generate spread schedule details as
      * additional output records per input
           PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-IDX > WS-SPREAD-MONTHS-N
               COMPUTE WS-REMAIN-SHORT =
                   IN-SHORTAGE-AMT -
                   (WS-MONTHLY-RND * (WS-IDX - 1))
               END-COMPUTE
               IF WS-REMAIN-SHORT < 0
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-REMAIN-SHORT
               END-IF
               MOVE WS-IDX TO OUT-SPREAD-SEQ
               MOVE WS-REMAIN-SHORT TO OUT-REMAIN-SHORT
      * Truncating MOVE again inside loop
               MOVE WS-REMAIN-SHORT TO WS-TRUNC-BUF
               MOVE WS-TRUNC-BUF TO OUT-REMAIN-TRUNC
               WRITE OUT-REC
               ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-CNT
           END-PERFORM
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  IN-REC.
           05 IN-ACCT-NO         PIC X(10).
           05 IN-PROP-TAX-CODE   PIC X(4).
           05 IN-ESCROW-BAL      PIC 9(6)V99.
           05 IN-SHORTAGE-AMT    PIC 9(6)V99.
           05 IN-BASE-PAYMENT    PIC 9(5)V99.
           05 IN-SPREAD-MONTHS   PIC 9(3).
           05 FILLER             PIC X(8).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-ACCT-NO         PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-PROP-TAX-CODE   PIC X(4).
           05 OUT-ESCROW-BAL      PIC 9(6)V99.
           05 OUT-BASE-PAYMENT    PIC 9(5)V99.
           05 OUT-MONTHLY-ADJ-RND PIC 9(5)V99.
           05 OUT-MONTHLY-ADJ-RAW PIC 9(5)V99.
           05 OUT-NEW-PAYMENT     PIC 9(5)V99.
           05 OUT-SHORTAGE-TRUNC  PIC 9(4)V9.
           05 OUT-SPREAD-SEQ      PIC 9(3).
           05 OUT-REMAIN-SHORT    PIC 9(6)V99.
           05 OUT-REMAIN-TRUNC    PIC 9(4)V9.
           05 FILLER              PIC X(5).

GEN0106.name: GEN0106
GEN0106.technique: packed decimal (COMP-3) amounts and signed totals
GEN0106.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0106.
      * SAVINGS DIVIDEND POSTING - FICTIONAL
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0106I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0106O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG PIC X VALUE "N".
              88 WS-EOF VALUE "Y".
              88 WS-NOT-EOF VALUE "N".
       01  WS-COUNTS.
           05 WS-IN-CNT PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-OUT-CNT PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-TOTALS.
           05 WS-TOT-BAL PIC S9(11)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-TOT-DIV PIC S9(11)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-TOT-NEW PIC S9(11)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-WORK.
           05 WS-CALC-DIV PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-CALC-NEW PIC S9(9)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-RATE-ADJ PIC S9(1)V999 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
                OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM READ-NEXT
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               ADD 1 TO WS-IN-CNT
               PERFORM CALC-DIVIDEND
               PERFORM WRITE-OUTPUT
               PERFORM READ-NEXT
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM SHOW-TOTALS
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           .
       READ-NEXT.
           READ IN-FILE
               AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
               NOT AT END CONTINUE
           END-READ
           .
       CALC-DIVIDEND.
      * COMPUTE RATE WITH BONUS FOR TYPE S
           MOVE SI-RATE TO WS-RATE-ADJ
           IF SI-ACCT-TYPE = "S"
               ADD 0.002 TO WS-RATE-ADJ
           END-IF
           IF SI-BALANCE < 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-CALC-DIV
           ELSE
               COMPUTE WS-CALC-DIV ROUNDED =
                 SI-BALANCE * WS-RATE-ADJ / 100
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-CALC-NEW = SI-BALANCE + WS-CALC-DIV
           ADD SI-BALANCE TO WS-TOT-BAL
           ADD WS-CALC-DIV TO WS-TOT-DIV
           ADD WS-CALC-NEW TO WS-TOT-NEW
           .
       WRITE-OUTPUT.
           MOVE SI-ACCT-NO TO SO-ACCT-NO
           MOVE SI-ACCT-TYPE TO SO-ACCT-TYPE
           MOVE WS-CALC-NEW TO SO-NEW-BAL
           MOVE WS-CALC-DIV TO SO-DIV-AMT
           MOVE WS-TOT-BAL TO SO-TOT-BAL
           MOVE WS-TOT-DIV TO SO-TOT-DIV
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-OUT-CNT
           .
       SHOW-TOTALS.
           DISPLAY "GEN0106 IN=" WS-IN-CNT
                   " OUT=" WS-OUT-CNT
           DISPLAY "TOT BAL=" WS-TOT-BAL
                   " TOT DIV=" WS-TOT-DIV
           DISPLAY "TOT NEW=" WS-TOT-NEW
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  IN-REC.
           05 SI-ACCT-NO PIC X(10).
           05 SI-ACCT-TYPE PIC X(01).
           05 SI-FILLER1 PIC X(05).
           05 SI-BALANCE PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
           05 SI-RATE PIC S9(1)V999 COMP-3.
           05 SI-RATE-X REDEFINES SI-RATE PIC X(03).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  OUT-REC.
           05 SO-ACCT-NO PIC X(10).
           05 SO-ACCT-TYPE PIC X(01).
           05 SO-FILLER1 PIC X(05).
           05 SO-NEW-BAL PIC S9(9)V99 COMP-3.
           05 SO-DIV-AMT PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
           05 SO-DIV-X REDEFINES SO-DIV-AMT PIC X(05).
           05 SO-TOT-BAL PIC S9(11)V99 COMP-3.
           05 SO-TOT-DIV PIC S9(11)V99 COMP-3.

GEN0108.technique: an OCCURS table searched with PERFORM VARYING
GEN0108.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0108.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0108I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0108O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG           PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
           88 WS-EOF              VALUE "Y".
           88 WS-NOT-EOF          VALUE "N".
       01  WS-INST-CNT           PIC 9(02) VALUE 00.
       01  WS-FOUND-FLAG         PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
       01  WS-FREQ-INTERVAL      PIC 9(03) VALUE 000.
       01  WS-FREQ-DESC          PIC X(10) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-CALC-DATE          PIC 9(08) VALUE 00000000.
       01  WS-TABLE-IX           PIC 9(02) VALUE 00.
       01  WS-FREQ-TABLE.
           05 WS-FREQ-ENTRY OCCURS 06 TIMES.
               10 WS-TAB-CODE    PIC X(02).
               10 WS-TAB-DAYS    PIC 9(03).
               10 WS-TAB-DESC    PIC X(10).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           PERFORM LOAD-TABLE-PARA
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END SET WS-EOF TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-ORDER-PARA
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           . 
       LOAD-TABLE-PARA.
           MOVE "WK" TO WS-TAB-CODE(1)
           MOVE 007 TO WS-TAB-DAYS(1)
           MOVE "WEEKLY    " TO WS-TAB-DESC(1)
           MOVE "BW" TO WS-TAB-CODE(2)
           MOVE 014 TO WS-TAB-DAYS(2)
           MOVE "BIWEEKLY  " TO WS-TAB-DESC(2)
           MOVE "MO" TO WS-TAB-CODE(3)
           MOVE 030 TO WS-TAB-DAYS(3)
           MOVE "MONTHLY   " TO WS-TAB-DESC(3)
           MOVE "QO" TO WS-TAB-CODE(4)
           MOVE 090 TO WS-TAB-DAYS(4)
           MOVE "QUARTERLY " TO WS-TAB-DESC(4)
           MOVE "SA" TO WS-TAB-CODE(5)
           MOVE 182 TO WS-TAB-DAYS(5)
           MOVE "SEMI-ANNL" TO WS-TAB-DESC(5)
           MOVE "AN" TO WS-TAB-CODE(6)
           MOVE 365 TO WS-TAB-DAYS(6)
           MOVE "ANNUAL    " TO WS-TAB-DESC(6)
           . 
       PROCESS-ORDER-PARA.
           MOVE "N" TO WS-FOUND-FLAG
           MOVE 030 TO WS-FREQ-INTERVAL
           MOVE "MONTHLY   " TO WS-FREQ-DESC
           PERFORM VARYING WS-TABLE-IX FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-TABLE-IX > 6
               IF WS-TAB-CODE(WS-TABLE-IX) = SO-FREQ-CODE
                   MOVE WS-TAB-DAYS(WS-TABLE-IX)
                       TO WS-FREQ-INTERVAL
                   MOVE WS-TAB-DESC(WS-TABLE-IX)
                       TO WS-FREQ-DESC
                   MOVE "Y" TO WS-FOUND-FLAG
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           IF SO-NUM-PAYMENTS = 00
               MOVE 01 TO SO-NUM-PAYMENTS
           END-IF
           IF SO-AMOUNT < 000000100
               MOVE 000000100 TO SO-AMOUNT
           END-IF
           PERFORM VARYING WS-INST-CNT FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-INST-CNT > SO-NUM-PAYMENTS
               PERFORM BUILD-OUTPUT-PARA
               WRITE GEN0108O-REC
           END-PERFORM
           . 
       BUILD-OUTPUT-PARA.
           MOVE SO-ORDER-ID TO OT-ORDER-ID
           MOVE WS-INST-CNT TO OT-INST-NUM
           MOVE SO-SOURCE-ACCT TO OT-SOURCE-ACCT
           MOVE SO-DEST-ACCT TO OT-DEST-ACCT
           MOVE SO-AMOUNT TO OT-AMOUNT
           MOVE SO-CURRENCY TO OT-CURRENCY
           MOVE WS-FREQ-DESC TO OT-FREQ-DESC
           COMPUTE WS-CALC-DATE = SO-START-YYYYMMDD
               + (WS-FREQ-INTERVAL * (WS-INST-CNT - 1))
           MOVE WS-CALC-DATE TO OT-DUE-DATE
           . 
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  GEN0108I-REC.
           05 SO-ORDER-ID         PIC X(08).
           05 SO-SOURCE-ACCT      PIC X(10).
           05 SO-DEST-ACCT        PIC X(10).
           05 SO-AMOUNT           PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 SO-FREQ-CODE        PIC X(02).
           05 SO-START-YYYYMMDD   PIC 9(08).
           05 SO-NUM-PAYMENTS     PIC 9(02).
           05 SO-CURRENCY         PIC X(03).
           05 FILLER              PIC X(15).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01  GEN0108O-REC.
           05 OT-ORDER-ID         PIC X(08).
           05 OT-INST-NUM         PIC 9(02).

GEN0113.name: GEN0113

GEN0113.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0113.
      * PAYROLL DEDUCTION POSTING - COMPUTE ROUNDED
      * WITH TRUNCATING MOVE DEMONSTRATION
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
       COPY GEN0113I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
       COPY GEN0113O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG      PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
               88 WS-EOF        VALUE "Y".
               88 WS-NOT-EOF    VALUE "N".
           05 WS-IN-COUNT      PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
           05 WS-OUT-COUNT     PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-CALC-FIELDS.
           05 WS-DEDUCT-CALC   PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-NET-CALC      PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-PCT-DIV       PIC 9(03)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-REMAINDER     PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-HOLD-REC.
           05 WS-H-EMP-ID      PIC X(06) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-H-GROSS       PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-H-PCT         PIC 9(03)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-H-DEPT        PIC X(04) VALUE SPACES.
      * WORK FIELD FOR ROUNDING DEMO
       01  WS-DETAIL-LINE      PIC X(50) VALUE SPACES.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       100-MAIN SECTION.
           PERFORM 200-OPEN-FILES
           PERFORM 300-PROCESS-LOOP UNTIL WS-EOF
           PERFORM 400-CLOSE-FILES
           GOBACK
           .
       200-OPEN-FILES SECTION.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           .
       300-PROCESS-LOOP SECTION.
           READ IN-FILE
               AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
               NOT AT END PERFORM 310-POST-DEDUCTION
           END-READ
           .
       310-POST-DEDUCTION SECTION.
           ADD 1 TO WS-IN-COUNT
           MOVE IN-EMP-ID TO WS-H-EMP-ID
           MOVE IN-GROSS-PAY TO WS-H-GROSS
           MOVE IN-DEDUCT-PCT TO WS-H-PCT
           MOVE IN-DEPT-CODE TO WS-H-DEPT
      * COMPUTE DEDUCTION WITH ROUNDING
           COMPUTE WS-DEDUCT-CALC ROUNDED =
               WS-H-GROSS * WS-H-PCT / 100
           END-COMPUTE
      * COMPUTE NET PAY
           COMPUTE WS-NET-CALC ROUNDED =
               WS-H-GROSS - WS-DEDUCT-CALC
           END-COMPUTE
      * SECOND COMPUTE TO SHOW ROUNDED INTERMEDIATE
           COMPUTE WS-REMAINDER ROUNDED =
               WS-DEDUCT-CALC * 1.005
           END-COMPUTE
      * MOVE TO OUTPUT - TRUNCATING MOVE INTO SMALLER FIELD
           MOVE WS-H-EMP-ID TO OUT-EMP-ID
           MOVE WS-H-GROSS TO OUT-GROSS-PAY
           MOVE WS-DEDUCT-CALC TO OUT-DEDUCT-AMT
           MOVE WS-DEDUCT-CALC TO OUT-TRUNC-DED
           MOVE WS-NET-CALC TO OUT-NET-PAY
           MOVE WS-H-DEPT TO OUT-DEPT-CODE
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-OUT-COUNT
      * EVERY INPUT YIELDS SECOND SUMMARY RECORD
           MOVE WS-H-EMP-ID TO OUT-EMP-ID
           MOVE WS-REMAINDER TO OUT-DEDUCT-AMT
           MOVE WS-REMAINDER TO OUT-TRUNC-DED
           MOVE WS-NET-CALC TO OUT-NET-PAY
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-OUT-COUNT
           .
       400-CLOSE-FILES SECTION.
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           .
       END PROGRAM GEN0113.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 IN-EMP-ID        PIC X(06).
           05 IN-EMP-NAME      PIC X(20).
           05 IN-GROSS-PAY     PIC 9(06)V99.
           05 IN-DEDUCT-PCT    PIC 9(03)V99.
           05 IN-DEPT-CODE     PIC X(04).
           05 IN-HOURS-WORKED  PIC 9(03).
           05 FILLER           PIC X(10).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-EMP-ID       PIC X(06).
           05 OUT-GROSS-PAY    PIC 9(06)V99.
           05 OUT-DEDUCT-AMT   PIC 9(05)V99.

GEN0111.name: GEN0111
GEN0111.technique: INSPECT and reference modification on a text field
GEN0111.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0111.
      * TERM DEPOSIT MATURITY - FICTIONAL INSTITUTION
      * USES INSPECT AND REFERENCE MODIFICATION
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0111I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0111O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG         PIC X VALUE "N".
           88 WS-EOF            VALUE "Y".
           88 WS-NOT-EOF        VALUE "N".
       01  WS-READ-COUNT       PIC 9(04) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-WRITE-COUNT      PIC 9(04) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-HOLDER-UPPER     PIC X(20).
       01  WS-HOLDER-TRIM      PIC X(20).
       01  WS-NAME-LEN         PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-INITIALS         PIC X(02).
       01  WS-INTEREST         PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-MATURITY         PIC 9(08)V99 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-RATE-DIV         PIC 9(03)V999 VALUE 0.
       01  WS-SPACE-COUNT      PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-DISPLAY-MAT      PIC $$$,$$9.99.
       01  WS-DISPLAY-INT      PIC $$$,$$9.99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-REC.
           ADD 1 TO WS-READ-COUNT
      *    NORMALIZE HOLDER NAME TO UPPER FOR REPORTING
           MOVE IN-HOLDER-NAME TO WS-HOLDER-UPPER
           INSPECT WS-HOLDER-UPPER CONVERTING
               "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" TO
               "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
           INSPECT WS-HOLDER-UPPER TALLYING WS-SPACE-COUNT
               FOR ALL " "
      *    TRIM LEADING SPACES USING REFERENCE MODIFICATION
           MOVE WS-HOLDER-UPPER TO WS-HOLDER-TRIM
           INSPECT WS-HOLDER-TRIM TALLYING WS-NAME-LEN
               FOR CHARACTERS BEFORE INITIAL "  "
           IF WS-HOLDER-TRIM(1:1) = SPACE
               INSPECT WS-HOLDER-TRIM REPLACING LEADING " " BY "*"
           END-IF
      *    BUILD INITIALS WITH REFERENCE MODIFICATION
           MOVE SPACE TO WS-INITIALS
           MOVE WS-HOLDER-UPPER(1:1) TO WS-INITIALS(1:1)
           IF WS-SPACE-COUNT > 0
               MOVE WS-HOLDER-UPPER(WS-NAME-LEN:1) TO WS-INITIALS(2:1)
           ELSE
               MOVE WS-HOLDER-UPPER(2:1) TO WS-INITIALS(2:1)
           END-IF
      *    CALCULATE SIMPLE INTEREST AND MATURITY
           COMPUTE WS-RATE-DIV = IN-INT-RATE / 100
           COMPUTE WS-INTEREST = IN-PRINCIPAL * WS-RATE-DIV
               * IN-TERM-MONTHS / 12
           COMPUTE WS-MATURITY = IN-PRINCIPAL + WS-INTEREST
           MOVE WS-INTEREST TO WS-DISPLAY-INT
           MOVE WS-MATURITY TO WS-DISPLAY-MAT
      *    MOVE FIELDS TO OUTPUT USING REFERENCE MODIFICATION
           MOVE IN-CUST-ID TO OUT-CUST-ID
           MOVE WS-HOLDER-UPPER(1:20) TO OUT-HOLDER-NAME-UP
           MOVE WS-INITIALS TO OUT-INITIALS
           MOVE IN-PRINCIPAL TO OUT-PRINCIPAL
           MOVE IN-INT-RATE TO OUT-INT-RATE
           MOVE IN-TERM-MONTHS TO OUT-TERM-MONTHS
           MOVE WS-INTEREST TO OUT-INTEREST-AMT
           MOVE WS-MATURITY TO OUT-MATURITY-AMT
           MOVE WS-HOLDER-TRIM(1:10) TO OUT-NAME-PREFIX
           MOVE WS-READ-COUNT TO OUT-SEQ-NUM
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-WRITE-COUNT
           MOVE 0 TO WS-SPACE-COUNT
           MOVE 0 TO WS-NAME-LEN.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 IN-CUST-ID        PIC X(08).
           05 IN-HOLDER-NAME    PIC X(20).
           05 IN-PRINCIPAL      PIC 9(07)V99.
           05 IN-INT-RATE       PIC 9(02)V99.
           05 IN-TERM-MONTHS    PIC 9(03).
           05 FILLER REDEFINES IN-TERM-MONTHS PIC X(03).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-SEQ-NUM       PIC 9(04).
           05 OUT-CUST-ID       PIC X(08).
           05 OUT-HOLDER-NAME-UP PIC X(20).
           05 OUT-INITIALS      PIC X(02).
