GEN0112.name: GEN0112
GEN0112.technique: a REDEFINES record with two record types
GEN0112.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0112.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0112I.
       FD OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0112O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG               PIC X VALUE "N".
       01 WS-COUNT-READ             PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-COUNT-WRITTEN          PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
      *
      * Teller drawer balancing counters
      *
       01 WS-TOTALS.
           05 WS-TOTAL-EXPECTED      PIC 9(09)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-TOTAL-COUNTED       PIC 9(09)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-TOTAL-DIFF          PIC S9(09)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-WORK-FIELDS.
           05 WS-DIFFERENCE          PIC S9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-STATUS              PIC X(10) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-REC-TYPE-WK         PIC X VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-DETAIL-FIELDS.
           05 WS-DRAWER-OPEN         PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-DRAWER-EXPECTED     PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-DRAWER-COUNTED      PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-TELLER-ID-WK        PIC X(05) VALUE SPACES.
           05 WS-BRANCH-WK           PIC X(04) VALUE SPACES.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
                OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = "Y"
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM WRITE-TRAILER-REC
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       PROCESS-REC.
           ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT-READ
           MOVE REC-TYPE TO WS-REC-TYPE-WK
           EVALUATE WS-REC-TYPE-WK
               WHEN "D" PERFORM HANDLE-DETAIL
               WHEN "A" PERFORM HANDLE-ADJUSTMENT
               WHEN OTHER PERFORM HANDLE-DETAIL
           END-EVALUATE.
       HANDLE-DETAIL.
      *
      * Type D = normal drawer count record
      *
           MOVE TELLER-ID TO WS-TELLER-ID-WK
           MOVE TELLER-BRANCH TO WS-BRANCH-WK
           MOVE DRAWER-OPEN-AMT TO WS-DRAWER-OPEN
           MOVE DRAWER-EXPECTED TO WS-DRAWER-EXPECTED
           MOVE DRAWER-COUNTED TO WS-DRAWER-COUNTED
           COMPUTE WS-DIFFERENCE = WS-DRAWER-COUNTED
               - WS-DRAWER-EXPECTED
           PERFORM SET-STATUS
           ADD WS-DRAWER-EXPECTED TO WS-TOTAL-EXPECTED
           ADD WS-DRAWER-COUNTED TO WS-TOTAL-COUNTED
           ADD WS-DIFFERENCE TO WS-TOTAL-DIFF
           PERFORM WRITE-OUT-REC.
       HANDLE-ADJUSTMENT.
      *
      * Type A = adjustment record reusing same layout
      * For balancing we treat counted as expected + adjustment
      *
           MOVE TELLER-ID TO WS-TELLER-ID-WK
           MOVE TELLER-BRANCH TO WS-BRANCH-WK
           MOVE DRAWER-OPEN-AMT TO WS-DRAWER-OPEN
           MOVE DRAWER-EXPECTED TO WS-DRAWER-EXPECTED
           MOVE DRAWER-COUNTED TO WS-DRAWER-COUNTED
           COMPUTE WS-DIFFERENCE = WS-DRAWER-COUNTED
               - WS-DRAWER-EXPECTED
           PERFORM SET-STATUS
           ADD WS-DRAWER-EXPECTED TO WS-TOTAL-EXPECTED
           ADD WS-DRAWER-COUNTED TO WS-TOTAL-COUNTED
           ADD WS-DIFFERENCE TO WS-TOTAL-DIFF
           PERFORM WRITE-OUT-REC.
       SET-STATUS.
           IF WS-DIFFERENCE = 0
               MOVE "BALANCED  " TO WS-STATUS
           ELSE
               IF WS-DIFFERENCE > 0
                   MOVE "OVER      " TO WS-STATUS
               ELSE
                   MOVE "SHORT     " TO WS-STATUS
               END-IF
           END-IF.
       WRITE-OUT-REC.
           MOVE "D" TO OUT-REC-TYPE
           MOVE WS-TELLER-ID-WK TO OUT-TELLER-ID
           MOVE WS-BRANCH-WK TO OUT-BRANCH
           MOVE WS-DRAWER-OPEN TO OUT-OPEN-AMT
           MOVE WS-DRAWER-EXPECTED TO OUT-EXPECTED
           MOVE WS-DRAWER-COUNTED TO OUT-COUNTED
           MOVE WS-DIFFERENCE TO OUT-DIFFERENCE
           MOVE WS-STATUS TO OUT-STATUS
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-FILLER
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT-WRITTEN.
       WRITE-TRAILER-REC.
      *
      * Trailer summary record for verification
      *
           MOVE "T" TO OUT-REC-TYPE
           MOVE "SUMM1" TO OUT-TELLER-ID
           MOVE "ALL " TO OUT-BRANCH
           MOVE 0 TO OUT-OPEN-AMT
           MOVE WS-TOTAL-EXPECTED TO OUT-EXPECTED
           MOVE WS-TOTAL-COUNTED TO OUT-COUNTED
           MOVE WS-TOTAL-DIFF TO OUT-DIFFERENCE
           IF WS-TOTAL-DIFF = 0
               MOVE "BALANCED  " TO OUT-STATUS
           ELSE
               MOVE "REVIEW    " TO OUT-STATUS
           END-IF
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-FILLER
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT-WRITTEN.
       END PROGRAM GEN0112.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 REC-TYPE              PIC X.
           05 IN-COMMON              PIC X(12).
           05 IN-BODY                PIC X(36).
           05 FILLER REDEFINES IN-BODY.
              10 TELLER-BRANCH       PIC X(04).
              10 TELLER-ID           PIC X(05).
              10 DRAWER-OPEN-AMT     PIC 9(06)V99.
              10 DRAWER-EXPECTED     PIC 9(06)V99.
              10 DRAWER-COUNTED      PIC 9(06)V99.
              10 FILLER              PIC X(03).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-REC-TYPE           PIC X.
           05 OUT-TELLER-ID          PIC X(05).
           05 OUT-BRANCH             PIC X(04).
           05 OUT-OPEN-AMT           PIC 9(06)V99.
           05 OUT-EXPECTED           PIC 9(06)V99.
           05 OUT-COUNTED            PIC 9(06)V99.
           05 OUT-DIFFERENCE         PIC S9(06)V99.
           05 OUT-STATUS             PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-FILLER             PIC X(05).

GEN0114.name: GEN0114
GEN0114.technique: packed decimal (COMP-3) amounts and signed totals
GEN0114.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0114.
      *
      * MERCHANT SETTLEMENT BATCHING - FICTIONAL INSTITUTION
      * PACKED DECIMAL AMOUNTS AND SIGNED TOTALS
      *
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0114I.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0114O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG              PIC X(01) VALUE 'N'.
           88 WS-EOF                VALUE 'Y'.
           88 WS-NOT-EOF            VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-CURR-MERCHANT          PIC X(10) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-CURR-BATCH             PIC X(06) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-FIRST-REC              PIC X(01) VALUE 'Y'.
       01 WS-SIGNED-AMT             PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-SIGNED-FEE             PIC S9(05)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-NET-AMT                PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-BATCH-GROSS            PIC S9(09)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-BATCH-FEE              PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-BATCH-NET              PIC S9(09)V99 COMP-3 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-BATCH-COUNT            PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-DETAIL-COUNT           PIC 9(05) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM INIT-BATCH
           PERFORM READ-NEXT
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               PERFORM PROCESS-RECORD
               PERFORM READ-NEXT
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM FLUSH-BATCH
           CLOSE IN-FILE
           CLOSE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK.
       INIT-BATCH.
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-CURR-MERCHANT
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-CURR-BATCH
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BATCH-GROSS
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BATCH-FEE
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BATCH-NET
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BATCH-COUNT
           MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FIRST-REC.
       READ-NEXT.
           READ IN-FILE
               AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
               NOT AT END MOVE 'N' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
           END-READ.
       PROCESS-RECORD.
           IF WS-FIRST-REC = 'Y'
               MOVE IN-MERCHANT-ID TO WS-CURR-MERCHANT
               MOVE IN-BATCH-ID TO WS-CURR-BATCH
               MOVE 'N' TO WS-FIRST-REC
           END-IF
           IF IN-MERCHANT-ID NOT = WS-CURR-MERCHANT
               OR IN-BATCH-ID NOT = WS-CURR-BATCH
               PERFORM FLUSH-BATCH
               MOVE IN-MERCHANT-ID TO WS-CURR-MERCHANT
               MOVE IN-BATCH-ID TO WS-CURR-BATCH
           END-IF
           PERFORM CALC-AMOUNTS
           PERFORM WRITE-DETAIL
           ADD 1 TO WS-BATCH-COUNT
           ADD WS-SIGNED-AMT TO WS-BATCH-GROSS
           ADD WS-SIGNED-FEE TO WS-BATCH-FEE
           ADD WS-NET-AMT TO WS-BATCH-NET.
       CALC-AMOUNTS.
      * DETERMINE SIGNED GROSS AND FEE BY TRANS TYPE
           IF IN-TRANS-TYPE = 'R' OR IN-TRANS-TYPE = 'r'
               COMPUTE WS-SIGNED-AMT = IN-TRANS-AMOUNT * -1
               COMPUTE WS-SIGNED-FEE = IN-FEE-AMOUNT * -1
           ELSE
               MOVE IN-TRANS-AMOUNT TO WS-SIGNED-AMT
               MOVE IN-FEE-AMOUNT TO WS-SIGNED-FEE
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-NET-AMT = WS-SIGNED-AMT - WS-SIGNED-FEE.
       WRITE-DETAIL.
           MOVE WS-CURR-MERCHANT TO OUT-MERCHANT-ID
           MOVE WS-CURR-BATCH TO OUT-BATCH-ID
           MOVE 'D' TO OUT-RECORD-TYPE
           MOVE WS-SIGNED-AMT TO OUT-GROSS-AMT
           MOVE WS-SIGNED-FEE TO OUT-FEE-TOTAL
           MOVE WS-NET-AMT TO OUT-NET-AMT
           MOVE 1 TO OUT-REC-COUNT
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-FILLER
           WRITE OUT-SETTLEMENT-REC
           ADD 1 TO WS-DETAIL-COUNT.
       FLUSH-BATCH.
           IF WS-FIRST-REC = 'Y'
               EXIT PARAGRAPH
           END-IF
           IF WS-BATCH-COUNT = 0
               EXIT PARAGRAPH
           END-IF
           MOVE WS-CURR-MERCHANT TO OUT-MERCHANT-ID
           MOVE WS-CURR-BATCH TO OUT-BATCH-ID
           MOVE 'T' TO OUT-RECORD-TYPE
           MOVE WS-BATCH-GROSS TO OUT-GROSS-AMT
           MOVE WS-BATCH-FEE TO OUT-FEE-TOTAL
           MOVE WS-BATCH-NET TO OUT-NET-AMT
           MOVE WS-BATCH-COUNT TO OUT-REC-COUNT
           MOVE SPACES TO OUT-FILLER
           WRITE OUT-SETTLEMENT-REC
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BATCH-GROSS
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BATCH-FEE
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BATCH-NET
           MOVE 0 TO WS-BATCH-COUNT.
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-SETTLEMENT-REC.
           05 IN-MERCHANT-ID        PIC X(10).
           05 IN-BATCH-ID           PIC X(06).
           05 IN-TRANS-DATE         PIC X(08).
           05 IN-TRANS-TYPE         PIC X(01).
           05 IN-TRANS-AMOUNT       PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3.
           05 IN-FEE-AMOUNT         PIC S9(05)V99 COMP-3.
           05 IN-TRANS-REF          PIC X(12).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-SETTLEMENT-REC.
           05 OUT-MERCHANT-ID       PIC X(10).
           05 OUT-BATCH-ID          PIC X(06).
           05 OUT-RECORD-TYPE       PIC X(01).
           05 OUT-GROSS-AMT         PIC S9(09)V99 COMP-3.
           05 OUT-FEE-TOTAL          PIC S9(07)V99 COMP-3.
           05 OUT-NET-AMT           PIC S9(09)V99 COMP-3.
           05 OUT-REC-COUNT          PIC 9(05).
           05 OUT-FILLER            PIC X(10).

GEN0115.name: GEN0115
GEN0115.technique: a control break with subtotals and a final trailer record
GEN0115.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0115.
      *
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
      *
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD INFILE.
       COPY GEN0115I.
       FD OUTFILE.
       COPY GEN0115O.
      *
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG           PIC X VALUE "N".
          88 WS-EOF             VALUE "Y".
          88 WS-NOT-EOF          VALUE "N".
       01 WS-PREV-BRANCH        PIC X(4) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-FIRST-REC          PIC X VALUE "Y".
          88 IS-FIRST           VALUE "Y".
       01 WS-SUBTOTAL-GROSS     PIC 9(9)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-SUBTOTAL-NET       PIC 9(9)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-SUBTOTAL-COUNT     PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-GRAND-GROSS        PIC 9(11)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-GRAND-NET          PIC 9(11)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-GRAND-COUNT        PIC 9(7) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-CUR-NET            PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
      *
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM READ-FIRST
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               PERFORM CHECK-BREAK
               PERFORM PROCESS-DETAIL
               PERFORM READ-NEXT
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM WRITE-SUBTOTAL
           PERFORM WRITE-TRAILER
           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE
           GOBACK
           .
       READ-FIRST.
           READ INFILE
               AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
               NOT AT END CONTINUE
           END-READ
           .
       READ-NEXT.
           READ INFILE
               AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
               NOT AT END CONTINUE
           END-READ
           .
       CHECK-BREAK.
           IF IS-FIRST
               MOVE IN-BRANCH-ID TO WS-PREV-BRANCH
               MOVE "N" TO WS-FIRST-REC
           ELSE
               IF IN-BRANCH-ID NOT = WS-PREV-BRANCH
                   PERFORM WRITE-SUBTOTAL
                   MOVE IN-BRANCH-ID TO WS-PREV-BRANCH
               END-IF
           END-IF
           .
       PROCESS-DETAIL.
           COMPUTE WS-CUR-NET = IN-GROSS-PREMIUM - IN-FEE-AMOUNT
           IF WS-CUR-NET < 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-CUR-NET
           END-IF
           MOVE IN-BRANCH-ID TO OUT-BRANCH-ID
           MOVE IN-POLICY-NO TO OUT-POLICY-NO
           MOVE "D" TO OUT-RECORD-TYPE
           MOVE WS-CUR-NET TO OUT-NET-PREMIUM
           MOVE IN-HOLDER-NAME TO OUT-DESCRIPTION
           MOVE WS-CUR-NET TO OUT-TOTAL-AMOUNT
           WRITE OUT-REC
           ADD IN-GROSS-PREMIUM TO WS-SUBTOTAL-GROSS
           ADD WS-CUR-NET TO WS-SUBTOTAL-NET
           ADD 1 TO WS-SUBTOTAL-COUNT
           ADD IN-GROSS-PREMIUM TO WS-GRAND-GROSS
           ADD WS-CUR-NET TO WS-GRAND-NET
           ADD 1 TO WS-GRAND-COUNT
           .
       WRITE-SUBTOTAL.
           IF WS-SUBTOTAL-COUNT > 0
               MOVE WS-PREV-BRANCH TO OUT-BRANCH-ID
               MOVE SPACES TO OUT-POLICY-NO
               MOVE "S" TO OUT-RECORD-TYPE
               MOVE WS-SUBTOTAL-NET TO OUT-NET-PREMIUM
               MOVE WS-SUBTOTAL-GROSS TO OUT-TOTAL-AMOUNT
               MOVE "** SUBTOTAL **" TO OUT-DESCRIPTION
               WRITE OUT-REC
           END-IF
           MOVE 0 TO WS-SUBTOTAL-GROSS
           MOVE 0 TO WS-SUBTOTAL-NET
           MOVE 0 TO WS-SUBTOTAL-COUNT
           .
       WRITE-TRAILER.
           MOVE "9999" TO OUT-BRANCH-ID
           MOVE "TRAILER " TO OUT-POLICY-NO
           MOVE "T" TO OUT-RECORD-TYPE
           MOVE WS-GRAND-NET TO OUT-NET-PREMIUM
           MOVE WS-GRAND-GROSS TO OUT-TOTAL-AMOUNT
           MOVE "** FINAL TOTAL **" TO OUT-DESCRIPTION
           WRITE OUT-REC
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-REC.
           05 IN-BRANCH-ID       PIC X(4).
           05 IN-POLICY-NO       PIC X(8).
           05 IN-HOLDER-NAME     PIC X(20).
           05 IN-GROSS-PREMIUM   PIC 9(7)V99.
           05 IN-FEE-AMOUNT      PIC 9(5)V99.
           05 FILLER REDEFINES IN-FEE-AMOUNT PIC X(7).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-REC.
           05 OUT-BRANCH-ID      PIC X(4).
           05 OUT-POLICY-NO      PIC X(8).
           05 OUT-RECORD-TYPE    PIC X(1).
           05 OUT-NET-PREMIUM    PIC 9(7)V99.
           05 OUT-TOTAL-AMOUNT   PIC 9(9)V99.
           05 OUT-DESCRIPTION    PIC X(20).
           05 FILLER REDEFINES OUT-DESCRIPTION PIC X(20).

GEN0118.name: GEN0118
GEN0118.technique: SIGN LEADING SEPARATE amounts and DIVIDE ... REMAINDER
GEN0118.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0118.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD INFILE.
       COPY GEN0118I.
       FD OUTFILE.
       COPY GEN0118O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG              PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
       01 WS-FEE-WORK              PIC S9(05)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE
                                   VALUE +0.
       01 WS-TOTAL-WORK            PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE
                                   VALUE +0.
       01 WS-TIER                  PIC 9(01) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-DIVISOR               PIC 9(04) VALUE 100.
       01 WS-QUOTIENT              PIC 9(07) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-REMAINDER             PIC 9(04) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-AMT-INT               PIC S9(07) VALUE +0.
       01 WS-REMAIN-FLAG           PIC 9(01) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = "Y"
               READ INFILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE INFILE
           CLOSE OUTFILE
           GOBACK
           .
       PROCESS-REC.
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN TRF-AMOUNT < 1000
                   MOVE 15 TO WS-FEE-WORK
                   MOVE 1 TO WS-TIER
               WHEN TRF-AMOUNT < 10000
                   MOVE 25 TO WS-FEE-WORK
                   MOVE 2 TO WS-TIER
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 35 TO WS-FEE-WORK
                   MOVE 3 TO WS-TIER
           END-EVALUATE
           IF TRF-PRIORITY = "H"
               ADD 10 TO WS-FEE-WORK
           END-IF
           MOVE TRF-AMOUNT TO WS-AMT-INT
           DIVIDE WS-AMT-INT BY WS-DIVISOR GIVING WS-QUOTIENT
               REMAINDER WS-REMAINDER
           END-DIVIDE
           IF WS-REMAINDER = 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-REMAIN-FLAG
           ELSE
               MOVE 1 TO WS-REMAIN-FLAG
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-WORK = TRF-AMOUNT + WS-FEE-WORK
           MOVE TRF-ID TO OUT-TRF-ID
           MOVE TRF-AMOUNT TO OUT-TRF-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-FEE-WORK TO OUT-FEE-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-TOTAL-WORK TO OUT-TOTAL-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-TIER TO OUT-FEE-TIER
           MOVE WS-REMAIN-FLAG TO OUT-REMAINDER-FLAG
           WRITE GEN0118O-RECORD
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 GEN0118I-RECORD.
           05 TRF-ID               PIC X(08).
           05 TRF-AMOUNT            PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 TRF-DEST-CODE         PIC X(03).
           05 TRF-PRIORITY          PIC X(01).
           05 TRF-ACCOUNT-NUM       PIC 9(08).
           05 TRF-FEE-CODE          PIC 9(02).
           05 FILLER REDEFINES TRF-FEE-CODE PIC X(02).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 GEN0118O-RECORD.
           05 OUT-TRF-ID            PIC X(08).
           05 OUT-TRF-AMOUNT        PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 OUT-FEE-AMOUNT        PIC S9(05)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 OUT-TOTAL-AMOUNT      PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE.
           05 OUT-FEE-TIER          PIC 9(01).
           05 OUT-REMAINDER-FLAG    PIC 9(01).
           05 FILLER REDEFINES OUT-REMAINDER-FLAG PIC X(01).

You are Diocle's COBOL-to-Java translator for a bank modernization project.
Translate the COBOL batch program into ONE self-contained Java 21 source file (JDK only, no libraries)
whose output is byte-identical to the original compiled with GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm).

I/O contract:
- The public class with main() must be named Gen0118, in the default package.
- Input file paths come from environment variables DD_INFILE; write the outputs to DD_OUTFILE.
- ORGANIZATION LINE SEQUENTIAL files are text, one record per line. ORGANIZATION SEQUENTIAL files are fixed-length
  byte records with no separators: read and write them as bytes (ISO-8859-1), record length from the copybook.
- IBM Enterprise COBOL defaults apply: TRUNC(STD), so a value stored in a binary (COMP) field keeps only its PIC digits;
  DISPLAY of a binary field shows its PIC digits (PIC 9(7) COMP displays 7 digits).
- Storage exactly as GnuCOBOL (-std=ibm) writes it: COMP-3 packed decimal with sign nibble C/D (F if unsigned);
  COMP/COMP-4/BINARY big-endian two's complement (2, 4 or 8 bytes by digits); COMP-5 little-endian; signed DISPLAY
  without SIGN SEPARATE carries the sign in the last digit, negative digit d written as the character d + 0x40;
  PIC 9(n)P(m) stores n digits worth value x 10^m.
- When environment variable DIOCLE_COLLATION is EBCDIC, alphanumeric comparisons (<, >) and SORT keys follow mainframe
  EBCDIC order (lowercase < uppercase < digits): compare the Cp037 bytes, not Java's String order.
- Reproduce every DISPLAY to stdout exactly, and exit with the program's RETURN-CODE (System.exit) when it is not 0.
- "Now" (ACCEPT FROM DATE/TIME/DAY, FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE) comes from environment variable DIOCLE_CLOCK when it is
  set (ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. 2000-02-29T13:45:10.00Z), otherwise from the system clock in UTC.

Fidelity rules:
- Preserve COBOL arithmetic semantics exactly: rounding, truncation, overflow, signs, and numeric display formats.
- Use java.math.BigDecimal for all decimal arithmetic. Never use float or double.
- One private method per COBOL paragraph, named after it in camelCase, called in the same order.
- Readable, idiomatic Java; no special-casing of particular input values.
- Name environment variables literally (System.getenv("DD_..."), DIOCLE_CLOCK, DIOCLE_COLLATION). No network,
  processes, reflection, native code or other files: a guard refuses to run such Java.

=== GEN0118.cbl ===
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0118.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD INFILE.
       COPY GEN0118I.
       FD OUTFILE.
       COPY GEN0118O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG              PIC X(01) VALUE "N".
       01 WS-FEE-WORK              PIC S9(05)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE
                                   VALUE +0.
       01 WS-TOTAL-WORK            PIC S9(07)V99 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE
                                   VALUE +0.
       01 WS-TIER                  PIC 9(01) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-DIVISOR               PIC 9(04) VALUE 100.
       01 WS-QUOTIENT              PIC 9(07) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-REMAINDER             PIC 9(04) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-AMT-INT               PIC S9(07) VALUE +0.
       01 WS-REMAIN-FLAG           PIC 9(01) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = "Y"
               READ INFILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE INFILE
           CLOSE OUTFILE
           GOBACK
           .
       PROCESS-REC.
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN TRF-AMOUNT < 1000
                   MOVE 15 TO WS-FEE-WORK
                   MOVE 1 TO WS-TIER
               WHEN TRF-AMOUNT < 10000
                   MOVE 25 TO WS-FEE-WORK
                   MOVE 2 TO WS-TIER
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 35 TO WS-FEE-WORK
                   MOVE 3 TO WS-TIER
           END-EVALUATE
           IF TRF-PRIORITY = "H"
               ADD 10 TO WS-FEE-WORK
           END-IF
           MOVE TRF-AMOUNT TO WS-AMT-INT
           DIVIDE WS-AMT-INT BY WS-DIVISOR GIVING WS-QUOTIENT
               REMAINDER WS-REMAINDER
           END-DIVIDE
           IF WS-REMAINDER = 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-REMAIN-FLAG
           ELSE
               MOVE 1 TO WS-REMAIN-FLAG
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-WORK = TRF-AMOUNT + WS-FEE-WORK
           MOVE TRF-ID TO OUT-TRF-ID
           MOVE TRF-AMOUNT TO OUT-TRF-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-FEE-WORK TO OUT-FEE-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-TOTAL-WORK TO OUT-TOTAL-AMOUNT
           MOVE WS-TIER TO OUT-FEE-TIER
           MOVE WS-REMAIN-FLAG TO OUT-REMAINDER-FLAG
           WRITE GEN0118O-RECORD
           .

GEN0117.name: GEN0117
GEN0117.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0117.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  INFILE.
       COPY GEN0117I.
       FD  OUTFILE.
       COPY GEN0117O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-FLAGS.
           05 WS-EOF-FLAG      PIC X(01) VALUE 'N'.
               88 WS-EOF       VALUE 'Y'.
               88 WS-NOT-EOF   VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-CALC.
           05 WS-RATE          PIC 9(04)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-INS-FEE       PIC 9(04)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-TOTAL         PIC 9(06)V99 VALUE 0.
           05 WS-STAT          PIC X(10) VALUE SPACES.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           OPEN INPUT INFILE
           OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF
               READ INFILE
                   AT END SET WS-EOF TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-ONE
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE
           GOBACK
           .
       PROCESS-ONE.
           MOVE 0 TO WS-RATE WS-INS-FEE WS-TOTAL
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-STAT
      * Determine monthly rate using 88-levels
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN BOX-SMALL
                   MOVE IN-BASE-FEE TO WS-RATE
                   MOVE 'STANDARD  ' TO WS-STAT
               WHEN BOX-MEDIUM
                   COMPUTE WS-RATE = IN-BASE-FEE * 1.50
                   MOVE 'STANDARD  ' TO WS-STAT
               WHEN BOX-LARGE
                   COMPUTE WS-RATE = IN-BASE-FEE * 2.00
                   MOVE 'PREMIUM   ' TO WS-STAT
               WHEN BOX-XLARGE
                   COMPUTE WS-RATE = IN-BASE-FEE * 3.00
                   MOVE 'PREMIUM   ' TO WS-STAT
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE IN-BASE-FEE TO WS-RATE
                   MOVE 'REVIEW    ' TO WS-STAT
           END-EVALUATE
      * Determine insurance fee using 88-levels
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN INS-YES
                   COMPUTE WS-INS-FEE = 12.50
                   IF BOX-LARGE OR BOX-XLARGE
                       COMPUTE WS-INS-FEE = WS-INS-FEE + 7.50
                   END-IF
               WHEN INS-NO
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-INS-FEE
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-INS-FEE
                   MOVE 'REVIEW    ' TO WS-STAT
           END-EVALUATE
      * Adjust for rental duration tier
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN IN-MONTHS = 0
                   MOVE 'ERROR     ' TO WS-STAT
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-TOTAL
               WHEN IN-MONTHS >= 12
                   COMPUTE WS-TOTAL = (WS-RATE + WS-INS-FEE)
                    * IN-MONTHS * 0.90
                   IF WS-STAT NOT = 'REVIEW    '
                    AND WS-STAT NOT = 'ERROR     '
                       MOVE 'DISCOUNT  ' TO WS-STAT
                   END-IF
               WHEN IN-MONTHS >= 6
                   COMPUTE WS-TOTAL = (WS-RATE + WS-INS-FEE)
                    * IN-MONTHS * 0.95
                   IF WS-STAT = 'STANDARD  '
                       MOVE 'SAVER     ' TO WS-STAT
                   END-IF
               WHEN OTHER
                   COMPUTE WS-TOTAL = (WS-RATE + WS-INS-FEE)
                    * IN-MONTHS
           END-EVALUATE
           MOVE IN-CUST-ID TO OUT-CUST-ID
           MOVE IN-BRANCH-CD TO OUT-BRANCH-CD
           MOVE IN-BOX-SIZE TO OUT-BOX-SIZE
           MOVE IN-MONTHS TO OUT-MONTHS
           MOVE WS-RATE TO OUT-MONTHLY-RATE
           MOVE WS-INS-FEE TO OUT-INS-FEE
           MOVE WS-TOTAL TO OUT-TOTAL-DUE
           MOVE WS-STAT TO OUT-BILL-STAT
           WRITE OUT-SAFE-REC
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 IN-SAFE-REC.
           05 IN-CUST-ID       PIC X(08).
           05 IN-BOX-SIZE      PIC X(01).
               88 BOX-SMALL    VALUE 'S'.
               88 BOX-MEDIUM   VALUE 'M'.
               88 BOX-LARGE    VALUE 'L'.
               88 BOX-XLARGE   VALUE 'X'.
           05 IN-MONTHS        PIC 9(02).
           05 IN-BASE-FEE      PIC 9(04)V99.
           05 IN-INS-OPT       PIC X(01).
               88 INS-YES      VALUE 'Y'.
               88 INS-NO       VALUE 'N'.
           05 IN-BRANCH-CD    PIC X(03).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 OUT-SAFE-REC.
           05 OUT-CUST-ID      PIC X(08).
           05 OUT-BRANCH-CD    PIC X(03).
           05 OUT-BOX-SIZE     PIC X(01).
           05 OUT-MONTHS       PIC 9(02).
           05 OUT-MONTHLY-RATE PIC 9(04)V99.
           05 OUT-INS-FEE      PIC 9(04)V99.
           05 OUT-TOTAL-DUE    PIC 9(06)V99.
           05 OUT-BILL-STAT    PIC X(10).

GEN0119.name: GEN0119
GEN0119.technique: INSPECT and reference modification on a text field
GEN0119.source:
* SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GEN0119.
      * ATM withdrawal limit checks
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO INFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO OUTFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD IN-FILE.
           COPY GEN0119I.
       FD OUT-FILE.
           COPY GEN0119O.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG PIC X VALUE "N".
       01 WS-REMAINING PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-APPROVED PIC 9(05)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 WS-NOTE-COUNT PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-STATUS-TEXT PIC X(08) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-MSG-BUF PIC X(30) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-NOTES-WORK PIC X(20) VALUE SPACES.
       01 WS-DISP-AMT PIC ZZ,ZZ9.99 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE OUTPUT OUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = "Y"
               READ IN-FILE
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF-FLAG
                   NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-REC
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE
           GOBACK
           STOP RUN
           .
       PROCESS-REC.
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-STATUS-TEXT
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-MSG-BUF
           MOVE 0 TO WS-REMAINING WS-APPROVED
           MOVE ATX-NOTES TO WS-NOTES-WORK
           INSPECT WS-NOTES-WORK TALLYING WS-NOTE-COUNT
               FOR ALL "*"
           INSPECT WS-NOTES-WORK REPLACING ALL "*" BY " "
           COMPUTE WS-REMAINING = ATX-DAILY-LIMIT
               - ATX-DAILY-TOTAL
           IF WS-REMAINING < 0
               MOVE 0 TO WS-REMAINING
           END-IF
           IF ATX-REQ-AMT <= 0
               MOVE "DENIED  " TO WS-STATUS-TEXT
               MOVE "INVALID AMOUNT REQUEST" TO WS-MSG-BUF
               MOVE 0 TO WS-APPROVED
           ELSE
               IF ATX-REQ-AMT > WS-REMAINING
                   MOVE "DENIED  " TO WS-STATUS-TEXT
                   MOVE "DAILY LIMIT EXCEEDED" TO WS-MSG-BUF
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-APPROVED
                   MOVE WS-MSG-BUF(1:12) TO WS-MSG-BUF(1:12)
               ELSE
                   MOVE "APPROVED" TO WS-STATUS-TEXT
                   MOVE ATX-REQ-AMT TO WS-APPROVED
                   STRING "APPROVED " DELIMITED BY SIZE
                       WS-NOTES-WORK DELIMITED BY SIZE
                       INTO WS-MSG-BUF
                   END-STRING
                   IF WS-NOTE-COUNT > 0
                       MOVE "*" TO WS-MSG-BUF(30:1)
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF
           MOVE ATX-CARD-NUM TO ATO-CARD-NUM
           MOVE ATX-ATM-ID TO ATO-ATM-ID
           MOVE ATX-REQ-AMT TO ATO-REQ-AMT
           MOVE WS-APPROVED TO ATO-APPROVED-AMT
           MOVE WS-STATUS-TEXT TO ATO-STATUS
           MOVE WS-MSG-BUF TO ATO-MESSAGE
           INSPECT ATO-MESSAGE REPLACING ALL " " BY "_"
           MOVE ATO-MESSAGE(1:20) TO ATO-MESSAGE(1:20)
           MOVE ATO-MESSAGE(21:10) TO ATO-MESSAGE(21:10)
           WRITE ATM-RESPONSE-REC
           .
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 ATM-REQUEST-REC.
           05 ATX-CARD-NUM PIC X(16).
           05 ATX-ATM-ID PIC X(06).
           05 ATX-REQ-AMT PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 ATX-DAILY-TOTAL PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 ATX-DAILY-LIMIT PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 ATX-NOTES PIC X(20).
      * SYNTHETIC. Fictional.
       01 ATM-RESPONSE-REC.
           05 ATO-CARD-NUM PIC X(16).
           05 ATO-ATM-ID PIC X(06).
           05 ATO-REQ-AMT PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 ATO-APPROVED-AMT PIC 9(05)V99.
           05 ATO-STATUS PIC X(08).
           05 ATO-MESSAGE PIC X(30).
